  Lax369799.Algebras.UnfoldInvariant E →
    ∀ [Finite (B 1)] (η : Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankedMap A B) {m n : Nat}
      (C : Lax369799.Flattening.SetContext A m 0),
      C.system.Deterministic →
        ∀ (S : Lax369799.RankedSystems.System A m) (σ : Fin m → Fin n),
          Exists fun m' =>
            Exists fun τ =>
              Exists fun sectionMap =>
                And (∀ (j : Fin m'), Eq (τ (sectionMap j)) j)
                  (And (∀ (i : Fin m), Eq (σ (sectionMap (τ i))) (σ i))
                    (And
                      (∀ (j : Fin n),
                        instLENat.le (Nat.card (Subtype fun i => Eq (σ (sectionMap i)) j))
                          (instHAdd.hAdd (Nat.card (B 1)) 1))
                      (Exists fun U =>
                        Exists fun V =>
                          And (Eq U.val (Lax369799.Flattening.plug C S.val))
                            (And
                              (Eq V.val
                                (Lax369799.Flattening.plug C
                                  (Lax369799.Renaming.renameSystem (Function.comp sectionMap τ) S).val))
                              (Eq (E.eval 0 (Lax369799.RankedSystems.relabelSystem η U))
                                (E.eval 0 (Lax369799.RankedSystems.relabelSystem η V)))))))

concepts.title: Unary normal form of deterministic elements
concepts.description:
In a set-algebra, every deterministic element of positive rank is a
parallel family of unary values, one at each variable. This is the
characterization in the earlier draft. The set-algebra hypothesis includes
continuity; it is not implicit in an arbitrary substitution algebra.
DirectionProjections proves the revised canonical decomposition for
extremal elements without that continuity hypothesis.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.AutomatonProperty
import Lax369799.UnarySystems

/-!
---
title: Unary normal form of deterministic elements
type: theorem
---
In a set-algebra, every deterministic element of positive rank is a
parallel family of unary values, one at each variable. This is the
characterization in the earlier draft. The set-algebra hypothesis includes
continuity; it is not implicit in an arbitrary substitution algebra.
DirectionProjections proves the revised canonical decomposition for
extremal elements without that continuity hypothesis.
-/
namespace Lax369799.DeterministicElements
open RankedSystems SetAlgebras AutomatonProperty

/-- Retain a chosen variable and rename it to the sole output variable. -/
def projection {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} (S : SetSystem A n) (i : Fin n) : SetSystem A 1 where
  size := S.size
  graph := {
    label := S.graph.label
    initial := S.graph.initial
    root := S.graph.root
    edge := fun v d t => S.graph.edge v d (Sum.map id (fun _ => i) t)
    direction_valid := fun v d _t h => S.graph.direction_valid v d _ h }
  reachable := S.reachable

/-- The disjoint unary letters b_i, with each sole edge going to x_i. -/
def parallel {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} (b : Fin n → A 1) : SetSystem A n where
  size := n
  graph := {
    label := fun v => ⟨1, b v⟩
    initial := Set.univ
    root := ∅
    edge := fun v d t => d = 0 ∧ t = .inr v
    direction_valid := by rintro v d t ⟨rfl, _⟩; exact Nat.zero_lt_one }
  reachable := fun v => ⟨v, Or.inl trivial, .refl⟩

axiom unary_normal_form {A : RankedSet} (E : SetAlgebra A) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    (a : A n) : Deterministic E a ↔ ∃ b : Fin n → A 1, E.eval n (parallel b) = a

end Lax369799.DeterministicElements

statements.signature:
unary_normal_form : ∀ {A : Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankedSet} (E : Lax369799.SetAlgebras.SetAlgebra A) {n : Nat},
  instLTNat.lt 0 n →
    ∀ (a : A n),
      Iff (Lax369799.AutomatonProperty.Deterministic E a)
        (Exists fun b => Eq (E.eval n (Lax369799.DeterministicElements.parallel b)) a)

concepts.title: Deterministic normal forms with identity continuations
concepts.description:
A closed deterministic context is represented by its hole value and the
optional values of its unary continuations. A missing continuation copies
the hole behavior. Vertex zero is the distinguished hole copy; the next
vertex is the entry continuation; the remaining vertices correspond to
hole directions. Every nonempty unary continuation returns to vertex zero.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.DeterministicPieces
import Lax369799.SystemEvaluation

/-!
---
title: Deterministic normal forms with identity continuations
type: theorem
---
A closed deterministic context is represented by its hole value and the
optional values of its unary continuations. A missing continuation copies
the hole behavior. Vertex zero is the distinguished hole copy; the next
vertex is the entry continuation; the remaining vertices correspond to
hole directions. Every nonempty unary continuation returns to vertex zero.
-/
namespace Lax369799.DeterministicNormalForms
open RankedSystems Flattening Algebras DeterministicPieces

/-- Missing unary pieces are copies of the distinguished vertex. -/
def label {A : RankedSet} {k : ℕ} (a : A k) (P : Fin (k + 1) → Option (A 1)) :
    Fin (k + 2) → Symbol A :=
  Fin.cases ⟨k, a⟩ (fun i => match P i with
    | none => ⟨k, a⟩
    | some b => ⟨1, b⟩)

def holeNext (k d : ℕ) : Fin (k + 2) :=
  if h : d < k then ⟨d + 2, Nat.add_lt_add_right h 2⟩ else 0

def next {A : RankedSet} {k : ℕ} (_a : A k) (P : Fin (k + 1) → Option (A 1))
    (v : Fin (k + 2)) (d : ℕ) : Fin (k + 2) :=
  Fin.cases (holeNext k d) (fun i => (P i).elim (holeNext k d) (fun _ => 0)) v

def graph {A : RankedSet} {k : ℕ} (a : A k) (P : Fin (k + 1) → Option (A 1)) :
    Presentation A 0 (Fin (k + 2)) where
  label := label a P
  initial := {1}
  root := ∅
  edge := fun v d t => ∃ _hd : d < (label a P v).1, t = .inl (next a P v d)
  direction_valid := fun _ _ _ h => h.choose


axiom pattern_exists {A : RankedSet} {k : ℕ} (a : A k)
    (P : Fin (k + 1) → Option (A 1)) :
    ∃ T : System A 0, T.val = trim (graph a P)

axiom normal_form {A : RankedSet} (E : Algebra A) (hE : UnfoldInvariant E)
    {k : ℕ} (C : SetContext A k 0) (hC : C.system.Deterministic) (S : System A k) :
    ∃ U V : System A 0,
      U.val = plug C S.val ∧
      V.val = trim (graph (E.eval k S) (fun i => (continuation C i).map (E.eval 1))) ∧
      E.eval 0 U = E.eval 0 V

end Lax369799.DeterministicNormalForms

concepts.title: Unary continuations of deterministic contexts
concepts.description:
In a closed deterministic context, an outgoing direction of the hole
leads either straight back to the hole or into a deterministic unary
piece. In the former case the corresponding cut piece is empty; the
continuation is the identity and is retained by the boundary loop flag.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.AlgebraicDecomposition
import Lax369799.VariableCompression

/-!
---
title: Unary continuations of deterministic contexts
type: theorem
---
In a closed deterministic context, an outgoing direction of the hole
leads either straight back to the hole or into a deterministic unary
piece. In the former case the corresponding cut piece is empty; the
continuation is the identity and is retained by the boundary loop flag.
-/
namespace Lax369799.DeterministicPieces
open RankedSystems Flattening ContextDecomposition AlgebraicDecomposition

axiom direction_piece {A : RankedSet} {k : ℕ} (C : SetContext A k 0)
    (hC : C.system.Deterministic) (i : Fin k) :
    (i ∈ (boundary C).loops ∧ (trim (ordinaryPiece C i.succ)).size = 0) ∨
    (i ∉ (boundary C).loops ∧ (trim (ordinaryPiece C i.succ)).Deterministic)

axiom entry_piece {A : RankedSet} {k : ℕ} (C : SetContext A k 0)
    (hC : C.system.Deterministic) :
    ((boundary C).initial ∧ (trim (ordinaryPiece C 0)).size = 0) ∨
    (¬ (boundary C).initial ∧ (trim (ordinaryPiece C 0)).Deterministic)

/-- `none` is the identity continuation, represented by a direct boundary connection. -/
noncomputable def continuation {A : RankedSet} {k : ℕ} (C : SetContext A k 0)
    (i : Fin (k + 1)) : Option (System A 1) := by
  classical
  exact if h : (trim (ordinaryPiece C i)).Deterministic then
    some ⟨trim (ordinaryPiece C i), h⟩ else none

axiom continuation_boundary {A : RankedSet} {k : ℕ} (C : SetContext A k 0)
    (hC : C.system.Deterministic) :
    (continuation C 0 = none ↔ (boundary C).initial) ∧
    ∀ i : Fin k, continuation C i.succ = none ↔ i ∈ (boundary C).loops

axiom compress_continuations {A : RankedSet} {V : Type} [Finite V] {m n : ℕ}
    (C : SetContext A m 0) (hC : C.system.Deterministic)
    (σ : Fin m → Fin n) (ρ : System A 1 → V) :
    ∃ (m' : ℕ) (τ : Fin m → Fin m') (sectionMap : Fin m' → Fin m),
      (∀ j, τ (sectionMap j) = j) ∧
      (∀ i, σ (sectionMap (τ i)) = σ i) ∧
      (∀ i, (continuation C (sectionMap (τ i)).succ).map ρ =
        (continuation C i.succ).map ρ) ∧
      (∀ i, sectionMap (τ i) ∈ (boundary C).loops ↔ i ∈ (boundary C).loops) ∧
      (∀ j, Nat.card {i // σ (sectionMap i) = j} ≤ Nat.card V + 1)

end Lax369799.DeterministicPieces

  C.system.Deterministic →
    ∀ (σ : Fin m → Fin n) (ρ : Lax369799.RankedSystems.System A 1 → V),
      Exists fun m' =>
        Exists fun τ =>
          Exists fun sectionMap =>
            And (∀ (j : Fin m'), Eq (τ (sectionMap j)) j)
              (And (∀ (i : Fin m), Eq (σ (sectionMap (τ i))) (σ i))
                (And
                  (∀ (i : Fin m),
                    Eq (Option.map ρ (Lax369799.DeterministicPieces.continuation C (sectionMap (τ i)).succ))
                      (Option.map ρ (Lax369799.DeterministicPieces.continuation C i.succ)))
                  (And
                    (∀ (i : Fin m),
                      Iff (Set.instMembership.mem (Lax369799.ContextDecomposition.boundary C).loops (sectionMap (τ i)))
                        (Set.instMembership.mem (Lax369799.ContextDecomposition.boundary C).loops i))
                    (∀ (j : Fin n),
                      instLENat.le (Nat.card (Subtype fun i => Eq (σ (sectionMap i)) j))
                        (instHAdd.hAdd (Nat.card V) 1)))))

  C.system.Deterministic →
    And
      (Iff (Eq (Lax369799.DeterministicPieces.continuation C 0) Option.none)
        (Lax369799.ContextDecomposition.boundary C).initial)
      (∀ (i : Fin k),
        Iff (Eq (Lax369799.DeterministicPieces.continuation C i.succ) Option.none)
          (Set.instMembership.mem (Lax369799.ContextDecomposition.boundary C).loops i))

direction_piece : ∀ {A : Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankedSet} {k : Nat} (C : Lax369799.Flattening.SetContext A k 0),
  C.system.Deterministic →
    ∀ (i : Fin k),
      Or
        (And (Set.instMembership.mem (Lax369799.ContextDecomposition.boundary C).loops i)
          (Eq (Lax369799.RankedSystems.trim (Lax369799.AlgebraicDecomposition.ordinaryPiece C i.succ)).size 0))
        (And (Not (Set.instMembership.mem (Lax369799.ContextDecomposition.boundary C).loops i))
          (Lax369799.RankedSystems.trim (Lax369799.AlgebraicDecomposition.ordinaryPiece C i.succ)).Deterministic)

entry_piece : ∀ {A : Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankedSet} {k : Nat} (C : Lax369799.Flattening.SetContext A k 0),
  C.system.Deterministic →
    Or
      (And (Lax369799.ContextDecomposition.boundary C).initial
        (Eq (Lax369799.RankedSystems.trim (Lax369799.AlgebraicDecomposition.ordinaryPiece C 0)).size 0))
      (And (Not (Lax369799.ContextDecomposition.boundary C).initial)
        (Lax369799.RankedSystems.trim (Lax369799.AlgebraicDecomposition.ordinaryPiece C 0)).Deterministic)

concepts.title: Contextual equivalence of deterministic systems
concepts.description:
Two systems are equivalent when every closed deterministic context gives
the same language-membership test. Recognition by a rankwise-finite algebra
makes this quotient rankwise finite, without requiring the recognizing
algebra itself to be unfolding-invariant. For an unfolding-invariant
language, equivalent unfoldings have the same contextual class.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.ContextRelabelling

/-!
---
title: Contextual equivalence of deterministic systems
type: theorem
---
Two systems are equivalent when every closed deterministic context gives
the same language-membership test. Recognition by a rankwise-finite algebra
makes this quotient rankwise finite, without requiring the recognizing
algebra itself to be unfolding-invariant. For an unfolding-invariant
language, equivalent unfoldings have the same contextual class.
-/
namespace Lax369799.DeterministicSyntacticOrder
open RankedSystems Flattening Algebras Morphisms

def Test {A : RankedSet} (L : Language A) {n : ℕ} (C : Context A n 0) (S : System A n) : Prop :=
  ∃ U : System A 0, U.val = plug C.val S.val ∧ U ∈ L

def Equivalent {A : RankedSet} (L : Language A) {n : ℕ} (S T : System A n) : Prop :=
  ∀ C : Context A n 0, Test L C S ↔ Test L C T

abbrev Carrier {A : RankedSet} (L : Language A) : RankedSet := fun n => Quot (@Equivalent A L n)

axiom value_refines {A B : RankedSet} (E : Algebra B) (η : RankedMap A B)
    (F : Set (B 0)) (L : Language A) (hL : Recognizes E η F L)
    {n : ℕ} (S T : System A n)
    (h : E.eval n (relabelSystem η S) = E.eval n (relabelSystem η T)) : Equivalent L S T

axiom unfold_refines {A : RankedSet} (L : Language A) (hL : UnfoldInvariantLanguage L)
    {n : ℕ} (S T : System A n) (h : UnfoldEquivalent S.val T.val) : Equivalent L S T

def AcceptingClass {A : RankedSet} (L : Language A) (a : Carrier L 0) : Prop :=
  ∃ S : System A 0, Quot.mk _ S = a ∧ S ∈ L

axiom closed_membership {A : RankedSet} (L : Language A) (hL : UnfoldInvariantLanguage L)
    (S T : System A 0) (h : Equivalent L S T) : S ∈ L ↔ T ∈ L

axiom accepting_class {A : RankedSet} (L : Language A) (hL : UnfoldInvariantLanguage L)
    (S : System A 0) : AcceptingClass L (Quot.mk _ S) ↔ S ∈ L

axiom finite_carrier {A : RankedSet} (L : Language A) (hL : Recognizable L) : RankwiseFinite (Carrier L)

end Lax369799.DeterministicSyntacticOrder

concepts.title: Direction projections of extremal elements
concepts.description:
In Section 5.3 the ith direction of a rank-k element is evaluated by
retaining only its edge to the ith variable and renaming that variable
to the single output. Extremal elements of positive rank equal the
parallel family of their direction projections (Lemma 92), and each
projection is itself an extremal unary element (Lemma 93).
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.ExtendedContexts

/-!
---
title: Direction projections of extremal elements
type: theorem
---
In Section 5.3 the ith direction of a rank-k element is evaluated by
retaining only its edge to the ith variable and renaming that variable
to the single output. Extremal elements of positive rank equal the
parallel family of their direction projections (Lemma 92), and each
projection is itself an extremal unary element (Lemma 93).
-/

namespace Lax369799.DirectionProjections
open RankedSystems (RankedSet)
open FinitePresentations FiniteContextualOrder FiniteSyntacticAlgebra FiniteAcceptance
open ExpandedSyntacticAlgebra

def projection {A : RankedSet} {k : ℕ} (a : A k) (i : Fin k) : FiniteSystem A 1 where
  size := 1
  graph := {
    label := fun _ => ⟨k, a⟩
    initial := Set.univ
    root := ∅
    edge := fun _ d t => d = i.val ∧ t = .inr 0
    direction_valid := by rintro _ d t ⟨rfl, _⟩; exact i.isLt }

def direction {A : RankedSet} (E : Algebra A) {k : ℕ} (a : A k) (i : Fin k) : A 1 :=
  E.eval 1 (projection a i)

def parallel {A : RankedSet} {k : ℕ} (b : Fin k → A 1) : FiniteSystem A k :=
  ofSetSystem (DeterministicElements.parallel b)

axiom monotone {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    (E : SyntacticAlgebra L) {k : ℕ} (a b : Carrier (Accepting L) k)
    (hab : ClassBelow (Accepting L) a b) (i : Fin k) :
    ClassBelow (Accepting L) (direction E.algebra a i) (direction E.algebra b i)

axiom reconstruction_bound {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    (E : SyntacticAlgebra L) {k : ℕ} (a : Carrier (Accepting L) k) :
    ClassBelow (Accepting L) a (E.algebra.eval k (parallel (direction E.algebra a)))

axiom parallel_projection_bound {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    (E : SyntacticAlgebra L) {k : ℕ} (b : Fin k → Carrier (Accepting L) 1) (i : Fin k) :
    ClassBelow (Accepting L) (direction E.algebra (E.algebra.eval k (parallel b)) i) (b i)

axiom extremal_decomposition {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    (E : SyntacticAlgebra L) {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (a : Carrier (Accepting L) k)
    (ha : ExtendedContexts.ExtremalElement L E a) :
    E.algebra.eval k (parallel (direction E.algebra a)) = a

axiom extremal_direction {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    (hL : Algebras.UnfoldInvariantLanguage L) (hrec : Algebras.Recognizable L)
    (E : SyntacticAlgebra L) {k : ℕ} (a : Carrier (Accepting L) k)
    (ha : ExtendedContexts.ExtremalElement L E a) (i : Fin k) :
    ExtendedContexts.ExtremalElement L E (direction E.algebra a i)

end Lax369799.DirectionProjections

  instLENat.le 1 k →
    ∀ (a : Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.Carrier (Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) k),

concepts.title: Reindexing the outgoing directions at each vertex
concepts.description:
Replace the directions at every vertex by a finite set mapping
surjectively onto the original directions. Successors and valuations
are preserved after forgetting direction order and multiplicity. The
resulting deterministic system has an isomorphic decoding, as used in
the cloning and rerouting constructions of Lemma 108.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.TransitionEncoding

/-!
---
title: Reindexing the outgoing directions at each vertex
type: theorem
---
Replace the directions at every vertex by a finite set mapping
surjectively onto the original directions. Successors and valuations
are preserved after forgetting direction order and multiplicity. The
resulting deterministic system has an isomorphic decoding, as used in
the cloning and rerouting constructions of Lemma 108.
-/

namespace Lax369799.DirectionReindexing
open RankedSystems TransitionEncoding

structure Reindexing {P : Type} (S : System (TransitionAlphabet P) 0) where
  arity : S.val.Vertex → ℕ
  map : ∀ v, Fin (arity v) → Fin (S.val.graph.label v).1
  surjective : ∀ v, Function.Surjective (map v)

def graph {P : Type} (S : System (TransitionAlphabet P) 0) (R : Reindexing S) :
    Presentation (TransitionAlphabet P) 0 S.val.Vertex where
  label := fun v => ⟨R.arity v, (S.val.graph.label v).2⟩
  initial := S.val.graph.initial
  root := ∅
  edge := fun v d t => ∃ i : Fin (R.arity v), d = i.val ∧ S.val.graph.edge v (R.map v i).val t
  direction_valid := by rintro v d t ⟨i, rfl, _⟩; exact i.isLt

structure Realizes {P : Type} (S : System (TransitionAlphabet P) 0) (R : Reindexing S)
    (T : System (TransitionAlphabet P) 0) where
  vertex : T.val.Vertex ≃ S.val.Vertex
  label : ∀ v, T.val.graph.label v = ⟨R.arity (vertex v), (S.val.graph.label (vertex v)).2⟩
  initial : ∀ v, T.val.graph.initial v ↔ S.val.graph.initial (vertex v)
  edge : ∀ v d t, T.val.graph.edge v d t ↔
    ∃ i : Fin (R.arity (vertex v)), d = i.val ∧
      S.val.graph.edge (vertex v) (R.map (vertex v) i).val (Sum.map vertex id t)

/-- Canonical realization, retaining exactly the original vertex type. -/
def system {P : Type} (S : System (TransitionAlphabet P) 0) (R : Reindexing S) :
    System (TransitionAlphabet P) 0 := by
  let G := graph S R
  have hstep {v w : S.val.Vertex} (h : S.val.graph.Step v w) : G.Step v w := by
    obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := h
    let i : Fin (S.val.graph.label v).1 := ⟨d, S.val.graph.direction_valid _ _ _ hd⟩
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := R.surjective v i
    exact ⟨j.val, j, rfl, by simpa only [hj] using hd⟩
  have hreach (v : S.val.Vertex) : G.Reachable v := by
    obtain ⟨a, ha, hp⟩ := S.val.reachable v
    have hi : S.val.graph.initial a := ha.elim id (fun h => by rw [S.property.2.1] at h; exact h.elim)
    refine ⟨a, Or.inl hi, ?_⟩
    induction hp with
    | refl => exact .refl
    | @tail y z hp hyz ih => exact ih.tail (hstep hyz)
  let U : SetSystem (TransitionAlphabet P) 0 := ⟨S.val.size, G, hreach⟩
  have hdet : U.Deterministic := by
    refine ⟨S.property.1, rfl, ?_⟩
    intro v d hd
    let i : Fin (R.arity v) := ⟨d, hd⟩
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hu⟩ := S.property.2.2 v (R.map v i).val (R.map v i).isLt
    refine ⟨t, ⟨i, rfl, ht⟩, ?_⟩
    rintro t' ⟨j, hj, ht'⟩
    have hji : j = i := Fin.ext hj.symm
    subst j
    exact hu t' ht'
  exact ⟨U, hdet⟩

/-- Its realization map is the identity on vertices. -/
def realizes {P : Type} (S : System (TransitionAlphabet P) 0) (R : Reindexing S) :
    Realizes S R (system S R) where
  vertex := Equiv.refl _
  label := fun _ => rfl
  initial := fun _ => Iff.rfl
  edge := by intro v d t; cases t <;> exact Iff.rfl


axiom zero_iff {P : Type} (S : System (TransitionAlphabet P) 0) (R : Reindexing S)
    (v : S.val.Vertex) : R.arity v = 0 ↔ (S.val.graph.label v).1 = 0

axiom realization {P : Type} (S : System (TransitionAlphabet P) 0) (R : Reindexing S) :
    ∃ T, Nonempty (Realizes S R T)

axiom decode_isomorphic {P : Type} {S T : System (TransitionAlphabet P) 0}
    (R : Reindexing S) (h : Realizes S R T) : Isomorphic (decode T) (decode S)

end Lax369799.DirectionReindexing

concepts.title: Effective translation of bisimulation-invariant finite MSO
concepts.description:
The algorithm is total on all MSO sentences over an explicitly encoded
finite vocabulary. It enumerates bounded modal transition tables and
selects a compiled sentence by finite graph tests. Under the promised
finite bisimulation invariance, the selected sentence agrees on every
finite reachable transition system. No invariance decision is required.
This formalizes the effectivity argument following Theorem 2.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.FiniteTesting
import Lax369799.QuantitativeFiniteTheorem
import Mathlib.Data.List.ProdSigma

/-!
---
title: Effective translation of bisimulation-invariant finite MSO
type: theorem
---
The algorithm is total on all MSO sentences over an explicitly encoded
finite vocabulary. It enumerates bounded modal transition tables and
selects a compiled sentence by finite graph tests. Under the promised
finite bisimulation invariance, the selected sentence agrees on every
finite reachable transition system. No invariance decision is required.
This formalizes the effectivity argument following Theorem 2.
-/

namespace Lax369799.EffectiveFiniteTranslation
open ModalMuCalculus

def candidates {P : Type} [Fintype P] [Encodable P] [DecidableEq P]
    (φ : MonadicSecondOrder.Sentence P) : List (Sentence P) :=
  let f := QuantitativeRecognition.msoBound φ
  (List.range (QuantitativeAutomata.unaryBound f+1)).flatMap (fun u =>
    (List.range (QuantitativeAutomata.nullaryBound f+1)).flatMap (fun z =>
      (List.range (QuantitativeAutomata.stateBound f+1)).flatMap (fun d =>
        (FiniteModalData.elements (FiniteModalData.Data P u z d (QuantitativeAutomata.priorityBound f))).map
          FiniteModalData.compile)))

def conjunction {P : Type} (φ ψ : MonadicSecondOrder.Sentence P) : MonadicSecondOrder.Sentence P :=
  .neg (.disj (.neg φ) (.neg ψ))

def difference {P : Type} (ψ χ : Sentence P) : MonadicSecondOrder.Sentence P :=
  .disj (conjunction (UnrestrictedLogic.sentence ψ) (.neg (UnrestrictedLogic.sentence χ)))
    (conjunction (.neg (UnrestrictedLogic.sentence ψ)) (UnrestrictedLogic.sentence χ))

def separationBound {P : Type} (cs : List (Sentence P)) : ℕ :=
  ((cs.product cs).map (fun e => QuantitativeFiniteTheorem.modelBound (difference e.1 e.2))).foldr max 0

def compile {P : Type} [Fintype P] [Encodable P] [DecidableEq P]
    (φ : MonadicSecondOrder.Sentence P) : Sentence P :=
  let cs := candidates φ
  (cs.find? (fun ψ => FiniteTesting.test (separationBound cs) φ ψ)).getD .bot

open TransitionSystems

axiom mu_translation_correct {P : Type} (ψ : Sentence P) (S : TransitionSystem P) :
    Models S ψ ↔ MonadicSecondOrder.Models S (UnrestrictedLogic.sentence ψ)

-- Compiler correctness is the effective theorem in FiniteBisimulationTheorem.
-- Keep one Archive statement for this result.

end Lax369799.EffectiveFiniteTranslation

    (Lax369799.MonadicSecondOrder.Models S (Lax369799.UnrestrictedLogic.sentence ψ))

import Lax369799.TransitionEncoding

/-!
---
title: Correctness of ranked transition encodings
type: theorem
---
Every finite reachable transition system has a ranked encoding. Ranked
bisimilarity coincides with usual bisimilarity of decodings, as asserted
by `lemma:bisimulation-is-bisimulation` in Section 6.1.
-/

namespace Lax369799.EncodingTheorems
open RankedSystems TransitionSystems TransitionEncoding

axiom encoding_exists {P : Type} (S : TransitionSystem P) :
  ∃ T : System (TransitionAlphabet P) 0, decode T = S

axiom bisimulation_iff {P : Type} (S T : System (TransitionAlphabet P) 0) :
  RankedBisimilar S T ↔ Bisimilar (decode S) (decode T)

end Lax369799.EncodingTheorems

bisimulation_iff : ∀ {P : Type} (S T : Lax369799.RankedSystems.System (Lax369799.TransitionEncoding.TransitionAlphabet P) 0),
  Iff (Lax369799.TransitionEncoding.RankedBisimilar S T)
    (Lax369799.TransitionSystems.Bisimilar (Lax369799.TransitionEncoding.decode S)
      (Lax369799.TransitionEncoding.decode T))

encoding_exists : ∀ {P : Type} (S : Lax369799.TransitionSystems.TransitionSystem P),
  Exists fun T => Eq (Lax369799.TransitionEncoding.decode T) S

concepts.title: Evaluation of sums and contexts
concepts.description:
Evaluation turns disjoint union into meet. Substituting a set-system has
the same value as substituting its evaluated atomic letter. Evaluation
in every context is monotone for the induced algebra order. These are
consequences of the unit, flattening, and morphism axioms used in the
normal-form and extremal-context arguments.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.SetAlgebras

/-!
---
title: Evaluation of sums and contexts
type: theorem
---
Evaluation turns disjoint union into meet. Substituting a set-system has
the same value as substituting its evaluated atomic letter. Evaluation
in every context is monotone for the induced algebra order. These are
consequences of the unit, flattening, and morphism axioms used in the
normal-form and extremal-context arguments.
-/

namespace Lax369799.EvaluationTheorems
open RankedSystems Flattening SetAlgebras

axiom eval_sum {A : RankedSet} (E : SetAlgebra A) {n : ℕ} (S T : SetSystem A n) :
  E.eval n (sum S T) = meet E (E.eval n S) (E.eval n T)

axiom context_evaluation {A : RankedSet} (E : SetAlgebra A) {k n : ℕ}
    (C : SetContext A k n) (S : SetSystem A k) :
  E.eval n (plug C S) = E.eval n (plug C (atomic (E.eval k S)))

axiom context_monotone {A : RankedSet} (E : SetAlgebra A) {k n : ℕ}
    (C : SetContext A k n) (a b : A k) (h : Below E a b) :
  Below E (E.eval n (plug C (atomic a))) (E.eval n (plug C (atomic b)))

axiom relabel_monotone {A B : RankedSet} (E : SetAlgebra A)
    (f g : RankedMap B A) (h : ∀ r b, Below E (f r b) (g r b))
    {n : ℕ} (S : SetSystem B n) :
  Below E (E.eval n (relabel f S)) (E.eval n (relabel g S))

end Lax369799.EvaluationTheorems

  (C : Lax369799.Flattening.SetContext A k n) (S : Lax369799.RankedSystems.SetSystem A k),
  Eq (E.eval n (Lax369799.Flattening.plug C S))
    (E.eval n (Lax369799.Flattening.plug C (Lax369799.RankedSystems.atomic (E.eval k S))))

  (C : Lax369799.Flattening.SetContext A k n) (a b : A k),
  Lax369799.SetAlgebras.Below E a b →
    Lax369799.SetAlgebras.Below E (E.eval n (Lax369799.Flattening.plug C (Lax369799.RankedSystems.atomic a)))
      (E.eval n (Lax369799.Flattening.plug C (Lax369799.RankedSystems.atomic b)))

  (f g : Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankedMap B A),
  (∀ (r : Nat) (b : B r), Lax369799.SetAlgebras.Below E (f r b) (g r b)) →
    ∀ {n : Nat} (S : Lax369799.RankedSystems.SetSystem B n),
      Lax369799.SetAlgebras.Below E (E.eval n (Lax369799.RankedSystems.relabel f S))
        (E.eval n (Lax369799.RankedSystems.relabel g S))

concepts.title: Acceptance certificates retaining expanded resolutions
concepts.description:
A certificate chooses a deterministic value below each vertex label and
representatives for the chosen values. It requires acceptance of all yields
of the expanded presentation. This is a characterization of acceptance,
not yet a finite-state branch condition.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.FiniteVertexReplacement

/-!
---
title: Acceptance certificates retaining expanded resolutions
type: theorem
---
A certificate chooses a deterministic value below each vertex label and
representatives for the chosen values. It requires acceptance of all yields
of the expanded presentation. This is a characterization of acceptance,
not yet a finite-state branch condition.
-/
namespace Lax369799.ExpandedCertificates
open RankedSystems (RankedSet System trim)
open FinitePresentations FiniteContextualOrder FiniteAcceptance FiniteSyntacticAlgebra
open ExpandedSyntacticAlgebra ExpandedContinuity

structure Certificate {A B : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    (E : SyntacticAlgebra L) (P : FiniteSystem B 0)
    (q : ∀ v : P.Vertex, Carrier (Accepting L) (P.graph.label v).1) where
  labels : ∀ v : P.Vertex, Carrier (Accepting L) (P.graph.label v).1
  local_choice : ∀ v, FiniteExtremal.Deterministic E.algebra (labels v) ∧
    ClassBelow (Accepting L) (labels v) (q v)
  representatives : Representatives L (withLabels P labels)
  represents : Represents L (withLabels P labels) representatives
  accepts : ∀ T, Morphisms.Yield (trim (expansion L (withLabels P labels) representatives).graph) T →
    Admissible L T

axiom acceptance_iff_certificate {A B : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    (hL : Algebras.UnfoldInvariantLanguage L) (hrec : Algebras.Recognizable L)
    (E : SyntacticAlgebra L) (P : FiniteSystem B 0)
    (q : ∀ v : P.Vertex, Carrier (Accepting L) (P.graph.label v).1) :
    AcceptingClass (Accepting L) (E.algebra.eval 0 (withLabels P q)) ↔
      Nonempty (Certificate L E P q)

axiom input_evaluation {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    (E : SyntacticAlgebra L) {n : ℕ} (S : FiniteSystem A n) :
    E.algebra.eval n (relabel (fun k a => quotientMap (Accepting L) k (atomic a)) S) =
      quotientMap (Accepting L) n S

axiom language_iff_certificate {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    (hL : Algebras.UnfoldInvariantLanguage L) (hrec : Algebras.Recognizable L)
    (E : SyntacticAlgebra L) (S : System A 0) :
    S ∈ L ↔ Nonempty (Certificate L E (ofSetSystem S.val)
      (fun v => quotientMap (Accepting L) _ (atomic (S.val.graph.label v).2)))

end Lax369799.ExpandedCertificates

  Lax369799.Algebras.UnfoldInvariantLanguage L →
    Lax369799.Algebras.Recognizable L →
      ∀ (E : Lax369799.ExpandedSyntacticAlgebra.SyntacticAlgebra L) (P : Lax369799.FinitePresentations.FiniteSystem B 0)
        (q :
          (v : P.Vertex) →
            Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.Carrier (Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) (P.graph.label v).fst),
        Iff
          (Lax369799.FiniteSyntacticAlgebra.AcceptingClass (Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L)
            (E.algebra.eval 0 (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.withLabels P q)))
          (Nonempty (Lax369799.ExpandedCertificates.Certificate L E P q))

input_evaluation : ∀ {A : Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankedSet} (L : Lax369799.Algebras.Language A)
  (E : Lax369799.ExpandedSyntacticAlgebra.SyntacticAlgebra L) {n : Nat}
  (S : Lax369799.FinitePresentations.FiniteSystem A n),
  Eq
    (E.algebra.eval n
      (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.relabel
        (fun k a =>
          Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.quotientMap (Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) k
            (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.atomic a))
        S))
    (Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.quotientMap (Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) n S)

language_iff_certificate : ∀ {A : Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankedSet} (L : Lax369799.Algebras.Language A),
  Lax369799.Algebras.UnfoldInvariantLanguage L →
    Lax369799.Algebras.Recognizable L →
      ∀ (E : Lax369799.ExpandedSyntacticAlgebra.SyntacticAlgebra L) (S : Lax369799.RankedSystems.System A 0),
        Iff (Set.instMembership.mem L S)
          (Nonempty
            (Lax369799.ExpandedCertificates.Certificate L E (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.ofSetSystem S.val) fun v =>
              Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.quotientMap (Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L)
                ((Lax369799.FinitePresentations.ofSetSystem S.val).graph.label v).fst
                (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.atomic (S.val.graph.label v).snd)))

concepts.title: Continuity through expanded representatives
concepts.description:
Expand every algebra-valued vertex into a representative before resolving
nondeterminism. All substitutions retain unreachable vertices until the
final yield observation. Acceptance of these expanded resolutions, also
in every surrounding context, is independent of the representatives.
This is a contextual continuity law; it does not identify the yields of
an atomic algebra-valued pattern with those of its expansion.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance
import Lax369799.FiniteContinuityOrder
import Lax369799.FiniteYieldMeets

/-!
---
title: Continuity through expanded representatives
type: theorem
---
Expand every algebra-valued vertex into a representative before resolving
nondeterminism. All substitutions retain unreachable vertices until the
final yield observation. Acceptance of these expanded resolutions, also
in every surrounding context, is independent of the representatives.
This is a contextual continuity law; it does not identify the yields of
an atomic algebra-valued pattern with those of its expansion.
-/
namespace Lax369799.ExpandedContinuity
open RankedSystems (RankedSet SetSystem System)
open FinitePresentations FiniteContexts FiniteContextualOrder FiniteSyntacticAlgebra
open FiniteAcceptance

abbrev Representatives {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A) {n : ℕ}
    (P : FiniteSystem (Carrier (Accepting L)) n) :=
  ∀ v : P.Vertex, FiniteSystem A (P.graph.label v).1

def Represents {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A) {n : ℕ}
    (P : FiniteSystem (Carrier (Accepting L)) n) (q : Representatives L P) : Prop :=
  ∀ v, quotientMap (Accepting L) _ (q v) = (P.graph.label v).2

noncomputable def expansion {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A) {n : ℕ}
    (P : FiniteSystem (Carrier (Accepting L)) n) (q : Representatives L P) : FiniteSystem A n :=
  flatten (withLabels P q)

def Admissible {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A) (T : SetSystem A 0) : Prop :=
  ∃ U : System A 0, U ∈ L ∧ (T = U.val ∨ T = RankedSystems.plant U.val)

def ResolvesIn {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A) {n : ℕ}
    (P : FiniteSystem (Carrier (Accepting L)) n) (q : Representatives L P)
    (C : Context A n 0) (T : SetSystem A 0) : Prop :=
  Morphisms.Yield (RankedSystems.trim (plug C (expansion L P q)).graph) T

axiom evaluation {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    (E : Algebra (Carrier (Accepting L)))
    (hE : ∀ n (S : FiniteSystem (FiniteSystem A) n),
      E.eval n (relabel (quotientMap (Accepting L)) S) = quotientMap (Accepting L) n (flatten S))
    {n : ℕ} (P : FiniteSystem (Carrier (Accepting L)) n)
    (q : Representatives L P) (hq : Represents L P q) :
    E.eval n P = quotientMap (Accepting L) n (expansion L P q)

axiom closed_continuity {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    (E : Algebra (Carrier (Accepting L)))
    (hE : ∀ n (S : FiniteSystem (FiniteSystem A) n),
      E.eval n (relabel (quotientMap (Accepting L)) S) = quotientMap (Accepting L) n (flatten S))
    (P : FiniteSystem (Carrier (Accepting L)) 0)
    (q : Representatives L P) (hq : Represents L P q) :
    AcceptingClass (Accepting L) (E.eval 0 P) ↔
      ∀ T, Morphisms.Yield (RankedSystems.trim (expansion L P q).graph) T → Admissible L T

axiom contextual_continuity {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    (E : Algebra (Carrier (Accepting L)))
    (hE : ∀ n (S : FiniteSystem (FiniteSystem A) n),
      E.eval n (relabel (quotientMap (Accepting L)) S) = quotientMap (Accepting L) n (flatten S))
    {n : ℕ} (P : FiniteSystem (Carrier (Accepting L)) n)
    (q : Representatives L P) (hq : Represents L P q) (R : FiniteSystem A n) :
    ClassBelow (Accepting L) (quotientMap (Accepting L) n R) (E.eval n P) ↔
      ∀ C : Context A n 0, Accepting L (plug C R) →
        ∀ T, ResolvesIn L P q C T → Admissible L T

axiom representative_independence {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    (E : Algebra (Carrier (Accepting L)))
    (hE : ∀ n (S : FiniteSystem (FiniteSystem A) n),
      E.eval n (relabel (quotientMap (Accepting L)) S) = quotientMap (Accepting L) n (flatten S))
    {n : ℕ} (P : FiniteSystem (Carrier (Accepting L)) n)
    (q r : Representatives L P) (hq : Represents L P q) (hr : Represents L P r)
    (C : Context A n 0) :
    (∀ T, ResolvesIn L P q C T → Admissible L T) ↔
      (∀ T, ResolvesIn L P r C T → Admissible L T)

axiom finite_approximation {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    (E : Algebra (Carrier (Accepting L)))
    (hE : ∀ n (S : FiniteSystem (FiniteSystem A) n),
      E.eval n (relabel (quotientMap (Accepting L)) S) = quotientMap (Accepting L) n (flatten S))
    {n : ℕ} (P : FiniteSystem (Carrier (Accepting L)) n)
    (q : Representatives L P) (hq : Represents L P q) (R : FiniteSystem A n) :
    ClassBelow (Accepting L) (quotientMap (Accepting L) n R) (E.eval n P) ↔
      ∀ (m : ℕ) (F : Fin m → SetSystem A n),
        (∀ i, Morphisms.Yield (RankedSystems.trim (expansion L P q).graph) (F i)) →
        ClassBelow (Accepting L) (quotientMap (Accepting L) n R)
          (quotientMap (Accepting L) n (ofSetSystem (YieldContinuity.finiteSum F)))

axiom yield_lower_bound {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    (E : Algebra (Carrier (Accepting L)))
    (hE : ∀ n (S : FiniteSystem (FiniteSystem A) n),
      E.eval n (relabel (quotientMap (Accepting L)) S) = quotientMap (Accepting L) n (flatten S))
    {n : ℕ} (P : FiniteSystem (Carrier (Accepting L)) n)
    (q : Representatives L P) (hq : Represents L P q) (R : FiniteSystem A n) :
    ClassBelow (Accepting L) (quotientMap (Accepting L) n R) (E.eval n P) ↔
      ∀ T : SetSystem A n,
        Morphisms.Yield (RankedSystems.trim (expansion L P q).graph) T →
        ClassBelow (Accepting L) (quotientMap (Accepting L) n R)
          (quotientMap (Accepting L) n (ofSetSystem T))

end Lax369799.ExpandedContinuity

  (E :
    Lax369799.FiniteSyntacticAlgebra.Algebra
      (Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.Carrier (Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L))),
  (∀ (n : Nat) (S : Lax369799.FinitePresentations.FiniteSystem (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.FiniteSystem A) n),
      Eq
        (E.eval n
          (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.relabel
            (Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.quotientMap (Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L)) S))
        (Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.quotientMap (Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) n
          (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.flatten S))) →
    ∀ {n : Nat}
      (P :

      (q : Lax369799.ExpandedContinuity.Representatives L P),
      Lax369799.ExpandedContinuity.Represents L P q →
        ∀ (R : Lax369799.FinitePresentations.FiniteSystem A n),

            (Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.ClassBelow (Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L)
              (Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.quotientMap (Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) n R) (E.eval n P))
            (∀ (C : Lax369799.FiniteContexts.Context A n 0),

concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.ExpandedContinuity
import Lax369799.FiniteAutomatonProperty
import Lax369799.FiniteResolutionNormalForms

/-!
---
title: Syntactic algebras with expanded continuity
type: theorem
---
The syntactic quotient is a substitution algebra of finite presentations.
Its continuity law resolves base-alphabet representatives after expansion.
It applies to every lower bound and every choice of representatives.
Finite resolution normal forms retain entire branching components.
-/
namespace Lax369799.ExpandedSyntacticAlgebra
open RankedSystems (RankedSet SetSystem System trim)
open FinitePresentations FiniteContextualOrder FiniteAcceptance
open FiniteSyntacticAlgebra ExpandedContinuity

structure SyntacticAlgebra {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A) where
  algebra : Algebra (Carrier (Accepting L))
  evaluates : ∀ n (S : FiniteSystem (FiniteSystem A) n),
    algebra.eval n (relabel (quotientMap (Accepting L)) S) =
      quotientMap (Accepting L) n (flatten S)
  continuity : ∀ {n} (P : FiniteSystem (Carrier (Accepting L)) n)
    (q : Representatives L P), Represents L P q → ∀ a : Carrier (Accepting L) n,
    ClassBelow (Accepting L) a (algebra.eval n P) ↔
      ∀ T : SetSystem A n, Morphisms.Yield (trim (expansion L P q).graph) T →
        ClassBelow (Accepting L) a (quotientMap (Accepting L) n (ofSetSystem T))

axiom syntactic_algebra_exists {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A) :
    Nonempty (SyntacticAlgebra L)

axiom representatives_exist {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A) {n : ℕ}
    (P : FiniteSystem (Carrier (Accepting L)) n) :
    ∃ q : Representatives L P, Represents L P q

axiom recognition {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    (hL : Algebras.UnfoldInvariantLanguage L) (T : System A 0) :
    AcceptingClass (Accepting L) (quotientMap (Accepting L) 0 (ofSetSystem T.val)) ↔ T ∈ L

axiom expanded_normal_form {A B : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    (E : SyntacticAlgebra L) (D : Algebras.Algebra B)
    (hD : Algebras.UnfoldInvariant D) (hB : RankedSystems.RankwiseFinite B)
    (η : RankedSystems.RankedMap A B) (F : Set (B 0))
    (hL : Algebras.Recognizes D η F L) {n : ℕ}
    (P : FiniteSystem (Carrier (Accepting L)) n)
    (q : Representatives L P) (hq : Represents L P q) :
    ∃ (k : ℕ) (c : Fin k → FiniteResolutionNormalForms.Component (trim (expansion L P q).graph)),
      E.algebra.eval n P = quotientMap (Accepting L) n (FiniteResolutionNormalForms.family c)

axiom automaton_property {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    (hL : Algebras.UnfoldInvariantLanguage L) (hrec : Algebras.Recognizable L)
    (E : SyntacticAlgebra L) {k : ℕ}
    (C : FiniteContexts.Context (Carrier (Accepting L)) k 0) (a : Carrier (Accepting L) k)
    (ha : AcceptingClass (Accepting L) (E.algebra.eval 0 (FiniteContexts.plug C (atomic a)))) :
    ∃ δ, FiniteExtremal.Deterministic E.algebra δ ∧ ClassBelow (Accepting L) δ a ∧
      AcceptingClass (Accepting L) (E.algebra.eval 0 (FiniteContexts.plug C (atomic δ)))

axiom expanded_yield_order {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    (E : SyntacticAlgebra L) {n : ℕ}
    (P Q : FiniteSystem (Carrier (Accepting L)) n)
    (p : Representatives L P) (q : Representatives L Q)
    (hp : Represents L P p) (hq : Represents L Q q)
    (h : Morphisms.YieldBelow (trim (expansion L P p).graph) (trim (expansion L Q q).graph)) :
    ClassBelow (Accepting L) (E.algebra.eval n Q) (E.algebra.eval n P)

axiom syntactic_automaton_property {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    (hL : Algebras.UnfoldInvariantLanguage L) (hrec : Algebras.Recognizable L) :
    ∃ E : SyntacticAlgebra L, ∀ {k : ℕ}
      (C : FiniteContexts.Context (Carrier (Accepting L)) k 0) (a : Carrier (Accepting L) k),
      AcceptingClass (Accepting L) (E.algebra.eval 0 (FiniteContexts.plug C (atomic a))) →
      ∃ δ, FiniteExtremal.Deterministic E.algebra δ ∧ ClassBelow (Accepting L) δ a ∧
        AcceptingClass (Accepting L) (E.algebra.eval 0 (FiniteContexts.plug C (atomic δ)))

end Lax369799.ExpandedSyntacticAlgebra

          (Lax369799.RankedSystems.trim (Lax369799.ExpandedContinuity.expansion L Q q).graph) →
        Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.ClassBelow (Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) (E.algebra.eval n Q)
          (E.algebra.eval n P)

          (Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.quotientMap (Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) 0
            (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.ofSetSystem T.val)))

concepts.title: Transition tables for the algebra with expanded continuity
concepts.description:
The split extremal construction supplies parallel transitions in accepting
contexts, after rank-one refinement of every component. Legal transitions
require these selected unary types, which preserve binary choices of closed
continuations. A run assigns their values to the input vertices. Pointwise
comparison then transfers acceptance of that evaluated run to the input.
Every accepted input also admits a legal run with an accepted evaluated
value. The separate implication from a word condition to acceptance of
the run value is not assumed here.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.SelectedParallel
import Lax369799.AlgebraicTransitions
import Lax369799.ExpandedCertificates

/-!
---
title: Transition tables for the algebra with expanded continuity
type: theorem
---
The split extremal construction supplies parallel transitions in accepting
contexts, after rank-one refinement of every component. Legal transitions
require these selected unary types, which preserve binary choices of closed
continuations. A run assigns their values to the input vertices. Pointwise
comparison then transfers acceptance of that evaluated run to the input.
Every accepted input also admits a legal run with an accepted evaluated
value. The separate implication from a word condition to acceptance of
the run value is not assumed here.
-/
namespace Lax369799.ExpandedTransitions
open RankedSystems (RankedSet RankedMap System)
open FinitePresentations FiniteContextualOrder FiniteAcceptance FiniteSyntacticAlgebra
open ExpandedSyntacticAlgebra UnfoldAutomata

noncomputable def automaton {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    [Fintype (Carrier (Accepting L) 1)] [Fintype (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)]
    (E : SyntacticAlgebra L)
    (D : WordCondition (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 1))
      (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 0))) : UnfoldAutomaton A where
  unary := Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 1)
  nullary := Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)
  transition := fun n a => {b |
    (∀ i, ExtremalUnaryTypes.Selected L E (AlgebraicTransitions.decodeTypes b i)) ∧
    ClassBelow (Accepting L)
    (E.algebra.eval (n + 1) (ofSetSystem (DeterministicElements.parallel
      (AlgebraicTransitions.decodeTypes b)))) (quotientMap (Accepting L) _ (atomic a))}
  leafTransition := fun a => {(Fintype.equivFin (Carrier (Accepting L) 0))
    (quotientMap (Accepting L) 0 (atomic a))}
  condition := D

noncomputable def runLabel {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    [Fintype (Carrier (Accepting L) 1)] [Fintype (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)]
    (E : SyntacticAlgebra L)
    (D : WordCondition (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 1))
      (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)))
    {S : System A 0} (r : Labelling (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 1))
      (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)) S) (v : S.val.Vertex) :
    Carrier (Accepting L) (Rank S v) :=
  if h : Rank S v = 0 then h.symm ▸
    (Fintype.equivFin (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)).symm (r.leafType v h)
  else E.algebra.eval _ (ofSetSystem (DeterministicElements.parallel
    (fun i => (Fintype.equivFin (Carrier (Accepting L) 1)).symm (r.edgeType v i))))

axiom accepting_transition {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    (hL : Algebras.UnfoldInvariantLanguage L) (hrec : Algebras.Recognizable L)
    [Fintype (Carrier (Accepting L) 1)] [Fintype (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)]
    (E : SyntacticAlgebra L)
    (D : WordCondition (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 1))
      (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)))
    (n : ℕ) (a : A (n + 1)) (C : FiniteContexts.Context (Carrier (Accepting L)) (n + 1) 0)
    (ha : AcceptingClass (Accepting L) (E.algebra.eval 0 (FiniteContexts.plug C
      (atomic (quotientMap (Accepting L) _ (atomic a)))))) :
    ∃ b ∈ (automaton L E D).transition n a,
      AcceptingClass (Accepting L) (E.algebra.eval 0 (FiniteContexts.plug C
        (atomic (E.algebra.eval (n + 1) (ofSetSystem
          (DeterministicElements.parallel (AlgebraicTransitions.decodeTypes b)))))))

axiom run_label_below {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    [Fintype (Carrier (Accepting L) 1)] [Fintype (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)]
    (E : SyntacticAlgebra L)
    (D : WordCondition (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 1))
      (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)))
    {S : System A 0} (r : Run (automaton L E D) S) (v : S.val.Vertex) :
    ClassBelow (Accepting L) (runLabel L E D r.toLabelling v)
      (quotientMap (Accepting L) _ (atomic (S.val.graph.label v).2))

axiom evaluated_run_sound {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    (hL : Algebras.UnfoldInvariantLanguage L)
    [Fintype (Carrier (Accepting L) 1)] [Fintype (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)]
    (E : SyntacticAlgebra L)
    (D : WordCondition (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 1))
      (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)))
    {S : System A 0} (r : Run (automaton L E D) S)
    (hr : AcceptingClass (Accepting L)
      (E.algebra.eval 0 (withLabels (ofSetSystem S.val) (runLabel L E D r.toLabelling)))) : S ∈ L

axiom evaluated_run_exists {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    (hL : Algebras.UnfoldInvariantLanguage L) (hrec : Algebras.Recognizable L)
    [Fintype (Carrier (Accepting L) 1)] [Fintype (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)]
    (E : SyntacticAlgebra L)
    (D : WordCondition (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 1))
      (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)))
    (S : System A 0) (hS : S ∈ L) :
    ∃ r : Run (automaton L E D) S, AcceptingClass (Accepting L)
      (E.algebra.eval 0 (withLabels (ofSetSystem S.val) (runLabel L E D r.toLabelling)))

axiom edge_preserves_choices {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    [Fintype (Carrier (Accepting L) 1)] [Fintype (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)]
    (E : SyntacticAlgebra L)
    (D : WordCondition (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 1))
      (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)))
    {S : System A 0} (r : Run (automaton L E D) S) (v : S.val.Vertex) (i : Fin (Rank S v)) :
    ChoicePreservingUnary.PreservesChoices E.algebra
      ((Fintype.equivFin (Carrier (Accepting L) 1)).symm (r.edgeType v i))

end Lax369799.ExpandedTransitions

  [inst : Fintype (Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.Carrier (Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) 1)]
  [inst_1 : Fintype (Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.Carrier (Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) 0)]
  (E : Lax369799.ExpandedSyntacticAlgebra.SyntacticAlgebra L)

concepts.title: Evaluation of closed contexts through extended unary pieces
concepts.description:
The unary pieces of a closed context, together with their immediate
initial/root markers, determine its evaluation for every hole label.
This is the algebraic form of context decomposition (Lemmas 44 and 66).
Initial and root marks remain distinct, and every vertex of each piece
is retained. It applies to arbitrary set-algebras without an assumption
that planting preserves acceptance.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.ExtendedContexts
import Lax369799.SetSystemAlgebras

/-!
---
title: Evaluation of closed contexts through extended unary pieces
type: theorem
---
The unary pieces of a closed context, together with their immediate
initial/root markers, determine its evaluation for every hole label.
This is the algebraic form of context decomposition (Lemmas 44 and 66).
Initial and root marks remain distinct, and every vertex of each piece
is retained. It applies to arbitrary set-algebras without an assumption
that planting preserves acceptance.
-/

namespace Lax369799.ExtendedContextDecomposition
open RankedSystems (RankedSet)
open FinitePresentations FiniteContexts

axiom context_decomposition {A : RankedSet} (E : SetSystemAlgebras.SetAlgebra A)
    {k : ℕ} (C : Context A k 0) :
    ∃ p : ExtendedContexts.Pieces A k, ∀ a : A k,
      E.eval 0 (plug (ExtendedContexts.context p) (atomic a)) = E.eval 0 (plug C (atomic a))

end Lax369799.ExtendedContextDecomposition

statements.signature:
context_decomposition : ∀ {A : Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankedSet} (E : Lax369799.SetSystemAlgebras.SetAlgebra A) {k : Nat}
  (C : Lax369799.FiniteContexts.Context A k 0),
  Exists fun p =>
    ∀ (a : A k),
      Eq
        (E.eval 0
          (Lax369799.FiniteContexts.plug (Lax369799.ExtendedContexts.context p)
            (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.atomic a)))
        (E.eval 0 (Lax369799.FiniteContexts.plug C (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.atomic a)))

concepts.title: Formal unary pieces and extremal accepted situations
concepts.description:
Definition 65 retains the immediate initial and root exits as two formal
markers alongside an ordinary unary value. A closed context made from
these pieces is an ordinary finite presentation: the initial marker of
piece zero marks the hole initial, a root marker in any piece marks it
root, and an initial marker in direction i adds a self-loop in that
direction. In the syntactic algebra, planting identifies the two hole
marks. Saturating their redundant formal representations relates
Definition 85 exactly to minimal planted situations.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.ExtremalSituations

/-!
---
title: Formal unary pieces and extremal accepted situations
type: theorem
---
Definition 65 retains the immediate initial and root exits as two formal
markers alongside an ordinary unary value. A closed context made from
these pieces is an ordinary finite presentation: the initial marker of
piece zero marks the hole initial, a root marker in any piece marks it
root, and an initial marker in direction i adds a self-loop in that
direction. In the syntactic algebra, planting identifies the two hole
marks. Saturating their redundant formal representations relates
Definition 85 exactly to minimal planted situations.
-/

namespace Lax369799.ExtendedContexts
open RankedSystems (RankedSet)
open FinitePresentations FiniteContexts FiniteContextualOrder FiniteSyntacticAlgebra
open FiniteAcceptance ExpandedSyntacticAlgebra
open ExtremalContexts (Data)

inductive Marker where
  | initial
  | root
  deriving DecidableEq

instance : Fintype Marker where
  elems := {.initial, .root}
  complete := by intro m; cases m <;> simp

abbrev Piece (A : RankedSet) := A 1 × Set Marker
abbrev Pieces (A : RankedSet) (k : ℕ) := Fin (k + 1) → Piece A

def PieceBelow {A : RankedSet} (F : ClosedProperty A)
    (p q : Piece (Carrier F)) : Prop :=
  ClassBelow F p.1 q.1 ∧ q.2 ⊆ p.2

def context {A : RankedSet} {k : ℕ} (p : Pieces A k) : Context A k 0 where
  system := {
    size := k + 2
    graph := {
      label := (ExtremalContexts.normalPresentation
        (A := A) ⟨False, ∅⟩ (fun i => (p i).1)).label
      initial := fun v => v = (0 : Fin (k + 1)).succ ∨
        (v = 0 ∧ Marker.initial ∈ (p 0).2)
      root := fun v => v = 0 ∧ ∃ i, Marker.root ∈ (p i).2
      edge := (ExtremalContexts.normalPresentation
        ⟨False, {i | Marker.initial ∈ (p i.succ).2}⟩ (fun i => (p i).1)).edge
      direction_valid := (ExtremalContexts.normalPresentation
        ⟨False, {i | Marker.initial ∈ (p i.succ).2}⟩ (fun i => (p i).1)).direction_valid } }
  one_hole := (ExtremalContexts.normalContext
    ⟨False, {i | Marker.initial ∈ (p i.succ).2}⟩ (fun i => (p i).1)).one_hole

def normalize {A : RankedSet} {k : ℕ} (p : Pieces A k) : Data A k :=
  ⟨⟨Marker.initial ∈ (p 0).2 ∨ ∃ i, Marker.root ∈ (p i).2,
    {i | Marker.initial ∈ (p i.succ).2}⟩, fun i => (p i).1⟩

def canonical {A : RankedSet} {k : ℕ} (x : Data A k) : Pieces A k :=
  fun i => ⟨x.2 i, {m | match m with
    | .root => x.1.root
    | .initial => Fin.cases x.1.root (fun j => j ∈ x.1.loops) i}⟩

def Accepted {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A) (E : SyntacticAlgebra L)
    {k : ℕ} (p : Pieces (Carrier (Accepting L)) k) (a : Carrier (Accepting L) k) : Prop :=
  AcceptingClass (Accepting L) (E.algebra.eval 0 (plug (context p) (atomic a)))

def IsExtremal {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A) (E : SyntacticAlgebra L)
    {k : ℕ} (p : Pieces (Carrier (Accepting L)) k) (a : Carrier (Accepting L) k) : Prop :=
  Accepted L E p a ∧ ∀ q b,
    (∀ i, PieceBelow (Accepting L) (q i) (p i)) → ClassBelow (Accepting L) b a →
    Accepted L E q b → q = p ∧ b = a

def ExtremalElement {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A) (E : SyntacticAlgebra L)
    {k : ℕ} (a : Carrier (Accepting L) k) : Prop := ∃ p, IsExtremal L E p a

axiom normalize_canonical {A : RankedSet} {k : ℕ} (x : Data A k) :
    normalize (canonical x) = x

axiom canonical_order {A : RankedSet} (F : ClosedProperty A) {k : ℕ}
    (x : Data (Carrier F) k) (p : Pieces (Carrier F) k) :
    (∀ i, PieceBelow F (canonical x i) (p i)) ↔
      FiniteExtremal.DataBelow F x (normalize p)

axiom acceptance_normalize {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    (E : SyntacticAlgebra L) {k : ℕ} (p : Pieces (Carrier (Accepting L)) k)
    (a : Carrier (Accepting L) k) :
    Accepted L E p a ↔ FiniteExtremal.Accepts (Accepting L) E.algebra a (normalize p)

axiom extremal_iff {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    (E : SyntacticAlgebra L) {k : ℕ} (p : Pieces (Carrier (Accepting L)) k)
    (a : Carrier (Accepting L) k) :
    IsExtremal L E p a ↔ canonical (normalize p) = p ∧
      ExtremalSituations.IsExtremal (Accepting L) E.algebra (normalize p, a)

axiom element_iff {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    (E : SyntacticAlgebra L) {k : ℕ} (a : Carrier (Accepting L) k) :
    ExtremalElement L E a ↔ ExtremalSituations.ExtremalElement (Accepting L) E.algebra a

axiom extremal_choice {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    (hL : Algebras.UnfoldInvariantLanguage L) (hrec : Algebras.Recognizable L)
    (E : SyntacticAlgebra L) {k : ℕ} (p : Pieces (Carrier (Accepting L)) k)
    (a : Carrier (Accepting L) k) (ha : Accepted L E p a) :
    ∃ q b, IsExtremal L E q b ∧
      (∀ i, PieceBelow (Accepting L) (q i) (p i)) ∧ ClassBelow (Accepting L) b a

axiom replacement {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    (hL : Algebras.UnfoldInvariantLanguage L) (hrec : Algebras.Recognizable L)
    (E : SyntacticAlgebra L) {k : ℕ}
    (C : Context (Carrier (Accepting L)) k 0) (a : Carrier (Accepting L) k)
    (ha : AcceptingClass (Accepting L) (E.algebra.eval 0 (plug C (atomic a)))) :
    ∃ b, ExtremalElement L E b ∧ ClassBelow (Accepting L) b a ∧
      AcceptingClass (Accepting L) (E.algebra.eval 0 (plug C (atomic b)))

axiom simultaneous {A B : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    (hL : Algebras.UnfoldInvariantLanguage L) (hrec : Algebras.Recognizable L)
    (E : SyntacticAlgebra L) (P : FiniteSystem B 0)
    (q : ∀ v : P.Vertex, Carrier (Accepting L) (P.graph.label v).1) :
    AcceptingClass (Accepting L) (E.algebra.eval 0 (withLabels P q)) ↔
      ∃ r : ∀ v : P.Vertex, Carrier (Accepting L) (P.graph.label v).1,
        (∀ v, ExtremalElement L E (r v) ∧ ClassBelow (Accepting L) (r v) (q v)) ∧
        AcceptingClass (Accepting L) (E.algebra.eval 0 (withLabels P r))

axiom normal_test {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    (E : SyntacticAlgebra L) {k : ℕ}
    (p q : Pieces (Carrier (Accepting L)) k) (a : Carrier (Accepting L) k)
    (ha : IsExtremal L E p a) :
    Accepted L E q a ↔ ∀ i, PieceBelow (Accepting L) (p i) (q i)

end Lax369799.ExtendedContexts

concepts.title: Extended set-algebras and extremal accepted situations
concepts.description:
The formal unary pieces of Definition 65 consist of an ordinary unary
value and a set of immediate initial/root markers. Their order compares
ordinary values and reverses marker inclusion. Expanding such pieces in
a closed context and then evaluating agrees with evaluating their ordinary
parts first (Lemma 66). Context evaluation is monotone (Lemma 86), and
finite minimality supplies extremal accepted situations (Lemma 87).
These constructions apply to arbitrary set-algebras.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.ExtendedContexts
import Lax369799.SetSystemAlgebras
import Lax369799.FiniteLocalReplacement

/-!
---
title: Extended set-algebras and extremal accepted situations
type: theorem
---
The formal unary pieces of Definition 65 consist of an ordinary unary
value and a set of immediate initial/root markers. Their order compares
ordinary values and reverses marker inclusion. Expanding such pieces in
a closed context and then evaluating agrees with evaluating their ordinary
parts first (Lemma 66). Context evaluation is monotone (Lemma 86), and
finite minimality supplies extremal accepted situations (Lemma 87).
These constructions apply to arbitrary set-algebras.
-/

namespace Lax369799.ExtendedSetAlgebras
open RankedSystems (RankedSet)
open FinitePresentations FiniteContexts
open SetSystemAlgebras
open ExtendedContexts (Piece Pieces Marker)

def PieceBelow {A : RankedSet} (E : SetAlgebra A) (p q : Piece A) : Prop :=
  Below E p.1 q.1 ∧ q.2 ⊆ p.2

def evaluatePieces {A : RankedSet} (E : SetAlgebra A) {k : ℕ}
    (p : Pieces (FiniteSystem A) k) : Pieces A k :=
  fun i => ⟨E.eval 1 (p i).1, (p i).2⟩

noncomputable def expansion {A : RankedSet} {k : ℕ}
    (p : Pieces (FiniteSystem A) k) (a : A k) : FiniteSystem A 0 :=
  flatten (relabel (fun _r u => match u with
    | .inl s => s
    | .inr ⟨h⟩ => h ▸ atomic a) (ExtendedContexts.context p).system)

noncomputable def value {A : RankedSet} (E : SetAlgebra A) {k : ℕ}
    (p : Pieces A k) (a : A k) : A 0 :=
  E.eval 0 (plug (ExtendedContexts.context p) (atomic a))

def Accepted {A : RankedSet} (E : SetAlgebra A) (F : Set (A 0)) {k : ℕ}
    (p : Pieces A k) (a : A k) : Prop := value E p a ∈ F

def IsExtremal {A : RankedSet} (E : SetAlgebra A) (F : Set (A 0)) {k : ℕ}
    (p : Pieces A k) (a : A k) : Prop :=
  Accepted E F p a ∧ ∀ q b, (∀ i, PieceBelow E (q i) (p i)) → Below E b a →
    Accepted E F q b → q = p ∧ b = a

def ExtremalElement {A : RankedSet} (E : SetAlgebra A) (F : Set (A 0)) {k : ℕ}
    (a : A k) : Prop := ∃ p, IsExtremal E F p a

def UpwardClosed {A : RankedSet} (E : SetAlgebra A) (F : Set (A 0)) : Prop :=
  ∀ a b, a ∈ F → Below E a b → b ∈ F

axiom pieces_evaluation {A : RankedSet} (E : SetAlgebra A) {k : ℕ}
    (p : Pieces (FiniteSystem A) k) (a : A k) :
    E.eval 0 (expansion p a) = value E (evaluatePieces E p) a

axiom context_monotone {A : RankedSet} (E : SetAlgebra A) {k : ℕ}
    (p q : Pieces A k) (hpq : ∀ i, PieceBelow E (p i) (q i))
    (a b : A k) (hab : Below E a b) : Below E (value E p a) (value E q b)

axiom extremal_choice {A : RankedSet} (E : SetAlgebra A) (hA : RankedSystems.RankwiseFinite A)
    (F : Set (A 0)) {k : ℕ} (p : Pieces A k) (a : A k) (ha : Accepted E F p a) :
    ∃ q b, IsExtremal E F q b ∧ (∀ i, PieceBelow E (q i) (p i)) ∧ Below E b a

axiom replacement {A : RankedSet} (E : SetAlgebra A) (hA : RankedSystems.RankwiseFinite A)
    (F : Set (A 0)) (hF : UpwardClosed E F) {k : ℕ}
    (C : Context A k 0) (a : A k) (ha : E.eval 0 (plug C (atomic a)) ∈ F) :
    ∃ b, ExtremalElement E F b ∧ Below E b a ∧ E.eval 0 (plug C (atomic b)) ∈ F

axiom simultaneous {A B : RankedSet} (E : SetAlgebra A) (hA : RankedSystems.RankwiseFinite A)
    (F : Set (A 0)) (hF : UpwardClosed E F) (P : FiniteSystem B 0)
    (q : ∀ v : P.Vertex, A (P.graph.label v).1) :
    E.eval 0 (withLabels P q) ∈ F ↔
      ∃ r : ∀ v : P.Vertex, A (P.graph.label v).1,
        (∀ v, ExtremalElement E F (r v) ∧ Below E (r v) (q v)) ∧
        E.eval 0 (withLabels P r) ∈ F

end Lax369799.ExtendedSetAlgebras

concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.AutomatonProperty

/-!
---
title: Planted normal contexts and deterministic witnesses
type: definition
---
A planted normal context records the hole's root mark and self-loop
directions, together with its unary pieces. Planting merges the original
initial and root marks. The unary components of the witness construction
retain these loops; its outer presentation retains the root mark. This
extends the construction of Section 5 to ordinary holes with arbitrary
boundary data. The extremal choice and comparison inequalities require
separate proofs.
-/

namespace Lax369799.ExtremalContexts
open RankedSystems Flattening SetAlgebras AutomatonProperty

structure Boundary (k : ℕ) where
  root : Prop
  loops : Set (Fin k)

/-- The root piece has index zero; direction i uses piece i+1. -/
def normalPresentation {A : RankedSet} {k : ℕ} (B : Boundary k)
    (m : Fin (k + 1) → A 1) : Presentation (WithHole A k) 0 (Fin (k + 2)) where
  label := Fin.cases ⟨k, Sum.inr ⟨rfl⟩⟩ (fun i => ⟨1, Sum.inl (m i)⟩)
  initial := ∅
  root := fun v => v = (0 : Fin (k + 1)).succ ∨ (v = 0 ∧ B.root)
  edge := fun v d t => Fin.cases
    ((∃ i : Fin k, d = i.val ∧ t = .inl i.succ.succ) ∨
      (∃ i : Fin k, i ∈ B.loops ∧ d = i.val ∧ t = .inl 0))
    (fun _ => d = 0 ∧ t = .inl 0) v
  direction_valid := by
    intro v d t
    refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => ?_) v
    · rintro (⟨i, rfl, _⟩ | ⟨i, _, rfl, _⟩) <;> exact i.isLt
    · rintro ⟨rfl, _⟩; exact Nat.zero_lt_one

def normalSystem {A : RankedSet} {k : ℕ} (B : Boundary k)
    (m : Fin (k + 1) → A 1) : SetSystem (WithHole A k) 0 where
  size := k + 2
  graph := normalPresentation B m
  reachable := by
    let G := normalPresentation B m
    have h1 : G.Reachable (0 : Fin (k + 1)).succ :=
      ⟨_, Or.inr (Or.inl rfl), .refl⟩
    have h0 : G.Reachable 0 := by
      obtain ⟨r, hr, hp⟩ := h1
      exact ⟨r, hr, hp.tail ⟨0, rfl, rfl⟩⟩
    intro v
    refine Fin.cases h0 (fun i => ?_) v
    refine Fin.cases h1 (fun j => ?_) i
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hp⟩ := h0
    exact ⟨r, hr, hp.tail ⟨j.val, Or.inl ⟨j, rfl, rfl⟩⟩⟩

def normalContext {A : RankedSet} {k : ℕ} (B : Boundary k)
    (m : Fin (k + 1) → A 1) : SetContext A k 0 where
  system := normalSystem B m
  one_hole := by
    change ∃! v : Fin (k + 2), IsHole ((normalPresentation B m).label v)
    refine ⟨0, ⟨⟨rfl⟩, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    intro v
    refine Fin.cases (fun _ => rfl) (fun i h => ?_) v
    obtain ⟨h, he⟩ := h
    cases he

/-- Unary component U_i, with the retained loop directions at its a-vertex. -/
def component {A : RankedSet} {k : ℕ} (B : Boundary k)
    (m : Fin (k + 1) → A 1) (a : A k) (i : Fin k) : SetSystem A 1 where
  size := k + 1
  graph := {
    label := Fin.cases ⟨k, a⟩ (fun j => ⟨1, m j.succ⟩)
    initial := {0}
    root := ∅
    edge := fun v d t => Fin.cases
      ((∃ j : Fin k, d = j.val ∧ t = .inl j.succ) ∨
        (∃ j : Fin k, j ∈ B.loops ∧ d = j.val ∧ t = .inl 0) ∨
        (d = i.val ∧ t = .inr 0))
      (fun _ => d = 0 ∧ t = .inl 0) v
    direction_valid := by
      intro v d t
      refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) v
      · rintro (⟨j, rfl, _⟩ | ⟨j, _, rfl, _⟩ | ⟨rfl, _⟩)
        · exact j.isLt
        · exact j.isLt
        · exact i.isLt
      · rintro ⟨rfl, _⟩; exact Nat.zero_lt_one }
  reachable := by
    intro v
    refine ⟨0, Or.inl rfl, ?_⟩
    refine Fin.cases Relation.ReflTransGen.refl (fun j => ?_) v
    exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl.tail ⟨j.val, Or.inl ⟨j, rfl, rfl⟩⟩

/-- The outer presentation uses only unary labels. -/
def deltaPattern {A : RankedSet} {k : ℕ} (B : Boundary k)
    (m : Fin (k + 1) → A 1) (a : A k) : SetSystem (SetSystem A) k where
  size := k + 1
  graph := {
    label := Fin.cases ⟨1, atomic (m 0)⟩ (fun i => ⟨1, component B m a i⟩)
    initial := fun v => v ≠ 0
    root := fun v => v = 0 ∨ B.root
    edge := fun v d t => d = 0 ∧ Fin.cases
      (∃ i : Fin k, t = .inl i.succ)
      (fun i => t = .inr i) v
    direction_valid := by
      rintro v d t ⟨rfl, _⟩
      refine Fin.cases Nat.zero_lt_one (fun _ => Nat.zero_lt_one) v }
  reachable := by
    intro v
    refine ⟨v, ?_, .refl⟩
    refine Fin.cases (Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)) (fun i => Or.inl (Fin.succ_ne_zero i)) v

noncomputable def delta {A : RankedSet} {k : ℕ} (B : Boundary k)
    (m : Fin (k + 1) → A 1) (a : A k) : SetSystem A k :=
  flatten (deltaPattern B m a)

axiom delta_deterministic {A : RankedSet} (E : SetAlgebra A) {k : ℕ}
    (B : Boundary k) (m : Fin (k + 1) → A 1) (a : A k) :
    Deterministic E (E.eval k (delta B m a))

abbrev Data (A : RankedSet) (k : ℕ) := Boundary k × (Fin (k + 1) → A 1)

/-- Smaller data have more boundary marks and smaller unary values. -/
def DataBelow {A : RankedSet} (E : SetAlgebra A) {k : ℕ} (x y : Data A k) : Prop :=
  (y.1.root → x.1.root) ∧ y.1.loops ⊆ x.1.loops ∧ ∀ i, Below E (x.2 i) (y.2 i)

noncomputable def value {A : RankedSet} (E : SetAlgebra A) {k : ℕ}
    (a : A k) (x : Data A k) : A 0 :=
  E.eval 0 (plug (normalContext x.1 x.2) (atomic a))

def Accepts {A : RankedSet} (E : SetAlgebra A) (f : A 0) {k : ℕ}
    (a : A k) (x : Data A k) : Prop := Below E f (value E a x)

def IsExtremal {A : RankedSet} (E : SetAlgebra A) (f : A 0) {k : ℕ}
    (a : A k) (x : Data A k) : Prop :=
  Accepts E f a x ∧ ∀ y, DataBelow E y x → Accepts E f a y → DataBelow E x y

/-- Finite minimization over boundary data as well as the unary pieces. -/
axiom extremal_choice {A : RankedSet} (E : SetAlgebra A) (hA : RankwiseFinite A)
    (f : A 0) {k : ℕ} (a : A k) (x : Data A k) (hx : Accepts E f a x) :
    ∃ y : Data A k, DataBelow E y x ∧ Accepts E f a y ∧
      ∀ z : Data A k, DataBelow E z y → Accepts E f a z → DataBelow E y z

axiom data_monotone {A : RankedSet} (E : SetAlgebra A) {k : ℕ}
    (x y : Data A k) (h : DataBelow E x y) (a : A k) :
    Below E (E.eval 0 (plug (normalContext x.1 x.2) (atomic a)))
      (E.eval 0 (plug (normalContext y.1 y.2) (atomic a)))

axiom delta_in_context {A : RankedSet} (E : SetAlgebra A) {k : ℕ}
    (x : Data A k) (a : A k) :
    Below E (value E a x) (value E (E.eval k (delta x.1 x.2 a)) x)

axiom delta_boundary_comparison {A : RankedSet} (E : SetAlgebra A) (f : A 0)
    {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (x y : Data A k) (a : A k)
    (hx : IsExtremal E f a x) (hy : Accepts E f (E.eval k (delta x.1 x.2 a)) y) :
    (y.1.root → x.1.root) ∧ y.1.loops ⊆ x.1.loops

axiom delta_piece_comparison {A : RankedSet} (E : SetAlgebra A) (f : A 0)
    {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (x y : Data A k) (a : A k)
    (hx : IsExtremal E f a x) (hy : Accepts E f (E.eval k (delta x.1 x.2 a)) y) :
    ∀ j, Below E (x.2 j) (y.2 j)

axiom delta_below {A : RankedSet} (E : SetAlgebra A) (f : A 0)
    (hp : PlantInvariant E f) (hs : OrderSeparating E f) {k : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k)
    (x : Data A k) (a : A k) (hx : IsExtremal E f a x) :
    Below E (E.eval k (delta x.1 x.2 a)) a

end Lax369799.ExtremalContexts

concepts.title: The path criterion and the automaton property
concepts.description:
A regular branch is a closed unary/nullary system admitting a morphism
into the tested set-system. Lemma 95 says that a root-free set-system
with all vertices initially reachable and with no blocked unary vertex
is accepted exactly when all its regular branches are accepted, provided
its unary labels are extremal. Together with canonical direction
decomposition this is Definition 90. Corollary 96 establishes both
conditions for the rankwise-finite yield-syntactic set-algebra.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.DirectionProjections

/-!
---
title: The path criterion and the automaton property
type: theorem
---
A regular branch is a closed unary/nullary system admitting a morphism
into the tested set-system. Lemma 95 says that a root-free set-system
with all vertices initially reachable and with no blocked unary vertex
is accepted exactly when all its regular branches are accepted, provided
its unary labels are extremal. Together with canonical direction
decomposition this is Definition 90. Corollary 96 establishes both
conditions for the rankwise-finite yield-syntactic set-algebra.
-/

namespace Lax369799.ExtremalPaths
open RankedSystems (RankedSet System)
open FinitePresentations FiniteContextualOrder FiniteSyntacticAlgebra FiniteAcceptance
open ExpandedSyntacticAlgebra

def Unary {A : RankedSet} (P : FiniteSystem A 0) : Prop :=
  ∀ v, (P.graph.label v).1 ≤ 1

def RegularBranch {A : RankedSet} (G : FiniteSystem A 0) (B : System A 0) : Prop :=
  Unary (ofSetSystem B.val) ∧ Nonempty (FiniteMorphisms.Morphism (ofSetSystem B.val) G)

def HasAutomatonProperty {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A) (E : SyntacticAlgebra L) : Prop :=
  (∀ k (_hk : 1 ≤ k) (a : Carrier (Accepting L) k), ExtendedContexts.ExtremalElement L E a →
    E.algebra.eval k (DirectionProjections.parallel (DirectionProjections.direction E.algebra a)) = a ∧
    ∀ i, ExtendedContexts.ExtremalElement L E (DirectionProjections.direction E.algebra a i)) ∧
  (∀ G : FiniteSystem (Carrier (Accepting L)) 0, Unary G → G.graph.root = ∅ → Reachable G →
    (∀ v, (G.graph.label v).1 = 1 → ∃ w, G.graph.edge v 0 (.inl w)) →
    (∀ v (h : (G.graph.label v).1 = 1),
      ExtendedContexts.ExtremalElement L E (h ▸ (G.graph.label v).2)) →
    (AcceptingClass (Accepting L) (E.algebra.eval 0 G) ↔
      ∀ B, RegularBranch G B → AcceptingClass (Accepting L) (E.algebra.eval 0 (ofSetSystem B.val))))

axiom path_criterion {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    (hL : Algebras.UnfoldInvariantLanguage L) (hrec : Algebras.Recognizable L)
    (E : SyntacticAlgebra L) (G : FiniteSystem (Carrier (Accepting L)) 0)
    (hu : Unary G) (hr : G.graph.root = ∅) (hreach : Reachable G)
    (ht : ∀ v, (G.graph.label v).1 = 1 → ∃ w, G.graph.edge v 0 (.inl w))
    (hs : ∀ v (h : (G.graph.label v).1 = 1),
      ExtendedContexts.ExtremalElement L E (h ▸ (G.graph.label v).2)) :
    AcceptingClass (Accepting L) (E.algebra.eval 0 G) ↔
      ∀ B : System (Carrier (Accepting L)) 0, Unary (ofSetSystem B.val) →
        Nonempty (FiniteMorphisms.Morphism (ofSetSystem B.val) G) →
        AcceptingClass (Accepting L) (E.algebra.eval 0 (ofSetSystem B.val))

axiom selected_path_criterion {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    (hL : Algebras.UnfoldInvariantLanguage L) (hrec : Algebras.Recognizable L)
    (E : SyntacticAlgebra L) (G : FiniteSystem (Carrier (Accepting L)) 0)
    (hu : Unary G) (hr : G.graph.root = ∅) (hreach : Reachable G)
    (ht : ∀ v, (G.graph.label v).1 = 1 → ∃ w, G.graph.edge v 0 (.inl w))
    (hs : ∀ v (h : (G.graph.label v).1 = 1),
      ExtremalUnaryTypes.Selected L E (h ▸ (G.graph.label v).2)) :
    AcceptingClass (Accepting L) (E.algebra.eval 0 G) ↔
      ∀ B : System (Carrier (Accepting L)) 0, Unary (ofSetSystem B.val) →
        Nonempty (FiniteMorphisms.Morphism (ofSetSystem B.val) G) →
        AcceptingClass (Accepting L) (E.algebra.eval 0 (ofSetSystem B.val))

axiom syntactic_automaton_property {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    (hL : Algebras.UnfoldInvariantLanguage L) (hrec : Algebras.Recognizable L)
    (E : SyntacticAlgebra L) : HasAutomatonProperty L E

end Lax369799.ExtremalPaths

  Lax369799.Algebras.UnfoldInvariantLanguage L →
    Lax369799.Algebras.Recognizable L →
      ∀ (E : Lax369799.ExpandedSyntacticAlgebra.SyntacticAlgebra L)
        (G :

concepts.title: Extremal accepted situations in the syntactic algebra
concepts.description:
Sections 5.1–5.2 minimize the element in the hole as well as its context
pieces. In the syntactic algebra, planting allows context pieces to be
recorded by their unary values, a root flag, and self-loop directions.
An extremal situation is a componentwise minimal accepted pair of these
data and an element. This is the planted form of Definition 85.
Unlike extremality of context data for a fixed element, it also forces
every accepted decrease of that element to be equal to it.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.ExpandedSyntacticAlgebra
import Lax369799.ExtremalUnaryTypes
import Lax369799.FiniteLocalReplacement

/-!
---
title: Extremal accepted situations in the syntactic algebra
type: theorem
---
Sections 5.1–5.2 minimize the element in the hole as well as its context
pieces. In the syntactic algebra, planting allows context pieces to be
recorded by their unary values, a root flag, and self-loop directions.
An extremal situation is a componentwise minimal accepted pair of these
data and an element. This is the planted form of Definition 85.
Unlike extremality of context data for a fixed element, it also forces
every accepted decrease of that element to be equal to it.
-/

namespace Lax369799.ExtremalSituations
open RankedSystems (RankedSet)
open FinitePresentations FiniteContexts FiniteContextualOrder FiniteSyntacticAlgebra
open FiniteAcceptance ExpandedSyntacticAlgebra
open ExtremalContexts (Data)

abbrev Situation {A : RankedSet} (F : ClosedProperty A) (k : ℕ) :=
  Data (Carrier F) k × Carrier F k

def Below {A : RankedSet} (F : ClosedProperty A) {k : ℕ}
    (x y : Situation F k) : Prop :=
  FiniteExtremal.DataBelow F x.1 y.1 ∧ ClassBelow F x.2 y.2

def Accepted {A : RankedSet} (F : ClosedProperty A) (E : Algebra (Carrier F))
    {k : ℕ} (x : Situation F k) : Prop :=
  FiniteExtremal.Accepts F E x.2 x.1

def IsExtremal {A : RankedSet} (F : ClosedProperty A) (E : Algebra (Carrier F))
    {k : ℕ} (x : Situation F k) : Prop :=
  Accepted F E x ∧ ∀ y, Below F y x → Accepted F E y → y = x

def ExtremalElement {A : RankedSet} (F : ClosedProperty A) (E : Algebra (Carrier F))
    {k : ℕ} (a : Carrier F k) : Prop :=
  ∃ x : Data (Carrier F) k, IsExtremal F E (x, a)

axiom choice {A : RankedSet} (F : ClosedProperty A) (E : Algebra (Carrier F))
    (hfinite : ∀ n, Finite (Carrier F n)) {k : ℕ} (x : Situation F k)
    (hx : Accepted F E x) :
    ∃ y, Below F y x ∧ IsExtremal F E y

axiom replacement {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    (hL : Algebras.UnfoldInvariantLanguage L) (hrec : Algebras.Recognizable L)
    (E : SyntacticAlgebra L) {k : ℕ}
    (C : Context (Carrier (Accepting L)) k 0) (a : Carrier (Accepting L) k)
    (ha : AcceptingClass (Accepting L) (E.algebra.eval 0 (plug C (atomic a)))) :
    ∃ b, ExtremalElement (Accepting L) E.algebra b ∧ ClassBelow (Accepting L) b a ∧
      AcceptingClass (Accepting L) (E.algebra.eval 0 (plug C (atomic b)))

axiom simultaneous {A B : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    (hL : Algebras.UnfoldInvariantLanguage L) (hrec : Algebras.Recognizable L)
    (E : SyntacticAlgebra L) (P : FiniteSystem B 0)
    (q : ∀ v : P.Vertex, Carrier (Accepting L) (P.graph.label v).1) :
    AcceptingClass (Accepting L) (E.algebra.eval 0 (withLabels P q)) ↔
      ∃ r : ∀ v : P.Vertex, Carrier (Accepting L) (P.graph.label v).1,
        (∀ v, ExtremalElement (Accepting L) E.algebra (r v) ∧
          ClassBelow (Accepting L) (r v) (q v)) ∧
        AcceptingClass (Accepting L) (E.algebra.eval 0 (withLabels P r))

axiom fixed_element {A : RankedSet} (F : ClosedProperty A) (E : Algebra (Carrier F))
    {k : ℕ} (x : Data (Carrier F) k) (a : Carrier F k)
    (hx : IsExtremal F E (x, a)) : FiniteExtremal.IsExtremal F E a x

axiom split_value {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    (E : SyntacticAlgebra L) {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (x : Data (Carrier (Accepting L)) k) (a : Carrier (Accepting L) k)
    (hx : IsExtremal (Accepting L) E.algebra (x, a)) :
    E.algebra.eval k (SplitExtremal.delta x.1 x.2 a) = a

axiom normal_test {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    (E : SyntacticAlgebra L) {k : ℕ}
    (x : Data (Carrier (Accepting L)) k) (a : Carrier (Accepting L) k)
    (hx : IsExtremal (Accepting L) E.algebra (x, a))
    (y : Data (Carrier (Accepting L)) k) :
    FiniteExtremal.Accepts (Accepting L) E.algebra a y ↔
      FiniteExtremal.DataBelow (Accepting L) x y

axiom unary_selected {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    (E : SyntacticAlgebra L) (b : Carrier (Accepting L) 1)
    (hb : ExtremalElement (Accepting L) E.algebra b) :
    ExtremalUnaryTypes.Selected L E b

axiom parallel_decomposition {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    (E : SyntacticAlgebra L) {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (a : Carrier (Accepting L) k)
    (ha : ExtremalElement (Accepting L) E.algebra a) :
    ∃ b : Fin k → Carrier (Accepting L) 1,
      E.algebra.eval k (ofSetSystem (DeterministicElements.parallel b)) = a

end Lax369799.ExtremalSituations

replacement : ∀ {A : Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankedSet} (L : Lax369799.Algebras.Language A),
  Lax369799.Algebras.UnfoldInvariantLanguage L →
    Lax369799.Algebras.Recognizable L →
      ∀ (E : Lax369799.ExpandedSyntacticAlgebra.SyntacticAlgebra L) {k : Nat}
        (C :
          Lax369799.FiniteContexts.Context
            (Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.Carrier (Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L)) k 0)
        (a : Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.Carrier (Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) k),

                  (E.algebra.eval 0 (Lax369799.FiniteContexts.plug C (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.atomic b)))))
