      ∀ (E : Lax369799.ExpandedSyntacticAlgebra.SyntacticAlgebra L) (P : Lax369799.FinitePresentations.FiniteSystem B 0)
        (q :

concepts.title: Successor confinement in the extremal witness
concepts.description:
Every component of the extremal witness is attached to its own successor.
An edge starting in the i-th component either stays in that component or
exits through x_i. This property does not require extremality of the context.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.FiniteExtremal

/-!
---
title: Successor confinement in the extremal witness
type: theorem
---
Every component of the extremal witness is attached to its own successor.
An edge starting in the i-th component either stays in that component or
exits through x_i. This property does not require extremality of the context.
-/
namespace Lax369799.ExtremalSuccessors
open RankedSystems (RankedSet)
open FinitePresentations

axiom component_step {A : RankedSet} {k : ℕ} (B : ExtremalContexts.Boundary k)
    (m : Fin (k + 1) → A 1) (a : A k) (i : Fin k)
    (w : (Inner (FiniteExtremal.deltaPattern B m a).graph i.succ).Vertex)
    (d : ℕ) (t) :
    (flattenPresentation (FiniteExtremal.deltaPattern B m a).graph).edge ⟨i.succ, w⟩ d t →
      (∃ u, t = .inl ⟨i.succ, u⟩) ∨ t = .inr i

end Lax369799.ExtremalSuccessors

  (m : Fin (instHAdd.hAdd k 1) → A 1) (a : A k) (i : Fin k)
  (w : (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.Inner (Lax369799.FiniteExtremal.deltaPattern B m a).graph i.succ).Vertex)
  (d : Nat)
  (t : Sum (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.FlattenedVertex (Lax369799.FiniteExtremal.deltaPattern B m a).graph) (Fin k)),
  (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.flattenPresentation (Lax369799.FiniteExtremal.deltaPattern B m a).graph).edge
      ⟨i.succ, w⟩ d t →
    Or (Exists fun u => Eq t (Sum.inl ⟨i.succ, u⟩)) (Eq t (Sum.inr i))

concepts.title: Unary types selected by extremal refinement
concepts.description:
Unary values can themselves be refined by the extremal construction.
The selected types retain acceptance in a prescribed context and lie
below the original value. Their tests in normal contexts are principal
filters of the unary context data.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.ExpandedSyntacticAlgebra
import Lax369799.SplitExtremal

/-!
---
title: Unary types selected by extremal refinement
type: theorem
---
Unary values can themselves be refined by the extremal construction.
The selected types retain acceptance in a prescribed context and lie
below the original value. Their tests in normal contexts are principal
filters of the unary context data.
-/
namespace Lax369799.ExtremalUnaryTypes
open RankedSystems (RankedSet)
open FinitePresentations FiniteContexts FiniteContextualOrder FiniteAcceptance
open FiniteSyntacticAlgebra ExpandedSyntacticAlgebra FiniteExtremal
open ExtremalContexts (Data)

def Selected {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A) (E : SyntacticAlgebra L)
    (b : Carrier (Accepting L) 1) : Prop :=
  ∃ (a : Carrier (Accepting L) 1) (x : Data (Carrier (Accepting L)) 1),
    IsExtremal (Accepting L) E.algebra a x ∧
      b = E.algebra.eval 1 (SplitExtremal.delta x.1 x.2 a)

axiom replacement {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    (hL : Algebras.UnfoldInvariantLanguage L) (hrec : Algebras.Recognizable L)
    (E : SyntacticAlgebra L) (C : Context (Carrier (Accepting L)) 1 0)
    (a : Carrier (Accepting L) 1)
    (ha : AcceptingClass (Accepting L) (E.algebra.eval 0 (plug C (atomic a)))) :
    ∃ b, Selected L E b ∧ ClassBelow (Accepting L) b a ∧
      AcceptingClass (Accepting L) (E.algebra.eval 0 (plug C (atomic b)))

axiom normal_test {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A) (E : SyntacticAlgebra L)
    (b : Carrier (Accepting L) 1) (hb : Selected L E b) :
    ∃ x : Data (Carrier (Accepting L)) 1, ∀ y,
      Accepts (Accepting L) E.algebra b y ↔ DataBelow (Accepting L) x y

end Lax369799.ExtremalUnaryTypes

  (b : Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.Carrier (Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) 1),
  Lax369799.ExtremalUnaryTypes.Selected L E b →
    Exists fun x =>
      ∀
        (y :
          Lax369799.ExtremalContexts.Data

          (Lax369799.FiniteExtremal.DataBelow (Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) x y)

        (C :

concepts.title: Yield acceptance of finite presentations
concepts.description:
Acceptance tests the yields starting at initial or root vertices. For an
ordinary finite presentation this is computed on its reachable restriction.
This final observation does not prune intermediate substitution patterns.
The resulting isomorphism-invariant property has a contextual quotient
algebra for unpruned substitution.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.FiniteSyntacticAlgebra
import Lax369799.SyntacticOrder

/-!
---
title: Yield acceptance of finite presentations
type: definition
---
Acceptance tests the yields starting at initial or root vertices. For an
ordinary finite presentation this is computed on its reachable restriction.
This final observation does not prune intermediate substitution patterns.
The resulting isomorphism-invariant property has a contextual quotient
algebra for unpruned substitution.
-/

namespace Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance
open RankedSystems (RankedSet)
open FinitePresentations FiniteContextualOrder

def Accepting {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A) (S : FiniteSystem A 0) : Prop :=
  SyntacticOrder.Accepting L (RankedSystems.trim S.graph)

axiom accepting_isomorphic {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A) :
    IsoInvariant (Accepting L)

axiom syntactic_substitution_algebra {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A) :
    ∃ E : FiniteSyntacticAlgebra.Algebra (Carrier (Accepting L)),
      ∀ n (S : FiniteSystem (FiniteSystem A) n),
        E.eval n (relabel (quotientMap (Accepting L)) S) =
          quotientMap (Accepting L) n (flatten S)

axiom accepting_sum {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A) (S T : FiniteSystem A 0) :
    Accepting L (sum S T) ↔ Accepting L S ∧ Accepting L T

axiom accepting_system {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    (hL : Algebras.UnfoldInvariantLanguage L) (S : RankedSystems.System A 0) :
    Accepting L (ofSetSystem S.val) ↔ S ∈ L

axiom accepting_empty {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A) :
    Accepting L (empty A 0)

end Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance

concepts.title: Finite meets in a set-algebra
concepts.description:
The value of a disjoint family of atomic elements is their meet. This
includes the empty family, whose value is the greatest element. The
universal property follows from the reverse morphism axiom and
monotonicity of evaluation; no continuity axiom is needed.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.SetSystemAlgebras

/-!
---
title: Finite meets in a set-algebra
type: theorem
---
The value of a disjoint family of atomic elements is their meet. This
includes the empty family, whose value is the greatest element. The
universal property follows from the reverse morphism axiom and
monotonicity of evaluation; no continuity axiom is needed.
-/

namespace Lax369799.FiniteAlgebraMeets
open RankedSystems (RankedSet)
open FinitePresentations SetSystemAlgebras

def family {A : RankedSet} {n k : ℕ} (f : Fin k → A n) : FiniteSystem A n where
  size := k
  graph := {
    label := fun i => ⟨n, f i⟩
    initial := Set.univ
    root := ∅
    edge := fun _ d t => ∃ j : Fin n, d = j.val ∧ t = .inr j
    direction_valid := by rintro v d t ⟨j, rfl, _⟩; exact j.isLt }

def value {A : RankedSet} (E : SetAlgebra A) {n k : ℕ} (f : Fin k → A n) : A n :=
  E.eval n (family f)

axiom lower_iff {A : RankedSet} (E : SetAlgebra A) {n k : ℕ}
    (f : Fin k → A n) (x : A n) : Below E x (value E f) ↔ ∀ i, Below E x (f i)

axiom component {A : RankedSet} (E : SetAlgebra A) {n k : ℕ}
    (f : Fin k → A n) (i : Fin k) : Below E (value E f) (f i)

axiom monotone {A : RankedSet} (E : SetAlgebra A) {n k : ℕ}
    (f g : Fin k → A n) (h : ∀ i, Below E (f i) (g i)) : Below E (value E f) (value E g)

end Lax369799.FiniteAlgebraMeets

concepts.title: Automaton property of the unpruned syntactic algebra
concepts.description:
If the unary contextual sort is finite, every value in an accepting
context can be replaced by a deterministic value below it while preserving
acceptance. The proof uses the unpruned normal form and its boundary data,
without a yield-continuity axiom.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.FiniteExtremal

/-!
---
title: Automaton property of the unpruned syntactic algebra
type: theorem
---
If the unary contextual sort is finite, every value in an accepting
context can be replaced by a deterministic value below it while preserving
acceptance. The proof uses the unpruned normal form and its boundary data,
without a yield-continuity axiom.
-/
namespace Lax369799.FiniteAutomatonProperty
open RankedSystems (RankedSet)
open FinitePresentations FiniteContexts FiniteContextualOrder FiniteSyntacticAlgebra
open FiniteAcceptance FiniteExtremal

axiom automaton_property {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    (E : Algebra (Carrier (Accepting L)))
    (hE : ∀ n (S : FiniteSystem (FiniteSystem A) n),
      E.eval n (relabel (quotientMap (Accepting L)) S) = quotientMap (Accepting L) n (flatten S))
    (hfinite : Finite (Carrier (Accepting L) 1))
    {k : ℕ} (C : Context (Carrier (Accepting L)) k 0) (a : Carrier (Accepting L) k)
    (ha : AcceptingClass (Accepting L) (E.eval 0 (plug C (atomic a)))) :
    ∃ δ, Deterministic E δ ∧ ClassBelow (Accepting L) δ a ∧
      AcceptingClass (Accepting L) (E.eval 0 (plug C (atomic δ)))

axiom recognizable_automaton_property {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    (hL : Algebras.UnfoldInvariantLanguage L) (hrec : Algebras.Recognizable L)
    (E : Algebra (Carrier (Accepting L)))
    (hE : ∀ n (S : FiniteSystem (FiniteSystem A) n),
      E.eval n (relabel (quotientMap (Accepting L)) S) = quotientMap (Accepting L) n (flatten S))
    {k : ℕ} (C : Context (Carrier (Accepting L)) k 0) (a : Carrier (Accepting L) k)
    (ha : AcceptingClass (Accepting L) (E.eval 0 (plug C (atomic a)))) :
    ∃ δ, Deterministic E δ ∧ ClassBelow (Accepting L) δ a ∧
      AcceptingClass (Accepting L) (E.eval 0 (plug C (atomic δ)))

end Lax369799.FiniteAutomatonProperty

concepts.title: Bisimulation-invariant MSO on finite graphs
concepts.description:
For a finite set of proposition letters, a property of finite reachable
transition systems is MSO-definable and bisimulation-invariant if and only
if it is definable in the modal mu-calculus. This is the main theorem
`theorem:bisim-invariant-finite` of Colcombet, Doumane and Kuperberg,
revised local manuscript of 13 November 2026. Invariance is required only between finite systems.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.EffectiveFiniteTranslation
import Lax369799.MonadicSecondOrder
import Lax369799.ModalMuCalculus

/-!
---
title: Bisimulation-invariant MSO on finite graphs
type: theorem
---
For a finite set of proposition letters, a property of finite reachable
transition systems is MSO-definable and bisimulation-invariant if and only
if it is definable in the modal mu-calculus. This is the main theorem
`theorem:bisim-invariant-finite` of Colcombet, Doumane and Kuperberg,
revised local manuscript of 13 November 2026. Invariance is required only between finite systems.
-/

namespace Lax369799.FiniteBisimulationTheorem
open TransitionSystems

axiom finite_bisimulation_invariant_mso {P : Type} [Finite P]
    (L : Set (TransitionSystem P)) :
    (MonadicSecondOrder.Definable L ∧ BisimulationInvariant L) ↔
      ModalMuCalculus.Definable L

/-- A total executable translation, correct under the finite-invariance promise. -/
axiom effective_finite_bisimulation_invariant_mso {P : Type}
    [Fintype P] [Encodable P] [DecidableEq P]
    (φ : MonadicSecondOrder.Sentence P)
    (hφ : BisimulationInvariant {S | MonadicSecondOrder.Models S φ}) :
    ∀ S : TransitionSystem P, MonadicSecondOrder.Models S φ ↔
      ModalMuCalculus.Models S (EffectiveFiniteTranslation.compile φ)

end Lax369799.FiniteBisimulationTheorem

  (φ : Lax369799.MonadicSecondOrder.Sentence P),
  Lax369799.TransitionSystems.BisimulationInvariant (Set.ofPred fun S => Lax369799.MonadicSecondOrder.Models S φ) →
    ∀ (S : Lax369799.TransitionSystems.TransitionSystem P),
      Iff (Lax369799.MonadicSecondOrder.Models S φ)
        (Lax369799.ModalMuCalculus.Models S (Lax369799.EffectiveFiniteTranslation.compile φ))

concepts.title: Finite-state evaluation of terminating branch words
concepts.description:
A finite unary word followed by a nullary value is evaluated by iterated
unary application. A deterministic word automaton stores the action of
the prefix on the nullary sort. Its state set is finite whenever that
sort is finite. Infinite words require a separate acceptance condition.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.FiniteSyntacticAlgebra
import Mathlib.Computability.DFA
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Option
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Pi
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Sum

/-!
---
title: Finite-state evaluation of terminating branch words
type: theorem
---
A finite unary word followed by a nullary value is evaluated by iterated
unary application. A deterministic word automaton stores the action of
the prefix on the nullary sort. Its state set is finite whenever that
sort is finite. Infinite words require a separate acceptance condition.
-/
namespace Lax369799.FiniteBranchWords
open RankedSystems (RankedSet)
open FinitePresentations FiniteSyntacticAlgebra

def application {A : RankedSet} (b : A 1) (a : A 0) : FiniteSystem A 0 where
  size := 2
  graph := {
    label := Fin.cases ⟨1, b⟩ (fun _ => ⟨0, a⟩)
    initial := {0}
    root := ∅
    edge := fun v d t => v = 0 ∧ d = 0 ∧ t = .inl 1
    direction_valid := by rintro v d t ⟨rfl, rfl, _⟩; exact Nat.zero_lt_one }

def act {A : RankedSet} (E : Algebra A) (b : A 1) (a : A 0) : A 0 :=
  E.eval 0 (application b a)

def value {A : RankedSet} (E : Algebra A) (w : List (A 1)) (a : A 0) : A 0 :=
  w.foldr (act E) a

noncomputable def chain {A : RankedSet} : List (A 1) → A 0 → FiniteSystem A 0
  | [], a => atomic a
  | b :: w, a => flatten (application (atomic b) (chain w a))

axiom chain_evaluation {A : RankedSet} (E : Algebra A) (w : List (A 1)) (a : A 0) :
    E.eval 0 (chain w a) = value E w a

abbrev State (Z : Type) := Option ((Z → Z) ⊕ Z)

def machine {U Z : Type} (f : U → Z → Z) (F : Set Z) : DFA (U ⊕ Z) (State Z) where
  start := some (.inl id)
  step := fun s c => match s, c with
    | some (.inl g), .inl b => some (.inl (g ∘ f b))
    | some (.inl g), .inr a => some (.inr (g a))
    | _, _ => none
  accept := {s | ∃ a ∈ F, s = some (.inr a)}

axiom evaluate {U Z : Type} (f : U → Z → Z) (F : Set Z)
    (w : List U) (a : Z) :
    (machine f F).eval (w.map Sum.inl ++ [Sum.inr a]) = some (.inr (w.foldr f a))

axiom accepts {A : RankedSet} (E : Algebra A) (F : Set (A 0))
    (w : List (A 1)) (a : A 0) :
    w.map Sum.inl ++ [Sum.inr a] ∈ (machine (act E) F).accepts ↔ E.eval 0 (chain w a) ∈ F

axiom finite_states {Z : Type} [Finite Z] : Finite (State Z)

end Lax369799.FiniteBranchWords

  (w : List (A 1)) (a : A 0),
  Iff
    (Language.instMembershipList.mem (Lax369799.FiniteBranchWords.machine (Lax369799.FiniteBranchWords.act E) F).accepts
      (instHAppendOfAppend.hAppend (List.map Sum.inl w) (List.cons (Sum.inr a) List.nil)))

  Eq (E.eval 0 (Lax369799.FiniteBranchWords.chain w a)) (Lax369799.FiniteBranchWords.value E w a)

concepts.title: Context tests and simultaneous substitution
concepts.description:
The set-system clause of Lemma 42. Relations are stated on enumerated
presentations, so compatibility with the manuscript's identification up
to isomorphism is explicit. A reflexive local relation is preserved by
all contexts exactly when it is preserved by simultaneous substitution
into every finite outer shape, for a reflexive transitive target relation.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.FiniteContexts

/-!
---
title: Context tests and simultaneous substitution
type: theorem
---
The set-system clause of Lemma 42. Relations are stated on enumerated
presentations, so compatibility with the manuscript's identification up
to isomorphism is explicit. A reflexive local relation is preserved by
all contexts exactly when it is preserved by simultaneous substitution
into every finite outer shape, for a reflexive transitive target relation.
-/

namespace Lax369799.FiniteContextCongruence
open RankedSystems FinitePresentations FiniteContexts

abbrev RelationFamily (A : RankedSet) := ∀ n, FiniteSystem A n → FiniteSystem A n → Prop

def InContexts {A : RankedSet} (R R' : RelationFamily A) : Prop :=
  ∀ (k n : ℕ) (C : Context A k n) (S T : FiniteSystem A k),
    R k S T → R' n (plug C S) (plug C T)

def InSubstitutions {A : RankedSet} (R R' : RelationFamily A) : Prop :=
  ∀ (B : RankedSet) (n : ℕ) (P : FiniteSystem B n)
    (q r : ∀ v : P.Vertex, FiniteSystem A (P.graph.label v).1),
    (∀ v, R _ (q v) (r v)) → R' n (flatten (withLabels P q)) (flatten (withLabels P r))

axiom context_iff_substitution {A : RankedSet} (R R' : RelationFamily A)
    (hR : ∀ n (S : FiniteSystem A n), R n S S) (hR' : ∀ n (S : FiniteSystem A n), R' n S S)
    (htrans : ∀ n (S T U : FiniteSystem A n), R' n S T → R' n T U → R' n S U)
    (hiso : ∀ n (S T : FiniteSystem A n), Isomorphic S T → R' n S T) :
    InContexts R R' ↔ InSubstitutions R R'

end Lax369799.FiniteContextCongruence

  (∀ (n : Nat) (S : Lax369799.FinitePresentations.FiniteSystem A n), R n S S) →
    (∀ (n : Nat) (S : Lax369799.FinitePresentations.FiniteSystem A n), R' n S S) →
      (∀ (n : Nat) (S T U : Lax369799.FinitePresentations.FiniteSystem A n), R' n S T → R' n T U → R' n S U) →
        (∀ (n : Nat) (S T : Lax369799.FinitePresentations.FiniteSystem A n),
            Lax369799.FinitePresentations.Isomorphic S T → R' n S T) →
          Iff (Lax369799.FiniteContextCongruence.InContexts R R')
            (Lax369799.FiniteContextCongruence.InSubstitutions R R')

concepts.title: Contexts over finite presentations
concepts.description:
A context has one distinguished hole vertex, with no restriction on its
marks, incident edges, or reachability. Composition and substitution retain
all vertices, so an unreachable hole remains available for a later
substitution that contributes roots.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.FinitePresentations
import Lax369799.Flattening

/-!
---
title: Contexts over finite presentations
type: definition
---
A context has one distinguished hole vertex, with no restriction on its
marks, incident edges, or reachability. Composition and substitution retain
all vertices, so an unreachable hole remains available for a later
substitution that contributes roots.
-/

namespace Lax369799.FiniteContexts
open RankedSystems FinitePresentations
open Flattening (WithHole IsHole)

structure Context (A : RankedSet) (k n : ℕ) where
  system : FiniteSystem (WithHole A k) n
  one_hole : ∃! v, IsHole (system.graph.label v)

def substitution {A : RankedSet} {k : ℕ} (S : FiniteSystem A k) :
    RankedMap (WithHole A k) (FiniteSystem A) :=
  fun _ a => match a with
    | .inl a => FinitePresentations.atomic a
    | .inr ⟨h⟩ => h ▸ S

noncomputable def plug {A : RankedSet} {k n : ℕ} (C : Context A k n)
    (S : FiniteSystem A k) : FiniteSystem A n :=
  flatten (FinitePresentations.relabel (substitution S) C.system)

def insertion {A : RankedSet} {k n : ℕ} (C : Context A k n) :
    RankedMap (WithHole A n) (FiniteSystem (WithHole A k)) :=
  fun _ a => match a with
    | .inl a => FinitePresentations.atomic (Sum.inl a)
    | .inr ⟨h⟩ => h ▸ C.system

noncomputable def compositionSystem {A : RankedSet} {k n m : ℕ}
    (D : Context A n m) (C : Context A k n) : FiniteSystem (WithHole A k) m :=
  flatten (FinitePresentations.relabel (insertion C) D.system)

def interpretation {A B : RankedSet} {k : ℕ}
    (f : RankedMap B (FiniteSystem A)) (S : FiniteSystem A k) :
    RankedMap (WithHole B k) (FiniteSystem A) :=
  fun _ a => match a with
    | .inl b => f _ b
    | .inr ⟨h⟩ => h ▸ S

/-- Replace each ordinary label by its assigned finite presentation. -/
axiom extension {A B : RankedSet} (f : RankedMap B (FiniteSystem A))
    {k n : ℕ} (C : Context B k n) :
    ∃ D : Context A k n, ∀ S,
      Isomorphic (plug D S) (flatten (FinitePresentations.relabel (interpretation f S) C.system))

axiom composition {A : RankedSet} {k n m : ℕ}
    (D : Context A n m) (C : Context A k n) :
    ∃ E : Context A k m, E.system = compositionSystem D C ∧
      ∀ S, FinitePresentations.Isomorphic (plug E S) (plug D (plug C S))

end Lax369799.FiniteContexts

  (C : Lax369799.FiniteContexts.Context A k n),
  Exists fun E =>
    And (Eq E.system (Lax369799.FiniteContexts.compositionSystem D C))
      (∀ (S : Lax369799.FinitePresentations.FiniteSystem A k),
        Lax369799.FinitePresentations.Isomorphic (Lax369799.FiniteContexts.plug E S)
          (Lax369799.FiniteContexts.plug D (Lax369799.FiniteContexts.plug C S)))

  (f : Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankedMap B (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.FiniteSystem A)) {k n : Nat}

    ∀ (S : Lax369799.FinitePresentations.FiniteSystem A k),

concepts.title: Contextual preorders on finite presentations
concepts.description:
For an isomorphism-invariant property of closed finite presentations,
comparison by all one-hole contexts is preserved by substitution.
This construction does not assume a continuity axiom for algebra values.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.FiniteContexts
import Mathlib.Data.Quot

/-!
---
title: Contextual preorders on finite presentations
type: theorem
---
For an isomorphism-invariant property of closed finite presentations,
comparison by all one-hole contexts is preserved by substitution.
This construction does not assume a continuity axiom for algebra values.
-/

namespace Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder
open RankedSystems (RankedSet)
open FinitePresentations FiniteContexts

abbrev ClosedProperty (A : RankedSet) := Set (FiniteSystem A 0)

def IsoInvariant {A : RankedSet} (F : ClosedProperty A) : Prop :=
  ∀ S T, Isomorphic S T → (S ∈ F ↔ T ∈ F)

def Below {A : RankedSet} (F : ClosedProperty A) {n : ℕ}
    (S T : FiniteSystem A n) : Prop :=
  ∀ C : Context A n 0, plug C S ∈ F → plug C T ∈ F

def Equivalent {A : RankedSet} (F : ClosedProperty A) {n : ℕ}
    (S T : FiniteSystem A n) : Prop := Below F S T ∧ Below F T S

abbrev Carrier {A : RankedSet} (F : ClosedProperty A) : RankedSet :=
  fun n => Quot (@Equivalent A F n)

def quotientMap {A : RankedSet} (F : ClosedProperty A) :
    RankedSystems.RankedMap (FiniteSystem A) (Carrier F) := fun _ => Quot.mk _

def ClassBelow {A : RankedSet} (F : ClosedProperty A) {n : ℕ}
    (a b : Carrier F n) : Prop :=
  Quot.liftOn₂ a b (Below F)
    (fun _ _ _ h => propext ⟨fun g C hc => h.1 C (g C hc), fun g C hc => h.2 C (g C hc)⟩)
    (fun _ _ _ h => propext ⟨fun g C hc => g C (h.2 C hc), fun g C hc => g C (h.1 C hc)⟩)

axiom class_order {A : RankedSet} (F : ClosedProperty A) (n : ℕ) :
    (∀ a : Carrier F n, ClassBelow F a a) ∧
    (∀ a b : Carrier F n, ClassBelow F a b → ClassBelow F b a → a = b) ∧
    (∀ a b c : Carrier F n, ClassBelow F a b → ClassBelow F b c → ClassBelow F a c)

axiom contextual_congruence {A : RankedSet} (F : ClosedProperty A) (hF : IsoInvariant F)
    {k n : ℕ} (C : Context A k n) (S T : FiniteSystem A k) (h : Below F S T) :
    Below F (plug C S) (plug C T)

axiom contextual_acceptance {A : RankedSet} (F : ClosedProperty A) (hF : IsoInvariant F)
    (S T : FiniteSystem A 0) (h : Below F S T) : S ∈ F → T ∈ F

axiom contextual_iso {A : RankedSet} (F : ClosedProperty A) (hF : IsoInvariant F)
    {n : ℕ} (S T : FiniteSystem A n) (h : Isomorphic S T) : Equivalent F S T

axiom flatten_monotone {A B : RankedSet} (F : ClosedProperty A) (hF : IsoInvariant F)
    {n : ℕ} (P : FiniteSystem B n)
    (q r : ∀ v : P.Vertex, FiniteSystem A (P.graph.label v).1)
    (h : ∀ v, Below F (q v) (r v)) :
    Below F (flatten (withLabels P q)) (flatten (withLabels P r))

end Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder

  And (∀ (a : Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.Carrier F n), Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.ClassBelow F a a)
    (And
      (∀ (a b : Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.Carrier F n),
        Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.ClassBelow F a b → Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.ClassBelow F b a → Eq a b)
      (∀ (a b c : Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.Carrier F n),
        Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.ClassBelow F a b →
          Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.ClassBelow F b c → Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.ClassBelow F a c))

    ∀ (S T : Lax369799.FinitePresentations.FiniteSystem A 0),
      Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.Below F S T → Set.instMembership.mem F S → Set.instMembership.mem F T

    ∀ {k n : Nat} (C : Lax369799.FiniteContexts.Context A k n) (S T : Lax369799.FinitePresentations.FiniteSystem A k),

        Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.Below F (Lax369799.FiniteContexts.plug C S) (Lax369799.FiniteContexts.plug C T)

    ∀ {n : Nat} (S T : Lax369799.FinitePresentations.FiniteSystem A n),
      Lax369799.FinitePresentations.Isomorphic S T → Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.Equivalent F S T

  Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.IsoInvariant F →
    ∀ {n : Nat} (P : Lax369799.FinitePresentations.FiniteSystem B n)
      (q r : (v : P.Vertex) → Lax369799.FinitePresentations.FiniteSystem A (P.graph.label v).fst),
      (∀ (v : P.Vertex), Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.Below F (q v) (r v)) →
        Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.Below F
          (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.flatten (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.withLabels P q))
          (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.flatten (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.withLabels P r))

concepts.title: Finite yield approximation of contextual acceptance and order
concepts.description:
Acceptance in a context is determined by all finite sums of yields of
the inserted presentation. Consequently, comparison in the contextual
order is determined by comparison with these finite sums. The yields
are taken over the base alphabet after expansion.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.FiniteYieldContinuity
import Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance

/-!
---
title: Finite yield approximation of contextual acceptance and order
type: theorem
---
Acceptance in a context is determined by all finite sums of yields of
the inserted presentation. Consequently, comparison in the contextual
order is determined by comparison with these finite sums. The yields
are taken over the base alphabet after expansion.
-/
namespace Lax369799.FiniteContinuityOrder
open RankedSystems (RankedSet SetSystem trim)
open FinitePresentations FiniteContexts FiniteContextualOrder FiniteAcceptance

axiom accepting_approximation {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A) {k : ℕ}
    (C : Context A k 0) (S : FiniteSystem A k) :
    Accepting L (plug C S) ↔
      ∀ (m : ℕ) (F : Fin m → SetSystem A k),
        (∀ i, Morphisms.Yield (trim S.graph) (F i)) →
        Accepting L (plug C (ofSetSystem (YieldContinuity.finiteSum F)))

axiom order_approximation {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A) {n : ℕ}
    (R S : FiniteSystem A n) :
    Below (Accepting L) R S ↔
      ∀ (m : ℕ) (F : Fin m → SetSystem A n),
        (∀ i, Morphisms.Yield (trim S.graph) (F i)) →
        Below (Accepting L) R (ofSetSystem (YieldContinuity.finiteSum F))

end Lax369799.FiniteContinuityOrder

  (C : Lax369799.FiniteContexts.Context A k 0) (S : Lax369799.FinitePresentations.FiniteSystem A k),
  Iff (Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L (Lax369799.FiniteContexts.plug C S))
    (∀ (m : Nat) (F : Fin m → Lax369799.RankedSystems.SetSystem A k),
      (∀ (i : Fin m), Lax369799.Morphisms.Yield (Lax369799.RankedSystems.trim S.graph) (F i)) →
        Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L
          (Lax369799.FiniteContexts.plug C
            (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.ofSetSystem (Lax369799.YieldContinuity.finiteSum F))))

  Iff (Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.Below (Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) R S)
    (∀ (m : Nat) (F : Fin m → Lax369799.RankedSystems.SetSystem A n),
      (∀ (i : Fin m), Lax369799.Morphisms.Yield (Lax369799.RankedSystems.trim S.graph) (F i)) →

          (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.ofSetSystem (Lax369799.YieldContinuity.finiteSum F)))

concepts.title: Acceptance from finite families of covering components
concepts.description:
A finite family of presentation maps jointly covers a target if it covers
all vertices and marks and lifts every successor at each source vertex.
Acceptance of the components implies acceptance of the target.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.ExpandedSyntacticAlgebra

/-!
---
title: Acceptance from finite families of covering components
type: theorem
---
A finite family of presentation maps jointly covers a target if it covers
all vertices and marks and lifts every successor at each source vertex.
Acceptance of the components implies acceptance of the target.
-/
namespace Lax369799.FiniteCoverFamilies
open RankedSystems (RankedSet)
open FinitePresentations FiniteSyntacticAlgebra FiniteContextualOrder FiniteAcceptance
open ExpandedSyntacticAlgebra

structure JointCover {A : RankedSet} {m : ℕ} (T : Fin m → FiniteSystem A 0)
    (P : FiniteSystem A 0) where
  map : ∀ i, FiniteMorphisms.Morphism (T i) P
  edges : ∀ i v d t, P.graph.edge ((map i).toFun v) d t →
    ∃ s, (T i).graph.edge v d s ∧ Sum.map (map i).toFun id s = t
  vertices : ∀ v : P.Vertex, ∃ i w, (map i).toFun w = v
  initials : ∀ v, v ∈ P.graph.initial → ∃ i w, w ∈ (T i).graph.initial ∧ (map i).toFun w = v
  roots : ∀ v, v ∈ P.graph.root → ∃ i w, w ∈ (T i).graph.root ∧ (map i).toFun w = v


axiom acceptance {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    [Finite (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)] (E : SyntacticAlgebra L)
    {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (T : Fin m → FiniteSystem (Carrier (Accepting L)) 0)
    (P : FiniteSystem (Carrier (Accepting L)) 0) (F : JointCover T P)
    (hT : ∀ i, AcceptingClass (Accepting L) (E.algebra.eval 0 (T i))) :
    AcceptingClass (Accepting L) (E.algebra.eval 0 P)

end Lax369799.FiniteCoverFamilies

  [Finite (Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.Carrier (Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) 0)]
  (E : Lax369799.ExpandedSyntacticAlgebra.SyntacticAlgebra L) {m : Nat},
  instLTNat.lt 0 m →
    ∀
      (T :
        Fin m →
          Lax369799.FinitePresentations.FiniteSystem
            (Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.Carrier (Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L)) 0)
      (P :
        Lax369799.FinitePresentations.FiniteSystem
          (Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.Carrier (Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L)) 0)
      (F : Lax369799.FiniteCoverFamilies.JointCover T P),
      (∀ (i : Fin m),

            (E.algebra.eval 0 (T i))) →

concepts.title: Context decomposition without pruning
concepts.description:
Retain all vertices in the unary pieces and in their recomposition. The
projection covers every original vertex, including unreachable vertices,
and restores the hole's initial flag, root flag, and self-loops.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.FiniteContexts
import Lax369799.FiniteOrderedAlgebra
import Lax369799.ContextDecomposition

/-!
---
title: Context decomposition without pruning
type: theorem
---
Retain all vertices in the unary pieces and in their recomposition. The
projection covers every original vertex, including unreachable vertices,
and restores the hole's initial flag, root flag, and self-loops.
-/
namespace Lax369799.FiniteDecomposition
open RankedSystems (RankedSet Presentation)
open Flattening (WithHole IsHole)
open FinitePresentations FiniteContexts
open ContextDecomposition (Boundary CopyVertex recomposePresentation)

noncomputable def holeVertex {A : RankedSet} {k : ℕ} (C : Context A k 0) :
    C.system.Vertex := Classical.choose C.one_hole

abbrev BodyVertex {A : RankedSet} {k : ℕ} (C : Context A k 0) :=
  {v : C.system.Vertex // v ≠ holeVertex C}

noncomputable def boundary {A : RankedSet} {k : ℕ} (C : Context A k 0) : Boundary k where
  initial := holeVertex C ∈ C.system.graph.initial
  root := holeVertex C ∈ C.system.graph.root
  loops := {d | C.system.graph.edge (holeVertex C) d.val (.inl (holeVertex C))}

noncomputable def piece {A : RankedSet} {k : ℕ} (C : Context A k 0)
    (i : Fin (k + 1)) : Presentation (WithHole A k) 1 (BodyVertex C) where
  label := fun v => C.system.graph.label v.val
  initial := fun v => (i = 0 ∧ v.val ∈ C.system.graph.initial) ∨
    ∃ d : Fin k, i = d.succ ∧ C.system.graph.edge (holeVertex C) d.val (.inl v.val)
  root := fun v => v.val ∈ C.system.graph.root
  edge := fun v d t => match t with
    | .inl w => C.system.graph.edge v.val d (.inl w.val)
    | .inr _ => C.system.graph.edge v.val d (.inl (holeVertex C))
  direction_valid := by
    intro v d t ht
    cases t with
    | inl w => exact C.system.graph.direction_valid v.val d _ ht
    | inr i => exact C.system.graph.direction_valid v.val d _ ht

noncomputable def recompose {A : RankedSet} {k : ℕ} (C : Context A k 0) :
    FiniteSystem (WithHole A k) 0 := by
  classical
  exact enumerate (recomposePresentation (boundary C) (piece C))

axiom piece_has_no_hole {A : RankedSet} {k : ℕ} (C : Context A k 0)
    (i : Fin (k + 1)) (v : BodyVertex C) : ¬ IsHole ((piece C i).label v)

axiom decomposition_cover {A : RankedSet} {k : ℕ} (C : Context A k 0) :
    ∃ f : PresentationCovers.Cover (recompose C).graph C.system.graph, Function.Surjective f.toFun

axiom recompose_one_hole {A : RankedSet} {k : ℕ} (C : Context A k 0) :
    ∃! v, IsHole ((recompose C).graph.label v)

axiom decomposition_evaluation {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    (E : FiniteSyntacticAlgebra.Algebra (FiniteContextualOrder.Carrier (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L)))
    (hE : ∀ n (S : FiniteSystem (FiniteSystem A) n),
      E.eval n (relabel (FiniteContextualOrder.quotientMap (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L)) S) =
        FiniteContextualOrder.quotientMap (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) n (flatten S))
    {k : ℕ} (C : Context (FiniteContextualOrder.Carrier (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L)) k 0) :
    ∃ D : Context (FiniteContextualOrder.Carrier (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L)) k 0,
      D.system = recompose C ∧ ∀ a,
        E.eval 0 (plug D (atomic a)) = E.eval 0 (plug C (atomic a))

end Lax369799.FiniteDecomposition

decomposition_cover : ∀ {A : Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankedSet} {k : Nat} (C : Lax369799.FiniteContexts.Context A k 0),
  Exists fun f => Function.Surjective f.toFun

decomposition_evaluation : ∀ {A : Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankedSet} (L : Lax369799.Algebras.Language A)
  (E :
    Lax369799.FiniteSyntacticAlgebra.Algebra
      (Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.Carrier (Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L))),
  (∀ (n : Nat) (S : Lax369799.FinitePresentations.FiniteSystem (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.FiniteSystem A) n),
      Eq
        (E.eval n
          (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.relabel
            (Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.quotientMap (Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L)) S))
        (Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.quotientMap (Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) n
          (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.flatten S))) →
    ∀ {k : Nat}
      (C :
        Lax369799.FiniteContexts.Context
          (Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.Carrier (Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L)) k 0),
      Exists fun D =>
        And (Eq D.system (Lax369799.FiniteDecomposition.recompose C))
          (∀ (a : Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.Carrier (Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) k),
            Eq (E.eval 0 (Lax369799.FiniteContexts.plug D (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.atomic a)))
              (E.eval 0 (Lax369799.FiniteContexts.plug C (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.atomic a))))

piece_has_no_hole : ∀ {A : Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankedSet} {k : Nat} (C : Lax369799.FiniteContexts.Context A k 0)
  (i : Fin (instHAdd.hAdd k 1)) (v : Lax369799.FiniteDecomposition.BodyVertex C),
  Not (Lax369799.Flattening.IsHole ((Lax369799.FiniteDecomposition.piece C i).label v))

recompose_one_hole : ∀ {A : Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankedSet} {k : Nat} (C : Lax369799.FiniteContexts.Context A k 0),
  ExistsUnique fun v => Lax369799.Flattening.IsHole ((Lax369799.FiniteDecomposition.recompose C).graph.label v)

concepts.title: Substitution closure of deterministic values
concepts.description:
Values generated by unary and nullary labels are closed under substitution.
Choose a generating presentation for each label and flatten them together.
The resulting presentation still has only unary and nullary labels,
although its vertices may have several edges in the same direction.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.FiniteExtremal

/-!
---
title: Substitution closure of deterministic values
type: theorem
---
Values generated by unary and nullary labels are closed under substitution.
Choose a generating presentation for each label and flatten them together.
The resulting presentation still has only unary and nullary labels,
although its vertices may have several edges in the same direction.
-/
namespace Lax369799.FiniteDeterministicElements
open RankedSystems (RankedSet)
open FinitePresentations FiniteSyntacticAlgebra FiniteExtremal

axiom realization {A B : RankedSet} (E : Algebra A) {n : ℕ} (P : FiniteSystem B n)
    (q : ∀ v : P.Vertex, A (P.graph.label v).1) (hq : ∀ v, Deterministic E (q v)) :
    ∃ D : ∀ v : P.Vertex, FiniteSystem A (P.graph.label v).1,
      (∀ v, (∀ w, ((D v).graph.label w).1 ≤ 1) ∧ E.eval _ (D v) = q v) ∧
      (∀ w, ((flatten (withLabels P D)).graph.label w).1 ≤ 1) ∧
      E.eval n (flatten (withLabels P D)) = E.eval n (withLabels P q)

axiom substitution_closed {A B : RankedSet} (E : Algebra A) {n : ℕ} (P : FiniteSystem B n)
    (q : ∀ v : P.Vertex, A (P.graph.label v).1) (hq : ∀ v, Deterministic E (q v)) :
    Deterministic E (E.eval n (withLabels P q))

end Lax369799.FiniteDeterministicElements

  (P : Lax369799.FinitePresentations.FiniteSystem B n) (q : (v : P.Vertex) → A (P.graph.label v).fst),
  (∀ (v : P.Vertex), Lax369799.FiniteExtremal.Deterministic E (q v)) →
    Exists fun D =>
      And
        (∀ (v : P.Vertex),
          And (∀ (w : Fin (D v).size), instLENat.le ((D v).graph.label w).fst 1)
            (Eq (E.eval (P.graph.label v).fst (D v)) (q v)))
        (And
          (∀ (w : Fin (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.flatten (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.withLabels P D)).size),
            instLENat.le
              ((Lax369799.FinitePresentations.flatten (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.withLabels P D)).graph.label w).fst
              1)
          (Eq (E.eval n (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.flatten (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.withLabels P D)))
            (E.eval n (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.withLabels P q))))

substitution_closed : ∀ {A B : Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankedSet} (E : Lax369799.FiniteSyntacticAlgebra.Algebra A) {n : Nat}
  (P : Lax369799.FinitePresentations.FiniteSystem B n) (q : (v : P.Vertex) → A (P.graph.label v).fst),
  (∀ (v : P.Vertex), Lax369799.FiniteExtremal.Deterministic E (q v)) →
    Lax369799.FiniteExtremal.Deterministic E (E.eval n (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.withLabels P q))

concepts.title: Context evaluation in finite-presentation algebras
concepts.description:
Associativity makes context evaluation depend only on the value of the
inserted presentation. Testing quotient values in all algebra contexts
recovers their contextual order.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.FiniteSyntacticAlgebra

/-!
---
title: Context evaluation in finite-presentation algebras
type: theorem
---
Associativity makes context evaluation depend only on the value of the
inserted presentation. Testing quotient values in all algebra contexts
recovers their contextual order.
-/
namespace Lax369799.FiniteEvaluation
open RankedSystems (RankedSet RankedMap)
open FinitePresentations FiniteContexts FiniteContextualOrder FiniteSyntacticAlgebra

axiom context_evaluation {A : RankedSet} (E : Algebra A) {k n : ℕ}
    (C : Context A k n) (S : FiniteSystem A k) :
    E.eval n (plug C S) = E.eval n (plug C (atomic (E.eval k S)))

def quotientContext {A : RankedSet} (F : ClosedProperty A) {k n : ℕ}
    (C : Context A k n) : Context (Carrier F) k n where
  system := relabel (fun r => Sum.map (fun a => quotientMap F r (atomic a)) id) C.system
  one_hole := by
    have hh (v : C.system.Vertex) :
        Lax369799.Flattening.IsHole
          ((relabel (fun r => Sum.map (fun a => quotientMap F r (atomic a)) id) C.system).graph.label v) ↔
        Lax369799.Flattening.IsHole (C.system.graph.label v) := by
      change (∃ h, Sum.map (fun a => quotientMap F (C.system.graph.label v).1 (atomic a)) id
        (C.system.graph.label v).2 = Sum.inr h) ↔
        (∃ h, (C.system.graph.label v).2 = Sum.inr h)
      generalize C.system.graph.label v = t
      obtain ⟨r, a⟩ := t
      cases a <;> simp
    obtain ⟨v, hv, hu⟩ := C.one_hole
    exact ⟨v, (hh v).mpr hv, fun w hw => hu w ((hh w).mp hw)⟩

    (E : Algebra (Carrier F))
    (hE : ∀ n (S : FiniteSystem (FiniteSystem A) n),
      E.eval n (relabel (quotientMap F) S) = quotientMap F n (flatten S))
    {k n : ℕ} (C : Context A k n) (S : FiniteSystem A k) :
    E.eval n (plug (quotientContext F C) (atomic (quotientMap F k S))) =
      quotientMap F n (plug C S)

    (hE : ∀ n (S : FiniteSystem (FiniteSystem A) n),

    (h : ∀ C : Context (Carrier F) n 0,
      AcceptingClass F (E.eval 0 (plug C (atomic a))) →
      AcceptingClass F (E.eval 0 (plug C (atomic b)))) : ClassBelow F a b

concepts.title: Extremal unary data for finite presentations
concepts.description:
Unary values, the planted hole mark, and its loop directions form a finite
space when the unary quotient sort is finite. Choose an accepting datum
minimal below a given datum, with boundary inclusions reversed.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.FiniteNormalForms

/-!
---
title: Extremal unary data for finite presentations
type: theorem
---
Unary values, the planted hole mark, and its loop directions form a finite
space when the unary quotient sort is finite. Choose an accepting datum
minimal below a given datum, with boundary inclusions reversed.
-/
namespace Lax369799.FiniteExtremal
open RankedSystems (RankedSet)
open FinitePresentations FiniteContexts FiniteContextualOrder FiniteSyntacticAlgebra
open ExtremalContexts (Data)
open FiniteNormalForms (normalContext)

def DataBelow {A : RankedSet} (F : ClosedProperty A) {k : ℕ}
    (x y : Data (Carrier F) k) : Prop :=
  (y.1.root → x.1.root) ∧ y.1.loops ⊆ x.1.loops ∧ ∀ i, ClassBelow F (x.2 i) (y.2 i)

noncomputable def value {A : RankedSet} {F : ClosedProperty A} (E : Algebra (Carrier F)) {k : ℕ}
    (a : Carrier F k) (x : Data (Carrier F) k) : Carrier F 0 :=
  E.eval 0 (plug (normalContext x.1 x.2) (atomic a))

def Accepts {A : RankedSet} (F : ClosedProperty A) (E : Algebra (Carrier F)) {k : ℕ}
    (a : Carrier F k) (x : Data (Carrier F) k) : Prop := AcceptingClass F (value E a x)

def IsExtremal {A : RankedSet} (F : ClosedProperty A) (E : Algebra (Carrier F)) {k : ℕ}
    (a : Carrier F k) (x : Data (Carrier F) k) : Prop :=
  Accepts F E a x ∧ ∀ y, DataBelow F y x → Accepts F E a y → DataBelow F x y

axiom extremal_choice {A : RankedSet} (F : ClosedProperty A) (E : Algebra (Carrier F))
    (hfinite : Finite (Carrier F 1)) {k : ℕ} (a : Carrier F k) (x : Data (Carrier F) k)
    (hx : Accepts F E a x) :
    ∃ y : Data (Carrier F) k, DataBelow F y x ∧ Accepts F E a y ∧
      ∀ z : Data (Carrier F) k, DataBelow F z y → Accepts F E a z → DataBelow F y z

axiom data_monotone {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    (E : Algebra (Carrier (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L)))
    (hE : ∀ n (S : FiniteSystem (FiniteSystem A) n),
      E.eval n (relabel (quotientMap (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L)) S) =
        quotientMap (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) n (flatten S))
    {k : ℕ} (x y : Data (Carrier (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L)) k)
    (h : DataBelow (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) x y) (a : Carrier (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) k) :
    ClassBelow (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) (value E a x) (value E a y)

def Deterministic {A : RankedSet} (E : Algebra A) {n : ℕ} (a : A n) : Prop :=
  ∃ S : FiniteSystem A n, (∀ v, (S.graph.label v).1 ≤ 1) ∧ E.eval n S = a

def deltaPattern {A : RankedSet} {k : ℕ} (B : ExtremalContexts.Boundary k)
    (m : Fin (k + 1) → A 1) (a : A k) : FiniteSystem (FiniteSystem A) k :=
  relabel (fun _ => ofSetSystem) (ofSetSystem (ExtremalContexts.deltaPattern B m a))

noncomputable def delta {A : RankedSet} {k : ℕ} (B : ExtremalContexts.Boundary k)
    (m : Fin (k + 1) → A 1) (a : A k) : FiniteSystem A k := flatten (deltaPattern B m a)

axiom delta_deterministic {A : RankedSet} (E : Algebra A) {k : ℕ}
    (B : ExtremalContexts.Boundary k) (m : Fin (k + 1) → A 1) (a : A k) :
    Deterministic E (E.eval k (delta B m a))

axiom delta_in_context {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    (E : Algebra (Carrier (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L)))
    (hE : ∀ n (S : FiniteSystem (FiniteSystem A) n),
      E.eval n (relabel (quotientMap (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L)) S) =
        quotientMap (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) n (flatten S))
    {k : ℕ} (x : Data (Carrier (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L)) k)
    (a : Carrier (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) k) :
    ClassBelow (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) (value E a x)
      (value E (E.eval k (delta x.1 x.2 a)) x)

axiom delta_boundary_comparison {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    (E : Algebra (Carrier (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L)))
    (hE : ∀ n (S : FiniteSystem (FiniteSystem A) n),
      E.eval n (relabel (quotientMap (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L)) S) =
        quotientMap (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) n (flatten S))
    {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (x y : Data (Carrier (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L)) k)
    (a : Carrier (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) k)
    (hx : IsExtremal (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) E a x)
    (hy : Accepts (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) E (E.eval k (delta x.1 x.2 a)) y) :
    (y.1.root → x.1.root) ∧ y.1.loops ⊆ x.1.loops

axiom delta_piece_comparison {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    (E : Algebra (Carrier (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L)))
    (hE : ∀ n (S : FiniteSystem (FiniteSystem A) n),
      E.eval n (relabel (quotientMap (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L)) S) =
        quotientMap (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) n (flatten S))
    {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (x y : Data (Carrier (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L)) k)
    (a : Carrier (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) k)
    (hx : IsExtremal (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) E a x)
    (hy : Accepts (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) E (E.eval k (delta x.1 x.2 a)) y) :
    ∀ j, ClassBelow (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) (x.2 j) (y.2 j)

axiom delta_below {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    (E : Algebra (Carrier (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L)))
    (hE : ∀ n (S : FiniteSystem (FiniteSystem A) n),
      E.eval n (relabel (quotientMap (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L)) S) =
        quotientMap (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) n (flatten S))
    {k : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) (x : Data (Carrier (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L)) k)
    (a : Carrier (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) k)
    (hx : IsExtremal (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) E a x) :
    ClassBelow (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) (E.eval k (delta x.1 x.2 a)) a

end Lax369799.FiniteExtremal

concepts.title: Unpruned substitution preserves morphisms and unfold-equivalence
concepts.description:
Lemmas 34 and 35 and their congruence consequences (Lemmas 39 and 40),
with all vertices retained. The outer lifting uses global surjectivity
to cover roots belonging to labels at unreachable outer vertices.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.FiniteStructureTheorems

/-!
---
title: Unpruned substitution preserves morphisms and unfold-equivalence
type: theorem
---
Lemmas 34 and 35 and their congruence consequences (Lemmas 39 and 40),
with all vertices retained. The outer lifting uses global surjectivity
to cover roots belonging to labels at unreachable outer vertices.
-/

namespace Lax369799.FiniteFlatteningMorphisms
open RankedSystems FinitePresentations FiniteMorphisms FiniteStructureTheorems

axiom inner {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} (P : FiniteSystem (FiniteSystem A) n)
    (Q : ∀ v, FiniteSystem A (P.graph.label v).1)
    (f : ∀ v, Morphism (Inner P.graph v) (Q v)) :
    ∃ g : Morphism (flatten P) (flatten (withLabels P Q)),
      ((∀ v, LocallySurjective (f v)) → LocallySurjective g) ∧
      ((∀ v, Folding (f v)) → Folding g)

axiom outer {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} {S T : FiniteSystem (FiniteSystem A) n}
    (f : Morphism S T) :
    ∃ g : Morphism (flatten S) (flatten T), Folding f → Folding g

axiom outer_congruence {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} (S T : FiniteSystem (FiniteSystem A) n)
    (h : UnfoldEquivalent S T) : UnfoldEquivalent (flatten S) (flatten T)

axiom inner_congruence {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} (P : FiniteSystem (FiniteSystem A) n)
    (Q : ∀ v, FiniteSystem A (P.graph.label v).1)
    (h : ∀ v, UnfoldEquivalent (Inner P.graph v) (Q v)) :
    UnfoldEquivalent (flatten P) (flatten (withLabels P Q))

end Lax369799.FiniteFlatteningMorphisms

concepts.title: Finite iteration of context-preserving local choices
concepts.description:
Any rule that replaces a label in its current accepting context can be
iterated over all vertices of a finite presentation. The local relation
records both the original and the chosen label.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.FiniteVertexReplacement

/-!
---
title: Finite iteration of context-preserving local choices
type: theorem
---
Any rule that replaces a label in its current accepting context can be
iterated over all vertices of a finite presentation. The local relation
records both the original and the chosen label.
-/
namespace Lax369799.FiniteLocalReplacement
open RankedSystems (RankedSet)
open FinitePresentations FiniteContexts FiniteSyntacticAlgebra

axiom simultaneous {A B : RankedSet} (E : Algebra A) (F : Set (A 0))
    (G : ∀ n, A n → A n → Prop)
    (hG : ∀ k (C : Context A k 0) (a : A k), E.eval 0 (plug C (atomic a)) ∈ F →
      ∃ b, G k a b ∧ E.eval 0 (plug C (atomic b)) ∈ F)
    (P : FiniteSystem B 0) (q : ∀ v : P.Vertex, A (P.graph.label v).1)
    (hq : E.eval 0 (withLabels P q) ∈ F) :
    ∃ r : ∀ v : P.Vertex, A (P.graph.label v).1,
      (∀ v, G _ (q v) (r v)) ∧ E.eval 0 (withLabels P r) ∈ F

end Lax369799.FiniteLocalReplacement

statements.signature:
simultaneous : ∀ {A B : Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankedSet} (E : Lax369799.FiniteSyntacticAlgebra.Algebra A) (F : Set (A 0))
  (G : (n : Nat) → A n → A n → Prop),
  (∀ (k : Nat) (C : Lax369799.FiniteContexts.Context A k 0) (a : A k),
      Set.instMembership.mem F (E.eval 0 (Lax369799.FiniteContexts.plug C (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.atomic a))) →
        Exists fun b =>
          And (G k a b)
            (Set.instMembership.mem F
              (E.eval 0 (Lax369799.FiniteContexts.plug C (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.atomic b))))) →
    ∀ (P : Lax369799.FinitePresentations.FiniteSystem B 0) (q : (v : P.Vertex) → A (P.graph.label v).fst),
      Set.instMembership.mem F (E.eval 0 (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.withLabels P q)) →
        Exists fun r =>
          And (∀ (v : P.Vertex), G (P.graph.label v).fst (q v) (r v))
            (Set.instMembership.mem F (E.eval 0 (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.withLabels P r)))

concepts.title: Unions of initial and root marks
concepts.description:
For three presentations with the same labels and edges, union of their
initial and root marks evaluates to the meet of the two separate values.
The covering map folds the two copies of each vertex together.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.ExpandedSyntacticAlgebra

/-!
---
title: Unions of initial and root marks
type: theorem
---
For three presentations with the same labels and edges, union of their
initial and root marks evaluates to the meet of the two separate values.
The covering map folds the two copies of each vertex together.
-/
namespace Lax369799.FiniteMarkUnion
open RankedSystems (RankedSet Presentation)
open FinitePresentations FiniteSyntacticAlgebra FiniteContextualOrder FiniteAcceptance

axiom evaluation_union {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    (E : ExpandedSyntacticAlgebra.SyntacticAlgebra L) {n : ℕ} {V : Type} [Fintype V]
    (G H K : Presentation (Carrier (Accepting L)) n V)
    (hl : ∀ v, G.label v = K.label v ∧ H.label v = K.label v)
    (hi : ∀ v, K.initial v ↔ G.initial v ∨ H.initial v)
    (hr : ∀ v, K.root v ↔ G.root v ∨ H.root v)
    (he : ∀ v d t, (G.edge v d t ↔ K.edge v d t) ∧ (H.edge v d t ↔ K.edge v d t)) :
    E.algebra.eval n (enumerate K) = sumValue E.algebra
      (E.algebra.eval n (enumerate G)) (E.algebra.eval n (enumerate H))

end Lax369799.FiniteMarkUnion

statements.signature:
evaluation_union : ∀ {A : Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankedSet} (L : Lax369799.Algebras.Language A)
  (E : Lax369799.ExpandedSyntacticAlgebra.SyntacticAlgebra L) {n : Nat} {V : Type} [inst : Fintype V]
  (G H K :
    Lax369799.RankedSystems.Presentation
      (Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.Carrier (Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L)) n V),
  (∀ (v : V), And (Eq (G.label v) (K.label v)) (Eq (H.label v) (K.label v))) →
    (∀ (v : V), Iff (K.initial v) (Or (G.initial v) (H.initial v))) →
      (∀ (v : V), Iff (K.root v) (Or (G.root v) (H.root v))) →
        (∀ (v : V) (d : Nat) (t : Sum V (Fin n)),
            And (Iff (G.edge v d t) (K.edge v d t)) (Iff (H.edge v d t) (K.edge v d t))) →
          Eq (E.algebra.eval n (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.enumerate K))
            (Lax369799.FiniteSyntacticAlgebra.sumValue E.algebra
              (E.algebra.eval n (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.enumerate G))
              (E.algebra.eval n (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.enumerate H)))

concepts.title: Executable modal compilation from finite Boolean tables
concepts.description:
An explicit encoding orders each finite table type and makes its complete
enumeration executable. Boolean valuation, leaf and support tables compile
to positive modal transitions and then to scalar fixed-point syntax.
Every bounded word condition and its modal tests have such a finite code.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.PriorityCompilation
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Prod
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Sum
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Pi
import Mathlib.Logic.Encodable.Pi
import Mathlib.Data.Finset.Sort

/-!
---
title: Executable modal compilation from finite Boolean tables
type: theorem
---
An explicit encoding orders each finite table type and makes its complete
enumeration executable. Boolean valuation, leaf and support tables compile
to positive modal transitions and then to scalar fixed-point syntax.
Every bounded word condition and its modal tests have such a finite code.
-/

namespace Lax369799.FiniteModalData
open ModalMuCalculus ModalTransitions UnfoldAutomata

def elements (α : Type) [Fintype α] [Encodable α] : List α :=
  letI : LinearOrder α := LinearOrder.lift' (fun a : α => Encodable.encode a) Encodable.encode_injective
  Finset.univ.sort (· ≤ ·)

abbrev Data (P : Type) (u z d p : ℕ) :=
  Fin d × (Fin d → (Fin u ⊕ Fin z) → Fin d) ×
    (Fin d → Fin (p+1)) × (Fin d → Bool) ×
    ((P → Bool) → Fin z → Bool) × ((P → Bool) → (Fin u → Bool) → Bool)

def word {P : Type} {u z d p : ℕ} (t : Data P u z d p) : WordCondition u z where
  states := d
  initial := t.1
  step := t.2.1
  priority := fun q => (t.2.2.1 q).val
  final := {q | t.2.2.2.1 q = true}

def valuationFormula {P : Type} [Fintype P] [Encodable P] {n : ℕ} (ν : P → Bool) : Formula P n :=
  conjunction ((elements P).map (fun a => if ν a then .proposition a else .negProposition a))

def supportFormula {P : Type} {u z d p : ℕ} (t : Data P u z d p) (q : Fin d)
    (B : Fin u → Bool) : Formula P d :=
  let bs := (elements (Fin u)).filter (fun b => B b = true)
  .conj (conjunction (bs.map (fun b => .diamond (.variable (t.2.1 q (.inl b))))))
    (.box (disjunction (bs.map (fun b => .variable (t.2.1 q (.inl b))))))

def transition {P : Type} [Fintype P] [Encodable P] [DecidableEq P] {u z d p : ℕ}
    (t : Data P u z d p) (q : Fin d) : Formula P d :=
  disjunction ((elements (P → Bool)).map (fun ν : P → Bool =>
    .conj (valuationFormula ν) (.disj
      (if ∃ a : Fin z,t.2.2.2.2.1 ν a = true ∧ t.2.2.2.1 (t.2.1 q (.inr a)) = true
        then .box .bot else .bot)
      (disjunction (((elements (Fin u → Bool)).filter (fun B => t.2.2.2.2.2 ν B = true)).map (supportFormula t q))))))

def compile {P : Type} [Fintype P] [Encodable P] [DecidableEq P] {u z d p : ℕ}
    (t : Data P u z d p) : Sentence P :=
  let D := word t
  PriorityCompilation.sentence (fun q => ModalAcceptanceGame.ceiling D - D.priority q)
    (transition t) (ModalAcceptanceGame.ceiling D+1) D.initial

open TransitionEncoding TransitionSystems

axiom exists_table {P : Type} [Fintype P] [Encodable P] [DecidableEq P]
    (M : UnfoldAutomaton (TransitionAlphabet P)) (p : ℕ)
    (hp : ∀ q,M.condition.priority q ≤ p) :
    ∃ t : Data P M.unary M.nullary M.condition.states p,
      ∀ S,Models S (compile t) ↔ ParityWinningRegions.Winning (ModalAcceptanceGame.game M S) true
        (ModalAcceptanceGame.position M.condition.initial S.initial)

end Lax369799.FiniteModalData

statements.signature:
exists_table : ∀ {P : Type} [inst : Fintype P] [inst_1 : Encodable P] [inst_2 : DecidableEq P]
  (M : Lax369799.UnfoldAutomata.UnfoldAutomaton (Lax369799.TransitionEncoding.TransitionAlphabet P)) (p : Nat),
  (∀ (q : Fin M.condition.states), instLENat.le (M.condition.priority q) p) →
    Exists fun t =>
      ∀ (S : Lax369799.TransitionSystems.TransitionSystem P),
        Iff (Lax369799.ModalMuCalculus.Models S (Lax369799.FiniteModalData.compile t))
          (Lax369799.ParityWinningRegions.Winning (Lax369799.ModalAcceptanceGame.game M S) Bool.true
            (Lax369799.ModalAcceptanceGame.position M.condition.initial S.initial))

concepts.title: Executable finite model checking for both logics
concepts.description:
Finite graphs and set assignments are Boolean tables. Quantifiers range
over explicitly finite types, including all Boolean set assignments.
The fixed-point clauses test every pre-fixed or post-fixed subset.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.UnrestrictedLogic
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Pi

/-!
---
title: Executable finite model checking for both logics
type: theorem
---
Finite graphs and set assignments are Boolean tables. Quantifiers range
over explicitly finite types, including all Boolean set assignments.
The fixed-point clauses test every pre-fixed or post-fixed subset.
-/

namespace Lax369799.FiniteModelChecking

abbrev Graph (P : Type) (k : ℕ) :=
  Fin (k+1) × (Fin (k+1) → Fin (k+1) → Bool) × (Fin (k+1) → P → Bool)

def semantics {P : Type} {k : ℕ} (G : Graph P k) : UnrestrictedTransitionSystems.TransitionSystem P :=
  ⟨Fin (k+1),G.1,(fun v w => G.2.1 v w = true),(fun v => {p | G.2.2 v p = true})⟩

def msoCheck {P : Type} {k : ℕ} (G : Graph P k) :
    {m n : ℕ} → MonadicSecondOrder.Formula P m n → (Fin m → Fin (k+1)) →
      (Fin n → Fin (k+1) → Bool) → Bool
  | _, _, .equal x y, ρ, _ => decide (ρ x = ρ y)
  | _, _, .initial x, ρ, _ => decide (ρ x = G.1)
  | _, _, .proposition p x, ρ, _ => G.2.2 (ρ x) p
  | _, _, .edge x y, ρ, _ => G.2.1 (ρ x) (ρ y)
  | _, _, .member x X, ρ, σ => σ X (ρ x)
  | _, _, .neg φ, ρ, σ => !(msoCheck G φ ρ σ)
  | _, _, .disj φ ψ, ρ, σ => msoCheck G φ ρ σ || msoCheck G ψ ρ σ
  | _, _, .existsVertex φ, ρ, σ => decide (∃ v,msoCheck G φ (Fin.cases v ρ) σ = true)
  | _, _, .existsSet φ, ρ, σ => decide (∃ X : Fin (k+1) → Bool,msoCheck G φ ρ (Fin.cases X σ) = true)

def muCheck {P : Type} {k : ℕ} (G : Graph P k) :
    {n : ℕ} → ModalMuCalculus.Formula P n → (Fin n → Fin (k+1) → Bool) → Fin (k+1) → Bool
  | _, .top, _, _ => true
  | _, .bot, _, _ => false
  | _, .proposition p, _, v => G.2.2 v p
  | _, .negProposition p, _, v => !(G.2.2 v p)
  | _, .variable i, ρ, v => ρ i v
  | _, .conj φ ψ, ρ, v => muCheck G φ ρ v && muCheck G ψ ρ v
  | _, .disj φ ψ, ρ, v => muCheck G φ ρ v || muCheck G ψ ρ v
  | _, .diamond φ, ρ, v => decide (∃ w,G.2.1 v w = true ∧ muCheck G φ ρ w = true)
  | _, .box φ, ρ, v => decide (∀ w,G.2.1 v w = true → muCheck G φ ρ w = true)
  | _, .mu φ, ρ, v => decide (∀ X : Fin (k+1) → Bool,
      (∀ w,muCheck G φ (Fin.cases X ρ) w = true → X w = true) → X v = true)
  | _, .nu φ, ρ, v => decide (∃ X : Fin (k+1) → Bool,
      X v = true ∧ ∀ w,X w = true → muCheck G φ (Fin.cases X ρ) w = true)

def mso {P : Type} {k : ℕ} (G : Graph P k) (φ : MonadicSecondOrder.Sentence P) : Bool :=
  msoCheck G φ Fin.elim0 Fin.elim0

def mu {P : Type} {k : ℕ} (G : Graph P k) (φ : ModalMuCalculus.Sentence P) : Bool :=
  muCheck G φ Fin.elim0 G.1

axiom mso_correct {P : Type} {k m n : ℕ} (G : Graph P k)
    (φ : MonadicSecondOrder.Formula P m n) (ρ : Fin m → Fin (k+1))
    (σ : Fin n → Fin (k+1) → Bool) :
    msoCheck G φ ρ σ = true ↔ UnrestrictedLogic.msoEval (semantics G) φ ρ (fun i => {v | σ i v = true})

axiom mu_correct {P : Type} {k n : ℕ} (G : Graph P k)
    (φ : ModalMuCalculus.Formula P n) (ρ : Fin n → Fin (k+1) → Bool) (v : Fin (k+1)) :
    muCheck G φ ρ v = true ↔ v ∈ UnrestrictedLogic.muEval (semantics G) φ (fun i => {w | ρ i w = true})

end Lax369799.FiniteModelChecking

statements.signature:
mso_correct : ∀ {P : Type} {k m n : Nat} (G : Lax369799.FiniteModelChecking.Graph P k)
  (φ : Lax369799.MonadicSecondOrder.Formula P m n) (ρ : Fin m → Fin (instHAdd.hAdd k 1))
  (σ : Fin n → Fin (instHAdd.hAdd k 1) → Bool),
  Iff (Eq (Lax369799.FiniteModelChecking.msoCheck G φ ρ σ) Bool.true)
    (Lax369799.UnrestrictedLogic.msoEval (Lax369799.FiniteModelChecking.semantics G) φ ρ fun i =>
      Set.ofPred fun v => Eq (σ i v) Bool.true)

mu_correct : ∀ {P : Type} {k n : Nat} (G : Lax369799.FiniteModelChecking.Graph P k) (φ : Lax369799.ModalMuCalculus.Formula P n)
  (ρ : Fin n → Fin (instHAdd.hAdd k 1) → Bool) (v : Fin (instHAdd.hAdd k 1)),
  Iff (Eq (Lax369799.FiniteModelChecking.muCheck G φ ρ v) Bool.true)
    (Set.instMembership.mem
      (Lax369799.UnrestrictedLogic.muEval (Lax369799.FiniteModelChecking.semantics G) φ fun i =>
        Set.ofPred fun w => Eq (ρ i w) Bool.true)
      v)

concepts.title: Morphisms of unpruned finite presentations
concepts.description:
Morphisms preserve labels, marks, and transitions, including at unreachable
vertices. They lift through substitution in a fixed context. Since they
preserve yields on reachable restrictions, they reverse acceptance and
the contextual preorder defined by yield acceptance.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance
import Lax369799.PresentationCovers

/-!
---
title: Morphisms of unpruned finite presentations
type: theorem
---
Morphisms preserve labels, marks, and transitions, including at unreachable
vertices. They lift through substitution in a fixed context. Since they
preserve yields on reachable restrictions, they reverse acceptance and
the contextual preorder defined by yield acceptance.
-/

namespace Lax369799.FiniteMorphisms
open RankedSystems (RankedSet)
open FinitePresentations FiniteContexts FiniteContextualOrder FiniteAcceptance

structure Morphism {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} (S T : FiniteSystem A n) where
  toFun : S.Vertex → T.Vertex
  initial : ∀ v, S.graph.initial v → T.graph.initial (toFun v)
  root : ∀ v, S.graph.root v → T.graph.root (toFun v)
  label : ∀ v, T.graph.label (toFun v) = S.graph.label v
  edge : ∀ v d t, S.graph.edge v d t → T.graph.edge (toFun v) d (Sum.map toFun id t)

axiom accepting_morphism {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    {S T : FiniteSystem A 0} (f : Morphism S T) : Accepting L T → Accepting L S

axiom contextual_morphism {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A) {n : ℕ}
    {S T : FiniteSystem A n} (f : Morphism S T) : Below (Accepting L) T S

axiom sum_lower {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A) {n : ℕ}
    (S T : FiniteSystem A n) :
    Below (Accepting L) (sum S T) S ∧ Below (Accepting L) (sum S T) T

axiom contextual_cover {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A) {n : ℕ}
    {S T : FiniteSystem A n} (f : PresentationCovers.Cover S.graph T.graph) :
    Equivalent (Accepting L) S T

axiom sum_idempotent {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A) {n : ℕ}
    (S : FiniteSystem A n) : Equivalent (Accepting L) (sum S S) S

axiom sum_meet {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A) {n : ℕ}
    (R S T : FiniteSystem A n) :
    Below (Accepting L) R (sum S T) ↔
      Below (Accepting L) R S ∧ Below (Accepting L) R T

end Lax369799.FiniteMorphisms

statements.signature:
accepting_morphism : ∀ {A : Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankedSet} (L : Lax369799.Algebras.Language A)
  {S T : Lax369799.FinitePresentations.FiniteSystem A 0} (f : Lax369799.FiniteMorphisms.Morphism S T),
  Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L T → Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L S

sum_idempotent : ∀ {A : Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankedSet} (L : Lax369799.Algebras.Language A) {n : Nat}
  (S : Lax369799.FinitePresentations.FiniteSystem A n),
  Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.Equivalent (Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L)
    (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.sum S S) S

sum_lower : ∀ {A : Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankedSet} (L : Lax369799.Algebras.Language A) {n : Nat}
  (S T : Lax369799.FinitePresentations.FiniteSystem A n),
  And
    (Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.Below (Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L)
      (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.sum S T) S)
    (Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.Below (Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L)
      (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.sum S T) T)

sum_meet : ∀ {A : Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankedSet} (L : Lax369799.Algebras.Language A) {n : Nat}
  (R S T : Lax369799.FinitePresentations.FiniteSystem A n),
  Iff
    (Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.Below (Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) R
      (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.sum S T))
    (And (Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.Below (Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) R S)
      (Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.Below (Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) R T))

concepts.title: Scalar formulas for finite fixed-point equation systems
concepts.description:
A simultaneous least or greatest solution of finitely many positive
modal equations is expressed by ordinary nested scalar fixed points.
Eliminate the tail equations with the head variable as a parameter,
solve the head equation, and substitute that solution in the tail.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.MuSubstitution
import Mathlib.Data.Fin.Tuple.Basic

/-!
---
title: Scalar formulas for finite fixed-point equation systems
type: theorem
---
A simultaneous least or greatest solution of finitely many positive
modal equations is expressed by ordinary nested scalar fixed points.
Eliminate the tail equations with the head variable as a parameter,
solve the head equation, and substitute that solution in the tail.
-/
namespace Lax369799.FiniteMuEquations
open ModalMuCalculus TransitionSystems MuSubstitution

inductive Binder where | least | greatest

def bind {P : Type} {m : ℕ} : Binder → Formula P (m + 1) → Formula P m
  | .least, φ => .mu φ
  | .greatest, φ => .nu φ

def move (n m : ℕ) : Fin ((n + 1) + m) → Fin (n + (m + 1)) :=
  Fin.addCases (Fin.cases (Fin.natAdd n 0) (fun i => Fin.castAdd (m + 1) i))
    (fun j => Fin.natAdd n j.succ)

def headSubstitution {P : Type} {n m : ℕ} (g : Fin n → Formula P (m + 1)) :
    Fin ((n + 1) + m) → Formula P (m + 1) :=
  Fin.addCases (Fin.cases (.variable 0) g) (fun j => .variable j.succ)

def solve {P : Type} (b : Binder) : {n m : ℕ} → (Fin n → Formula P (n + m)) → Fin n → Formula P m
  | 0, _, _ => Fin.elim0
  | n + 1, m, φ =>
    let g := solve b (fun i : Fin n => rename (move n m) (φ i.succ))
    let a := bind b (substitute
      (Fin.addCases (Fin.cases (.variable 0) g) (fun j => .variable j.succ)) (φ 0))
    Fin.cases a (fun i => substitute (Fin.cases a Formula.variable) (g i))

def value {P : Type} (b : Binder) (S : TransitionSystem P) {n m : ℕ}
    (φ : Fin n → Formula P (n + m)) (ρ : Fin m → Set S.Vertex) : Fin n → Set S.Vertex :=
  match b with
  | .least => sInf {X | ∀ i, (φ i).eval S (Fin.addCases X ρ) ⊆ X i}
  | .greatest => sSup {X | ∀ i, X i ⊆ (φ i).eval S (Fin.addCases X ρ)}

axiom solve_correct {P : Type} (b : Binder) (S : TransitionSystem P) {n m : ℕ}
    (φ : Fin n → Formula P (n + m)) (ρ : Fin m → Set S.Vertex) :
    (fun i => (solve b φ i).eval S ρ) = value b S φ ρ

end Lax369799.FiniteMuEquations

statements.signature:
solve_correct : ∀ {P : Type} (b : Lax369799.FiniteMuEquations.Binder) (S : Lax369799.TransitionSystems.TransitionSystem P) {n m : Nat}
  (φ : Fin n → Lax369799.ModalMuCalculus.Formula P (instHAdd.hAdd n m)) (ρ : Fin m → Set S.Vertex),
  Eq (fun i => Lax369799.ModalMuCalculus.Formula.eval S (Lax369799.FiniteMuEquations.solve b φ i) ρ)
    (Lax369799.FiniteMuEquations.value b S φ ρ)

concepts.title: Unary normal forms without pruning
concepts.description:
Evaluate the unpruned unary pieces of a context. Together with the hole's
planted root flag and loop directions, these values describe a normal
context whose evaluation is the planted evaluation of the original.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.FiniteDecomposition
import Lax369799.ExtremalContexts

/-!
---
title: Unary normal forms without pruning
type: theorem
---
Evaluate the unpruned unary pieces of a context. Together with the hole's
planted root flag and loop directions, these values describe a normal
context whose evaluation is the planted evaluation of the original.
-/
namespace Lax369799.FiniteNormalForms
open RankedSystems (RankedSet Presentation)
open Flattening (WithHole IsHole)
open FinitePresentations FiniteContexts FiniteDecomposition FiniteSyntacticAlgebra

/-- The label of a non-hole vertex is an ordinary letter of the same rank. -/
noncomputable def ordinaryLetter {A : RankedSet} {k : ℕ} (C : Context A k 0)
    (v : BodyVertex C) :
    {a : A (C.system.graph.label v.val).1 // (C.system.graph.label v.val).2 = Sum.inl a} := by
  cases h : (C.system.graph.label v.val).2 with
  | inl a => exact ⟨a, rfl⟩
  | inr hkr =>
    have hv : IsHole (C.system.graph.label v.val) := ⟨hkr, h⟩
    exact False.elim (v.property ((Classical.choose_spec C.one_hole).2 v.val hv))

noncomputable def ordinaryPiece {A : RankedSet} {k : ℕ} (C : Context A k 0)
    (i : Fin (k + 1)) : Presentation A 1 (BodyVertex C) where
  label := fun v => ⟨(C.system.graph.label v.val).1, (ordinaryLetter C v).val⟩
  initial := (piece C i).initial
  root := (piece C i).root
  edge := (piece C i).edge
  direction_valid := (piece C i).direction_valid

noncomputable def pieceValue {A : RankedSet} (E : Algebra A) {k : ℕ}
    (C : Context A k 0) (i : Fin (k + 1)) : A 1 := by
  classical
  exact E.eval 1 (enumerate (ordinaryPiece C i))

noncomputable def plantedBoundary {A : RankedSet} {k : ℕ} (C : Context A k 0) :
    ExtremalContexts.Boundary k where
  root := (boundary C).initial ∨ (boundary C).root
  loops := (boundary C).loops

def normalContext {A : RankedSet} {k : ℕ} (B : ExtremalContexts.Boundary k)
    (m : Fin (k + 1) → A 1) : Context A k 0 :=
  ⟨ofSetSystem (ExtremalContexts.normalContext B m).system,
    (ExtremalContexts.normalContext B m).one_hole⟩

axiom algebraic_decomposition {A : RankedSet} (E : Algebra A)
    (hcover : ∀ n (S T : FiniteSystem A n) (f : PresentationCovers.Cover S.graph T.graph),
      Function.Surjective f.toFun → E.eval n S = E.eval n T)
    {k : ℕ} (C : Context A k 0) (a : A k) :
    E.eval 0 (plug (normalContext (plantedBoundary C) (pieceValue E C)) (atomic a)) =
      E.eval 0 (plant (plug C (atomic a)))

end Lax369799.FiniteNormalForms

concepts.title: Ordered syntactic algebras of finite presentations
concepts.description:
For yield acceptance, binary disjoint union induces meet on the
contextual quotient. The substitution algebra recognizes the original
language on reachable deterministic systems.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.FiniteMorphisms

/-!
---
title: Ordered syntactic algebras of finite presentations
type: theorem
---
For yield acceptance, binary disjoint union induces meet on the
contextual quotient. The substitution algebra recognizes the original
language on reachable deterministic systems.
-/

namespace Lax369799.FiniteOrderedAlgebra
open RankedSystems (RankedSet)
open FinitePresentations FiniteContextualOrder FiniteAcceptance FiniteSyntacticAlgebra

axiom sum_value_meet {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    (E : Algebra (Carrier (Accepting L)))
    (hE : ∀ n (S : FiniteSystem (FiniteSystem A) n),
      E.eval n (relabel (quotientMap (Accepting L)) S) = quotientMap (Accepting L) n (flatten S))
    {n : ℕ} (a b c : Carrier (Accepting L) n) :
    ClassBelow (Accepting L) c (sumValue E a b) ↔
      ClassBelow (Accepting L) c a ∧ ClassBelow (Accepting L) c b

axiom language_recognition {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    (hL : Algebras.UnfoldInvariantLanguage L) :
    ∃ E : Algebra (Carrier (Accepting L)), ∃ P : Set (Carrier (Accepting L) 0),
      ∀ S : RankedSystems.System A 0,
        E.eval 0 (relabel (fun r a => quotientMap (Accepting L) r (atomic a))
          (ofSetSystem S.val)) ∈ P ↔ S ∈ L

axiom principal_acceptance {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    (E : Algebra (Carrier (Accepting L)))
    (hE : ∀ n (S : FiniteSystem (FiniteSystem A) n),
      E.eval n (relabel (quotientMap (Accepting L)) S) = quotientMap (Accepting L) n (flatten S))
    (hfinite : Finite (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)) :
    ∃ p, ∀ a, AcceptingClass (Accepting L) a ↔ ClassBelow (Accepting L) p a

axiom evaluation_morphism {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    (E : Algebra (Carrier (Accepting L)))
    (hE : ∀ n (S : FiniteSystem (FiniteSystem A) n),
      E.eval n (relabel (quotientMap (Accepting L)) S) = quotientMap (Accepting L) n (flatten S))
    {n : ℕ} {S T : FiniteSystem (Carrier (Accepting L)) n} (f : FiniteMorphisms.Morphism S T) :
    ClassBelow (Accepting L) (E.eval n T) (E.eval n S)

axiom evaluation_cover {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    (E : Algebra (Carrier (Accepting L)))
    (hE : ∀ n (S : FiniteSystem (FiniteSystem A) n),
      E.eval n (relabel (quotientMap (Accepting L)) S) = quotientMap (Accepting L) n (flatten S))
    {n : ℕ} {S T : FiniteSystem (Carrier (Accepting L)) n}
    (f : PresentationCovers.Cover S.graph T.graph) (hf : Function.Surjective f.toFun) :
    E.eval n S = E.eval n T

end Lax369799.FiniteOrderedAlgebra

    Exists fun E =>
      Exists fun P =>
        ∀ (S : Lax369799.RankedSystems.System A 0),
          Iff
            (Set.instMembership.mem P
              (E.eval 0
                (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.relabel
                  (fun r a =>
                    Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.quotientMap (Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) r
                      (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.atomic a))
                  (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.ofSetSystem S.val))))
            (Set.instMembership.mem L S)
