  (E :
    Lax369799.FiniteSyntacticAlgebra.Algebra
      (Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.Carrier (Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L))),
  (∀ (n : Nat) (S : Lax369799.FinitePresentations.FiniteSystem (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.FiniteSystem A) n),
      Eq
        (E.eval n
          (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.relabel
            (Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.quotientMap (Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L)) S))
        (Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.quotientMap (Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) n
          (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.flatten S))) →
    Finite (Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.Carrier (Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) 0) →
      Exists fun p =>
        ∀ (a : Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.Carrier (Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) 0),
          Iff (Lax369799.FiniteSyntacticAlgebra.AcceptingClass (Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) a)
            (Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.ClassBelow (Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) p a)

sum_value_meet : ∀ {A : Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankedSet} (L : Lax369799.Algebras.Language A)
  (E :
    Lax369799.FiniteSyntacticAlgebra.Algebra
      (Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.Carrier (Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L))),
  (∀ (n : Nat) (S : Lax369799.FinitePresentations.FiniteSystem (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.FiniteSystem A) n),
      Eq
        (E.eval n
          (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.relabel
            (Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.quotientMap (Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L)) S))
        (Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.quotientMap (Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) n
          (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.flatten S))) →
    ∀ {n : Nat} (a b c : Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.Carrier (Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) n),
      Iff
        (Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.ClassBelow (Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) c
          (Lax369799.FiniteSyntacticAlgebra.sumValue E a b))
        (And (Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.ClassBelow (Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) c a)
          (Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.ClassBelow (Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) c b))

concepts.title: Positional determinacy of finite parity games
concepts.description:
A finite parity game admits positional winning strategies for both
players on their winning regions. The arena is total. In this interface
the greatest priority occurring infinitely often is even for Eve to win;
reversing a bounded priority function converts this to the least-priority
convention.
concepts.sourceText:
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Basic
import Mathlib.Algebra.Group.Nat.Even

/-!
---
title: Positional determinacy of finite parity games
type: theorem
---
A finite parity game admits positional winning strategies for both
players on their winning regions. The arena is total. In this interface
the greatest priority occurring infinitely often is even for Eve to win;
reversing a bounded priority function converts this to the least-priority
convention.
-/

namespace Lax369799.FiniteParityGames

structure Game (V : Type) where
  eve : V → Prop
  edge : V → V → Prop
  priority : V → ℕ
  total : ∀ v, ∃ w, edge v w

def Game.IsPlay {V : Type} (G : Game V) (p : ℕ → V) : Prop :=
  ∀ n, G.edge (p n) (p (n + 1))

def Game.EveWins {V : Type} (G : Game V) (p : ℕ → V) : Prop :=
  ∃ c, ((∀ N, ∃ n, N ≤ n ∧ G.priority (p n) = c) ∧
    (∀ b, c < b → ¬ ∀ N, ∃ n, N ≤ n ∧ G.priority (p n) = b)) ∧ Even c

def Game.Legal {V : Type} (G : Game V) (eve : Bool) (f : V → V) : Prop :=
  ∀ v, (G.eve v ↔ eve = true) → G.edge v (f v)

def Game.Consistent {V : Type} (G : Game V) (eve : Bool)
    (f : V → V) (p : ℕ → V) : Prop :=
  ∀ n, (G.eve (p n) ↔ eve = true) → p (n + 1) = f (p n)

def Game.WinsFrom {V : Type} (G : Game V) (eve : Bool) (f : V → V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  ∀ p, G.IsPlay p → p 0 = v → G.Consistent eve f p → (G.EveWins p ↔ eve = true)

axiom positional_determinacy {V : Type} [Finite V] (G : Game V) :
    ∃ f g : V → V, G.Legal true f ∧ G.Legal false g ∧
      ∀ v, G.WinsFrom true f v ∨ G.WinsFrom false g v

end Lax369799.FiniteParityGames

statements.signature:
positional_determinacy : ∀ {V : Type} [Finite V] (G : Lax369799.FiniteParityGames.Game V),
  Exists fun f =>
    Exists fun g =>
      And (G.Legal Bool.true f)
        (And (G.Legal Bool.false g) (∀ (v : V), Or (G.WinsFrom Bool.true f v) (G.WinsFrom Bool.false g v)))

concepts.title: Evaluation of finite path graphs
concepts.description:
The graph with one vertex for each unary letter and a final nullary
vertex evaluates to the iterated unary action on the nullary value.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.FiniteBranchWords

/-!
---
title: Evaluation of finite path graphs
type: theorem
---
The graph with one vertex for each unary letter and a final nullary
vertex evaluates to the iterated unary action on the nullary value.
-/
namespace Lax369799.FinitePathEvaluation
open RankedSystems (RankedSet)
open FinitePresentations FiniteSyntacticAlgebra FiniteBranchWords

def path {A : RankedSet} {k : ℕ} (w : Fin k → A 1) (a : A 0) : FiniteSystem A 0 where
  size := k + 1
  graph := {
    label := Fin.lastCases ⟨0, a⟩ (fun i => ⟨1, w i⟩)
    initial := {0}
    root := ∅
    edge := fun v d t => ∃ i : Fin k, v = i.castSucc ∧ d = 0 ∧ t = .inl i.succ
    direction_valid := by rintro v d t ⟨i, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩; simp }


axiom evaluation {A : RankedSet} (E : Algebra A) {k : ℕ}
    (w : Fin k → A 1) (a : A 0) :
    E.eval 0 (path w a) = value E (List.ofFn w) a

end Lax369799.FinitePathEvaluation

evaluation : ∀ {A : Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankedSet} (E : Lax369799.FiniteSyntacticAlgebra.Algebra A) {k : Nat} (w : Fin k → A 1)
  (a : A 0),
  Eq (E.eval 0 (Lax369799.FinitePathEvaluation.path w a)) (Lax369799.FiniteBranchWords.value E (List.ofFn w) a)

concepts.title: Planting finite presentations
concepts.description:
Planting moves initial vertices to roots. Since acceptance checks both
initial and root yields, planting preserves acceptance.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance

/-!
---
title: Planting finite presentations
type: theorem
---
Planting moves initial vertices to roots. Since acceptance checks both
initial and root yields, planting preserves acceptance.
-/
namespace Lax369799.FinitePlant
open RankedSystems (RankedSet)
open FinitePresentations FiniteAcceptance

axiom accepting_plant {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A) (S : FiniteSystem A 0) :
    Accepting L (plant S) ↔ Accepting L S

axiom flatten_plant {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} (S : FiniteSystem (FiniteSystem A) n) :
    Isomorphic (flatten (plant S)) (plant (flatten S))

axiom accepting_evaluation_plant {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    (E : FiniteSyntacticAlgebra.Algebra (FiniteContextualOrder.Carrier (Accepting L)))

        FiniteContextualOrder.quotientMap (Accepting L) n (flatten S))
    (P : FiniteSystem (FiniteContextualOrder.Carrier (Accepting L)) 0) :
    FiniteSyntacticAlgebra.AcceptingClass (Accepting L) (E.eval 0 (plant P)) ↔
      FiniteSyntacticAlgebra.AcceptingClass (Accepting L) (E.eval 0 P)

end Lax369799.FinitePlant

concepts.title: Finite presentations without reachability pruning
concepts.description:
Finite presentations retain every vertex during substitution. Reachability
is an additional property, rather than a restriction on intermediate
presentations. This distinction is needed for associativity when labels
may themselves contain roots: an intermediate unreachable vertex may
carry a label with a root that becomes visible at the next substitution.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.RankedSystems

/-!
---
title: Finite presentations without reachability pruning
type: definition
---
Finite presentations retain every vertex during substitution. Reachability
is an additional property, rather than a restriction on intermediate
presentations. This distinction is needed for associativity when labels
may themselves contain roots: an intermediate unreachable vertex may
carry a label with a root that becomes visible at the next substitution.
-/

namespace Lax369799.FinitePresentations
open RankedSystems

structure FiniteSystem (A : RankedSet) (n : ℕ) where
  size : ℕ
  graph : Presentation A n (Fin size)

abbrev FiniteSystem.Vertex {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} (S : FiniteSystem A n) := Fin S.size

def Reachable {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} (S : FiniteSystem A n) : Prop :=
  ∀ v, S.graph.Reachable v

def ofSetSystem {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} (S : SetSystem A n) : FiniteSystem A n :=
  ⟨S.size, S.graph⟩

def atomic {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} (a : A n) : FiniteSystem A n :=
  ofSetSystem (RankedSystems.atomic a)

def reindex {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} {V W : Type}
    (G : Presentation A n V) (e : V ≃ W) : Presentation A n W where
  label := fun w => G.label (e.symm w)
  initial := fun w => G.initial (e.symm w)
  root := fun w => G.root (e.symm w)
  edge := fun w d t => G.edge (e.symm w) d (Sum.map e.symm id t)
  direction_valid := fun _ d _ h => G.direction_valid _ d _ h

noncomputable def enumerate {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} {V : Type} [Fintype V]
    (G : Presentation A n V) : FiniteSystem A n :=
  ⟨Fintype.card V, reindex G (Fintype.equivFin V)⟩

def sumPresentation {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} {V W : Type}
    (G : Presentation A n V) (H : Presentation A n W) : Presentation A n (V ⊕ W) where
  label := Sum.elim G.label H.label
  initial := Sum.elim G.initial H.initial
  root := Sum.elim G.root H.root
  edge := fun v d t => match v with
    | .inl v => ∃ s, G.edge v d s ∧ t = Sum.map Sum.inl id s
    | .inr w => ∃ s, H.edge w d s ∧ t = Sum.map Sum.inr id s
  direction_valid := by
    intro v d t h
    cases v with
    | inl v => obtain ⟨s, hs, _⟩ := h; exact G.direction_valid v d s hs
    | inr w => obtain ⟨s, hs, _⟩ := h; exact H.direction_valid w d s hs

noncomputable def sum {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} (S T : FiniteSystem A n) : FiniteSystem A n :=
  enumerate (sumPresentation S.graph T.graph)

/-- The presentation with no vertices. -/
def empty (A : RankedSet) (n : ℕ) : FiniteSystem A n where
  size := 0
  graph := {
    label := Fin.elim0
    initial := ∅
    root := ∅
    edge := fun _ _ _ => False
    direction_valid := fun v => Fin.elim0 v }

/-- Turn all initial vertices into roots without deleting vertices. -/
def plant {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} (S : FiniteSystem A n) : FiniteSystem A n where
  size := S.size
  graph := { S.graph with initial := ∅, root := S.graph.root ∪ S.graph.initial }

/-- A two-component pattern for disjoint union. -/
def binary {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} (a b : A n) : FiniteSystem A n where
  size := 2
  graph := {
    label := Fin.cases ⟨n, a⟩ (fun _ => ⟨n, b⟩)
    initial := Set.univ
    root := ∅
    edge := fun _ d t => ∃ i : Fin n, d = i.val ∧ t = .inr i
    direction_valid := by
      rintro v d t ⟨i, rfl, _⟩
      exact Fin.cases i.isLt (fun _ => i.isLt) v }

abbrev Inner {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} {V : Type}
    (P : Presentation (FiniteSystem A) n V) (v : V) := (P.label v).2

/-- A vertex of a flattened presentation retains its outer and inner positions. -/
abbrev FlattenedVertex {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} {V : Type}
    (P : Presentation (FiniteSystem A) n V) := (v : V) × (Inner P v).Vertex

def flattenPresentation {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} {V : Type}
    (P : Presentation (FiniteSystem A) n V) :
    Presentation A n (FlattenedVertex P) where
  label := fun v => (Inner P v.1).graph.label v.2
  initial := fun v => P.initial v.1 ∧ (Inner P v.1).graph.initial v.2
  root := fun v => (Inner P v.1).graph.root v.2 ∨
    (P.root v.1 ∧ (Inner P v.1).graph.initial v.2)
  edge := fun v d t =>
    (∃ w, (Inner P v.1).graph.edge v.2 d (.inl w) ∧ t = .inl ⟨v.1, w⟩) ∨
    (∃ i : Fin (P.label v.1).1, (Inner P v.1).graph.edge v.2 d (.inr i) ∧
      ((∃ w : (v : V) × (Inner P v).Vertex,
        P.edge v.1 i.val (.inl w.1) ∧ (Inner P w.1).graph.initial w.2 ∧ t = .inl w) ∨
       (∃ j, P.edge v.1 i.val (.inr j) ∧ t = .inr j)))
  direction_valid := by
    intro v d t h
    rcases h with ⟨w, hw, _⟩ | ⟨i, hi, _⟩
    · exact (Inner P v.1).graph.direction_valid _ d _ hw
    · exact (Inner P v.1).graph.direction_valid _ d _ hi

noncomputable def flatten {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ}
    (S : FiniteSystem (FiniteSystem A) n) : FiniteSystem A n :=
  enumerate (flattenPresentation S.graph)

def relabel {A B : RankedSet} (f : RankedMap A B) {n : ℕ}
    (S : FiniteSystem A n) : FiniteSystem B n where
  size := S.size
  graph := {
    label := fun v => ⟨(S.graph.label v).1, f _ (S.graph.label v).2⟩
    initial := S.graph.initial
    root := S.graph.root
    edge := S.graph.edge
    direction_valid := S.graph.direction_valid }

def withLabels {A B : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} (P : FiniteSystem B n)
    (q : ∀ v : P.Vertex, A (P.graph.label v).1) : FiniteSystem A n where
  size := P.size
  graph := {
    label := fun v => ⟨(P.graph.label v).1, q v⟩
    initial := P.graph.initial
    root := P.graph.root
    edge := P.graph.edge
    direction_valid := P.graph.direction_valid }

structure PresentationIso {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} {V W : Type}
    (G : Presentation A n V) (H : Presentation A n W) where
  vertex : V ≃ W
  label : ∀ v, H.label (vertex v) = G.label v
  initial : ∀ v, H.initial (vertex v) ↔ G.initial v
  root : ∀ v, H.root (vertex v) ↔ G.root v
  edge : ∀ v d t, H.edge (vertex v) d (Sum.map vertex id t) ↔ G.edge v d t

def Isomorphic {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} (S T : FiniteSystem A n) : Prop :=
  Nonempty (PresentationIso S.graph T.graph)

axiom flatten_associative {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ}
    (S : FiniteSystem (FiniteSystem (FiniteSystem A)) n) :
    Isomorphic (flatten (flatten S)) (flatten (relabel (fun _ T => flatten T) S))

axiom outer_atomic {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} (S : FiniteSystem A n) :
    Isomorphic (flatten (atomic S)) S

axiom inner_atomic {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} (S : FiniteSystem A n) :
    Isomorphic (flatten (relabel (fun _ a => atomic a) S)) S

axiom flatten_natural {A B : RankedSet} (f : RankedMap A B) {n : ℕ}
    (S : FiniteSystem (FiniteSystem A) n) :
    relabel f (flatten S) = flatten (relabel (fun _ T => relabel f T) S)

axiom flatten_binary {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} (S T : FiniteSystem A n) :
    Isomorphic (flatten (binary S T)) (sum S T)

end Lax369799.FinitePresentations

concepts.title: Small profiles of finite presentations
concepts.description:
Initial and root profiles observe the reachable restriction of a finite
presentation. Their small versions range over a finite set when every
sort of the observing algebra is finite. Every contextual class also has
a reachable representative.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.FiniteMorphisms
import Lax369799.SyntacticAlgebraTheorems

/-!
---
title: Small profiles of finite presentations
type: theorem
---
Initial and root profiles observe the reachable restriction of a finite
presentation. Their small versions range over a finite set when every
sort of the observing algebra is finite. Every contextual class also has
a reachable representative.
-/
namespace Lax369799.FiniteProfiles
open RankedSystems (RankedSet RankwiseFinite)
open FinitePresentations FiniteContextualOrder FiniteAcceptance

def SmallProfileEquivalent {A B : RankedSet}
    (ρ : ∀ n, RankedSystems.System A n → B n) {n : ℕ} (S T : FiniteSystem A n) : Prop :=
  Resolutions.SmallProfileEquivalent ρ (RankedSystems.trim S.graph) (RankedSystems.trim T.graph)

axiom small_profile_finite {A B : RankedSet} (hB : RankwiseFinite B)
    (ρ : ∀ n, RankedSystems.System A n → B n) (n : ℕ) :
    Finite (Quot (@SmallProfileEquivalent A B ρ n))

/-- A bound independent of the algebra permits an additional identity continuation. -/
def BoundedProfile {A B : RankedSet} (bound : ℕ)
    (ρ : ∀ n, RankedSystems.System A n → B n) {n : ℕ}
    (S : RankedSystems.SetSystem A n) : Set (Resolutions.ProfileEntry B n) :=
  {e | e ∈ Resolutions.Profile ρ S ∧ ∀ j, Nat.card {i // e.2.2 i = j} ≤ bound}

def BoundedProfileEquivalent {A B : RankedSet} (bound : ℕ)
    (ρ : ∀ n, RankedSystems.System A n → B n) {n : ℕ} (S T : FiniteSystem A n) : Prop :=
  BoundedProfile bound ρ (RankedSystems.trim S.graph) =
      BoundedProfile bound ρ (RankedSystems.trim T.graph) ∧
  BoundedProfile bound ρ (RankedSystems.uproot (RankedSystems.trim S.graph)) =
      BoundedProfile bound ρ (RankedSystems.uproot (RankedSystems.trim T.graph))

axiom bounded_profile_finite {A B : RankedSet} (hB : RankwiseFinite B) (bound : ℕ)
    (ρ : ∀ n, RankedSystems.System A n → B n) (n : ℕ) :
    Finite (Quot (@BoundedProfileEquivalent A B bound ρ n))

axiom reachable_representative {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A) {n : ℕ}
    (a : Carrier (Accepting L) n) :
    ∃ S : RankedSystems.SetSystem A n, quotientMap (Accepting L) n (ofSetSystem S) = a

end Lax369799.FiniteProfiles

  Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankwiseFinite B →
    ∀ (bound : Nat) (ρ : (n : Nat) → Lax369799.RankedSystems.System A n → B n) (n : Nat),
      Finite (Quot (Lax369799.FiniteProfiles.BoundedProfileEquivalent bound ρ))

    Eq
      (Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.quotientMap (Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) n
        (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.ofSetSystem S))
      a

concepts.title: Eventual membership in finite families
concepts.description:
For a sequence of subsets of a finite set, every sufficiently late set
contains only elements occurring infinitely often. One threshold works
for finitely many such sequences. This is the finite stabilization step
for the compressed transitions in Lemma 108.
concepts.sourceText:
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Basic
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.EquivFin
import Mathlib.Data.Finset.Lattice.Fold

/-!
---
title: Eventual membership in finite families
type: theorem
---
For a sequence of subsets of a finite set, every sufficiently late set
contains only elements occurring infinitely often. One threshold works
for finitely many such sequences. This is the finite stabilization step
for the compressed transitions in Lemma 108.
-/

namespace Lax369799.FiniteRecurrence

def Recurrent {X : Type} (F : ℕ → Set X) : Set X :=
  {x | ∀ N, ∃ k, N ≤ k ∧ x ∈ F k}

axiom eventual_subset {X : Type} [Finite X] (F : ℕ → Set X) :
    ∃ N, ∀ k, N ≤ k → F k ⊆ Recurrent F

axiom simultaneous {I X : Type} [Finite I] [Finite X] (F : I → ℕ → Set X) :
    ∃ N, ∀ i k, N ≤ k → F i k ⊆ Recurrent (F i)

end Lax369799.FiniteRecurrence

  Exists fun N => ∀ (k : Nat), instLENat.le N k → Set.instLE.le (F k) (Lax369799.FiniteRecurrence.Recurrent F)

  Exists fun N =>
    ∀ (i : I) (k : Nat), instLENat.le N k → Set.instLE.le (F i k) (Lax369799.FiniteRecurrence.Recurrent (F i))

concepts.title: Variable renaming and inverse renaming without pruning
concepts.description:
Direct images and inverse images of variable edges retain all vertices.
Their adjunction is Lemma 17 of the revised manuscript. Both operations
preserve morphisms, local surjectivity, and foldings.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.FiniteStructureTheorems

/-!
---
title: Variable renaming and inverse renaming without pruning
type: theorem
---
Direct images and inverse images of variable edges retain all vertices.
Their adjunction is Lemma 17 of the revised manuscript. Both operations
preserve morphisms, local surjectivity, and foldings.
-/

namespace Lax369799.FiniteRenaming
open RankedSystems FinitePresentations FiniteMorphisms FiniteStructureTheorems

def push {A : RankedSet} {m n : ℕ} (σ : Fin m → Fin n) (S : FiniteSystem A m) :
    FiniteSystem A n where
  size := S.size
  graph := {
    label := S.graph.label, initial := S.graph.initial, root := S.graph.root
    edge := fun v d t => ∃ s, S.graph.edge v d s ∧ t = Sum.map id σ s
    direction_valid := by rintro v d t ⟨s,hs,_⟩; exact S.graph.direction_valid v d s hs }

def pull {A : RankedSet} {m n : ℕ} (σ : Fin m → Fin n) (S : FiniteSystem A n) :
    FiniteSystem A m where
  size := S.size
  graph := {
    label := S.graph.label, initial := S.graph.initial, root := S.graph.root
    edge := fun v d t => S.graph.edge v d (Sum.map id σ t)
    direction_valid := fun v d _t h => S.graph.direction_valid v d _ h }

axiom adjunction {A : RankedSet} {m n : ℕ} (σ : Fin m → Fin n)
    (S : FiniteSystem A m) (T : FiniteSystem A n) (ρ : S.Vertex → T.Vertex) :
    (∃ f : Morphism (push σ S) T, f.toFun = ρ) ↔
      (∃ g : Morphism S (pull σ T), g.toFun = ρ)

axiom push_morphism {A : RankedSet} {m n : ℕ} (σ : Fin m → Fin n)
    {S T : FiniteSystem A m} (f : Morphism S T) :
    ∃ g : Morphism (push σ S) (push σ T), g.toFun = f.toFun ∧
      (LocallySurjective f → LocallySurjective g) ∧ (Folding f → Folding g)

axiom pull_morphism {A : RankedSet} {m n : ℕ} (σ : Fin m → Fin n)
    {S T : FiniteSystem A n} (f : Morphism S T) :
    ∃ g : Morphism (pull σ S) (pull σ T), g.toFun = f.toFun ∧
      (LocallySurjective f → LocallySurjective g) ∧ (Folding f → Folding g)

axiom pull_flatten {A : RankedSet} {m n : ℕ} (σ : Fin m → Fin n)
    (P : FiniteSystem (FiniteSystem A) n) : pull σ (flatten P) = flatten (pull σ P)

end Lax369799.FiniteRenaming

  (S : Lax369799.FinitePresentations.FiniteSystem A m) (T : Lax369799.FinitePresentations.FiniteSystem A n)
  (ρ : S.Vertex → T.Vertex), Iff (Exists fun f => Eq f.toFun ρ) (Exists fun g => Eq g.toFun ρ)

  Eq (Lax369799.FiniteRenaming.pull σ (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.flatten P))
    (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.flatten (Lax369799.FiniteRenaming.pull σ P))

  {S T : Lax369799.FinitePresentations.FiniteSystem A n} (f : Lax369799.FiniteMorphisms.Morphism S T),
  Exists fun g =>
    And (Eq g.toFun f.toFun)
      (And
        (Lax369799.FiniteStructureTheorems.LocallySurjective f → Lax369799.FiniteStructureTheorems.LocallySurjective g)
        (Lax369799.FiniteStructureTheorems.Folding f → Lax369799.FiniteStructureTheorems.Folding g))

  {S T : Lax369799.FinitePresentations.FiniteSystem A m} (f : Lax369799.FiniteMorphisms.Morphism S T),
  Exists fun g =>
    And (Eq g.toFun f.toFun)
      (And
        (Lax369799.FiniteStructureTheorems.LocallySurjective f → Lax369799.FiniteStructureTheorems.LocallySurjective g)
        (Lax369799.FiniteStructureTheorems.Folding f → Lax369799.FiniteStructureTheorems.Folding g))

concepts.title: Finite approximation of a flattening resolution
concepts.description:
A direct resolution of a flattening can be reproduced, up to unfolding,
using only finitely many direct resolutions of each inner label. The
variable maps of the flatten-resolution are retained when selecting and
reassembling these components. This is the initial-resolution argument
underlying the yield-continuity corollary in Section 2.9.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.FiniteResolutionNormalForms
import Lax369799.FlatteningTheorems
import Lax369799.ProfileSubstitution

/-!
---
title: Finite approximation of a flattening resolution
type: theorem
---
A direct resolution of a flattening can be reproduced, up to unfolding,
using only finitely many direct resolutions of each inner label. The
variable maps of the flatten-resolution are retained when selecting and
reassembling these components. This is the initial-resolution argument
underlying the yield-continuity corollary in Section 2.9.
-/
namespace Lax369799.FiniteResolutionApproximation
open RankedSystems Morphisms Flattening Resolutions FiniteResolutionNormalForms

noncomputable def replace {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} (S : SetSystem (SetSystem A) n)
    (k : S.Vertex → ℕ) (c : ∀ v, Fin (k v) → Component (Inner S v)) : SetSystem (SetSystem A) n :=
  { S with graph := { S.graph with label := fun v => ⟨(S.graph.label v).1, trim (family (c v)).graph⟩ } }

/-- A finite family of local resolutions suffices for any replacement
that still admits those resolutions. -/
axiom finite_support {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ}
    (S : SetSystem (SetSystem A) n) (R : System A n)
    (hR : DirectResolution (flatten S) R) :
    ∃ (k : S.Vertex → ℕ) (c : ∀ v, Fin (k v) → Component (Inner S v)),
      (∀ v i, (c v i).rooted = false) ∧
      ∀ (Q : ∀ v, SetSystem A (S.graph.label v).1),
        (∀ v i, DirectResolution (Q v) (c v i).system) →
        ∃ U : System A n,
          DirectResolution (flatten (ProfileSubstitution.withLabels S Q)) U ∧
          UnfoldsTo R.val U.val

axiom direct_approximation {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ}
    (S : SetSystem (SetSystem A) n) (R : System A n)
    (hR : DirectResolution (flatten S) R) :
    ∃ (k : S.Vertex → ℕ) (c : ∀ v, Fin (k v) → Component (Inner S v)) (U : System A n),
      (∀ v i, (c v i).rooted = false) ∧
      DirectResolution (flatten (replace S k c)) U ∧ UnfoldsTo R.val U.val

end Lax369799.FiniteResolutionApproximation

  (S : Lax369799.RankedSystems.SetSystem (Lax369799.RankedSystems.SetSystem A) n)
  (R : Lax369799.RankedSystems.System A n),
  Lax369799.Morphisms.DirectResolution (Lax369799.Flattening.flatten S) R →
    Exists fun k =>
      Exists fun c =>
        Exists fun U =>
          And (∀ (v : S.Vertex) (i : Fin (k v)), Eq (c v i).rooted Bool.false)
            (And
              (Lax369799.Morphisms.DirectResolution
                (Lax369799.Flattening.flatten (Lax369799.FiniteResolutionApproximation.replace S k c)) U)
              (Lax369799.Morphisms.UnfoldsTo R.val U.val))

  (S : Lax369799.RankedSystems.SetSystem (Lax369799.RankedSystems.SetSystem A) n)
  (R : Lax369799.RankedSystems.System A n),
  Lax369799.Morphisms.DirectResolution (Lax369799.Flattening.flatten S) R →
    Exists fun k =>
      Exists fun c =>
        And (∀ (v : S.Vertex) (i : Fin (k v)), Eq (c v i).rooted Bool.false)
          (∀ (Q : (v : Fin S.size) → Lax369799.RankedSystems.SetSystem A (S.graph.label v).fst),
            (∀ (v : Fin S.size) (i : Fin (k v)), Lax369799.Morphisms.DirectResolution (Q v) (c v i).system) →
              Exists fun U =>
                And
                  (Lax369799.Morphisms.DirectResolution
                    (Lax369799.Flattening.flatten (Lax369799.ProfileSubstitution.withLabels S Q)) U)
                  (Lax369799.Morphisms.UnfoldsTo R.val U.val))

concepts.title: Normal forms retaining split-variable resolutions
concepts.description:
A finite disjoint family of initial and planted root resolutions can
preserve every bounded profile of a presentation. Each component is a
whole deterministic system; its internal branching is retained.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.ResolutionFamilies
import Lax369799.BoundedProfileRefinement

/-!
---
title: Normal forms retaining split-variable resolutions
type: theorem
---
A finite disjoint family of initial and planted root resolutions can
preserve every bounded profile of a presentation. Each component is a
whole deterministic system; its internal branching is retained.
-/
namespace Lax369799.FiniteResolutionNormalForms
open RankedSystems Morphisms FinitePresentations FiniteProfiles

structure Component {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} (S : SetSystem A n) where
  system : System A n
  rooted : Bool
  resolves : DirectResolution (if rooted then RankedSystems.uproot S else S) system

def familyGraph {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} {I : Type} {S : SetSystem A n}
    (c : I → Component S) : Presentation A n ((i : I) × (c i).system.val.Vertex) where
  label := fun v => ((c v.1).system.val.graph.label v.2)
  initial := fun v => (c v.1).rooted = false ∧ v.2 ∈ (c v.1).system.val.graph.initial
  root := fun v => (c v.1).rooted = true ∧ v.2 ∈ (c v.1).system.val.graph.initial
  edge := fun v d t => ∃ s, (c v.1).system.val.graph.edge v.2 d s ∧
    t = Sum.map (Sigma.mk v.1) id s
  direction_valid := by rintro v d t ⟨s, hs, _⟩; exact (c v.1).system.val.graph.direction_valid v.2 d s hs

noncomputable def family {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} {I : Type} [Fintype I]
    {S : SetSystem A n} (c : I → Component S) : FiniteSystem A n := enumerate (familyGraph c)

axiom bounded_normal_form {A B : RankedSet} (hB : RankwiseFinite B) (bound : ℕ)
    (ρ : ∀ n, System A n → B n) {n : ℕ} (S : FiniteSystem A n) :
    ∃ (k : ℕ) (c : Fin k → Component (trim S.graph)),
      BoundedProfileEquivalent bound ρ S (family c)

axiom contextual_normal_form {A B : RankedSet} (E : Algebras.Algebra B)
    (hE : Algebras.UnfoldInvariant E) (hB : RankwiseFinite B)
    (η : RankedMap A B) (F : Set (B 0)) (L : Algebras.Language A)
    (hL : Algebras.Recognizes E η F L) {n : ℕ} (S : FiniteSystem A n) :
    ∃ (k : ℕ) (c : Fin k → Component (trim S.graph)),
      FiniteContextualOrder.quotientMap (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) n S =
        FiniteContextualOrder.quotientMap (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) n (family c)

end Lax369799.FiniteResolutionNormalForms

  Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankwiseFinite B →
    ∀ (bound : Nat) (ρ : (n : Nat) → Lax369799.RankedSystems.System A n → B n) {n : Nat}
      (S : Lax369799.FinitePresentations.FiniteSystem A n),
      Exists fun k =>
        Exists fun c =>
          Lax369799.FiniteProfiles.BoundedProfileEquivalent bound ρ S (Lax369799.FiniteResolutionNormalForms.family c)

  Lax369799.Algebras.UnfoldInvariant E →
    Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankwiseFinite B →
      ∀ (η : Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankedMap A B) (F : Set (B 0)) (L : Lax369799.Algebras.Language A),
        Lax369799.Algebras.Recognizes E η F L →
          ∀ {n : Nat} (S : Lax369799.FinitePresentations.FiniteSystem A n),
            Exists fun k =>
              Exists fun c =>
                Eq (Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.quotientMap (Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) n S)
                  (Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.quotientMap (Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) n
                    (Lax369799.FiniteResolutionNormalForms.family c))

concepts.title: Composition and pullbacks without reachability pruning
concepts.description:
The morphisms of revised Definition 8 retain every vertex. Local
surjectivity and surjectivity on vertices are separate requirements.
Lemmas 9 and 14 hold for these presentations, including the folding
clauses and the full pullback universal property.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.FiniteMorphisms

/-!
---
title: Composition and pullbacks without reachability pruning
type: theorem
---
The morphisms of revised Definition 8 retain every vertex. Local
surjectivity and surjectivity on vertices are separate requirements.
Lemmas 9 and 14 hold for these presentations, including the folding
clauses and the full pullback universal property.
-/

namespace Lax369799.FiniteStructureTheorems
open RankedSystems FinitePresentations FiniteMorphisms

def LocallySurjective {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} {S T : FiniteSystem A n}
    (f : Morphism S T) : Prop :=
  (∀ w, T.graph.initial w → ∃ v, S.graph.initial v ∧ f.toFun v = w) ∧
  (∀ w, T.graph.root w → ∃ v, S.graph.root v ∧ f.toFun v = w) ∧
  ∀ v d t, T.graph.edge (f.toFun v) d t →
    ∃ s, S.graph.edge v d s ∧ Sum.map f.toFun id s = t

def Folding {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} {S T : FiniteSystem A n}
    (f : Morphism S T) : Prop := LocallySurjective f ∧ Function.Surjective f.toFun

def UnfoldEquivalent {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} (S T : FiniteSystem A n) : Prop :=
  ∃ (U : FiniteSystem A n) (f : Morphism U S) (g : Morphism U T), Folding f ∧ Folding g

axiom composition {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} {S T U : FiniteSystem A n}
    (f : Morphism S T) (g : Morphism T U) :
    ∃ h : Morphism S U, h.toFun = g.toFun ∘ f.toFun ∧
      (LocallySurjective f → LocallySurjective g → LocallySurjective h) ∧
      (Folding f → Folding g → Folding h)

axiom pullback {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} {S T U : FiniteSystem A n}
    (f : Morphism S U) (g : Morphism T U) :
    ∃ (P : FiniteSystem A n) (p : Morphism P S) (q : Morphism P T),
      f.toFun ∘ p.toFun = g.toFun ∘ q.toFun ∧
      (∀ (V : FiniteSystem A n) (a : Morphism V S) (b : Morphism V T),
        f.toFun ∘ a.toFun = g.toFun ∘ b.toFun →
        ∃! h : Morphism V P, p.toFun ∘ h.toFun = a.toFun ∧ q.toFun ∘ h.toFun = b.toFun) ∧
      (LocallySurjective f → LocallySurjective q) ∧
      (LocallySurjective g → LocallySurjective p) ∧
      (Folding f → Folding q) ∧ (Folding g → Folding p)

axiom unfold_equivalence (A : RankedSet) (n : ℕ) :
    Equivalence (@UnfoldEquivalent A n)

end Lax369799.FiniteStructureTheorems

concepts.title: Contextual quotient algebras of finite presentations
concepts.description:
The contextual quotient carries evaluation for unpruned finite
presentations. Evaluation respects isomorphism, the atomic unit, and
associativity. This is the substitution-algebra structure alone; no
yield-continuity law is asserted here.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder

/-!
---
title: Contextual quotient algebras of finite presentations
type: theorem
---
The contextual quotient carries evaluation for unpruned finite
presentations. Evaluation respects isomorphism, the atomic unit, and
associativity. This is the substitution-algebra structure alone; no
yield-continuity law is asserted here.
-/

namespace Lax369799.FiniteSyntacticAlgebra
open RankedSystems (RankedSet)
open FinitePresentations FiniteContextualOrder

structure Algebra (A : RankedSet) where
  eval : ∀ n, FiniteSystem A n → A n
  unit : ∀ n (a : A n), eval n (atomic a) = a
  associative : ∀ n (S : FiniteSystem (FiniteSystem A) n),
    eval n (relabel eval S) = eval n (flatten S)
  isomorphic : ∀ n (S T : FiniteSystem A n), Isomorphic S T → eval n S = eval n T

def sumValue {A : RankedSet} (E : Algebra A) {n : ℕ} (a b : A n) : A n :=
  E.eval n (binary a b)

def AcceptingClass {A : RankedSet} (F : ClosedProperty A) (a : Carrier F 0) : Prop :=
  ∃ S : FiniteSystem A 0, quotientMap F 0 S = a ∧ S ∈ F

axiom accepting_classes {A : RankedSet} (F : ClosedProperty A) (hF : IsoInvariant F) :
    (∀ S, AcceptingClass F (quotientMap F 0 S) ↔ S ∈ F) ∧
    (∀ a b, AcceptingClass F a → ClassBelow F a b → AcceptingClass F b)

axiom contextual_algebra {A : RankedSet} (F : ClosedProperty A) (hF : IsoInvariant F) :
    ∃ E : Algebra (Carrier F), ∀ n (S : FiniteSystem (FiniteSystem A) n),
      E.eval n (relabel (quotientMap F) S) = quotientMap F n (flatten S)

axiom contextual_recognition {A : RankedSet} (F : ClosedProperty A) (hF : IsoInvariant F)
    (E : Algebra (Carrier F))
    (hE : ∀ n (S : FiniteSystem (FiniteSystem A) n),
      E.eval n (relabel (quotientMap F) S) = quotientMap F n (flatten S)) :
    ∃ P : Set (Carrier F 0), ∀ S : FiniteSystem A 0,
      E.eval 0 (relabel (fun r a => quotientMap F r (atomic a)) S) ∈ P ↔ S ∈ F

axiom evaluation_monotone {A B : RankedSet} (F : ClosedProperty A) (hF : IsoInvariant F)
    (E : Algebra (Carrier F))
    (hE : ∀ n (S : FiniteSystem (FiniteSystem A) n),
      E.eval n (relabel (quotientMap F) S) = quotientMap F n (flatten S))
    {n : ℕ} (P : FiniteSystem B n)
    (q r : ∀ v : P.Vertex, Carrier F (P.graph.label v).1)
    (h : ∀ v, ClassBelow F (q v) (r v)) :
    ClassBelow F (E.eval n (withLabels P q)) (E.eval n (withLabels P r))

axiom sum_value {A : RankedSet} (F : ClosedProperty A) (hF : IsoInvariant F)
    (E : Algebra (Carrier F))
    (hE : ∀ n (S : FiniteSystem (FiniteSystem A) n),
      E.eval n (relabel (quotientMap F) S) = quotientMap F n (flatten S))
    {n : ℕ} (S T : FiniteSystem A n) :
    sumValue E (quotientMap F n S) (quotientMap F n T) = quotientMap F n (sum S T)

axiom accepting_sum_value {A : RankedSet} (F : ClosedProperty A) (hF : IsoInvariant F)
    (hSum : ∀ S T, S ∈ F → T ∈ F → sum S T ∈ F)
    (E : Algebra (Carrier F))
    (hE : ∀ n (S : FiniteSystem (FiniteSystem A) n),
      E.eval n (relabel (quotientMap F) S) = quotientMap F n (flatten S))
    (a b : Carrier F 0) :
    AcceptingClass F a → AcceptingClass F b → AcceptingClass F (sumValue E a b)

end Lax369799.FiniteSyntacticAlgebra

concepts.title: Executable bounded comparison of MSO and modal formulas
concepts.description:
Enumerate finite Boolean graph tables up to the prescribed vertex bound.
A second-order closure test filters exactly the reachable models, and
the verified model checkers compare the two sentence semantics.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.FiniteModelChecking
import Lax369799.FiniteModalData

/-!
---
title: Executable bounded comparison of MSO and modal formulas
type: theorem
---
Enumerate finite Boolean graph tables up to the prescribed vertex bound.
A second-order closure test filters exactly the reachable models, and
the verified model checkers compare the two sentence semantics.
-/

namespace Lax369799.FiniteTesting
open FiniteModelChecking

def valid {P : Type} {k : ℕ} (G : Graph P k) : Bool :=
  decide (∀ X : Fin (k+1) → Bool,X G.1 = true →
    (∀ v w,X v = true → G.2.1 v w = true → X w = true) → ∀ v,X v = true)

def agree {P : Type} {k : ℕ} (G : Graph P k) (φ : MonadicSecondOrder.Sentence P)
    (ψ : ModalMuCalculus.Sentence P) : Bool :=
  if valid G then (mso G φ == mu G ψ) else true

def test {P : Type} [Fintype P] [Encodable P] [DecidableEq P] (K : ℕ)
    (φ : MonadicSecondOrder.Sentence P) (ψ : ModalMuCalculus.Sentence P) : Bool :=
  (List.range K).all (fun k => (FiniteModalData.elements (Graph P k)).all (fun G => agree G φ ψ))

open TransitionSystems

axiom test_correct {P : Type} [Fintype P] [Encodable P] [DecidableEq P] (K : ℕ)
    (φ : MonadicSecondOrder.Sentence P) (ψ : ModalMuCalculus.Sentence P) :
    test K φ ψ = true ↔ ∀ S : TransitionSystem P,S.size ≤ K →
      (MonadicSecondOrder.Models S φ ↔ ModalMuCalculus.Models S ψ)

end Lax369799.FiniteTesting

statements.signature:
test_correct : ∀ {P : Type} [inst : Fintype P] [inst_1 : Encodable P] [inst_2 : DecidableEq P] (K : Nat)
  (φ : Lax369799.MonadicSecondOrder.Sentence P) (ψ : Lax369799.ModalMuCalculus.Sentence P),
  Iff (Eq (Lax369799.FiniteTesting.test K φ ψ) Bool.true)
    (∀ (S : Lax369799.TransitionSystems.TransitionSystem P),
      instLENat.le S.size K → Iff (Lax369799.MonadicSecondOrder.Models S φ) (Lax369799.ModalMuCalculus.Models S ψ))

concepts.title: Simultaneous deterministic replacements in finite presentations
concepts.description:
Marking a vertex gives a context that retains all its incident edges and
boundary marks. Iterating the automaton property over the finite vertex
set replaces every label by a deterministic value below it and preserves
acceptance. No parallel-unary normal form is used.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.ExpandedSyntacticAlgebra

/-!
---
title: Simultaneous deterministic replacements in finite presentations
type: theorem
---
Marking a vertex gives a context that retains all its incident edges and
boundary marks. Iterating the automaton property over the finite vertex
set replaces every label by a deterministic value below it and preserves
acceptance. No parallel-unary normal form is used.
-/
namespace Lax369799.FiniteVertexReplacement
open RankedSystems (RankedSet)
open FinitePresentations FiniteContexts FiniteContextualOrder FiniteAcceptance
open FiniteSyntacticAlgebra ExpandedSyntacticAlgebra

axiom vertex_context {A B : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} (P : FiniteSystem B n)
    (q : ∀ v : P.Vertex, A (P.graph.label v).1) (v : P.Vertex) :
    ∃ C : Context A (P.graph.label v).1 n,
      ∀ r : ∀ w : P.Vertex, A (P.graph.label w).1,
        (∀ w, w ≠ v → q w = r w) →
        Isomorphic (plug C (atomic (r v))) (withLabels P r)

axiom simultaneous_replacement {A B : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    (hL : Algebras.UnfoldInvariantLanguage L) (hrec : Algebras.Recognizable L)
    (E : SyntacticAlgebra L) (P : FiniteSystem B 0)
    (q : ∀ v : P.Vertex, Carrier (Accepting L) (P.graph.label v).1)
    (hq : AcceptingClass (Accepting L) (E.algebra.eval 0 (withLabels P q))) :
    ∃ r : ∀ v : P.Vertex, Carrier (Accepting L) (P.graph.label v).1,
      (∀ v, FiniteExtremal.Deterministic E.algebra (r v) ∧ ClassBelow (Accepting L) (r v) (q v)) ∧
      AcceptingClass (Accepting L) (E.algebra.eval 0 (withLabels P r))

end Lax369799.FiniteVertexReplacement

  Lax369799.Algebras.UnfoldInvariantLanguage L →
    Lax369799.Algebras.Recognizable L →
      ∀ (E : Lax369799.ExpandedSyntacticAlgebra.SyntacticAlgebra L) (P : Lax369799.FinitePresentations.FiniteSystem B 0)
        (q :
          (v : P.Vertex) →
            Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.Carrier (Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) (P.graph.label v).fst),
        Lax369799.FiniteSyntacticAlgebra.AcceptingClass (Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L)
            (E.algebra.eval 0 (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.withLabels P q)) →
          Exists fun r =>
            And
              (∀ (v : P.Vertex),
                And (Lax369799.FiniteExtremal.Deterministic E.algebra (r v))
                  (Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.ClassBelow (Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) (r v) (q v)))
              (Lax369799.FiniteSyntacticAlgebra.AcceptingClass (Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L)
                (E.algebra.eval 0 (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.withLabels P r)))

  (q : (v : P.Vertex) → A (P.graph.label v).fst) (v : P.Vertex),
  Exists fun C =>
    ∀ (r : (w : P.Vertex) → A (P.graph.label w).fst),

concepts.title: Yield continuity for finite-presentation contexts
concepts.description:
The finite approximation of yields also holds for contexts retaining
unreachable vertices. Substitution precedes the final reachable
restriction, so roots supplied at an unreachable hole remain observable.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.YieldContinuity
import Lax369799.FiniteContexts
import Lax369799.InitialResolutionApproximation

/-!
---
title: Yield continuity for finite-presentation contexts
type: theorem
---
The finite approximation of yields also holds for contexts retaining
unreachable vertices. Substitution precedes the final reachable
restriction, so roots supplied at an unreachable hole remain observable.
-/
namespace Lax369799.FiniteYieldContinuity
open RankedSystems Morphisms

noncomputable def insert {A : RankedSet} {k n : ℕ}
    (C : FiniteContexts.Context A k n) (S : SetSystem A k) : SetSystem A n :=
  trim (FiniteContexts.plug C (FinitePresentations.ofSetSystem S)).graph

axiom context_mono {A : RankedSet} {k n : ℕ}
    (C : FiniteContexts.Context A k n) (S T : SetSystem A k) (h : YieldBelow S T) :
    YieldBelow (insert C S) (insert C T)

axiom continuity {A : RankedSet} {k n : ℕ}
    (C : FiniteContexts.Context A k n) (S : SetSystem A k) (R : SetSystem A n) :
    Yield (insert C S) R ↔
      ∃ (m : ℕ) (F : Fin m → SetSystem A k),
        (∀ i, Yield S (F i)) ∧ Yield (insert C (YieldContinuity.finiteSum F)) R

end Lax369799.FiniteYieldContinuity

  (S T : Lax369799.RankedSystems.SetSystem A k),
  Lax369799.Morphisms.YieldBelow S T →
    Lax369799.Morphisms.YieldBelow (Lax369799.FiniteYieldContinuity.insert C S)
      (Lax369799.FiniteYieldContinuity.insert C T)

continuity : ∀ {A : Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankedSet} {k n : Nat} (C : Lax369799.FiniteContexts.Context A k n)
  (S : Lax369799.RankedSystems.SetSystem A k) (R : Lax369799.RankedSystems.SetSystem A n),
  Iff (Lax369799.Morphisms.Yield (Lax369799.FiniteYieldContinuity.insert C S) R)
    (Exists fun m =>
      Exists fun F =>
        And (∀ (i : Fin m), Lax369799.Morphisms.Yield S (F i))
          (Lax369799.Morphisms.Yield (Lax369799.FiniteYieldContinuity.insert C (Lax369799.YieldContinuity.finiteSum F))
            R))

concepts.title: Finite sums are contextual meets
concepts.description:
A finite disjoint sum represents the meet of its summands in the
contextual order. The empty sum represents the greatest element.
Together with finite yield approximation, this gives continuity over
base-alphabet yields.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.FiniteContinuityOrder

/-!
---
title: Finite sums are contextual meets
type: theorem
---
A finite disjoint sum represents the meet of its summands in the
contextual order. The empty sum represents the greatest element.
Together with finite yield approximation, this gives continuity over
base-alphabet yields.
-/
namespace Lax369799.FiniteYieldMeets
open RankedSystems (RankedSet SetSystem trim)
open FinitePresentations FiniteContextualOrder FiniteAcceptance

axiom finite_meet {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A) {n m : ℕ}
    (R : FiniteSystem A n) (F : Fin m → SetSystem A n) :

axiom yield_lower_bound {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A) {n : ℕ}

      ∀ T : SetSystem A n, Morphisms.Yield (trim S.graph) T →
        Below (Accepting L) R (ofSetSystem T)

concepts.title: Elimination of simultaneous fixed points
concepts.description:
Bekić's identity expresses a simultaneous least or greatest fixed point
on a product as two nested fixed points. Iterating the identity eliminates
finite vectors of modal fixed-point variables.
concepts.sourceText:
import Mathlib.Order.FixedPoints

/-!
---
title: Elimination of simultaneous fixed points
type: theorem
---
Bekić's identity expresses a simultaneous least or greatest fixed point
on a product as two nested fixed points. Iterating the identity eliminates
finite vectors of modal fixed-point variables.
-/
namespace Lax369799.FixedPointElimination

variable {α β : Type} [CompleteLattice α] [CompleteLattice β]

def sectionMap (F : α × β →o α × β) (a : α) : β →o β where
  toFun := fun b => (F (a, b)).2
  monotone' := fun b c h => (F.monotone (show (a, b) ≤ (a, c) from ⟨le_rfl, h⟩)).2

def leastSection (F : α × β →o α × β) : α →o β where
  toFun := fun a => (sectionMap F a).lfp
  monotone' := fun a b h => OrderHom.lfp.monotone
    (fun c => (F.monotone (show (a, c) ≤ (b, c) from ⟨h, le_rfl⟩)).2)

def greatestSection (F : α × β →o α × β) : α →o β where
  toFun := fun a => (sectionMap F a).gfp
  monotone' := fun a b h => OrderHom.gfp.monotone
    (fun c => (F.monotone (show (a, c) ≤ (b, c) from ⟨h, le_rfl⟩)).2)

def firstMap (F : α × β →o α × β) (s : α →o β) : α →o α where
  toFun := fun a => (F (a, s a)).1
  monotone' := fun _ _ h => (F.monotone ⟨h, s.monotone h⟩).1

axiom least (F : α × β →o α × β) :
    F.lfp = ((firstMap F (leastSection F)).lfp,
      leastSection F (firstMap F (leastSection F)).lfp)

axiom greatest (F : α × β →o α × β) :
    F.gfp = ((firstMap F (greatestSection F)).gfp,
      greatestSection F (firstMap F (greatestSection F)).gfp)

end Lax369799.FixedPointElimination

greatest : ∀ {α β : Type} [inst : CompleteLattice α] [inst_1 : CompleteLattice β] (F : OrderHom (Prod α β) (Prod α β)),
  Eq (OrderHom.instFunLike.coe OrderHom.gfp F)
    {
      fst :=
        OrderHom.instFunLike.coe OrderHom.gfp
          (Lax369799.FixedPointElimination.firstMap F (Lax369799.FixedPointElimination.greatestSection F)),
      snd :=
        OrderHom.instFunLike.coe (Lax369799.FixedPointElimination.greatestSection F)
          (OrderHom.instFunLike.coe OrderHom.gfp
            (Lax369799.FixedPointElimination.firstMap F (Lax369799.FixedPointElimination.greatestSection F))) }

least : ∀ {α β : Type} [inst : CompleteLattice α] [inst_1 : CompleteLattice β] (F : OrderHom (Prod α β) (Prod α β)),
  Eq (OrderHom.instFunLike.coe OrderHom.lfp F)
    {
      fst :=
        OrderHom.instFunLike.coe OrderHom.lfp
          (Lax369799.FixedPointElimination.firstMap F (Lax369799.FixedPointElimination.leastSection F)),
      snd :=
        OrderHom.instFunLike.coe (Lax369799.FixedPointElimination.leastSection F)
          (OrderHom.instFunLike.coe OrderHom.lfp
            (Lax369799.FixedPointElimination.firstMap F (Lax369799.FixedPointElimination.leastSection F))) }

concepts.title: Fixed points through a monotone retraction
concepts.description:
If every value of a monotone operator lies in the image of a monotone
section, projection to that image preserves its least and greatest fixed
points. This removes auxiliary coordinates whose values are determined
by the retained coordinates.
concepts.sourceText:
import Mathlib.Order.FixedPoints

/-!
---
title: Fixed points through a monotone retraction
type: theorem
---
If every value of a monotone operator lies in the image of a monotone
section, projection to that image preserves its least and greatest fixed
points. This removes auxiliary coordinates whose values are determined
by the retained coordinates.
-/
namespace Lax369799.FixedPointRetraction
variable {α β : Type} [CompleteLattice α] [CompleteLattice β]

def reduced (F : α →o α) (p : α →o β) (l : β →o α) : β →o β := p.comp (F.comp l)

axiom least (F : α →o α) (p : α →o β) (l : β →o α)
    (hp : ∀ x, p (l x) = x) (hF : ∀ x, l (p (F x)) = F x) :
    p F.lfp = (reduced F p l).lfp

axiom greatest (F : α →o α) (p : α →o β) (l : β →o α)
    (hp : ∀ x, p (l x) = x) (hF : ∀ x, l (p (F x)) = F x) :
    p F.gfp = (reduced F p l).gfp

end Lax369799.FixedPointRetraction

statements.signature:
greatest : ∀ {α β : Type} [inst : CompleteLattice α] [inst_1 : CompleteLattice β] (F : OrderHom α α) (p : OrderHom α β)
  (l : OrderHom β α),
  (∀ (x : β), Eq (OrderHom.instFunLike.coe p (OrderHom.instFunLike.coe l x)) x) →
    (∀ (x : α),
        Eq (OrderHom.instFunLike.coe l (OrderHom.instFunLike.coe p (OrderHom.instFunLike.coe F x)))
          (OrderHom.instFunLike.coe F x)) →
      Eq (OrderHom.instFunLike.coe p (OrderHom.instFunLike.coe OrderHom.gfp F))
        (OrderHom.instFunLike.coe OrderHom.gfp (Lax369799.FixedPointRetraction.reduced F p l))

least : ∀ {α β : Type} [inst : CompleteLattice α] [inst_1 : CompleteLattice β] (F : OrderHom α α) (p : OrderHom α β)
  (l : OrderHom β α),
  (∀ (x : β), Eq (OrderHom.instFunLike.coe p (OrderHom.instFunLike.coe l x)) x) →
    (∀ (x : α),
        Eq (OrderHom.instFunLike.coe l (OrderHom.instFunLike.coe p (OrderHom.instFunLike.coe F x)))
          (OrderHom.instFunLike.coe F x)) →
      Eq (OrderHom.instFunLike.coe p (OrderHom.instFunLike.coe OrderHom.lfp F))
        (OrderHom.instFunLike.coe OrderHom.lfp (Lax369799.FixedPointRetraction.reduced F p l))

concepts.title: Flattening and contexts
concepts.description:
Flattening substitutes a finite set-system at each vertex of a pattern.
Inner transition edges are retained; an inner variable edge is connected
according to the corresponding direction in the pattern. Inner roots remain
roots, and inner initial vertices become roots when the outer vertex is a
root. Unreachable vertices are removed. A context has exactly one vertex
labelled by a hole of the prescribed rank. See Sections 2.6 and 2.8.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.RankedSystems

/-!
---
title: Flattening and contexts
type: definition
---
Flattening substitutes a finite set-system at each vertex of a pattern.
Inner transition edges are retained; an inner variable edge is connected
according to the corresponding direction in the pattern. Inner roots remain
roots, and inner initial vertices become roots when the outer vertex is a
root. Unreachable vertices are removed. A context has exactly one vertex
labelled by a hole of the prescribed rank. See Sections 2.6 and 2.8.
-/

namespace Lax369799.Flattening
open RankedSystems

abbrev Inner {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} (S : SetSystem (SetSystem A) n)
    (v : S.Vertex) := (S.graph.label v).2

noncomputable def flatten {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ}
    (S : SetSystem (SetSystem A) n) : SetSystem A n :=
  trim (V := (v : S.Vertex) × (Inner S v).Vertex) {
    label := fun v => (Inner S v.1).graph.label v.2
    initial := fun v => v.1 ∈ S.graph.initial ∧ v.2 ∈ (Inner S v.1).graph.initial
    root := fun v => v.2 ∈ (Inner S v.1).graph.root ∨
      (v.1 ∈ S.graph.root ∧ v.2 ∈ (Inner S v.1).graph.initial)
    edge := fun v d t =>
      (∃ w, (Inner S v.1).graph.edge v.2 d (.inl w) ∧ t = .inl ⟨v.1, w⟩) ∨
      (∃ i : Fin (S.graph.label v.1).1,
        (Inner S v.1).graph.edge v.2 d (.inr i) ∧
        ((∃ w : (v : S.Vertex) × (Inner S v).Vertex,
          S.graph.edge v.1 i.val (.inl w.1) ∧
          w.2 ∈ (Inner S w.1).graph.initial ∧ t = .inl w) ∨
         (∃ j, S.graph.edge v.1 i.val (.inr j) ∧ t = .inr j)))
    direction_valid := by
      intro v d t h
      rcases h with ⟨w, hw, _⟩ | ⟨i, hi, _⟩
      · exact (Inner S v.1).graph.direction_valid v.2 d _ hw
      · exact (Inner S v.1).graph.direction_valid v.2 d _ hi }

abbrev WithHole (A : RankedSet) (k : ℕ) : RankedSet := fun n => A n ⊕ PLift (k = n)

def IsHole {A : RankedSet} {k : ℕ} (a : Symbol (WithHole A k)) : Prop :=
  ∃ h, a.2 = Sum.inr h

structure SetContext (A : RankedSet) (k n : ℕ) where
  system : SetSystem (WithHole A k) n
  one_hole : ∃! v, IsHole (system.graph.label v)

abbrev Context (A : RankedSet) (k n : ℕ) :=
  {C : SetContext A k n // C.system.Deterministic}

def substitution {A : RankedSet} {k : ℕ} (S : SetSystem A k) :
    RankedMap (WithHole A k) (SetSystem A) :=
  fun _ a => match a with
    | .inl a => atomic a
    | .inr ⟨h⟩ => h ▸ S

noncomputable def plug {A : RankedSet} {k n : ℕ}
    (C : SetContext A k n) (S : SetSystem A k) : SetSystem A n :=
  flatten (relabel (substitution S) C.system)

/-- The flattening relation avoids making a choice of proof of determinism. -/
def SystemFlattening {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ}
    (S : System (System A) n) (T : System A n) : Prop :=
  T.val = flatten (relabel (fun _ U => U.val) S.val)

end Lax369799.Flattening

concepts.title: Flattening, resolutions, and yield congruence
concepts.description:
Flattening preserves systems. Flatten-resolutions give direct resolutions
of a flattening; conversely, every direct resolution has an unfolding
obtained by flattening a flatten-resolution. Yield inclusion is preserved
by substitution into contexts. These are the central compositional results
of Sections 2.6–2.9.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.Resolutions

/-!
---
title: Flattening, resolutions, and yield congruence
type: theorem
---
Flattening preserves systems. Flatten-resolutions give direct resolutions
of a flattening; conversely, every direct resolution has an unfolding
obtained by flattening a flatten-resolution. Yield inclusion is preserved
by substitution into contexts. These are the central compositional results
of Sections 2.6–2.9.
-/

namespace Lax369799.FlatteningTheorems
open RankedSystems Morphisms Flattening Resolutions

axiom atomic_flatten_cover {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} (S : SetSystem A n) :
  UnfoldsTo S (flatten (relabel (fun _ a => atomic a) S))

axiom outer_atomic_cover {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} (S : SetSystem A n) :
  UnfoldsTo S (flatten (atomic S))

axiom flatten_system {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} (S : System (System A) n) :
  ∃ T : System A n, SystemFlattening S T

axiom flatten_resolution_sound {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ}
    (S : SetSystem (SetSystem A) n) (T : System (System A) n)
    (h : FlattenResolution S T) (U : System A n) (hU : SystemFlattening T U) :
    DirectResolution (flatten S) U

axiom resolution_to_flatten_resolution {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ}
    (S : SetSystem (SetSystem A) n) (R : System A n)
    (hR : DirectResolution (flatten S) R) :
    ∃ (T : System (System A) n) (U : System A n),
      Nonempty (FlattenResolution S T) ∧ SystemFlattening T U ∧ UnfoldsTo R.val U.val

axiom yield_context_congruence {A : RankedSet} {k n : ℕ}
    (C : SetContext A k n) (S T : SetSystem A k) (h : YieldBelow S T) :
    YieldBelow (plug C S) (plug C T)

axiom unfold_context_congruence {A : RankedSet} {k n : ℕ}
    (C : SetContext A k n) (S T : SetSystem A k) (h : UnfoldEquivalent S T) :
    UnfoldEquivalent (plug C S) (plug C T)

end Lax369799.FlatteningTheorems

concepts.title: The subalgebra generated by a recognizing alphabet
concepts.description:
Retain exactly the algebra values realized by systems over the original
alphabet. This forms a subalgebra, since associativity evaluates a system
of realized values by substituting their witnesses. Restricting to these
values preserves recognition and rankwise finiteness.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.Algebras

/-!
---
title: The subalgebra generated by a recognizing alphabet
type: theorem
---
Retain exactly the algebra values realized by systems over the original
alphabet. This forms a subalgebra, since associativity evaluates a system
of realized values by substituting their witnesses. Restricting to these
values preserves recognition and rankwise finiteness.
-/
namespace Lax369799.GeneratedAlgebra
open RankedSystems Algebras

def Carrier {A B : RankedSet} (E : Algebra B) (η : RankedMap A B) : RankedSet :=
  fun n => {b : B n // ∃ S : System A n, E.eval n (relabelSystem η S) = b}

def projection {A B : RankedSet} (E : Algebra B) (η : RankedMap A B) : RankedMap (Carrier E η) B :=
  fun _ b => b.val

def letter {A B : RankedSet} (E : Algebra B) (η : RankedMap A B) : RankedMap A (Carrier E η) :=
  fun n a => ⟨η n a, atomicSystem a, E.unit n (η n a)⟩

axiom algebra {A B : RankedSet} (E : Algebra B) (η : RankedMap A B) :
    ∃ G : Algebra (Carrier E η), ∀ n (S : System (Carrier E η) n),
      (G.eval n S).val = E.eval n (relabelSystem (projection E η) S)

axiom finite_carrier {A B : RankedSet} (E : Algebra B) (η : RankedMap A B)
    (hB : RankwiseFinite B) : RankwiseFinite (Carrier E η)

axiom recognition {A B : RankedSet} (E : Algebra B) (η : RankedMap A B)
    (G : Algebra (Carrier E η))
    (hG : ∀ n (S : System (Carrier E η) n), (G.eval n S).val = E.eval n (relabelSystem (projection E η) S))
    (F : Set (B 0)) (L : Language A) (hL : Recognizes E η F L) :
    Recognizes G (letter E η) {b | b.val ∈ F} L

end Lax369799.GeneratedAlgebra

  Exists fun G =>
    ∀ (n : Nat) (S : Lax369799.RankedSystems.System (Lax369799.GeneratedAlgebra.Carrier E η) n),
      Eq (G.eval n S).val
        (E.eval n (Lax369799.RankedSystems.relabelSystem (Lax369799.GeneratedAlgebra.projection E η) S))

  (η : Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankedMap A B),
  Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankwiseFinite B →
    Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankwiseFinite (Lax369799.GeneratedAlgebra.Carrier E η)

  (∀ (n : Nat) (S : Lax369799.RankedSystems.System (Lax369799.GeneratedAlgebra.Carrier E η) n),
      Eq (G.eval n S).val
        (E.eval n (Lax369799.RankedSystems.relabelSystem (Lax369799.GeneratedAlgebra.projection E η) S))) →
    ∀ (F : Set (B 0)) (L : Lax369799.Algebras.Language A),
      Lax369799.Algebras.Recognizes E η F L →

          (Set.ofPred fun b => Set.instMembership.mem F b.val) L

concepts.title: Functional restrictions of selected unary graphs
concepts.description:
In a finite unary/nullary presentation, selected unary labels allow each
outgoing target set to be split independently. Acceptance is equivalent
to acceptance of all functional restrictions, including in the presence
of cycles. Restrictions retain all vertices and all initial/root marks.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.ContextChoices

/-!
---
title: Functional restrictions of selected unary graphs
type: theorem
---
In a finite unary/nullary presentation, selected unary labels allow each
outgoing target set to be split independently. Acceptance is equivalent
to acceptance of all functional restrictions, including in the presence
of cycles. Restrictions retain all vertices and all initial/root marks.
-/
namespace Lax369799.GraphChoices
open RankedSystems (RankedSet)
open FinitePresentations FiniteContexts FiniteContextualOrder FiniteAcceptance
open FiniteSyntacticAlgebra ExpandedSyntacticAlgebra

noncomputable def restrictRow {A : RankedSet} (P : FiniteSystem A 0)
    (v : P.Vertex) (p : Set P.Vertex) : FiniteSystem A 0 where
  size := P.size
  graph := { P.graph with
    edge := fun w d t => P.graph.edge w d t ∧
      (w = v → match t with | .inl u => p u | .inr _ => False)
    direction_valid := fun w d t h => P.graph.direction_valid w d t h.1 }


noncomputable def chooseRows {A : RankedSet} (P : FiniteSystem A 0)
    (s : Finset P.Vertex) (f : P.Vertex → P.Vertex) : FiniteSystem A 0 where
  size := P.size
  graph := { P.graph with
    edge := fun v d t => P.graph.edge v d t ∧ (v ∈ s → t = .inl (f v))
    direction_valid := fun v d t h => P.graph.direction_valid v d t h.1 }


axiom row_choices {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    (E : SyntacticAlgebra L) (P : FiniteSystem (Carrier (Accepting L)) 0)
    (v : P.Vertex) (hv : (P.graph.label v).1 = 1)
    (hs : ExtremalUnaryTypes.Selected L E (hv ▸ (P.graph.label v).2)) :
    AcceptingClass (Accepting L) (E.algebra.eval 0 P) ↔
      ∀ w : P.Vertex, AcceptingClass (Accepting L)
        (E.algebra.eval 0 (restrictRow P v {w}))

axiom finite_choices {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    (E : SyntacticAlgebra L) (P : FiniteSystem (Carrier (Accepting L)) 0)
    (hu : ∀ v, (P.graph.label v).1 ≤ 1)
    (hs : ∀ v (h : (P.graph.label v).1 = 1),
      ExtremalUnaryTypes.Selected L E (h ▸ (P.graph.label v).2))
    (s : Finset P.Vertex) :
    AcceptingClass (Accepting L) (E.algebra.eval 0 P) ↔
      ∀ f : P.Vertex → P.Vertex, AcceptingClass (Accepting L) (E.algebra.eval 0 (chooseRows P s f))

axiom chosen_functional {A : RankedSet} (P : FiniteSystem A 0)
    (f : P.Vertex → P.Vertex) (v : P.Vertex) (d : ℕ) (t u : P.Vertex ⊕ Fin 0)
    (ht : (chooseRows P Finset.univ f).graph.edge v d t)
    (hu : (chooseRows P Finset.univ f).graph.edge v d u) : t = u

def Admissible {A : RankedSet} (P : FiniteSystem A 0) (f : P.Vertex → P.Vertex) : Prop :=
  ∀ v, (∃ d w, P.graph.edge v d (.inl w)) → ∃ d, P.graph.edge v d (.inl (f v))


axiom admissible_test {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    (E : SyntacticAlgebra L) (P : FiniteSystem (Carrier (Accepting L)) 0)
    (hu : ∀ v, (P.graph.label v).1 ≤ 1)
    (hs : ∀ v (h : (P.graph.label v).1 = 1),
      ExtremalUnaryTypes.Selected L E (h ▸ (P.graph.label v).2)) :
    AcceptingClass (Accepting L) (E.algebra.eval 0 P) ↔

concepts.title: Infinite Ramsey theorem for pairs
concepts.description:
A coloring of increasing pairs of natural numbers with finitely many
colors has an infinite homogeneous subsequence. This supplies the
factorization argument for infinite branch words in Section 6.3.
concepts.sourceText:
import Mathlib.Order.Monotone.Basic
import Mathlib.Data.Finite.Defs

/-!
---
title: Infinite Ramsey theorem for pairs
type: theorem
---
A coloring of increasing pairs of natural numbers with finitely many
colors has an infinite homogeneous subsequence. This supplies the
factorization argument for infinite branch words in Section 6.3.
-/
namespace Lax369799.InfiniteRamsey

axiom pairs {C : Type} [Finite C] (color : ℕ → ℕ → C) :
    ∃ (f : ℕ → ℕ) (c : C), StrictMono f ∧ ∀ i j, i < j → color (f i) (f j) = c

end Lax369799.InfiniteRamsey

concepts.title: The initial-label algebra
concepts.description:
A constant ranked set carries an algebra that reads only the label of the
initial vertex. Finite instances recognize initial-vertex predicates.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.Algebras

/-!
---
title: The initial-label algebra
type: theorem
---
A constant ranked set carries an algebra that reads only the label of the
initial vertex. Finite instances recognize initial-vertex predicates.

namespace Lax369799.InitialAlgebra
open RankedSystems Algebras

noncomputable def initial {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} (S : System A n) : S.val.Vertex :=
  Classical.choose S.property.1

noncomputable def evaluate {C : Type} (n : ℕ) (S : System (fun _ => C) n) : C :=
  (S.val.graph.label (initial S)).2

axiom algebra (C : Type) : ∃ E : Algebra (fun _ => C), E.eval = evaluate

axiom recognizes {A : RankedSet} (p : ∀ n, A n → Prop) :
  Recognizable {S : System A 0 | p _ (S.val.graph.label (initial S)).2}

end Lax369799.InitialAlgebra

        (S.val.graph.label (Lax369799.InitialAlgebra.initial S)).snd)

concepts.title: Finite support for initial observations
concepts.description:
Initial observations of a substitution depend on finitely many initial
resolutions of its labels, including when the outer presentation retains
unreachable vertices. Removing root marks before factoring preserves
these observations.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.RootResolutionApproximation

/-!
---
title: Finite support for initial observations
type: theorem
---
Initial observations of a substitution depend on finitely many initial
resolutions of its labels, including when the outer presentation retains
unreachable vertices. Removing root marks before factoring preserves
these observations.
-/
namespace Lax369799.InitialResolutionApproximation
open RankedSystems Morphisms FiniteResolutionNormalForms ObservedSubstitution

axiom finite_support {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} {V : Type} [Fintype V]
    (P : Presentation (SetSystem A) n V) (R : System A n)
    (hR : InitYield (trim (FinitePresentations.flattenPresentation (finiteLabels P))) R) :
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (v : Fin m → V) (c : ∀ i, Component (P.label (v i)).2),
      (∀ i, (c i).rooted = false) ∧
      ∀ (Q : ∀ v, SetSystem A (P.label v).1),
        (∀ i, DirectResolution (Q (v i)) (c i).system) →
        InitYield (trim (FinitePresentations.flattenPresentation
          (finiteLabels (replaceLabels P Q)))) R

end Lax369799.InitialResolutionApproximation

finite_support : ∀ {A : Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankedSet} {n : Nat} {V : Type} [inst : Fintype V]
  (P : Lax369799.RankedSystems.Presentation (Lax369799.RankedSystems.SetSystem A) n V)
  (R : Lax369799.RankedSystems.System A n),
  Lax369799.Morphisms.InitYield
      (Lax369799.RankedSystems.trim
        (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.flattenPresentation (Lax369799.ObservedSubstitution.finiteLabels P)))
      R →
    Exists fun m =>
      Exists fun v =>
        Exists fun c =>
          And (∀ (i : Fin m), Eq (c i).rooted Bool.false)
            (∀ (Q : (v : V) → Lax369799.RankedSystems.SetSystem A (P.label v).fst),
              (∀ (i : Fin m), Lax369799.Morphisms.DirectResolution (Q (v i)) (c i).system) →
                Lax369799.Morphisms.InitYield
                  (Lax369799.RankedSystems.trim
                    (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.flattenPresentation
                      (Lax369799.ObservedSubstitution.finiteLabels (Lax369799.ObservedSubstitution.replaceLabels P Q))))
                  R)

concepts.title: Recurrent cuts in a linked-pair factorization
concepts.description:
A linked-pair factorization can be thinned so that every cut visits the
same vertex of a finite graph. Absorption and idempotence preserve the
prefix and block values when successive blocks are grouped.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.OmegaProducts

/-!
---
title: Recurrent cuts in a linked-pair factorization
type: theorem
---
A linked-pair factorization can be thinned so that every cut visits the
same vertex of a finite graph. Absorption and idempotence preserve the
prefix and block values when successive blocks are grouped.
-/

namespace Lax369799.LinkedPairFactorizations
open WordFactorization OmegaProducts

axiom recurrent_factorization {M V : Type} [Monoid M] [Finite V] {u : ℕ}
    (f : Fin u → M) (P : M → M → Prop) (w : ℕ → Fin u) (v : ℕ → V)
    (h : Accepts f P w) :
    ∃ (a e : M) (c : ℕ → ℕ) (r : V), P a e ∧ e * e = e ∧ a * e = a ∧
      StrictMono c ∧ 0 < c 0 ∧ (∀ i, v (c i) = r) ∧
      (∀ i, block (f ∘ w) 0 (c i) = a) ∧
      (∀ i j, i < j → block (f ∘ w) (c i) (c j) = e)

end Lax369799.LinkedPairFactorizations

statements.signature:
recurrent_factorization : ∀ {M V : Type} [inst : Monoid M] [Finite V] {u : Nat} (f : Fin u → M) (P : M → M → Prop) (w : Nat → Fin u)
  (v : Nat → V),
  Lax369799.OmegaProducts.Accepts f P w →
    Exists fun a =>
      Exists fun e =>
        Exists fun c =>
          Exists fun r =>
            And (P a e)
              (And (Eq (instHMul.hMul e e) e)
                (And (Eq (instHMul.hMul a e) a)
                  (And (StrictMono c)
                    (And (instLTNat.lt 0 (c 0))
                      (And (∀ (i : Nat), Eq (v (c i)) r)
                        (And (∀ (i : Nat), Eq (Lax369799.WordFactorization.block (Function.comp f w) 0 (c i)) a)
                          (∀ (i j : Nat),
                            instLTNat.lt i j →
                              Eq (Lax369799.WordFactorization.block (Function.comp f w) (c i) (c j)) e)))))))

concepts.description:
Finite path-summary algebras recognize the presence of a vertex satisfying

Finite path-summary algebras recognize the presence of a vertex satisfying

namespace Lax369799.LocalRecognition

axiom occurrence {A : RankedSet} (p : ∀ n, A n → Prop) :

    p _ (S.val.graph.label v).2 ∧ q _ (S.val.graph.label w).2 ∧ S.val.graph.edge v d (.inl w)}

concepts.title: The finite modal acceptance game
concepts.description:
At a position consisting of a word state and an input vertex, Eve chooses
a marking satisfying the modal transition. Adam chooses a marked successor.
An empty legal marking ends in the winning terminal; absence of any legal
marking ends in the losing terminal. Both terminals have self-loops, so the
arena is total. The two-move predecessor operation is exactly the modal
one-step condition. Reversed bounded priorities implement the least-even
word condition using the greatest-even convention of finite parity games.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.ModalTransitions
import Lax369799.ParityWinningRegions
import Lax369799.ParityGameEquations
import Mathlib.Data.Finset.Lattice.Fold

/-!
---
title: The finite modal acceptance game
type: theorem
---
At a position consisting of a word state and an input vertex, Eve chooses
a marking satisfying the modal transition. Adam chooses a marked successor.
An empty legal marking ends in the winning terminal; absence of any legal
marking ends in the losing terminal. Both terminals have self-loops, so the
arena is total. The two-move predecessor operation is exactly the modal
one-step condition. Reversed bounded priorities implement the least-even
word condition using the greatest-even convention of finite parity games.
-/

namespace Lax369799.ModalAcceptanceGame
open TransitionEncoding TransitionSystems UnfoldAutomata ModalTransitions FiniteParityGames

def Pre {V : Type} (G : Game V) (X : Set V) : Set V :=
  ParityWinningRegions.Pre G X

abbrev Marking {P : Type} (M : UnfoldAutomaton (TransitionAlphabet P))
    (S : TransitionSystem P) := Fin M.condition.states → Set S.Vertex

abbrev Vertex {P : Type} (M : UnfoldAutomaton (TransitionAlphabet P))
    (S : TransitionSystem P) :=
  (Fin M.condition.states × S.Vertex) ⊕ ((S.Vertex × Marking M S) ⊕ Bool)

def position {P : Type} {M : UnfoldAutomaton (TransitionAlphabet P)} {S : TransitionSystem P}
    (q : Fin M.condition.states) (v : S.Vertex) : Vertex M S := .inl (q, v)

def selection {P : Type} {M : UnfoldAutomaton (TransitionAlphabet P)} {S : TransitionSystem P}
    (v : S.Vertex) (ρ : Marking M S) : Vertex M S := .inr (.inl (v, ρ))

def terminal {P : Type} {M : UnfoldAutomaton (TransitionAlphabet P)} {S : TransitionSystem P}
    (b : Bool) : Vertex M S := .inr (.inr b)

def Edge {P : Type} (M : UnfoldAutomaton (TransitionAlphabet P)) (S : TransitionSystem P) :
    Vertex M S → Vertex M S → Prop
  | .inl (q, v), .inr (.inl (w, ρ)) => v = w ∧ OneStep M q S v ρ
  | .inl (q, v), .inr (.inr false) => ¬ ∃ ρ, OneStep M q S v ρ
  | .inr (.inl (v, ρ)), .inl (q, w) => S.edge v w ∧ w ∈ ρ q
  | .inr (.inl (v, ρ)), .inr (.inr true) => ¬ ∃ q w, S.edge v w ∧ w ∈ ρ q
  | .inr (.inr b), .inr (.inr c) => b = c
  | _, _ => False

def eve {P : Type} (M : UnfoldAutomaton (TransitionAlphabet P)) (S : TransitionSystem P) :
    Vertex M S → Prop
  | .inl _ => True
  | .inr _ => False

def ceiling {u z : ℕ} (D : WordCondition u z) : ℕ :=
  2 * (Finset.univ.sup D.priority + 1)

def priority {P : Type} (M : UnfoldAutomaton (TransitionAlphabet P)) (S : TransitionSystem P) :
    Vertex M S → ℕ
  | .inl (q, _) => ceiling M.condition - M.condition.priority q
  | .inr (.inr false) => 1
  | _ => 0

noncomputable def game {P : Type} (M : UnfoldAutomaton (TransitionAlphabet P))
    (S : TransitionSystem P) : Game (Vertex M S) where
  eve := eve M S
  edge := Edge M S
  priority := priority M S
  total := by
    classical
    intro v
    rcases v with ⟨q, v⟩ | (⟨v, ρ⟩ | b)
    · by_cases h : ∃ ρ, OneStep M q S v ρ
      · exact ⟨selection v h.choose, rfl, h.choose_spec⟩
      · exact ⟨terminal false, h⟩
    · by_cases h : ∃ q w, S.edge v w ∧ w ∈ ρ q
      · obtain ⟨q, w, h⟩ := h
        exact ⟨position q w, h⟩
      · exact ⟨terminal true, h⟩
    · exact ⟨terminal b, rfl⟩

def target {P : Type} (M : UnfoldAutomaton (TransitionAlphabet P))
    (S : TransitionSystem P) (X : Marking M S) : Set (Vertex M S)
  | .inl (q, v) => v ∈ X q
  | .inr (.inr true) => True
  | _ => False

axiom predecessor {P : Type} (M : UnfoldAutomaton (TransitionAlphabet P))
    (S : TransitionSystem P) (q : Fin M.condition.states) (v : S.Vertex) (X : Marking M S) :
    position q v ∈ Pre (game M S) (Pre (game M S) (target M S X)) ↔ OneStep M q S v X

axiom finite {P : Type} (M : UnfoldAutomaton (TransitionAlphabet P)) (S : TransitionSystem P) :
    Finite (Vertex M S)

axiom determined {P : Type} (M : UnfoldAutomaton (TransitionAlphabet P)) (S : TransitionSystem P) :
    ∃ f g : Vertex M S → Vertex M S,
      (game M S).Legal true f ∧ (game M S).Legal false g ∧
        ∀ v, (game M S).WinsFrom true f v ∨ (game M S).WinsFrom false g v

axiom priority_positive {u z : ℕ} (D : WordCondition u z) (q : Fin D.states) :
    0 < ceiling D - D.priority q

axiom reverse_parity {u z : ℕ} (D : WordCondition u z) (w : ℕ → Fin u) :
    D.AcceptsInfinite w ↔ ∃ c, Even c ∧
      (∀ N, ∃ n, N ≤ n ∧ ceiling D - D.priority (D.run w n) = c) ∧
      ∀ b, c < b → ¬ ∀ N, ∃ n, N ≤ n ∧ ceiling D - D.priority (D.run w n) = b

axiom terminal_winning {P : Type} (M : UnfoldAutomaton (TransitionAlphabet P))
    (S : TransitionSystem P) (b : Bool) :
    ParityWinningRegions.Winning (game M S) true (terminal b) ↔ b = true

axiom winning_equation {P : Type} (M : UnfoldAutomaton (TransitionAlphabet P))
    (S : TransitionSystem P) (q : Fin M.condition.states) (v : S.Vertex) :
    ParityWinningRegions.Winning (game M S) true (position q v) ↔
      OneStep M q S v (fun p => {w | ParityWinningRegions.Winning (game M S) true (position p w)})

axiom winning_nested {P : Type} (M : UnfoldAutomaton (TransitionAlphabet P))
    (S : TransitionSystem P) (q : Fin M.condition.states) (v : S.Vertex) :
    ParityWinningRegions.Winning (game M S) true (position q v) ↔
      position q v ∈ ParityGameEquations.solve (game M S) (ceiling M.condition + 1) (fun _ => ∅)

end Lax369799.ModalAcceptanceGame

  (S : Lax369799.TransitionSystems.TransitionSystem P),

    Exists fun g =>
      And ((Lax369799.ModalAcceptanceGame.game M S).Legal Bool.true f)

            Or ((Lax369799.ModalAcceptanceGame.game M S).WinsFrom Bool.true f v)

  (S : Lax369799.TransitionSystems.TransitionSystem P) (q : Fin M.condition.states) (v : S.Vertex)
  (X : Lax369799.ModalAcceptanceGame.Marking M S),
  Iff
    (Set.instMembership.mem
      (Lax369799.ModalAcceptanceGame.Pre (Lax369799.ModalAcceptanceGame.game M S)
        (Lax369799.ModalAcceptanceGame.Pre (Lax369799.ModalAcceptanceGame.game M S)
          (Lax369799.ModalAcceptanceGame.target M S X)))
      (Lax369799.ModalAcceptanceGame.position q v))
