  (S : Lax369799.RankedSystems.System (Lax369799.TransitionEncoding.TransitionAlphabet P) 0)
  (R : Lax369799.DirectionReindexing.Reindexing S)
  (B : (v : S.val.Vertex) → Lax369799.FinitePresentations.FiniteSystem Y (R.arity v))
  (E : Lax369799.SetSystemAlgebras.SetAlgebra Y),
  Eq
    (E.eval 0
      (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.withLabels (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.ofSetSystem S.val) fun v =>
        E.eval ((Lax369799.FinitePresentations.ofSetSystem S.val).graph.label v).fst
          (Lax369799.PortReindexing.rename (B v) (R.map v))))
    (E.eval 0
      (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.withLabels
        (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.ofSetSystem (Lax369799.DirectionReindexing.system S R).val) fun v =>
        E.eval
          ((Lax369799.FinitePresentations.ofSetSystem (Lax369799.DirectionReindexing.system S R).val).graph.label v).fst
          (B v)))

concepts.title: Locally surjective maps of finite presentations
concepts.description:
A cover of presentations preserves labels, initial vertices, roots, and
edges, and is surjective on initial vertices, roots, and each successor
set. Presentations may contain unreachable vertices. Restricting the
source of a cover to its reachable part still covers a reachable target.
This permits finite constructions to be checked before enumerating and
removing unreachable vertices.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.Morphisms

/-!
---
title: Locally surjective maps of finite presentations
type: definition
---
A cover of presentations preserves labels, initial vertices, roots, and
edges, and is surjective on initial vertices, roots, and each successor
set. Presentations may contain unreachable vertices. Restricting the
source of a cover to its reachable part still covers a reachable target.
This permits finite constructions to be checked before enumerating and
removing unreachable vertices.
-/

namespace Lax369799.PresentationCovers
open RankedSystems Morphisms

structure Cover {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} {V W : Type}
    (S : Presentation A n V) (T : Presentation A n W) where
  toFun : V → W
  label : ∀ v, T.label (toFun v) = S.label v
  initial : ∀ v, v ∈ S.initial → toFun v ∈ T.initial
  root : ∀ v, v ∈ S.root → toFun v ∈ T.root
  edge : ∀ v d t, S.edge v d t → T.edge (toFun v) d (Sum.map toFun id t)
  initial_lift : ∀ w, w ∈ T.initial → ∃ v, v ∈ S.initial ∧ toFun v = w
  root_lift : ∀ w, w ∈ T.root → ∃ v, v ∈ S.root ∧ toFun v = w
  edge_lift : ∀ v d t, T.edge (toFun v) d t →
    ∃ s, S.edge v d s ∧ Sum.map toFun id s = t

axiom surjective_of_reachable {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} {V W : Type}
    {S : Presentation A n V} {T : Presentation A n W} (f : Cover S T)
    (hT : ∀ w, T.Reachable w) : Function.Surjective f.toFun

axiom trim_cover {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} {V : Type} [Fintype V]
    (S : Presentation A n V) (T : SetSystem A n) (f : Cover S T.graph) :
    UnfoldsTo T (trim S)

end Lax369799.PresentationCovers

  (S : Lax369799.RankedSystems.Presentation A n V) (T : Lax369799.RankedSystems.SetSystem A n)
  (f : Lax369799.PresentationCovers.Cover S T.graph), Lax369799.Morphisms.UnfoldsTo T (Lax369799.RankedSystems.trim S)

concepts.title: Resolution values of finite presentations
concepts.description:
Initial observations are values of deterministic resolutions of the reachable
restriction. Root observations use roots as starting vertices. Locally
surjective maps preserve both sets of observations.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.Algebras
import Lax369799.RootExpansion

/-!
---
title: Resolution values of finite presentations
type: theorem
---
Initial observations are values of deterministic resolutions of the reachable
restriction. Root observations use roots as starting vertices. Locally
surjective maps preserve both sets of observations.
-/
namespace Lax369799.PresentationObservations
open RankedSystems Morphisms Algebras

noncomputable def values {A B : RankedSet} (E : Algebra B) (η : RankedMap A B)
    {n : ℕ} {V : Type} [Fintype V] (G : Presentation A n V) : Set (B n) :=
  {b | ∃ R : System A n, DirectResolution (trim G) R ∧ E.eval n (relabelSystem η R) = b}

axiom values_remove_roots {A B : RankedSet} (E : Algebra B) (η : RankedMap A B)
    {n : ℕ} {V : Type} [Fintype V] (G : Presentation A n V) :
    values E η { G with root := ∅ } = values E η G

axiom values_cover {A B : RankedSet} (E : Algebra B) (hE : UnfoldInvariant E)
    (η : RankedMap A B) {n : ℕ} {V W : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype W]
    {G : Presentation A n V} {H : Presentation A n W} (f : PresentationCovers.Cover G H) :
    values E η G = values E η H

axiom root_values_cover {A B : RankedSet} (E : Algebra B) (hE : UnfoldInvariant E)
    (η : RankedMap A B) {n : ℕ} {V W : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype W]
    {G : Presentation A n V} {H : Presentation A n W} (f : PresentationCovers.Cover G H) :
    values E η (RootExpansion.startAtRoots G) = values E η (RootExpansion.startAtRoots H)

end Lax369799.PresentationObservations

  Lax369799.Algebras.UnfoldInvariant E →
    ∀ (η : Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankedMap A B) {n : Nat} {V W : Type} [inst : Fintype V] [inst_1 : Fintype W]
      {G : Lax369799.RankedSystems.Presentation A n V} {H : Lax369799.RankedSystems.Presentation A n W}
      (f : Lax369799.PresentationCovers.Cover G H),
      Eq (Lax369799.PresentationObservations.values E η (Lax369799.RootExpansion.startAtRoots G))
        (Lax369799.PresentationObservations.values E η (Lax369799.RootExpansion.startAtRoots H))

  Lax369799.Algebras.UnfoldInvariant E →
    ∀ (η : Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankedMap A B) {n : Nat} {V W : Type} [inst : Fintype V] [inst_1 : Fintype W]
      {G : Lax369799.RankedSystems.Presentation A n V} {H : Lax369799.RankedSystems.Presentation A n W}
      (f : Lax369799.PresentationCovers.Cover G H),
      Eq (Lax369799.PresentationObservations.values E η G) (Lax369799.PresentationObservations.values E η H)

values_remove_roots : ∀ {A B : Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankedSet} (E : Lax369799.Algebras.Algebra B)
  (η : Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankedMap A B) {n : Nat} {V : Type} [inst : Fintype V]
  (G : Lax369799.RankedSystems.Presentation A n V),
  Eq
    (Lax369799.PresentationObservations.values E η
      { label := G.label, initial := G.initial, root := Set.instEmptyCollection.emptyCollection, edge := G.edge,
        direction_valid := ⋯ })
    (Lax369799.PresentationObservations.values E η G)

concepts.title: Executable compilation of modal priority equations
concepts.description:
An explicit finite family of positive modal transition formulas and a
priority map compile to a scalar sentence by structural recursion. The
compiler uses only finite syntax operations. A semantic certificate for
the transition formulas identifies its output with the modal acceptance
game. This is the effective final stage, with the finite transition table
provided as input.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.FiniteMuEquations
import Lax369799.ModalGameEquations

/-!
---
title: Executable compilation of modal priority equations
type: theorem
---
An explicit finite family of positive modal transition formulas and a
priority map compile to a scalar sentence by structural recursion. The
compiler uses only finite syntax operations. A semantic certificate for
the transition formulas identifies its output with the modal acceptance
game. This is the effective final stage, with the finite transition table
provided as input.
-/

namespace Lax369799.PriorityCompilation
open ModalMuCalculus MuSubstitution TransitionEncoding TransitionSystems UnfoldAutomata
open ModalAcceptanceGame

def boundary {P : Type} {d m : ℕ} (n : ℕ)
    (θ : ℕ → Fin d → Formula P m) : ℕ → Fin d → Formula P (d+m) :=
  fun p q => if p = n then .variable (Fin.castAdd m q)
    else rename (Fin.natAdd d) (θ p q)

def compile {P : Type} {d : ℕ} (priority : Fin d → ℕ)
    (transition : Fin d → Formula P d) :
    (n : ℕ) → {m : ℕ} → (ℕ → Fin d → Formula P m) → Fin d → Formula P m
  | 0, _, θ => fun q => substitute (θ (priority q)) (transition q)
  | n+1, _, θ => FiniteMuEquations.solve
      (if n % 2 = 0 then .greatest else .least) (compile priority transition n (boundary n θ))

def sentence {P : Type} {d : ℕ} (priority : Fin d → ℕ)
    (transition : Fin d → Formula P d) (depth : ℕ) (initial : Fin d) : Sentence P :=
  compile priority transition depth (fun _ _ => .bot) initial

axiom compile_correct {P : Type} (M : UnfoldAutomaton (TransitionAlphabet P))
    (δ : Fin M.condition.states → Formula P M.condition.states)
    (S : TransitionSystem P)
    (hδ : ∀ q ρ v, v ∈ (δ q).eval S ρ ↔ ModalTransitions.OneStep M q S v ρ)
    (n : ℕ) {m : ℕ} (θ : ℕ → Fin M.condition.states → Formula P m)
    (ρ : Fin m → Set S.Vertex) :
    (fun q => (compile (ModalGameEquations.statePriority M) δ n θ q).eval S ρ) =
      ModalGameEquations.solve M S n (fun p q => (θ p q).eval S ρ)

axiom sentence_correct {P : Type} (M : UnfoldAutomaton (TransitionAlphabet P))
    (δ : Fin M.condition.states → Formula P M.condition.states)
    (S : TransitionSystem P)
    (hδ : ∀ q ρ v, v ∈ (δ q).eval S ρ ↔ ModalTransitions.OneStep M q S v ρ) :
    Models S (sentence (ModalGameEquations.statePriority M) δ (ceiling M.condition+1)
      M.condition.initial) ↔
      ParityWinningRegions.Winning (game M S) true (position M.condition.initial S.initial)

end Lax369799.PriorityCompilation

statements.signature:
compile_correct : ∀ {P : Type} (M : Lax369799.UnfoldAutomata.UnfoldAutomaton (Lax369799.TransitionEncoding.TransitionAlphabet P))
  (δ : Fin M.condition.states → Lax369799.ModalMuCalculus.Formula P M.condition.states)
  (S : Lax369799.TransitionSystems.TransitionSystem P),
  (∀ (q : Fin M.condition.states) (ρ : Fin M.condition.states → Set S.Vertex) (v : S.Vertex),
      Iff (Set.instMembership.mem (Lax369799.ModalMuCalculus.Formula.eval S (δ q) ρ) v)
        (Lax369799.ModalTransitions.OneStep M q S v ρ)) →
    ∀ (n : Nat) {m : Nat} (θ : Nat → Fin M.condition.states → Lax369799.ModalMuCalculus.Formula P m)
      (ρ : Fin m → Set S.Vertex),
      Eq
        (fun q =>
          Lax369799.ModalMuCalculus.Formula.eval S
            (Lax369799.PriorityCompilation.compile (Lax369799.ModalGameEquations.statePriority M) δ n θ q) ρ)
        (Lax369799.ModalGameEquations.solve M S n fun p q => Lax369799.ModalMuCalculus.Formula.eval S (θ p q) ρ)

sentence_correct : ∀ {P : Type} (M : Lax369799.UnfoldAutomata.UnfoldAutomaton (Lax369799.TransitionEncoding.TransitionAlphabet P))
  (δ : Fin M.condition.states → Lax369799.ModalMuCalculus.Formula P M.condition.states)
  (S : Lax369799.TransitionSystems.TransitionSystem P),
  (∀ (q : Fin M.condition.states) (ρ : Fin M.condition.states → Set S.Vertex) (v : S.Vertex),
      Iff (Set.instMembership.mem (Lax369799.ModalMuCalculus.Formula.eval S (δ q) ρ) v)
        (Lax369799.ModalTransitions.OneStep M q S v ρ)) →
    Iff
      (Lax369799.ModalMuCalculus.Models S
        (Lax369799.PriorityCompilation.sentence (Lax369799.ModalGameEquations.statePriority M) δ
          (instHAdd.hAdd (Lax369799.ModalAcceptanceGame.ceiling M.condition) 1) M.condition.initial))
      (Lax369799.ParityWinningRegions.Winning (Lax369799.ModalAcceptanceGame.game M S) Bool.true
        (Lax369799.ModalAcceptanceGame.position M.condition.initial S.initial))

concepts.title: Transfer of resolutions through bounded profiles
concepts.description:
An inner set-system can be replaced by another with the same bounded
profile. A resolution of the closed flattening then has a resolution of
the replacement with the same value in the observing algebra. The proof
uses factorisation into local resolutions followed by bounded optimal
flatten-resolution replacement.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.OptimalResolutions
import Lax369799.FiniteProfiles

/-!
---
title: Transfer of resolutions through bounded profiles
type: theorem
---
An inner set-system can be replaced by another with the same bounded
profile. A resolution of the closed flattening then has a resolution of
the replacement with the same value in the observing algebra. The proof
uses factorisation into local resolutions followed by bounded optimal
flatten-resolution replacement.
-/
namespace Lax369799.ProfileSubstitution
open RankedSystems Flattening Morphisms Algebras

def withLabels {A B : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} (S : SetSystem A n)
    (f : ∀ v, B (S.graph.label v).1) : SetSystem B n where
  size := S.size
  graph := { S.graph with label := fun v => ⟨(S.graph.label v).1, f v⟩ }
  reachable := S.reachable

axiom transfer_resolution {A B : RankedSet} (E : Algebra B) (hE : UnfoldInvariant E)
    [Finite (B 1)] (η : RankedMap A B) (P : SetSystem (SetSystem A) 0)
    (Q : ∀ v, SetSystem A (P.graph.label v).1)
    (hQ : ∀ v, FiniteProfiles.BoundedProfile (Nat.card (B 1) + 1)
        (fun k R => E.eval k (relabelSystem η R)) (Inner P v) =
      FiniteProfiles.BoundedProfile (Nat.card (B 1) + 1)
        (fun k R => E.eval k (relabelSystem η R)) (Q v))
    (R : System A 0) (hR : DirectResolution (flatten P) R) :
    ∃ U : System A 0, DirectResolution (flatten (withLabels P Q)) U ∧
      E.eval 0 (relabelSystem η R) = E.eval 0 (relabelSystem η U)

end Lax369799.ProfileSubstitution

statements.signature:
transfer_resolution : ∀ {A B : Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankedSet} (E : Lax369799.Algebras.Algebra B),
  Lax369799.Algebras.UnfoldInvariant E →
    ∀ [Finite (B 1)] (η : Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankedMap A B)
      (P : Lax369799.RankedSystems.SetSystem (Lax369799.RankedSystems.SetSystem A) 0)
      (Q : (v : Fin P.size) → Lax369799.RankedSystems.SetSystem A (P.graph.label v).fst),
      (∀ (v : P.Vertex),
          Eq
            (Lax369799.FiniteProfiles.BoundedProfile (instHAdd.hAdd (Nat.card (B 1)) 1)
              (fun k R => E.eval k (Lax369799.RankedSystems.relabelSystem η R)) (Lax369799.Flattening.Inner P v))
            (Lax369799.FiniteProfiles.BoundedProfile (instHAdd.hAdd (Nat.card (B 1)) 1)
              (fun k R => E.eval k (Lax369799.RankedSystems.relabelSystem η R)) (Q v))) →
        ∀ (R : Lax369799.RankedSystems.System A 0),
          Lax369799.Morphisms.DirectResolution (Lax369799.Flattening.flatten P) R →
            Exists fun U =>
              And
                (Lax369799.Morphisms.DirectResolution
                  (Lax369799.Flattening.flatten (Lax369799.ProfileSubstitution.withLabels P Q)) U)
                (Eq (E.eval 0 (Lax369799.RankedSystems.relabelSystem η R))
                  (E.eval 0 (Lax369799.RankedSystems.relabelSystem η U)))

concepts.title: Quantitative automata for the finite bisimulation theorem
concepts.description:
A bound for the recognizing algebra gives explicit bounds for the unary
and nullary types, word states and priorities of the equivalent clone
automaton. The infinite stabilization defining its transition table does
not change any of these finite bounds.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.QuantitativeProfiles
import Lax369799.QuantitativeWordConditions
import Lax369799.BisimAutomatonTheorem

/-!
---
title: Quantitative automata for the finite bisimulation theorem
type: theorem
---
A bound for the recognizing algebra gives explicit bounds for the unary
and nullary types, word states and priorities of the equivalent clone
automaton. The infinite stabilization defining its transition table does
not change any of these finite bounds.
-/

namespace Lax369799.QuantitativeAutomata

def unaryBound (f : ℕ → ℕ) := QuantitativeProfiles.quotientBound f 1
def nullaryBound (f : ℕ → ℕ) := QuantitativeProfiles.quotientBound f 0

def stateBound (f : ℕ → ℕ) :=
  QuantitativeWordConditions.stateBound (unaryBound f) (nullaryBound f)

def priorityBound (f : ℕ → ℕ) :=
  QuantitativeWordConditions.priorityBound (unaryBound f)

open TransitionEncoding UnfoldAutomata

axiom automaton_bound {P : Type} [Finite P]
    (L : Algebras.Language (TransitionAlphabet P))
    (hL : ∀ S T,RankedBisimilar S T → (S ∈ L ↔ T ∈ L))
    (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hA : QuantitativeRecognition.Bound f L) :
    ∃ M : UnfoldAutomaton (TransitionAlphabet P),
      BisimAutomata.IsBisimAutomaton M ∧ Recognizes M L ∧
      M.unary ≤ unaryBound f ∧ M.nullary ≤ nullaryBound f ∧
      M.condition.states ≤ stateBound f ∧ (∀ q,M.condition.priority q ≤ priorityBound f)

end Lax369799.QuantitativeAutomata

statements.signature:
automaton_bound : ∀ {P : Type} [Finite P] (L : Lax369799.Algebras.Language (Lax369799.TransitionEncoding.TransitionAlphabet P)),
  (∀ (S T : Lax369799.RankedSystems.System (Lax369799.TransitionEncoding.TransitionAlphabet P) 0),
      Lax369799.TransitionEncoding.RankedBisimilar S T →
        Iff (Set.instMembership.mem L S) (Set.instMembership.mem L T)) →
    ∀ (f : Nat → Nat),
      Lax369799.QuantitativeRecognition.Bound f L →
        Exists fun M =>
          And (Lax369799.BisimAutomata.IsBisimAutomaton M)
            (And (Lax369799.UnfoldAutomata.Recognizes M L)
              (And (instLENat.le M.unary (Lax369799.QuantitativeAutomata.unaryBound f))
                (And (instLENat.le M.nullary (Lax369799.QuantitativeAutomata.nullaryBound f))
                  (And (instLENat.le M.condition.states (Lax369799.QuantitativeAutomata.stateBound f))
                    (∀ (q : Fin M.condition.states),
                      instLENat.le (M.condition.priority q) (Lax369799.QuantitativeAutomata.priorityBound f))))))

concepts.title: Explicit state and priority bounds for word determinization
concepts.description:
Safra positions admit padded finite-vector encodings. Bounding the full
label-and-mark table and the subsequent appearance record gives numeric
bounds computed from the number of nondeterministic states.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.OmegaDeterminization

/-!
---
title: Explicit state and priority bounds for word determinization
type: theorem
---
Safra positions admit padded finite-vector encodings. Bounding the full
label-and-mark table and the subsequent appearance record gives numeric
bounds computed from the number of nondeterministic states.
-/

namespace Lax369799.QuantitativeDeterminization

def safraBound (n : ℕ) : ℕ := (2^(n+1))^((n+2)^n)
def stateBound (n : ℕ) : ℕ := safraBound n * (safraBound n)^(safraBound n)
def priorityBound (n : ℕ) : ℕ := 2*safraBound n

open UnfoldAutomata OmegaDeterminization

axiom determinization_bound {u z : ℕ} (B : Buchi u) (bound : ℕ) (hb : B.states ≤ bound) :
    ∃ D : WordCondition u z,
      (∀ w,D.AcceptsInfinite w ↔ B.Accepts w) ∧
      D.states ≤ stateBound bound ∧ (∀ q,D.priority q ≤ priorityBound bound)

end Lax369799.QuantitativeDeterminization

statements.signature:
determinization_bound : ∀ {u z : Nat} (B : Lax369799.OmegaDeterminization.Buchi u) (bound : Nat),
  instLENat.le B.states bound →
    Exists fun D =>
      And (∀ (w : Nat → Fin u), Iff (D.AcceptsInfinite w) (B.Accepts w))
        (And (instLENat.le D.states (Lax369799.QuantitativeDeterminization.stateBound bound))
          (∀ (q : Fin D.states),
            instLENat.le (D.priority q) (Lax369799.QuantitativeDeterminization.priorityBound bound)))

concepts.title: A computable finite-model bound under bisimulation invariance
concepts.description:
The quantitative construction of Theorem 2 gives a bounded modal
certificate. Its small-model property provides a syntax-computed bound
for every nonempty bisimulation-invariant MSO sentence on finite systems.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.QuantitativeAutomata
import Lax369799.ModalSmallModels
import Lax369799.MonadicSecondOrder

/-!
---
title: A computable finite-model bound under bisimulation invariance
type: theorem
---
The quantitative construction of Theorem 2 gives a bounded modal
certificate. Its small-model property provides a syntax-computed bound
for every nonempty bisimulation-invariant MSO sentence on finite systems.
-/

namespace Lax369799.QuantitativeFiniteTheorem

def modelBound {P : Type} (φ : MonadicSecondOrder.Sentence P) : ℕ :=
  QuantitativeAutomata.stateBound (QuantitativeRecognition.msoBound φ)

open TransitionEncoding TransitionSystems UnfoldAutomata ParityWinningRegions

axiom modal_certificate {P : Type} [Finite P] (φ : MonadicSecondOrder.Sentence P)
    (hφ : BisimulationInvariant {S | MonadicSecondOrder.Models S φ}) :
    ∃ M : UnfoldAutomaton (TransitionAlphabet P),
      M.unary ≤ QuantitativeAutomata.unaryBound (QuantitativeRecognition.msoBound φ) ∧
      M.nullary ≤ QuantitativeAutomata.nullaryBound (QuantitativeRecognition.msoBound φ) ∧
      M.condition.states ≤ modelBound φ ∧
      (∀ q,M.condition.priority q ≤ QuantitativeAutomata.priorityBound (QuantitativeRecognition.msoBound φ)) ∧
      ∀ S,MonadicSecondOrder.Models S φ ↔ Winning (ModalAcceptanceGame.game M S) true
        (ModalAcceptanceGame.position M.condition.initial S.initial)

open TransitionEncoding TransitionSystems UnfoldAutomata ParityWinningRegions

axiom nonempty_bound {P : Type} [Finite P] (φ : MonadicSecondOrder.Sentence P)
    (hφ : BisimulationInvariant {S | MonadicSecondOrder.Models S φ})
    (h : ∃ S,MonadicSecondOrder.Models S φ) :
    ∃ T : TransitionSystem P,T.size ≤ modelBound φ ∧ MonadicSecondOrder.Models T φ

end Lax369799.QuantitativeFiniteTheorem

statements.signature:
modal_certificate : ∀ {P : Type} [Finite P] (φ : Lax369799.MonadicSecondOrder.Sentence P),
  Lax369799.TransitionSystems.BisimulationInvariant (Set.ofPred fun S => Lax369799.MonadicSecondOrder.Models S φ) →
    Exists fun M =>
      And
        (instLENat.le M.unary
          (Lax369799.QuantitativeAutomata.unaryBound (Lax369799.QuantitativeRecognition.msoBound φ)))
        (And
          (instLENat.le M.nullary
            (Lax369799.QuantitativeAutomata.nullaryBound (Lax369799.QuantitativeRecognition.msoBound φ)))
          (And (instLENat.le M.condition.states (Lax369799.QuantitativeFiniteTheorem.modelBound φ))
            (And
              (∀ (q : Fin M.condition.states),
                instLENat.le (M.condition.priority q)
                  (Lax369799.QuantitativeAutomata.priorityBound (Lax369799.QuantitativeRecognition.msoBound φ)))
              (∀ (S : Lax369799.TransitionSystems.TransitionSystem P),
                Iff (Lax369799.MonadicSecondOrder.Models S φ)
                  (Lax369799.ParityWinningRegions.Winning (Lax369799.ModalAcceptanceGame.game M S) Bool.true
                    (Lax369799.ModalAcceptanceGame.position M.condition.initial S.initial))))))

nonempty_bound : ∀ {P : Type} [Finite P] (φ : Lax369799.MonadicSecondOrder.Sentence P),
  Lax369799.TransitionSystems.BisimulationInvariant (Set.ofPred fun S => Lax369799.MonadicSecondOrder.Models S φ) →
    (Exists fun S => Lax369799.MonadicSecondOrder.Models S φ) →
      Exists fun T =>
        And (instLENat.le T.size (Lax369799.QuantitativeFiniteTheorem.modelBound φ))
          (Lax369799.MonadicSecondOrder.Models T φ)

concepts.title: Computable bounds on the syntactic nullary and unary sorts
concepts.description:
The number of possible small profile entries is bounded by a finite sum.
Initial and root profile codes give a bound on each contextual quotient
without computing equivalence of contexts. This is the quantitative
step used in the effectivity argument after Theorem 2.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.QuantitativeRecognition
import Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder
import Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance
import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Group.Finset.Basic

/-!
---
title: Computable bounds on the syntactic nullary and unary sorts
type: theorem
---
The number of possible small profile entries is bounded by a finite sum.
Initial and root profile codes give a bound on each contextual quotient
without computing equivalence of contexts. This is the quantitative
step used in the effectivity argument after Theorem 2.
-/

namespace Lax369799.QuantitativeProfiles

def entryBound (f : ℕ → ℕ) (bound n : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n*bound+1),f k*n^k

def quotientBound (f : ℕ → ℕ) (n : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  2 ^ (2*entryBound f (f 1+1) n)

open RankedSystems Algebras QuantitativeRecognition

axiom syntactic_bound {A : RankedSet} (L : Language A) (hL : UnfoldInvariantLanguage L)
    (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hrec : Bound f L) (n : ℕ) :
    Nat.card (FiniteContextualOrder.Carrier (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) n) ≤ quotientBound f n

end Lax369799.QuantitativeProfiles

statements.signature:
syntactic_bound : ∀ {A : Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankedSet} (L : Lax369799.Algebras.Language A),
  Lax369799.Algebras.UnfoldInvariantLanguage L →
    ∀ (f : Nat → Nat),
      Lax369799.QuantitativeRecognition.Bound f L →
        ∀ (n : Nat),
          instLENat.le (Nat.card (Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.Carrier (Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) n))
            (Lax369799.QuantitativeProfiles.quotientBound f n)

concepts.title: Computable bounds for MSO recognizing algebras
concepts.description:
The effectivity argument starts with a syntax-computed bound for every
sort of an MSO recognizing algebra. Products multiply bounds, nonempty
powersets exponentiate them, and atomic path summaries have explicit
finite cardinalities.
concepts.sourceText:
import Mathlib.SetTheory.Cardinal.NatCard
import Lax369799.MSORecognition
import Lax369799.SetLogicTranslation

/-!
---
title: Computable bounds for MSO recognizing algebras
type: theorem
---
The effectivity argument starts with a syntax-computed bound for every
sort of an MSO recognizing algebra. Products multiply bounds, nonempty
powersets exponentiate them, and atomic path summaries have explicit
finite cardinalities.
-/

namespace Lax369799.QuantitativeRecognition
open RankedSystems Algebras SetLogic

def Bound (f : ℕ → ℕ) {A : RankedSet} (L : Language A) : Prop :=
  ∃ (B : RankedSet) (E : Algebra B) (η : RankedMap A B) (F : Set (B 0)),
    RankwiseFinite B ∧ Recognizes E η F L ∧ ∀ k,Nat.card (B k) ≤ f k

def logicBound {P : Type} : {X : Type} → Formula P X → ℕ → ℕ
  | _, .subset _ _, k => 2 ^ (4*(k+1))
  | _, .initial _, k => 2 ^ (4*(k+1))
  | _, .proposition _ _, k => 2 ^ (4*(k+1))
  | _, .edge _ _, k => 2 ^ (4*(k+1))
  | _, .neg φ, k => logicBound φ k
  | _, .disj φ ψ, k => logicBound φ k * logicBound ψ k
  | _, .existsSet φ, k => 2 ^ logicBound φ k

def msoBound {P : Type} (φ : MonadicSecondOrder.Sentence P) : ℕ → ℕ :=
  logicBound (SetLogicTranslation.translate φ (X := Empty) Fin.elim0 Fin.elim0)

axiom mso_bound {P : Type} [Finite P] (φ : MonadicSecondOrder.Sentence P) :
    Bound (msoBound φ) {S | MonadicSecondOrder.Models (TransitionEncoding.decode S) φ}

end Lax369799.QuantitativeRecognition

statements.signature:
mso_bound : ∀ {P : Type} [Finite P] (φ : Lax369799.MonadicSecondOrder.Sentence P),
  Lax369799.QuantitativeRecognition.Bound (Lax369799.QuantitativeRecognition.msoBound φ)
    (Set.ofPred fun S => Lax369799.MonadicSecondOrder.Models (Lax369799.TransitionEncoding.decode S) φ)

concepts.title: Computable bounds for the algebraic branch automaton
concepts.description:
The linked-pair automaton stores three elements of the unary monoid and
two flags. Determinization and the finite-word evaluator give explicit
state and priority bounds from the unary and nullary sort bounds.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.QuantitativeDeterminization
import Lax369799.AlgebraicBranchCondition

/-!
---
title: Computable bounds for the algebraic branch automaton
type: theorem
---
The linked-pair automaton stores three elements of the unary monoid and
two flags. Determinization and the finite-word evaluator give explicit
state and priority bounds from the unary and nullary sort bounds.
-/

namespace Lax369799.QuantitativeWordConditions

def buchiBound (u : ℕ) : ℕ := 4*(u+1)^3

def stateBound (u z : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  QuantitativeDeterminization.stateBound (buchiBound u) * (z^z+z+1)

def priorityBound (u : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  QuantitativeDeterminization.priorityBound (buchiBound u)

open UnfoldAutomata

axiom exists_condition {A : RankedSystems.RankedSet} (E : FiniteSyntacticAlgebra.Algebra A)
    (F : Set (A 0)) [Fintype (A 1)] [Fintype (A 0)]
    (u z : ℕ) (hu : Fintype.card (A 1) ≤ u) (hz : Fintype.card (A 0) ≤ z) :
    ∃ D : WordCondition (Fintype.card (A 1)) (Fintype.card (A 0)),
      (∀ w a,D.AcceptsFinite w a ↔ FiniteBranchWords.value E
        (w.map (Fintype.equivFin (A 1)).symm) ((Fintype.equivFin (A 0)).symm a) ∈ F) ∧
      (∀ w,D.AcceptsInfinite w ↔ AlgebraicOmegaWords.Accepts E F
        (fun n => (Fintype.equivFin (A 1)).symm (w n))) ∧
      D.states ≤ stateBound u z ∧ (∀ q,D.priority q ≤ priorityBound u)

end Lax369799.QuantitativeWordConditions

statements.signature:
exists_condition : ∀ {A : Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankedSet} (E : Lax369799.FiniteSyntacticAlgebra.Algebra A) (F : Set (A 0))
  [inst : Fintype (A 1)] [inst_1 : Fintype (A 0)] (u z : Nat),
  instLENat.le (Fintype.card (A 1)) u →
    instLENat.le (Fintype.card (A 0)) z →
      Exists fun D =>
        And
          (∀ (w : List (Fin (Fintype.card (A 1)))) (a : Fin (Fintype.card (A 0))),
            Iff (D.AcceptsFinite w a)
              (Set.instMembership.mem F
                (Lax369799.FiniteBranchWords.value E
                  (List.map (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (Fintype.equivFin (A 1)).symm) w)
                  (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (Fintype.equivFin (A 0)).symm a))))
          (And
            (∀ (w : Nat → Fin (Fintype.card (A 1))),
              Iff (D.AcceptsInfinite w)
                (Lax369799.AlgebraicOmegaWords.Accepts E F fun n =>
                  EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (Fintype.equivFin (A 1)).symm (w n)))
            (And (instLENat.le D.states (Lax369799.QuantitativeWordConditions.stateBound u z))
              (∀ (q : Fin D.states),
                instLENat.le (D.priority q) (Lax369799.QuantitativeWordConditions.priorityBound u))))

concepts.description:
Ordinary bisimilarity is an equivalence relation. Ranked unfolding and
isomorphism of decodings both preserve it, so the equivalence generated
by these operations implies ordinary bisimilarity after decoding.

concepts.title: Ranking a functional bisimulation
concepts.description:
A functional bisimulation between finite transition systems can be
represented by a ranked system morphism. Directions enumerate target
successors with enough repeated copies to cover every source successor.
Forgetting the directions recovers the original transition systems.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.BisimulationQuotient
import Lax369799.TransitionEncoding

/-!
---
title: Ranking a functional bisimulation
type: theorem
---
A functional bisimulation between finite transition systems can be
represented by a ranked system morphism. Directions enumerate target
successors with enough repeated copies to cover every source successor.
Forgetting the directions recovers the original transition systems.
-/
namespace Lax369799.RankedLifting
open RankedSystems Morphisms TransitionSystems TransitionEncoding BisimulationQuotient

axiom map_lift {P : Type} (S T : TransitionSystem P) (f : SystemMap S T) :
    ∃ (R U : System (TransitionAlphabet P) 0), decode R = S ∧ decode U = T ∧
      Nonempty (Morphism R.val U.val)

end Lax369799.RankedLifting

  Exists fun R =>
    Exists fun U =>
      And (Eq (Lax369799.TransitionEncoding.decode R) S)
        (And (Eq (Lax369799.TransitionEncoding.decode U) T) (Nonempty (Lax369799.Morphisms.Morphism R.val U.val)))

concepts.title: Ranked sets, set-systems, and systems
concepts.description:
A ranked set is a family of sets indexed by natural numbers. A set-system
has finitely many labelled vertices, initial and root vertices, and edges
with a direction and either a vertex or a variable as target. Every vertex
is reachable from an initial or root vertex. A system has one initial
vertex, no roots, and exactly one successor in every available direction.

This is the earlier reachable interface. The revised Section 2.2 allows
unreachable vertices in set-systems (`FinitePresentations`) and requires
all output variables of a deterministic system to be reachable
(`SupportedSystems`). Finite vertex sets are enumerated by
`Fin size`; directions and variables use zero-based indices. `Presentation`
allows an arbitrary finite vertex type when constructing these objects.
concepts.sourceText:
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.EquivFin
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Sum
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Sigma
import Mathlib.Logic.Relation
import Mathlib.Data.Set.Finite.Basic

/-!
---
title: Ranked sets, set-systems, and systems
type: definition
---
A ranked set is a family of sets indexed by natural numbers. A set-system
has finitely many labelled vertices, initial and root vertices, and edges
with a direction and either a vertex or a variable as target. Every vertex
is reachable from an initial or root vertex. A system has one initial
vertex, no roots, and exactly one successor in every available direction.

This is the earlier reachable interface. The revised Section 2.2 allows
unreachable vertices in set-systems (`FinitePresentations`) and requires
all output variables of a deterministic system to be reachable
(`SupportedSystems`). Finite vertex sets are enumerated by
`Fin size`; directions and variables use zero-based indices. `Presentation`
allows an arbitrary finite vertex type when constructing these objects.
-/

namespace Lax369799.RankedSystems

abbrev RankedSet := ℕ → Type
abbrev Symbol (A : RankedSet) := (n : ℕ) × A n
abbrev RankedMap (A B : RankedSet) := ∀ n, A n → B n

def RankwiseFinite (A : RankedSet) : Prop := ∀ n, Finite (A n)

structure Presentation (A : RankedSet) (n : ℕ) (V : Type) where
  label : V → Symbol A
  initial : Set V
  root : Set V
  edge : V → ℕ → V ⊕ Fin n → Prop
  direction_valid : ∀ v d t, edge v d t → d < (label v).1

def Presentation.Step {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} {V : Type}
    (S : Presentation A n V) (v w : V) : Prop :=
  ∃ d, S.edge v d (.inl w)

def Presentation.Reachable {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} {V : Type}
    (S : Presentation A n V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  ∃ r, (r ∈ S.initial ∨ r ∈ S.root) ∧ Relation.ReflTransGen S.Step r v

structure SetSystem (A : RankedSet) (n : ℕ) where
  size : ℕ
  graph : Presentation A n (Fin size)
  reachable : ∀ v, graph.Reachable v

abbrev SetSystem.Vertex {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} (S : SetSystem A n) := Fin S.size

/-- Restrict to reachable vertices and enumerate the resulting finite set. -/
noncomputable def trim {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} {V : Type} [Fintype V]
    (S : Presentation A n V) : SetSystem A n := by
  classical
  let W := {v : V // S.Reachable v}
  let e : W ≃ Fin (Fintype.card W) := Fintype.equivFin W
  let g : Fin (Fintype.card W) → V := fun v => (e.symm v).val
  let G : Presentation A n (Fin (Fintype.card W)) := {
    label := fun v => S.label (g v)
    initial := fun v => S.initial (g v)
    root := fun v => S.root (g v)
    edge := fun v d t => S.edge (g v) d (Sum.map g id t)
    direction_valid := fun v d t h => S.direction_valid (g v) d _ h }
  refine ⟨Fintype.card W, G, ?_⟩
  intro v
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hp⟩ := (e.symm v).property
  have rr : S.Reachable r := ⟨r, hr, .refl⟩
  refine ⟨e ⟨r, rr⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change S.initial (g (e ⟨r, rr⟩)) ∨ S.root (g (e ⟨r, rr⟩))
    simp only [g, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
    exact hr
  · have liftPath : ∀ {a b : V} (h : Relation.ReflTransGen S.Step a b)
        (ha : S.Reachable a) (hb : S.Reachable b),
        Relation.ReflTransGen G.Step (e ⟨a, ha⟩) (e ⟨b, hb⟩) := by
      intro a b h
      induction h with
      | refl => intro ha hb; exact .refl
      | @tail b c h hbc ih =>
        intro ha hc
        have hb : S.Reachable b := by
          obtain ⟨r, hr, hp⟩ := ha
          exact ⟨r, hr, hp.trans h⟩
        apply Relation.ReflTransGen.tail (ih ha hb)
        obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := hbc
        exact ⟨d, by simpa [G, g] using hd⟩
    simpa using liftPath hp rr (e.symm v).property

def SetSystem.Deterministic {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} (S : SetSystem A n) : Prop :=
  (∃ i, S.graph.initial = {i}) ∧ S.graph.root = ∅ ∧
  ∀ v d, d < (S.graph.label v).1 → ∃! t, S.graph.edge v d t

abbrev System (A : RankedSet) (n : ℕ) := {S : SetSystem A n // S.Deterministic}

def relabel {A B : RankedSet} (f : RankedMap A B) {n : ℕ}
    (S : SetSystem A n) : SetSystem B n where
  size := S.size
  graph := { S.graph with label := fun v => ⟨(S.graph.label v).1,
    f _ (S.graph.label v).2⟩ }
  reachable := S.reachable

def relabelSystem {A B : RankedSet} (f : RankedMap A B) {n : ℕ}
    (S : System A n) : System B n := ⟨relabel f S.val, S.property⟩

def atomic {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} (a : A n) : SetSystem A n where
  size := 1
  graph := {
    label := fun _ => ⟨n, a⟩
    initial := Set.univ
    root := ∅
    edge := fun _ d t => ∃ i : Fin n, d = i.val ∧ t = Sum.inr i
    direction_valid := by rintro _ _ _ ⟨i, rfl, rfl⟩; exact i.isLt }
  reachable := fun v => ⟨v, Or.inl (Set.mem_univ v), .refl⟩

def atomicSystem {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} (a : A n) : System A n :=
  ⟨atomic a, by
    change (∃ i : Fin 1, Set.univ = {i}) ∧ (∅ : Set (Fin 1)) = ∅ ∧ _
    refine ⟨⟨0, by ext v; simp [Subsingleton.elim v 0]⟩, rfl, ?_⟩
    intro v d hd
    refine ⟨Sum.inr ⟨d, hd⟩, ⟨⟨d, hd⟩, rfl, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    rintro t ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
    congr 1
    exact Fin.ext hi.symm⟩

noncomputable def uproot {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} (S : SetSystem A n) : SetSystem A n :=
  trim { S.graph with initial := S.graph.root, root := ∅ }

def plant {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} (S : SetSystem A n) : SetSystem A n where
  size := S.size
  graph := { S.graph with initial := ∅, root := S.graph.root ∪ S.graph.initial }
  reachable := by
    intro v
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hp⟩ := S.reachable v
    exact ⟨r, Or.inr (hr.elim Or.inr Or.inl), hp⟩

noncomputable def sum {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} (S T : SetSystem A n) : SetSystem A n :=
  trim {
    label := Sum.elim S.graph.label T.graph.label
    initial := Sum.elim S.graph.initial T.graph.initial
    root := Sum.elim S.graph.root T.graph.root
    edge := fun v d t => match v with
      | .inl v => ∃ t', S.graph.edge v d t' ∧ t = Sum.map Sum.inl id t'
      | .inr v => ∃ t', T.graph.edge v d t' ∧ t = Sum.map Sum.inr id t'
    direction_valid := by
      intro v d t h
      cases v with
      | inl v => obtain ⟨t', ht, _⟩ := h; exact S.graph.direction_valid v d t' ht
      | inr v => obtain ⟨t', ht, _⟩ := h; exact T.graph.direction_valid v d t' ht }

end Lax369799.RankedSystems

concepts.title: Boolean closure and inverse relabelling of recognizable languages
concepts.description:
Rankwise-finite algebraic recognition is preserved by Boolean operations
and inverse relabelling. Products combine recognizing algebras; complement
changes the accepting subset, and inverse relabelling composes letter maps.
These are the Boolean and cylindrification clauses of Section 3.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.Algebras

/-!
---
title: Boolean closure and inverse relabelling of recognizable languages
type: theorem
---
Rankwise-finite algebraic recognition is preserved by Boolean operations
and inverse relabelling. Products combine recognizing algebras; complement
changes the accepting subset, and inverse relabelling composes letter maps.
These are the Boolean and cylindrification clauses of Section 3.
-/
namespace Lax369799.RecognitionClosure
open RankedSystems Algebras

axiom complement {A : RankedSet} (L : Language A) (h : Recognizable L) : Recognizable Lᶜ

axiom intersection {A : RankedSet} (L K : Language A)
    (hL : Recognizable L) (hK : Recognizable K) : Recognizable (L ∩ K)

axiom union {A : RankedSet} (L K : Language A)
    (hL : Recognizable L) (hK : Recognizable K) : Recognizable (L ∪ K)

axiom inverse_relabel {A B : RankedSet} (η : RankedMap A B) (L : Language B)
    (hL : Recognizable L) : Recognizable {S | relabelSystem η S ∈ L}

end Lax369799.RecognitionClosure

  Lax369799.Algebras.Recognizable L → Lax369799.Algebras.Recognizable (Set.instCompl.compl L)

  Lax369799.Algebras.Recognizable L →
    Lax369799.Algebras.Recognizable K → Lax369799.Algebras.Recognizable (Set.instInter.inter L K)

inverse_relabel : ∀ {A B : Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankedSet} (η : Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankedMap A B)
  (L : Lax369799.Algebras.Language B),
  Lax369799.Algebras.Recognizable L →
    Lax369799.Algebras.Recognizable
      (Set.ofPred fun S => Set.instMembership.mem L (Lax369799.RankedSystems.relabelSystem η S))

  Lax369799.Algebras.Recognizable L →
    Lax369799.Algebras.Recognizable K → Lax369799.Algebras.Recognizable (Set.instUnion.union L K)

concepts.title: Existential projection of recognizable languages
concepts.description:
Forgetting vertex marks preserves recognizability. More generally, a
surjective rank-preserving letter map induces an existential projection:
a system is accepted if its vertices admit labels above their old labels
that form an accepted system. Nonempty powerset evaluation records all
possible evaluations of these choices.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.NonemptyPowersets

/-!
---
title: Existential projection of recognizable languages
type: theorem
---
Forgetting vertex marks preserves recognizability. More generally, a
surjective rank-preserving letter map induces an existential projection:
a system is accepted if its vertices admit labels above their old labels
that form an accepted system. Nonempty powerset evaluation records all
possible evaluations of these choices.
-/
namespace Lax369799.RecognitionProjection
open RankedSystems Algebras PolynomialContexts

def Projected {A B : RankedSet} (η : RankedMap A B) (L : Language A) : Language B :=
  {S | ∃ q : ∀ v, A (S.val.graph.label v).1,
    (∀ v, η _ (q v) = (S.val.graph.label v).2) ∧ withLabels S q ∈ L}

axiom recognizable {A B : RankedSet} (η : RankedMap A B)
    (hη : ∀ n, Function.Surjective (η n)) (L : Language A) (hL : Recognizable L) :
    Recognizable (Projected η L)

end Lax369799.RecognitionProjection

statements.signature:
recognizable : ∀ {A B : Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankedSet} (η : Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankedMap A B),
  (∀ (n : Nat), Function.Surjective (η n)) →
    ∀ (L : Lax369799.Algebras.Language A),
      Lax369799.Algebras.Recognizable L →
        Lax369799.Algebras.Recognizable (Lax369799.RecognitionProjection.Projected η L)

concepts.title: Testing infinite runs on finite branch graphs
concepts.description:
A finite branch graph unfolds to an ultimately periodic branch, and every
ultimately periodic branch has such a presentation. Thus a parity condition
holds on all infinite branches exactly when it holds on the unfoldings of
all finite branch graphs.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.RunBranchObservations
import Lax369799.UnfoldBranches

/-!
---
title: Testing infinite runs on finite branch graphs
type: theorem
---
A finite branch graph unfolds to an ultimately periodic branch, and every
ultimately periodic branch has such a presentation. Thus a parity condition
holds on all infinite branches exactly when it holds on the unfoldings of
all finite branch graphs.
-/
namespace Lax369799.RegularBranchWords
open RankedSystems (RankedSet System)
open UnfoldAutomata RunBranchObservations

def position {A : RankedSet} {S : System A 0} (b : RegularBranch S) : ℕ → Fin b.size
  | 0 => b.start
  | n + 1 => b.next (position b n)

def trace {A : RankedSet} {S : System A 0} (b : RegularBranch S) : InfiniteBranch S where
  vertex := fun n => b.vertex (position b n)
  direction := fun n => b.direction (position b n)
  starts := b.starts
  follows := fun n => b.follows (position b n)

axiom periodic {A : RankedSet} {S : System A 0} (b : RegularBranch S) :
    UnfoldBranches.Periodic (trace b)

axiom represents {A : RankedSet} {S : System A 0} (b : InfiniteBranch S)
    (hb : UnfoldBranches.Periodic b) :
    ∃ c : RegularBranch S, ∀ n,
      (⟨(trace c).vertex n, (trace c).direction n⟩ : (v : S.val.Vertex) × Fin (Rank S v)) =
        ⟨b.vertex n, b.direction n⟩

axiom regular_test {A : RankedSet} (M : UnfoldAutomaton A) (S : System A 0) (r : Run M S) :
    (∀ b : RegularBranch S, M.condition.AcceptsInfinite
      (fun n => r.edgeType ((trace b).vertex n) ((trace b).direction n))) ↔
    (∀ b : InfiniteBranch S, M.condition.AcceptsInfinite
      (fun n => r.edgeType (b.vertex n) (b.direction n)))

end Lax369799.RegularBranchWords

statements.signature:
regular_test : ∀ {A : Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankedSet} (M : Lax369799.UnfoldAutomata.UnfoldAutomaton A)
  (S : Lax369799.RankedSystems.System A 0) (r : Lax369799.UnfoldAutomata.Run M S),
  Iff
    (∀ (b : Lax369799.RunBranchObservations.RegularBranch S),
      M.condition.AcceptsInfinite fun n =>
        r.edgeType ((Lax369799.RegularBranchWords.trace b).vertex n)
          ((Lax369799.RegularBranchWords.trace b).direction n))
    (∀ (b : Lax369799.UnfoldAutomata.InfiniteBranch S),
      M.condition.AcceptsInfinite fun n => r.edgeType (b.vertex n) (b.direction n))

represents : ∀ {A : Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankedSet} {S : Lax369799.RankedSystems.System A 0}
  (b : Lax369799.UnfoldAutomata.InfiniteBranch S),
  Lax369799.UnfoldBranches.Periodic b →
    Exists fun c =>
      ∀ (n : Nat),
        Eq ⟨(Lax369799.RegularBranchWords.trace c).vertex n, (Lax369799.RegularBranchWords.trace c).direction n⟩
          ⟨b.vertex n, b.direction n⟩

concepts.title: Regular-tree recognition from unfold-invariant recognition
concepts.description:
An unfold-invariant language recognized by a rankwise-finite algebra has
a rankwise-finite unfolding-invariant recognizing algebra. First restrict
to values realized by systems over the original alphabet. Then quotient by
all closed polynomial acceptance tests.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.GeneratedAlgebra
import Lax369799.PolynomialUnfolding

/-!
---
title: Regular-tree recognition from unfold-invariant recognition
type: theorem
---
An unfold-invariant language recognized by a rankwise-finite algebra has
a rankwise-finite unfolding-invariant recognizing algebra. First restrict
to values realized by systems over the original alphabet. Then quotient by
all closed polynomial acceptance tests.
-/
namespace Lax369799.Regularization
open RankedSystems Algebras

axiom generated_closed_invariant {A B : RankedSet} (E : Algebra B) (η : RankedMap A B)
    (G : Algebra (GeneratedAlgebra.Carrier E η))
    (hG : ∀ n (S : System (GeneratedAlgebra.Carrier E η) n),
      (G.eval n S).val = E.eval n (relabelSystem (GeneratedAlgebra.projection E η) S))
    (F : Set (B 0)) (L : Language A) (hL : UnfoldInvariantLanguage L) (hrec : Recognizes E η F L) :
    PolynomialUnfolding.ClosedInvariant G {b | b.val ∈ F}

axiom regular_tree_recognizable {A : RankedSet} (L : Language A)
    (hL : UnfoldInvariantLanguage L) (hrec : Recognizable L) : RegularTreeRecognizable L

end Lax369799.Regularization

statements.signature:
generated_closed_invariant : ∀ {A B : Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankedSet} (E : Lax369799.Algebras.Algebra B)
  (η : Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankedMap A B) (G : Lax369799.Algebras.Algebra (Lax369799.GeneratedAlgebra.Carrier E η)),
  (∀ (n : Nat) (S : Lax369799.RankedSystems.System (Lax369799.GeneratedAlgebra.Carrier E η) n),
      Eq (G.eval n S).val
        (E.eval n (Lax369799.RankedSystems.relabelSystem (Lax369799.GeneratedAlgebra.projection E η) S))) →
    ∀ (F : Set (B 0)) (L : Lax369799.Algebras.Language A),
      Lax369799.Algebras.UnfoldInvariantLanguage L →
        Lax369799.Algebras.Recognizes E η F L →
          Lax369799.PolynomialUnfolding.ClosedInvariant G (Set.ofPred fun b => Set.instMembership.mem F b.val)

regular_tree_recognizable : ∀ {A : Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankedSet} (L : Lax369799.Algebras.Language A),
  Lax369799.Algebras.UnfoldInvariantLanguage L →
    Lax369799.Algebras.Recognizable L → Lax369799.Algebras.RegularTreeRecognizable L

concepts.title: Renaming variables in systems and resolutions
concepts.description:
Variable renaming preserves deterministic systems, commutes with relabelling,
and respects identity and composition. Morphisms and their local lifting
properties are preserved even when several variables are identified.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.Resolutions

/-!
---
title: Renaming variables in systems and resolutions
type: theorem
---
Variable renaming preserves deterministic systems, commutes with relabelling,
and respects identity and composition. Morphisms and their local lifting
properties are preserved even when several variables are identified.
-/
namespace Lax369799.Renaming
open RankedSystems Morphisms Resolutions

def renameSystem {A : RankedSet} {m n : ℕ} (σ : Fin m → Fin n) (S : System A m) : System A n :=
  ⟨rename σ S.val, S.property.1, S.property.2.1, by
    intro v d hd
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hu⟩ := S.property.2.2 v d hd
    refine ⟨Sum.map id σ t, ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    rintro u ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩
    exact congrArg (Sum.map id σ) (hu s hs)⟩

axiom rename_identity {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} (S : SetSystem A n) : rename id S = S

axiom rename_composition {A : RankedSet} {m n k : ℕ}
    (σ : Fin m → Fin n) (τ : Fin n → Fin k) (S : SetSystem A m) :
    rename τ (rename σ S) = rename (τ ∘ σ) S

axiom rename_relabel {A B : RankedSet} (η : RankedMap A B) {m n : ℕ}
    (σ : Fin m → Fin n) (S : SetSystem A m) :
    rename σ (relabel η S) = relabel η (rename σ S)

axiom rename_morphism {A : RankedSet} {m n : ℕ} (σ : Fin m → Fin n)
    {S T : SetSystem A m} (f : Morphism S T) :
    ∃ g : Morphism (rename σ S) (rename σ T), g.toFun = f.toFun ∧
      (f.LocallySurjective → g.LocallySurjective)

axiom resolution_factor {A : RankedSet} {m m' n : ℕ} (S : SetSystem A n) (T : System A m)
    (σ : Fin m → Fin n) (τ : Fin m → Fin m') (σ' : Fin m' → Fin n)
    (hσ : ∀ i, σ' (τ i) = σ i) (h : IsResolution S T σ) :
    IsResolution S (renameSystem τ T) σ'

end Lax369799.Renaming

statements.signature:
rename_composition : ∀ {A : Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankedSet} {m n k : Nat} (σ : Fin m → Fin n) (τ : Fin n → Fin k)
  (S : Lax369799.RankedSystems.SetSystem A m),
  Eq (Lax369799.Resolutions.rename τ (Lax369799.Resolutions.rename σ S))
    (Lax369799.Resolutions.rename (Function.comp τ σ) S)

rename_identity : ∀ {A : Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankedSet} {n : Nat} (S : Lax369799.RankedSystems.SetSystem A n),
  Eq (Lax369799.Resolutions.rename id S) S

rename_relabel : ∀ {A B : Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankedSet} (η : Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankedMap A B) {m n : Nat} (σ : Fin m → Fin n)
  (S : Lax369799.RankedSystems.SetSystem A m),
  Eq (Lax369799.Resolutions.rename σ (Lax369799.RankedSystems.relabel η S))
    (Lax369799.RankedSystems.relabel η (Lax369799.Resolutions.rename σ S))

resolution_factor : ∀ {A : Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankedSet} {m m' n : Nat} (S : Lax369799.RankedSystems.SetSystem A n)
  (T : Lax369799.RankedSystems.System A m) (σ : Fin m → Fin n) (τ : Fin m → Fin m') (σ' : Fin m' → Fin n),
  (∀ (i : Fin m), Eq (σ' (τ i)) (σ i)) →
    Lax369799.Resolutions.IsResolution S T σ →
      Lax369799.Resolutions.IsResolution S (Lax369799.Renaming.renameSystem τ T) σ'

concepts.title: Compression of the variables of flatten-resolutions
concepts.description:
Rename the variables of each inner system and retain one outer edge for
each new variable. If the selected representatives preserve the original
variable maps, the resulting outer system is still a flatten-resolution.
Uniform bounds on the representative fibres pass to the new resolution.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.Renaming

/-!
---
title: Compression of the variables of flatten-resolutions
type: theorem
---
Rename the variables of each inner system and retain one outer edge for
each new variable. If the selected representatives preserve the original
variable maps, the resulting outer system is still a flatten-resolution.
Uniform bounds on the representative fibres pass to the new resolution.
-/
namespace Lax369799.ResolutionCompression
open RankedSystems Resolutions Renaming

def compressedPresentation {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} (T : System (System A) n)
    (arity : T.val.Vertex → ℕ)
    (τ : ∀ v, Fin (T.val.graph.label v).1 → Fin (arity v))
    (sectionMap : ∀ v, Fin (arity v) → Fin (T.val.graph.label v).1) :
    Presentation (System A) n T.val.Vertex where
  label := fun v => ⟨arity v, renameSystem (τ v) (T.val.graph.label v).2⟩
  initial := T.val.graph.initial
  root := T.val.graph.root
  edge := fun v d t => ∃ i : Fin (arity v), d = i.val ∧ T.val.graph.edge v (sectionMap v i).val t
  direction_valid := by rintro v d t ⟨i, rfl, _⟩; exact i.isLt

def backPresentation {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} (T : System (System A) n)
    (arity : T.val.Vertex → ℕ)
    (τ : ∀ v, Fin (T.val.graph.label v).1 → Fin (arity v))
    (sectionMap : ∀ v, Fin (arity v) → Fin (T.val.graph.label v).1) :
    Presentation (System A) n T.val.Vertex := {
  T.val.graph with label := fun v => ⟨(T.val.graph.label v).1,
    renameSystem (sectionMap v ∘ τ v) (T.val.graph.label v).2⟩ }


axiom compress_flatten_resolution {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} (S : SetSystem (SetSystem A) n)
    (T : System (System A) n) (r : FlattenResolution S T)
    (arity : T.val.Vertex → ℕ)
    (τ : ∀ v, Fin (T.val.graph.label v).1 → Fin (arity v))
    (sectionMap : ∀ v, Fin (arity v) → Fin (T.val.graph.label v).1)
    (hσ : ∀ v i, r.variableMap v (sectionMap v (τ v i)) = r.variableMap v i)
    (bound : ℕ) (hb : ∀ v j, Nat.card {i // r.variableMap v (sectionMap v i) = j} ≤ bound) :
    ∃ U : System (System A) n,
      U.val = trim (compressedPresentation T arity τ sectionMap) ∧
      ∃ r' : FlattenResolution S U,
        ∀ v j, Nat.card {i // r'.variableMap v i = j} ≤ bound

axiom evaluation {A : RankedSet} (E : Algebras.Algebra A) (hE : Algebras.UnfoldInvariant E) {n : ℕ}
    (T : System (System A) n) (arity : T.val.Vertex → ℕ)
    (τ : ∀ v, Fin (T.val.graph.label v).1 → Fin (arity v))
    (sectionMap : ∀ v, Fin (arity v) → Fin (T.val.graph.label v).1) :
    ∃ U V : System (System A) n,
      U.val = trim (backPresentation T arity τ sectionMap) ∧
      V.val = trim (compressedPresentation T arity τ sectionMap) ∧
      E.eval n (relabelSystem E.eval U) = E.eval n (relabelSystem E.eval V)

end Lax369799.ResolutionCompression

concepts.title: Finite families of split-variable resolutions
concepts.description:
A bounded profile can be represented by finitely many actual resolutions,
retaining each resolution's variable map. A rank-n representative needs
only resolutions of rank at most n times the fibre bound. In particular,
unary representatives may require multi-variable resolutions; these are
retained rather than replaced by unary branches.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.FiniteProfiles

/-!
---
title: Finite families of split-variable resolutions
type: theorem
---
A bounded profile can be represented by finitely many actual resolutions,
retaining each resolution's variable map. A rank-n representative needs
only resolutions of rank at most n times the fibre bound. In particular,
unary representatives may require multi-variable resolutions; these are
retained rather than replaced by unary branches.
-/
namespace Lax369799.ResolutionFamilies
open RankedSystems Resolutions FiniteProfiles

structure Witness {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} (S : SetSystem A n) where
  arity : ℕ
  system : System A arity
  variableMap : Fin arity → Fin n
  resolves : IsResolution S system variableMap

def Witness.entry {A B : RankedSet} (ρ : ∀ n, System A n → B n) {n : ℕ}
    {S : SetSystem A n} (w : Witness S) : ProfileEntry B n :=
  ⟨w.arity, ρ w.arity w.system, w.variableMap⟩

axiom finite_family {A B : RankedSet} (hB : RankwiseFinite B) (bound : ℕ)
    (ρ : ∀ n, System A n → B n) {n : ℕ} (S : SetSystem A n) :
    ∃ (k : ℕ) (w : Fin k → Witness S),
      (∀ i, (w i).arity ≤ n * bound) ∧
      BoundedProfile bound ρ S = Set.range (fun i => (w i).entry ρ)

end Lax369799.ResolutionFamilies

statements.signature:
finite_family : ∀ {A B : Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankedSet},
  Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankwiseFinite B →
    ∀ (bound : Nat) (ρ : (n : Nat) → Lax369799.RankedSystems.System A n → B n) {n : Nat}
      (S : Lax369799.RankedSystems.SetSystem A n),
      Exists fun k =>
        Exists fun w =>
          And (∀ (i : Fin k), instLENat.le (w i).arity (instHMul.hMul n bound))
            (Eq (Lax369799.FiniteProfiles.BoundedProfile bound ρ S)
              (Set.range fun i => Lax369799.ResolutionFamilies.Witness.entry ρ (w i)))

concepts.title: Lifting unfoldings through variable renaming
concepts.description:
A morphism into a renamed system can be lifted by restoring the variable
names dictated by the original system. Renaming the lifted system gives
back the source exactly. This preserves variable origins when passing
from direct resolutions to resolutions.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.Renaming

/-!
---
title: Lifting unfoldings through variable renaming
type: theorem
---
A morphism into a renamed system can be lifted by restoring the variable
names dictated by the original system. Renaming the lifted system gives
back the source exactly. This preserves variable origins when passing
from direct resolutions to resolutions.
-/
namespace Lax369799.ResolutionLifting
open RankedSystems Morphisms Resolutions

axiom rename_lift {A : RankedSet} {m n : ℕ} (σ : Fin m → Fin n)
    (S : System A m) (R : System A n) (f : Morphism R.val (rename σ S.val)) :
    ∃ U : System A m, rename σ U.val = R.val ∧ UnfoldsTo S.val U.val

/-- Yield inclusion transfers resolutions while preserving the variable map. -/
axiom transfer {A : RankedSet} {m n : ℕ} {S S' : SetSystem A n}
    (h : YieldBelow S S') (T : System A m) (σ : Fin m → Fin n)
    (hT : IsResolution S T σ) :
    ∃ T' : System A m, IsResolution S' T' σ ∧ UnfoldsTo T.val T'.val

end Lax369799.ResolutionLifting

  (R : Lax369799.RankedSystems.System A n)
  (f : Lax369799.Morphisms.Morphism R.val (Lax369799.Resolutions.rename σ S.val)),
  Exists fun U => And (Eq (Lax369799.Resolutions.rename σ U.val) R.val) (Lax369799.Morphisms.UnfoldsTo S.val U.val)

  Lax369799.Morphisms.YieldBelow S S' →
    ∀ (T : Lax369799.RankedSystems.System A m) (σ : Fin m → Fin n),
      Lax369799.Resolutions.IsResolution S T σ →
        Exists fun T' => And (Lax369799.Resolutions.IsResolution S' T' σ) (Lax369799.Morphisms.UnfoldsTo T.val T'.val)

concepts.title: Resolutions and bounded profiles
concepts.description:
A resolution consists of a system and a map from its variables to those of
the target set-system, such that the renamed system maps into the target.
A flatten-resolution resolves both the outer pattern and its labels,
keeping track of a separate variable map at each vertex (Section 2.9).

For a recognising evaluation, a profile records the values and variable
maps of resolutions. A map is small when each fibre has at most
`|B₀| + |B₁| + 1` elements, accounting for closed continuations, unary
continuations, and the immediate exit. This is the bound b_A in the
revised Section 4.3. Small profiles and small root profiles are the finite
summaries used there.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.Algebras
import Mathlib.SetTheory.Cardinal.Finite

/-!
---
title: Resolutions and bounded profiles
type: definition
---
A resolution consists of a system and a map from its variables to those of
the target set-system, such that the renamed system maps into the target.
A flatten-resolution resolves both the outer pattern and its labels,
keeping track of a separate variable map at each vertex (Section 2.9).

For a recognising evaluation, a profile records the values and variable
maps of resolutions. A map is small when each fibre has at most
`|B₀| + |B₁| + 1` elements, accounting for closed continuations, unary
continuations, and the immediate exit. This is the bound b_A in the
revised Section 4.3. Small profiles and small root profiles are the finite
summaries used there.
-/

namespace Lax369799.Resolutions
open RankedSystems Morphisms Flattening Algebras

def rename {A : RankedSet} {m n : ℕ} (σ : Fin m → Fin n)
    (S : SetSystem A m) : SetSystem A n where
  size := S.size
  graph := {
    label := S.graph.label
    initial := S.graph.initial
    root := S.graph.root
    edge := fun v d t => ∃ s, S.graph.edge v d s ∧ t = Sum.map id σ s
    direction_valid := by
      rintro v d t ⟨s, hs, _⟩
      exact S.graph.direction_valid v d s hs }
  reachable := by
    intro v
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hp⟩ := S.reachable v
    refine ⟨r, hr, Relation.ReflTransGen.mono ?_ r v hp⟩
    rintro a b ⟨d, hd⟩
    exact ⟨d, .inl b, hd, rfl⟩

def IsResolution {A : RankedSet} {m n : ℕ} (S : SetSystem A n)
    (T : System A m) (σ : Fin m → Fin n) : Prop :=
  Nonempty (Morphism (rename σ T.val) S)

structure FlattenResolution {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ}
    (S : SetSystem (SetSystem A) n) (T : System (System A) n) where
  vertex : T.val.Vertex → S.Vertex
  variableMap : ∀ v, Fin (T.val.graph.label v).1 → Fin (S.graph.label (vertex v)).1
  initial : ∀ v, v ∈ T.val.graph.initial → vertex v ∈ S.graph.initial
  resolves : ∀ v, IsResolution (Inner S (vertex v)) (T.val.graph.label v).2 (variableMap v)
  transition : ∀ v (i : Fin (T.val.graph.label v).1) w,
    T.val.graph.edge v i.val (.inl w) → S.graph.edge (vertex v) (variableMap v i).val (.inl (vertex w))
  exit : ∀ v (i : Fin (T.val.graph.label v).1) j,
    T.val.graph.edge v i.val (.inr j) → S.graph.edge (vertex v) (variableMap v i).val (.inr j)

abbrev ProfileEntry (B : RankedSet) (n : ℕ) := (m : ℕ) × B m × (Fin m → Fin n)

noncomputable def SmallBound (B : RankedSet) : ℕ := Nat.card (B 0) + Nat.card (B 1) + 1

def SmallMap (B : RankedSet) {m n : ℕ} (σ : Fin m → Fin n) : Prop :=
  ∀ j, Nat.card {i // σ i = j} ≤ SmallBound B

def Profile {A B : RankedSet} (ρ : ∀ n, System A n → B n) {n : ℕ}
    (S : SetSystem A n) : Set (ProfileEntry B n) :=
  {e | ∃ T : System A e.1, IsResolution S T e.2.2 ∧ ρ e.1 T = e.2.1}

def SmallProfile {A B : RankedSet} (ρ : ∀ n, System A n → B n) {n : ℕ}
    (S : SetSystem A n) : Set (ProfileEntry B n) :=
  {e | e ∈ Profile ρ S ∧ SmallMap B e.2.2}

def ProfileEquivalent {A B : RankedSet} (ρ : ∀ n, System A n → B n) {n : ℕ}
    (S T : SetSystem A n) : Prop :=
  Profile ρ S = Profile ρ T ∧ Profile ρ (uproot S) = Profile ρ (uproot T)

def SmallProfileEquivalent {A B : RankedSet} (ρ : ∀ n, System A n → B n) {n : ℕ}
    (S T : SetSystem A n) : Prop :=
  SmallProfile ρ S = SmallProfile ρ T ∧ SmallProfile ρ (uproot S) = SmallProfile ρ (uproot T)

end Lax369799.Resolutions

concepts.title: Root entries in substituted presentations
concepts.description:
To observe the roots of a substitution, give every outer vertex a separate
starting copy whose inner roots become initial. Subsequent outer transitions
go to ordinary copies, where inner initial vertices remain initial. Outer
roots also start at their ordinary copies. All root marks in the expanded
presentation are removed. This preserves root observations even at vertices
that were unreachable in the original outer presentation.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.FinitePresentations
import Lax369799.PresentationCovers

/-!
---
title: Root entries in substituted presentations
type: theorem
---
To observe the roots of a substitution, give every outer vertex a separate
starting copy whose inner roots become initial. Subsequent outer transitions
go to ordinary copies, where inner initial vertices remain initial. Outer
roots also start at their ordinary copies. All root marks in the expanded
presentation are removed. This preserves root observations even at vertices
that were unreachable in the original outer presentation.
-/
namespace Lax369799.RootExpansion
open RankedSystems FinitePresentations

def startAtRoots {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} {V : Type} (G : Presentation A n V) :
    Presentation A n V := { G with initial := G.root, root := ∅ }

def component {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} (S : FiniteSystem A n) (start : Bool) : FiniteSystem A n where
  size := S.size
  graph := { S.graph with initial := if start then S.graph.root else S.graph.initial, root := ∅ }

def pattern {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} {V : Type}
    (P : Presentation (FiniteSystem A) n V) : Presentation (FiniteSystem A) n (Bool × V) where
  label := fun v => ⟨(P.label v.2).1, component (Inner P v.2) v.1⟩
  initial := fun v => if v.1 then True else P.root v.2
  root := ∅
  edge := fun v d t => ∃ s, P.edge v.2 d s ∧ t = Sum.map (fun w => (false, w)) id s
  direction_valid := by rintro v d t ⟨s, hs, _⟩; exact P.direction_valid _ _ _ hs

axiom expansion_cover {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} {V : Type}
    (P : Presentation (FiniteSystem A) n V) :
    Nonempty (PresentationCovers.Cover (flattenPresentation (pattern P))
      (startAtRoots (flattenPresentation P)))

axiom expansion_folding {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} {V : Type}
    (P : Presentation (FiniteSystem A) n V) :
    ∃ f : PresentationCovers.Cover (flattenPresentation (pattern P))
      (startAtRoots (flattenPresentation P)), Function.Surjective f.toFun

end Lax369799.RootExpansion

  (P : Lax369799.RankedSystems.Presentation (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.FiniteSystem A) n V),
  Nonempty
    (Lax369799.PresentationCovers.Cover
      (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.flattenPresentation (Lax369799.RootExpansion.pattern P))
      (Lax369799.RootExpansion.startAtRoots (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.flattenPresentation P)))

concepts.title: Reachable substitution with root-free components
concepts.description:
When every component has no roots, pruning unreachable outer vertices
before substitution is sound. One may first restrict each component and
then the outer pattern to reachable vertices. The resulting reachable
flattening covers the reachable restriction of the original substitution.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.RootExpansion
import Lax369799.Flattening

/-!
---
title: Reachable substitution with root-free components
type: theorem
---
When every component has no roots, pruning unreachable outer vertices
before substitution is sound. One may first restrict each component and
then the outer pattern to reachable vertices. The resulting reachable
flattening covers the reachable restriction of the original substitution.
-/
namespace Lax369799.RootlessFlattening
open RankedSystems

noncomputable def trimLabels {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} {V : Type}
    (P : Presentation (FinitePresentations.FiniteSystem A) n V) :
    Presentation (SetSystem A) n V := {
  P with label := fun v => ⟨(P.label v).1, trim (FinitePresentations.Inner P v).graph⟩ }

axiom flatten_cover {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} {V : Type} [Fintype V]
    (P : Presentation (FinitePresentations.FiniteSystem A) n V)
    (h : ∀ v, (FinitePresentations.Inner P v).graph.root = ∅) :
    Morphisms.UnfoldsTo (trim (FinitePresentations.flattenPresentation P))
      (Flattening.flatten (trim (trimLabels P)))

end Lax369799.RootlessFlattening

  (P : Lax369799.RankedSystems.Presentation (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.FiniteSystem A) n V),
  (∀ (v : V), Eq (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.Inner P v).graph.root Set.instEmptyCollection.emptyCollection) →
    Lax369799.Morphisms.UnfoldsTo (Lax369799.RankedSystems.trim (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.flattenPresentation P))
      (Lax369799.Flattening.flatten (Lax369799.RankedSystems.trim (Lax369799.RootlessFlattening.trimLabels P)))

concepts.title: Initial and root observations of set-systems
concepts.description:
Initial resolutions do not depend on root marks. Removing these marks
and restricting to initial reachability therefore preserves the complete
initial profile. Root observations can be treated separately by making
roots initial, as in uprooting.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.FiniteProfiles

/-!
---
title: Initial and root observations of set-systems
type: theorem
---
Initial resolutions do not depend on root marks. Removing these marks
and restricting to initial reachability therefore preserves the complete
initial profile. Root observations can be treated separately by making
roots initial, as in uprooting.
-/
namespace Lax369799.RootObservations
open RankedSystems Morphisms Resolutions

noncomputable def initialPart {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} (S : SetSystem A n) : SetSystem A n :=
  trim { S.graph with root := ∅ }

axiom resolution_initial_part {A : RankedSet} {m n : ℕ} (S : SetSystem A n)
    (T : System A m) (σ : Fin m → Fin n) :
    IsResolution (initialPart S) T σ ↔ IsResolution S T σ

axiom initial_profile {A B : RankedSet} (ρ : ∀ n, System A n → B n) {n : ℕ}
    (S : SetSystem A n) : Profile ρ (initialPart S) = Profile ρ S

axiom rootless_outer_cover {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ}
    (S T : FinitePresentations.FiniteSystem (FinitePresentations.FiniteSystem A) n)
    (f : PresentationCovers.Cover S.graph T.graph)
    (h : ∀ w, (FinitePresentations.Inner T.graph w).graph.root = ∅) :
    Nonempty (PresentationCovers.Cover (FinitePresentations.flatten S).graph
      (FinitePresentations.flatten T).graph)

end Lax369799.RootObservations

  (T : Lax369799.RankedSystems.System A m) (σ : Fin m → Fin n),
  Iff (Lax369799.Resolutions.IsResolution (Lax369799.RootObservations.initialPart S) T σ)
    (Lax369799.Resolutions.IsResolution S T σ)

  (f : Lax369799.PresentationCovers.Cover S.graph T.graph),
  (∀ (w : Fin T.size),
      Eq (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.Inner T.graph w).graph.root Set.instEmptyCollection.emptyCollection) →
    Nonempty
      (Lax369799.PresentationCovers.Cover (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.flatten S).graph
        (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.flatten T).graph)

concepts.title: Initial and root observations under bounded-profile substitution
concepts.description:
Bounded initial and root profiles suffice to transfer root observations of
substitution, including observations starting in unreachable outer components.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.ObservedSubstitution

/-!
---
title: Initial and root observations under bounded-profile substitution
type: theorem
---
Bounded initial and root profiles suffice to transfer root observations of
substitution, including observations starting in unreachable outer components.
-/
namespace Lax369799.RootProfileSubstitution
open RankedSystems Algebras ObservedSubstitution

axiom transfer_initial_value {A B : RankedSet} (E : Algebra B) (hE : UnfoldInvariant E)
    [Finite (B 1)] (η : RankedMap A B) {V : Type} [Fintype V]
    (P : Presentation (SetSystem A) 0 V) (Q : ∀ v, SetSystem A (P.label v).1)
    (hi : ∀ v, FiniteProfiles.BoundedProfile (Nat.card (B 1) + 1)
        (fun k R => E.eval k (relabelSystem η R)) (P.label v).2 =
      FiniteProfiles.BoundedProfile (Nat.card (B 1) + 1)
        (fun k R => E.eval k (relabelSystem η R)) (Q v)) :
    PresentationObservations.values E η (FinitePresentations.flattenPresentation (finiteLabels P)) ⊆
      PresentationObservations.values E η
        (FinitePresentations.flattenPresentation (finiteLabels (replaceLabels P Q)))

axiom transfer_root_value {A B : RankedSet} (E : Algebra B) (hE : UnfoldInvariant E)
    [Finite (B 1)] (η : RankedMap A B) {V : Type} [Fintype V]
    (P : Presentation (SetSystem A) 0 V) (Q : ∀ v, SetSystem A (P.label v).1)
    (hi : ∀ v, FiniteProfiles.BoundedProfile (Nat.card (B 1) + 1)
        (fun k R => E.eval k (relabelSystem η R)) (P.label v).2 =
      FiniteProfiles.BoundedProfile (Nat.card (B 1) + 1)
        (fun k R => E.eval k (relabelSystem η R)) (Q v))
    (hr : ∀ v, FiniteProfiles.BoundedProfile (Nat.card (B 1) + 1)
        (fun k R => E.eval k (relabelSystem η R)) (uproot (P.label v).2) =
      FiniteProfiles.BoundedProfile (Nat.card (B 1) + 1)
        (fun k R => E.eval k (relabelSystem η R)) (uproot (Q v))) :
    PresentationObservations.values E η
        (RootExpansion.startAtRoots (FinitePresentations.flattenPresentation (finiteLabels P))) ⊆
      PresentationObservations.values E η (RootExpansion.startAtRoots
        (FinitePresentations.flattenPresentation (finiteLabels (replaceLabels P Q))))

end Lax369799.RootProfileSubstitution

  Lax369799.Algebras.UnfoldInvariant E →
    ∀ [Finite (B 1)] (η : Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankedMap A B) {V : Type} [inst : Fintype V]
      (P : Lax369799.RankedSystems.Presentation (Lax369799.RankedSystems.SetSystem A) 0 V)

          Eq

              (fun k R => E.eval k (Lax369799.RankedSystems.relabelSystem η R)) (P.label v).snd)
            (Lax369799.FiniteProfiles.BoundedProfile (instHAdd.hAdd (Nat.card (B 1)) 1)

              (Lax369799.ObservedSubstitution.finiteLabels (Lax369799.ObservedSubstitution.replaceLabels P Q))))

    ∀ [Finite (B 1)] (η : Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankedMap A B) {V : Type} [inst : Fintype V]

              (fun k R => E.eval k (Lax369799.RankedSystems.relabelSystem η R)) (Q v))) →
        (∀ (v : V),
            Eq
              (Lax369799.FiniteProfiles.BoundedProfile (instHAdd.hAdd (Nat.card (B 1)) 1)
                (fun k R => E.eval k (Lax369799.RankedSystems.relabelSystem η R))
                (Lax369799.RankedSystems.uproot (P.label v).snd))
              (Lax369799.FiniteProfiles.BoundedProfile (instHAdd.hAdd (Nat.card (B 1)) 1)
                (fun k R => E.eval k (Lax369799.RankedSystems.relabelSystem η R))

                (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.flattenPresentation (Lax369799.ObservedSubstitution.finiteLabels P))))

concepts.title: Finite support for root observations
concepts.description:
A root observation of a substitution uses finitely many initial or root
resolutions of its labels. Retaining these resolutions preserves the
observation. Starting copies distinguish entry through an inner root
from ordinary transitions into an inner initial vertex.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.FiniteResolutionApproximation
import Lax369799.ObservedSubstitution
import Lax369799.RootExpansion

/-!
---
title: Finite support for root observations
type: theorem
---
A root observation of a substitution uses finitely many initial or root
resolutions of its labels. Retaining these resolutions preserves the
observation. Starting copies distinguish entry through an inner root
from ordinary transitions into an inner initial vertex.
-/
namespace Lax369799.RootResolutionApproximation
open RankedSystems Morphisms FiniteResolutionNormalForms ObservedSubstitution

axiom finite_support {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} {V : Type} [Fintype V]
    (P : Presentation (SetSystem A) n V) (R : System A n)
    (hR : InitYield (trim (RootExpansion.startAtRoots
      (FinitePresentations.flattenPresentation (finiteLabels P)))) R) :
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (v : Fin m → V) (c : ∀ i, Component (P.label (v i)).2),
      ∀ (Q : ∀ v, SetSystem A (P.label v).1),
        (∀ i, DirectResolution (if (c i).rooted then uproot (Q (v i)) else Q (v i)) (c i).system) →
        InitYield (trim (RootExpansion.startAtRoots
          (FinitePresentations.flattenPresentation (finiteLabels (replaceLabels P Q))))) R

end Lax369799.RootResolutionApproximation

  (P : Lax369799.RankedSystems.Presentation (Lax369799.RankedSystems.SetSystem A) n V)
  (R : Lax369799.RankedSystems.System A n),
  Lax369799.Morphisms.InitYield
      (Lax369799.RankedSystems.trim
        (Lax369799.RootExpansion.startAtRoots

            (∀ (i : Fin m),
                Lax369799.Morphisms.DirectResolution
                  (ite (Eq (c i).rooted Bool.true) (Lax369799.RankedSystems.uproot (Q (v i))) (Q (v i))) (c i).system) →

concepts.title: Word acceptance and evaluation of algebraic runs
concepts.description:
For the algebraic unfold-automaton, legal runs expand into root-free
reachable unary presentations with no blocked unary vertex. Projecting
their branches back to the input preserves the run's word labels. The
algebraic branch condition therefore makes a run accepting exactly when
the evaluated run value is accepted (Lemmas 104–105).
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.AlgebraicBranchCondition
import Lax369799.RunPresentations

/-!
---
title: Word acceptance and evaluation of algebraic runs
type: theorem
---
For the algebraic unfold-automaton, legal runs expand into root-free
reachable unary presentations with no blocked unary vertex. Projecting
their branches back to the input preserves the run's word labels. The
algebraic branch condition therefore makes a run accepting exactly when
the evaluated run value is accepted (Lemmas 104–105).
-/

namespace Lax369799.RunAcceptance
open RankedSystems (RankedSet System)
open FinitePresentations FiniteContextualOrder FiniteAcceptance FiniteSyntacticAlgebra
open ExpandedSyntacticAlgebra UnfoldAutomata ExpandedTransitions RunPresentations

def WordCorrect {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    [Fintype (Carrier (Accepting L) 1)] [Fintype (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)]
    (E : SyntacticAlgebra L)
    (D : WordCondition (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 1))
      (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 0))) : Prop :=
  (∀ w a, D.AcceptsFinite w a ↔ AcceptingClass (Accepting L)
    (FiniteBranchWords.value E.algebra (w.map (Fintype.equivFin (Carrier (Accepting L) 1)).symm)
      ((Fintype.equivFin (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)).symm a))) ∧
  (∀ w, D.AcceptsInfinite w ↔ AlgebraicOmegaWords.Accepts E.algebra
    {a | AcceptingClass (Accepting L) a}
    (fun n => (Fintype.equivFin (Carrier (Accepting L) 1)).symm (w n)))

axiom exists_condition {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    [Fintype (Carrier (Accepting L) 1)] [Fintype (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)]
    (E : SyntacticAlgebra L) :
    ∃ D : WordCondition (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 1))
      (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)), WordCorrect L E D

section
variable {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    [Fintype (Carrier (Accepting L) 1)] [Fintype (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)]
    (E : SyntacticAlgebra L)
    (D : WordCondition (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 1))
      (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)))
    {S : System A 0} (r : Run (automaton L E D) S)

axiom shape :
    (presentation L E D r.toLabelling).graph.root = ∅ ∧ Reachable (presentation L E D r.toLabelling) ∧
      ∀ v, ((presentation L E D r.toLabelling).graph.label v).1 = 1 →
        ∃ w, (presentation L E D r.toLabelling).graph.edge v 0 (.inl w)

axiom accepting_run_value (hL : Algebras.UnfoldInvariantLanguage L) (hrec : Algebras.Recognizable L)
    (hD : WordCorrect L E D) (hr : r.Accepting) :
    AcceptingClass (Accepting L) (E.algebra.eval 0
      (withLabels (ofSetSystem S.val) (runLabel L E D r.toLabelling)))

axiom evaluated_run_accepting (hD : WordCorrect L E D)
    (hr : AcceptingClass (Accepting L) (E.algebra.eval 0
      (withLabels (ofSetSystem S.val) (runLabel L E D r.toLabelling)))) : r.Accepting

axiom evaluated_run_iff (hL : Algebras.UnfoldInvariantLanguage L) (hrec : Algebras.Recognizable L)
    (hD : WordCorrect L E D) : r.Accepting ↔
    AcceptingClass (Accepting L) (E.algebra.eval 0
      (withLabels (ofSetSystem S.val) (runLabel L E D r.toLabelling)))

/-- Accepted evaluation implies word acceptance without transition legality. -/
axiom labelling_accepting (r : Labelling (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 1))
      (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)) S) (hD : WordCorrect L E D)
    (hr : AcceptingClass (Accepting L) (E.algebra.eval 0
      (withLabels (ofSetSystem S.val) (runLabel L E D r)))) : r.Accepting D

end

end Lax369799.RunAcceptance
