concepts.title: Finite branch observations of a run
concepts.description:
A terminating branch determines a unary path followed by its nullary leaf.
This path maps into the flattened run presentation. Consequently an
accepted evaluated run has accepted terminating branch observations.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.RunPresentations
import Lax369799.FinitePathEvaluation

/-!
---
title: Finite branch observations of a run
type: theorem
---
A terminating branch determines a unary path followed by its nullary leaf.
This path maps into the flattened run presentation. Consequently an
accepted evaluated run has accepted terminating branch observations.
-/
namespace Lax369799.RunBranchObservations
open RankedSystems (RankedSet System)
open FinitePresentations FiniteContextualOrder FiniteAcceptance
open FiniteSyntacticAlgebra ExpandedSyntacticAlgebra UnfoldAutomata ExpandedTransitions

noncomputable def path {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    [Fintype (Carrier (Accepting L) 1)] [Fintype (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)]
    (E : SyntacticAlgebra L)
    (D : WordCondition (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 1))
      (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)))
    {S : System A 0} (r : Labelling (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 1))
      (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)) S)
    {k : ℕ} (b : FiniteBranch S k) : FiniteSystem (Carrier (Accepting L)) 0 where
  size := k + 1
  graph := {
    label := Fin.lastCases
      ⟨0, (Fintype.equivFin (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)).symm
        (r.leafType (b.vertex (Fin.last k)) b.ends)⟩
      (fun i => ⟨1, (Fintype.equivFin (Carrier (Accepting L) 1)).symm
        (r.edgeType (b.vertex i.castSucc) (b.direction i))⟩)
    initial := {0}
    root := ∅
    edge := fun v d t => ∃ i : Fin k, v = i.castSucc ∧ d = 0 ∧ t = .inl i.succ
    direction_valid := by
      rintro v d t ⟨i, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
      simp }

axiom path_morphism {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    [Fintype (Carrier (Accepting L) 1)] [Fintype (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)]
    (E : SyntacticAlgebra L)
    (D : WordCondition (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 1))
      (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)))
    {S : System A 0} (r : Labelling (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 1))
      (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)) S)
    {k : ℕ} (b : FiniteBranch S k) :
    Nonempty (FiniteMorphisms.Morphism (path L E D r b) (RunPresentations.presentation L E D r))

axiom path_accepting {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    [Fintype (Carrier (Accepting L) 1)] [Fintype (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)]
    (E : SyntacticAlgebra L)
    (D : WordCondition (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 1))
      (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)))
    {S : System A 0} (r : Labelling (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 1))
      (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)) S)
    (hr : AcceptingClass (Accepting L) (E.algebra.eval 0
      (withLabels (ofSetSystem S.val) (runLabel L E D r))))
    {k : ℕ} (b : FiniteBranch S k) :
    AcceptingClass (Accepting L) (E.algebra.eval 0 (path L E D r b))

/-- A finite graph describing a regular infinite branch of the input. -/
structure RegularBranch {A : RankedSet} (S : System A 0) where
  size : ℕ
  start : Fin size
  next : Fin size → Fin size
  vertex : Fin size → S.val.Vertex
  direction : ∀ i, Fin (Rank S (vertex i))
  starts : vertex start ∈ S.val.graph.initial
  follows : ∀ i, S.val.graph.edge (vertex i) (direction i).val (.inl (vertex (next i)))

noncomputable def regularPath {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    [Fintype (Carrier (Accepting L) 1)] [Fintype (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)]
    (E : SyntacticAlgebra L)
    (D : WordCondition (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 1))
      (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)))
    {S : System A 0} (r : Labelling (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 1))
      (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)) S)
    (b : RegularBranch S) : FiniteSystem (Carrier (Accepting L)) 0 where
  size := b.size
  graph := {
    label := fun i => ⟨1, (Fintype.equivFin (Carrier (Accepting L) 1)).symm
      (r.edgeType (b.vertex i) (b.direction i))⟩
    initial := {b.start}
    root := ∅
    edge := fun v d t => d = 0 ∧ t = .inl (b.next v)
    direction_valid := by rintro v d t ⟨rfl, _⟩; exact Nat.zero_lt_one }

axiom regularPath_morphism {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    [Fintype (Carrier (Accepting L) 1)] [Fintype (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)]
    (E : SyntacticAlgebra L)
    (D : WordCondition (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 1))
      (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)))
    {S : System A 0} (r : Labelling (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 1))
      (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)) S)
    (b : RegularBranch S) :
    Nonempty (FiniteMorphisms.Morphism (regularPath L E D r b) (RunPresentations.presentation L E D r))

axiom regularPath_accepting {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    [Fintype (Carrier (Accepting L) 1)] [Fintype (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)]
    (E : SyntacticAlgebra L)
    (D : WordCondition (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 1))
      (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)))
    {S : System A 0} (r : Labelling (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 1))
      (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)) S)
    (hr : AcceptingClass (Accepting L) (E.algebra.eval 0
      (withLabels (ofSetSystem S.val) (runLabel L E D r))))
    (b : RegularBranch S) :
    AcceptingClass (Accepting L) (E.algebra.eval 0 (regularPath L E D r b))

axiom path_evaluation {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    [Fintype (Carrier (Accepting L) 1)] [Fintype (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)]
    (E : SyntacticAlgebra L)
    (D : WordCondition (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 1))
      (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)))
    {S : System A 0} (r : Labelling (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 1))
      (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)) S)
    {k : ℕ} (b : FiniteBranch S k) :
    E.algebra.eval 0 (path L E D r b) = FiniteBranchWords.value E.algebra
      (List.ofFn (fun i => (Fintype.equivFin (Carrier (Accepting L) 1)).symm
        (r.edgeType (b.vertex i.castSucc) (b.direction i))))
      ((Fintype.equivFin (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)).symm
        (r.leafType (b.vertex (Fin.last k)) b.ends))

end Lax369799.RunBranchObservations

concepts.title: Unary presentations associated with legal runs
concepts.description:
Replace each internal vertex by its chosen parallel tuple and each leaf by
its nullary value, then flatten. The resulting unary/nullary presentation
has the value of the evaluated run. Its path and cycle observations inherit
acceptance through presentation morphisms.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.ExpandedTransitions
import Lax369799.GraphChoices

/-!
---
title: Unary presentations associated with legal runs
type: theorem
---
Replace each internal vertex by its chosen parallel tuple and each leaf by
its nullary value, then flatten. The resulting unary/nullary presentation
has the value of the evaluated run. Its path and cycle observations inherit
acceptance through presentation morphisms.
-/
namespace Lax369799.RunPresentations
open RankedSystems (RankedSet System)
open FinitePresentations FiniteContextualOrder FiniteAcceptance FiniteSyntacticAlgebra
open ExpandedSyntacticAlgebra UnfoldAutomata ExpandedTransitions

noncomputable def piece {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    [Fintype (Carrier (Accepting L) 1)] [Fintype (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)]
    (E : SyntacticAlgebra L)
    (D : WordCondition (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 1))
      (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)))
    {S : System A 0} (r : Labelling (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 1))
      (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)) S) (v : S.val.Vertex) :
    FiniteSystem (Carrier (Accepting L)) (Rank S v) :=
  if Rank S v = 0 then atomic (runLabel L E D r v)
  else ofSetSystem (DeterministicElements.parallel
    (fun i => (Fintype.equivFin (Carrier (Accepting L) 1)).symm (r.edgeType v i)))

noncomputable def presentation {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    [Fintype (Carrier (Accepting L) 1)] [Fintype (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)]
    (E : SyntacticAlgebra L)
    (D : WordCondition (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 1))
      (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)))
    {S : System A 0} (r : Labelling (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 1))
      (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)) S) : FiniteSystem (Carrier (Accepting L)) 0 :=
  flatten (withLabels (ofSetSystem S.val) (piece L E D r))

axiom evaluation {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    [Fintype (Carrier (Accepting L) 1)] [Fintype (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)]
    (E : SyntacticAlgebra L)
    (D : WordCondition (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 1))
      (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)))
    {S : System A 0} (r : Labelling (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 1))
      (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)) S) :
    E.algebra.eval 0 (presentation L E D r) =
      E.algebra.eval 0 (withLabels (ofSetSystem S.val) (runLabel L E D r))

axiom unary {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    [Fintype (Carrier (Accepting L) 1)] [Fintype (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)]
    (E : SyntacticAlgebra L)
    (D : WordCondition (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 1))
      (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)))
    {S : System A 0} (r : Labelling (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 1))
      (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)) S) :
    ∀ v, ((presentation L E D r).graph.label v).1 ≤ 1

axiom observation_accepting {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    [Fintype (Carrier (Accepting L) 1)] [Fintype (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)]
    (E : SyntacticAlgebra L)
    (D : WordCondition (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 1))
      (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)))
    {S : System A 0} (r : Labelling (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 1))
      (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)) S)
    (hr : AcceptingClass (Accepting L) (E.algebra.eval 0
      (withLabels (ofSetSystem S.val) (runLabel L E D r))))
    (T : FiniteSystem (Carrier (Accepting L)) 0)
    (f : FiniteMorphisms.Morphism T (presentation L E D r)) :
    AcceptingClass (Accepting L) (E.algebra.eval 0 T)

axiom selected {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    [Fintype (Carrier (Accepting L) 1)] [Fintype (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)]
    (E : SyntacticAlgebra L)
    (D : WordCondition (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 1))
      (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)))
    {S : System A 0} (r : Run (automaton L E D) S) :
    ∀ v (h : ((presentation L E D r.toLabelling).graph.label v).1 = 1),
      ExtremalUnaryTypes.Selected L E (h ▸ ((presentation L E D r.toLabelling).graph.label v).2)

axiom functional_test {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    [Fintype (Carrier (Accepting L) 1)] [Fintype (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)]
    (E : SyntacticAlgebra L)
    (D : WordCondition (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 1))
      (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)))
    {S : System A 0} (r : Run (automaton L E D) S) :
    AcceptingClass (Accepting L) (E.algebra.eval 0
      (withLabels (ofSetSystem S.val) (runLabel L E D r.toLabelling))) ↔
    ∀ f : (presentation L E D r.toLabelling).Vertex → (presentation L E D r.toLabelling).Vertex,
      GraphChoices.Admissible (presentation L E D r.toLabelling) f →
      AcceptingClass (Accepting L) (E.algebra.eval 0
        (GraphChoices.chooseRows (presentation L E D r.toLabelling) Finset.univ f))

end Lax369799.RunPresentations

concepts.title: The terminating-word condition for algebraic runs
concepts.description:
Encode unary actions and the accepting nullary values as finite types.
Combining their finite-word evaluator with a parity condition tests finite
run paths exactly by algebraic evaluation and retains the given infinite
word condition.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.RunBranchObservations
import Lax369799.CombinedWordCondition

/-!
---
title: The terminating-word condition for algebraic runs
type: theorem
---
Encode unary actions and the accepting nullary values as finite types.
Combining their finite-word evaluator with a parity condition tests finite
run paths exactly by algebraic evaluation and retains the given infinite
word condition.
-/
namespace Lax369799.RunWordCondition
open RankedSystems (RankedSet System)
open FiniteContextualOrder FiniteAcceptance FiniteSyntacticAlgebra ExpandedSyntacticAlgebra
open UnfoldAutomata ExpandedTransitions

noncomputable def action {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    [Fintype (Carrier (Accepting L) 1)] [Fintype (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)]
    (E : SyntacticAlgebra L) :
    Fin (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 1)) →
    Fin (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)) → Fin (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)) :=
  fun b a => (Fintype.equivFin (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)) (FiniteBranchWords.act E.algebra
    ((Fintype.equivFin (Carrier (Accepting L) 1)).symm b)
    ((Fintype.equivFin (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)).symm a))

noncomputable def finalCodes {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    [Fintype (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)] : Set (Fin (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 0))) :=
  {a | AcceptingClass (Accepting L) ((Fintype.equivFin (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)).symm a)}

noncomputable def condition {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    [Fintype (Carrier (Accepting L) 1)] [Fintype (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)]
    (E : SyntacticAlgebra L)
    (D : WordCondition (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 1))
      (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 0))) :=
  CombinedWordCondition.combine D (action L E) (finalCodes L)


axiom finite_path_iff {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    [Fintype (Carrier (Accepting L) 1)] [Fintype (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)]
    (E : SyntacticAlgebra L)
    (D : WordCondition (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 1))
      (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)))
    {S : System A 0} (r : Run (automaton L E (condition L E D)) S)
    {k : ℕ} (b : FiniteBranch S k) :
    (condition L E D).AcceptsFinite
      (List.ofFn (fun i => r.edgeType (b.vertex i.castSucc) (b.direction i)))
      (r.leafType (b.vertex (Fin.last k)) b.ends) ↔
      AcceptingClass (Accepting L)
        (E.algebra.eval 0 (RunBranchObservations.path L E (condition L E D) r.toLabelling b))

axiom infinite_iff {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    [Fintype (Carrier (Accepting L) 1)] [Fintype (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)]
    (E : SyntacticAlgebra L)
    (D : WordCondition (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 1))
      (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 0)))
    (w : ℕ → Fin (Fintype.card (Carrier (Accepting L) 1))) :
    (condition L E D).AcceptsInfinite w ↔ D.AcceptsInfinite w

end Lax369799.RunWordCondition

  [inst : Fintype (Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.Carrier (Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) 1)]

  {k : Nat} (b : Lax369799.UnfoldAutomata.FiniteBranch S k),
  Iff
    ((Lax369799.RunWordCondition.condition L E D).AcceptsFinite
      (List.ofFn fun i => r.edgeType (b.vertex i.castSucc) (b.direction i)) (r.leafType (b.vertex (Fin.last k)) ⋯))
    (Lax369799.FiniteSyntacticAlgebra.AcceptingClass (Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L)
      (E.algebra.eval 0
        (Lax369799.RunBranchObservations.path L E (Lax369799.RunWordCondition.condition L E D) r.toLabelling b)))

  [inst : Fintype (Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.Carrier (Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) 1)]
  [inst_1 : Fintype (Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.Carrier (Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) 0)]
  (E : Lax369799.ExpandedSyntacticAlgebra.SyntacticAlgebra L)

    Lax369799.UnfoldAutomata.WordCondition

concepts.title: Choice preservation of extremally selected unary types
concepts.description:
Rank-one extremal selection makes acceptance in normal contexts a
principal test on their data. The data for a sum of closed continuations
are the meet of the separate data. Contextual order separation therefore
gives preservation of binary choices by every selected unary type.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.ExtremalUnaryTypes
import Lax369799.ChoicePreservingUnary

/-!
---
title: Choice preservation of extremally selected unary types
type: theorem
---
Rank-one extremal selection makes acceptance in normal contexts a
principal test on their data. The data for a sum of closed continuations
are the meet of the separate data. Contextual order separation therefore
gives preservation of binary choices by every selected unary type.
-/
namespace Lax369799.SelectedChoicePreservation

    (E : SyntacticAlgebra L) (b : Carrier (Accepting L) 1)
    (hb : ExtremalUnaryTypes.Selected L E b) :
    ChoicePreservingUnary.PreservesChoices E.algebra b

end Lax369799.SelectedChoicePreservation

concepts.title: Parallel transitions with selected unary components
concepts.description:
Refine the components of an accepting parallel tuple one at a time.
Rank-one extremal replacement preserves acceptance and decreases each
component. Consequently the parallel transition inequality is retained,
and every resulting component preserves binary choices of closed
continuations.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.SelectedChoicePreservation
import Lax369799.ParallelReplacement

/-!
---
title: Parallel transitions with selected unary components
type: theorem
---
Refine the components of an accepting parallel tuple one at a time.
Rank-one extremal replacement preserves acceptance and decreases each
component. Consequently the parallel transition inequality is retained,
and every resulting component preserves binary choices of closed
continuations.
-/
namespace Lax369799.SelectedParallel
open RankedSystems (RankedSet)
open FinitePresentations FiniteContexts FiniteContextualOrder FiniteAcceptance
open FiniteSyntacticAlgebra ExpandedSyntacticAlgebra

axiom accepting_parallel {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    (hL : Algebras.UnfoldInvariantLanguage L) (hrec : Algebras.Recognizable L)
    (E : SyntacticAlgebra L) {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (C : Context (Carrier (Accepting L)) k 0) (a : Carrier (Accepting L) k)
    (ha : AcceptingClass (Accepting L) (E.algebra.eval 0 (plug C (atomic a)))) :
    ∃ b : Fin k → Carrier (Accepting L) 1,
      (∀ i, ExtremalUnaryTypes.Selected L E (b i)) ∧
      ClassBelow (Accepting L) (E.algebra.eval k (ofSetSystem (DeterministicElements.parallel b))) a ∧
      AcceptingClass (Accepting L) (E.algebra.eval 0 (plug C
        (atomic (E.algebra.eval k (ofSetSystem (DeterministicElements.parallel b))))))

end Lax369799.SelectedParallel

  Lax369799.Algebras.UnfoldInvariantLanguage L →
    Lax369799.Algebras.Recognizable L →
      ∀ (E : Lax369799.ExpandedSyntacticAlgebra.SyntacticAlgebra L) {k : Nat},
        instLENat.le 1 k →
          ∀
            (C :
              Lax369799.FiniteContexts.Context
                (Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.Carrier (Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L)) k 0)
            (a : Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.Carrier (Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) k),
            Lax369799.FiniteSyntacticAlgebra.AcceptingClass (Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L)
                (E.algebra.eval 0 (Lax369799.FiniteContexts.plug C (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.atomic a))) →
              Exists fun b =>
                And (∀ (i : Fin k), Lax369799.ExtremalUnaryTypes.Selected L E (b i))

                      (E.algebra.eval k
                        (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.ofSetSystem (Lax369799.DeterministicElements.parallel b)))
                      a)
                    (Lax369799.FiniteSyntacticAlgebra.AcceptingClass (Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L)
                      (E.algebra.eval 0
                        (Lax369799.FiniteContexts.plug C
                          (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.atomic
                            (E.algebra.eval k
                              (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.ofSetSystem
                                (Lax369799.DeterministicElements.parallel b))))))))

concepts.title: Stable factorization with recurrent vertices
concepts.description:
A word over a finite semigroup admits stable idempotent blocks without
assuming an identity element. For a simultaneous sequence in a finite
vertex set, all block boundaries can be chosen at the same vertex. This
is the factorization used to turn a branch into a periodic branch in
Section 6.3.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.WordFactorization
import Mathlib.Algebra.Group.WithOne.Basic
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Option

/-!
---
title: Stable factorization with recurrent vertices
type: theorem
---
A word over a finite semigroup admits stable idempotent blocks without
assuming an identity element. For a simultaneous sequence in a finite
vertex set, all block boundaries can be chosen at the same vertex. This
is the factorization used to turn a branch into a periodic branch in
Section 6.3.
-/
namespace Lax369799.SemigroupFactorization

/-- Product of a nonempty interval [i,j), starting with its first letter. -/
def block {M : Type} [Semigroup M] (w : ℕ → M) (i j : ℕ) : M :=
  ((List.range' (i + 1) (j - i - 1)).map w).foldl (· * ·) (w i)

axiom factorization {M V : Type} [Semigroup M] [Finite M] [Finite V]
    (w : ℕ → M) (v : ℕ → V) :
    ∃ (cut : ℕ → ℕ) (a e : M) (r : V), StrictMono cut ∧ 0 < cut 0 ∧
      e * e = e ∧ a * e = a ∧ (∀ i, v (cut i) = r) ∧
      (∀ i, block w 0 (cut i) = a) ∧
      (∀ i j, i < j → block w (cut i) (cut j) = e)

end Lax369799.SemigroupFactorization

statements.signature:
factorization : ∀ {M V : Type} [inst : Semigroup M] [Finite M] [Finite V] (w : Nat → M) (v : Nat → V),
  Exists fun cut =>
    Exists fun a =>
      Exists fun e =>
        Exists fun r =>
          And (StrictMono cut)
            (And (instLTNat.lt 0 (cut 0))
              (And (Eq (instHMul.hMul e e) e)
                (And (Eq (instHMul.hMul a e) a)
                  (And (∀ (i : Nat), Eq (v (cut i)) r)
                    (And (∀ (i : Nat), Eq (Lax369799.SemigroupFactorization.block w 0 (cut i)) a)
                      (∀ (i j : Nat),
                        instLTNat.lt i j → Eq (Lax369799.SemigroupFactorization.block w (cut i) (cut j)) e))))))

concepts.title: The earlier continuity-bearing set-algebra interface
concepts.description:
A set-algebra evaluates set-systems and satisfies the unit, flattening,
unfold-invariance, morphism, and continuity axioms of the earlier draft.
The disjoint union of atomic systems defines meet; the induced order has
`a ≤ b` exactly when `a ∧ b = a`. Morphisms reverse this order, while
continuity says that a common lower bound for all yields is a lower bound
for the original set-system. Both initial and root yields occur here.
This original interface is retained for conditional results. The syntactic
quotient instead uses ExpandedSyntacticAlgebra and expanded continuity.
The revised Definition 63 is represented in SetSystemAlgebras, using
unpruned finite presentations and no continuity field.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.Algebras

/-!
---
title: The earlier continuity-bearing set-algebra interface
type: definition
---
A set-algebra evaluates set-systems and satisfies the unit, flattening,
unfold-invariance, morphism, and continuity axioms of the earlier draft.
The disjoint union of atomic systems defines meet; the induced order has
`a ≤ b` exactly when `a ∧ b = a`. Morphisms reverse this order, while
continuity says that a common lower bound for all yields is a lower bound
for the original set-system. Both initial and root yields occur here.
This original interface is retained for conditional results. The syntactic
quotient instead uses ExpandedSyntacticAlgebra and expanded continuity.
The revised Definition 63 is represented in SetSystemAlgebras, using
unpruned finite presentations and no continuity field.
-/

namespace Lax369799.SetAlgebras
open RankedSystems Morphisms Flattening

noncomputable def meetOf {A : RankedSet} (eval : ∀ n, SetSystem A n → A n)
    {n : ℕ} (a b : A n) : A n := eval n (sum (atomic a) (atomic b))

def BelowOf {A : RankedSet} (eval : ∀ n, SetSystem A n → A n)
    {n : ℕ} (a b : A n) : Prop := meetOf eval a b = a

structure SetAlgebra (A : RankedSet) where
  eval : ∀ n, SetSystem A n → A n
  unit : ∀ n (a : A n), eval n (atomic a) = a
  associative : ∀ n (S : SetSystem (SetSystem A) n),
    eval n (relabel eval S) = eval n (flatten S)
  unfold_invariant : ∀ n (S T : SetSystem A n),
    UnfoldEquivalent S T → eval n S = eval n T
  morphism : ∀ n (S T : SetSystem A n), Nonempty (Morphism S T) →
    BelowOf eval (eval n T) (eval n S)
  continuity : ∀ n (S : SetSystem A n) (a : A n),
    (∀ T, Yield S T → BelowOf eval a (eval n T)) → BelowOf eval a (eval n S)

noncomputable def meet {A : RankedSet} (E : SetAlgebra A) {n : ℕ} (a b : A n) : A n :=
  meetOf E.eval a b

def Below {A : RankedSet} (E : SetAlgebra A) {n : ℕ} (a b : A n) : Prop :=
  BelowOf E.eval a b

structure SetAlgebraMorphism {A B : RankedSet} (E : SetAlgebra A) (F : SetAlgebra B) where
  map : RankedMap A B
  commutes : ∀ n (S : SetSystem A n), F.eval n (relabel map S) = map n (E.eval n S)

end Lax369799.SetAlgebras

concepts.title: Order and yield properties of set-algebras
concepts.description:
Meet is associative, commutative, and idempotent, and its induced relation
is a partial order with meet as infimum (`lemma:meet-is-meet`). Evaluation
reverses yield inclusion (`lemma:yieldssubset-yaleq`). Elements of ranks
zero and one are deterministic (`lemma:det-characterisation`).
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.AutomatonProperty

/-!
---
title: Order and yield properties of set-algebras
type: theorem
---
Meet is associative, commutative, and idempotent, and its induced relation
is a partial order with meet as infimum (`lemma:meet-is-meet`). Evaluation
reverses yield inclusion (`lemma:yieldssubset-yaleq`). Elements of ranks
zero and one are deterministic (`lemma:det-characterisation`).
-/

namespace Lax369799.SetAlgebraTheorems
open RankedSystems Morphisms SetAlgebras AutomatonProperty

axiom meet_laws {A : RankedSet} (E : SetAlgebra A) (n : ℕ) :
    (∀ a b c : A n, meet E (meet E a b) c = meet E a (meet E b c)) ∧
    (∀ a b : A n, meet E a b = meet E b a) ∧
    (∀ a : A n, meet E a a = a)

axiom order_laws {A : RankedSet} (E : SetAlgebra A) (n : ℕ) :
    (∀ a : A n, Below E a a) ∧
    (∀ a b : A n, Below E a b → Below E b a → a = b) ∧
    (∀ a b c : A n, Below E a b → Below E b c → Below E a c) ∧
    (∀ a b c : A n, Below E c (meet E a b) ↔ Below E c a ∧ Below E c b)

axiom yield_order {A : RankedSet} (E : SetAlgebra A) {n : ℕ}
    (S T : SetSystem A n) (h : YieldBelow S T) : Below E (E.eval n T) (E.eval n S)

axiom low_rank_deterministic {A : RankedSet} (E : SetAlgebra A)
    {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≤ 1) (a : A n) : Deterministic E a

end Lax369799.SetAlgebraTheorems

statements.signature:
low_rank_deterministic : ∀ {A : Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankedSet} (E : Lax369799.SetAlgebras.SetAlgebra A) {n : Nat},
  instLENat.le n 1 → ∀ (a : A n), Lax369799.AutomatonProperty.Deterministic E a

meet_laws : ∀ {A : Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankedSet} (E : Lax369799.SetAlgebras.SetAlgebra A) (n : Nat),
  And
    (∀ (a b c : A n),
      Eq (Lax369799.SetAlgebras.meet E (Lax369799.SetAlgebras.meet E a b) c)
        (Lax369799.SetAlgebras.meet E a (Lax369799.SetAlgebras.meet E b c)))
    (And (∀ (a b : A n), Eq (Lax369799.SetAlgebras.meet E a b) (Lax369799.SetAlgebras.meet E b a))
      (∀ (a : A n), Eq (Lax369799.SetAlgebras.meet E a a) a))

order_laws : ∀ {A : Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankedSet} (E : Lax369799.SetAlgebras.SetAlgebra A) (n : Nat),
  And (∀ (a : A n), Lax369799.SetAlgebras.Below E a a)
    (And (∀ (a b : A n), Lax369799.SetAlgebras.Below E a b → Lax369799.SetAlgebras.Below E b a → Eq a b)
      (And
        (∀ (a b c : A n),
          Lax369799.SetAlgebras.Below E a b → Lax369799.SetAlgebras.Below E b c → Lax369799.SetAlgebras.Below E a c)
        (∀ (a b c : A n),
          Iff (Lax369799.SetAlgebras.Below E c (Lax369799.SetAlgebras.meet E a b))
            (And (Lax369799.SetAlgebras.Below E c a) (Lax369799.SetAlgebras.Below E c b)))))

concepts.title: Pure second-order syntax
concepts.description:
The set-only presentation of MSO uses inclusion, initial membership,
universal proposition tests, and existential edge tests. Bound variables
are represented by a new option value. Empty sets and singletons are
definable using inclusion and quantification over sets, as in Section 6.2.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.MonadicSecondOrder

/-!
---
title: Pure second-order syntax
type: theorem
---
The set-only presentation of MSO uses inclusion, initial membership,
universal proposition tests, and existential edge tests. Bound variables
are represented by a new option value. Empty sets and singletons are
definable using inclusion and quantification over sets, as in Section 6.2.
-/
namespace Lax369799.SetLogic
open TransitionSystems

inductive Formula (P : Type) : Type → Type 1
  | subset {X} : X → X → Formula P X
  | initial {X} : X → Formula P X
  | proposition {X} : P → X → Formula P X
  | edge {X} : X → X → Formula P X
  | neg {X} : Formula P X → Formula P X
  | disj {X} : Formula P X → Formula P X → Formula P X
  | existsSet {X} : Formula P (Option X) → Formula P X

def Formula.eval {P : Type} (S : TransitionSystem P) :
    {X : Type} → Formula P X → (X → Set S.Vertex) → Prop
  | _, .subset x y, σ => σ x ⊆ σ y
  | _, .initial x, σ => S.initial ∈ σ x
  | _, .proposition p x, σ => ∀ v ∈ σ x, p ∈ S.valuation v
  | _, .edge x y, σ => ∃ v ∈ σ x, ∃ w ∈ σ y, S.edge v w
  | _, .neg φ, σ => ¬ φ.eval S σ
  | _, .disj φ ψ, σ => φ.eval S σ ∨ ψ.eval S σ
  | _, .existsSet φ, σ => ∃ U, φ.eval S (Option.elim · U σ)

def Formula.conj {P X : Type} (φ ψ : Formula P X) : Formula P X :=
  .neg (.disj (.neg φ) (.neg ψ))

def Formula.empty {P X : Type} (x : X) : Formula P X :=
  .neg (.existsSet (.neg (.subset (.some x) .none)))

def Formula.singleton {P X : Type} (x : X) : Formula P X :=
  .conj (.neg (.empty x)) (.neg (.existsSet
    (.conj (.subset .none (.some x))
      (.conj (.neg (.empty .none)) (.neg (.subset (.some x) .none))))))

axiom empty_iff {P X : Type} (S : TransitionSystem P) (σ : X → Set S.Vertex) (x : X) :
    (Formula.empty x).eval S σ ↔ σ x = ∅

axiom singleton_iff {P X : Type} (S : TransitionSystem P) (σ : X → Set S.Vertex) (x : X) :
    (Formula.singleton x).eval S σ ↔ ∃ v, σ x = {v}

end Lax369799.SetLogic

statements.signature:
empty_iff : ∀ {P X : Type} (S : Lax369799.TransitionSystems.TransitionSystem P) (σ : X → Set S.Vertex) (x : X),
  Iff (Lax369799.SetLogic.Formula.eval S (Lax369799.SetLogic.Formula.empty x) σ)
    (Eq (σ x) Set.instEmptyCollection.emptyCollection)

singleton_iff : ∀ {P X : Type} (S : Lax369799.TransitionSystems.TransitionSystem P) (σ : X → Set S.Vertex) (x : X),
  Iff (Lax369799.SetLogic.Formula.eval S (Lax369799.SetLogic.Formula.singleton x) σ)
    (Exists fun v => Eq (σ x) (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton v))

concepts.title: Recognition induction for pure second-order logic
concepts.description:
Free set variables are recorded as extra vertex marks. The atomic
languages have finite recognizing algebras. Boolean closure and existential
projection then give recognition for every formula. The induction is
also stated separately with explicit atomic-language hypotheses.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.SetLogicTranslation
import Lax369799.RecognitionProjection
import Lax369799.TransitionEncoding

/-!
---
title: Recognition induction for pure second-order logic
type: theorem
---
Free set variables are recorded as extra vertex marks. The atomic
languages have finite recognizing algebras. Boolean closure and existential
projection then give recognition for every formula. The induction is
also stated separately with explicit atomic-language hypotheses.
-/
namespace Lax369799.SetLogicRecognition
open RankedSystems Algebras SetLogic TransitionEncoding

abbrev Alphabet (P X : Type) : RankedSet := fun _ => Set P × Set X

noncomputable def language {P X : Type} (φ : Formula P X) : Language (Alphabet P X) :=
  {S | φ.eval (decode (relabelSystem (fun _ a => a.1) S))
    (fun x v => x ∈ (S.val.graph.label v).2.2)}

structure AtomicRecognizable (P : Type) : Prop where
  subset : ∀ (X : Type) [Finite X] (x y : X), Recognizable (language (Formula.subset (P := P) x y))
  initial : ∀ (X : Type) [Finite X] (x : X), Recognizable (language (Formula.initial (P := P) x))
  proposition : ∀ (X : Type) [Finite X] (p : P) (x : X), Recognizable (language (Formula.proposition p x))
  edge : ∀ (X : Type) [Finite X] (x y : X), Recognizable (language (Formula.edge (P := P) x y))

axiom atomic_recognizable (P : Type) : AtomicRecognizable P

axiom initial_recognizable {P X : Type} (x : X) :
    Recognizable (language (Formula.initial (P := P) x))

axiom recognizable {P X : Type} [Finite X] (h : AtomicRecognizable P) (φ : Formula P X) :
    Recognizable (language φ)

end Lax369799.SetLogicRecognition

statements.signature: atomic_recognizable : ∀ (P : Type), Lax369799.SetLogicRecognition.AtomicRecognizable P

initial_recognizable : ∀ {P X : Type} (x : X),
  Lax369799.Algebras.Recognizable (Lax369799.SetLogicRecognition.language (Lax369799.SetLogic.Formula.initial x))

recognizable : ∀ {P X : Type} [Finite X],
  Lax369799.SetLogicRecognition.AtomicRecognizable P →
    ∀ (φ : Lax369799.SetLogic.Formula P X), Lax369799.Algebras.Recognizable (Lax369799.SetLogicRecognition.language φ)

concepts.title: Translation to pure second-order logic
concepts.description:
Vertex variables are represented by singleton-valued set variables. A
vertex quantifier becomes a set quantifier restricted to singletons; the
other atomic predicates have their usual singleton interpretations.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.SetLogic

/-!
---
title: Translation to pure second-order logic
type: theorem
---
Vertex variables are represented by singleton-valued set variables. A
vertex quantifier becomes a set quantifier restricted to singletons; the
other atomic predicates have their usual singleton interpretations.
-/
namespace Lax369799.SetLogicTranslation
open TransitionSystems

def translate {P : Type} : {m n : ℕ} → MonadicSecondOrder.Formula P m n →
    {X : Type} → (Fin m → X) → (Fin n → X) → SetLogic.Formula P X
  | _, _, .equal x y, _, xv, _ => (SetLogic.Formula.subset (xv x) (xv y)).conj (.subset (xv y) (xv x))
  | _, _, .initial x, _, xv, _ => .initial (xv x)
  | _, _, .proposition p x, _, xv, _ => .proposition p (xv x)
  | _, _, .edge x y, _, xv, _ => .edge (xv x) (xv y)
  | _, _, .member x Y, _, xv, sv => .subset (xv x) (sv Y)
  | _, _, .neg φ, _, xv, sv => .neg (translate φ xv sv)
  | _, _, .disj φ ψ, _, xv, sv => .disj (translate φ xv sv) (translate ψ xv sv)
  | _, _, .existsVertex φ, _, xv, sv => .existsSet
      ((SetLogic.Formula.singleton .none).conj (translate φ (Fin.cases .none (fun i => .some (xv i))) (fun i => .some (sv i))))
  | _, _, .existsSet φ, _, xv, sv => .existsSet
      (translate φ (fun i => .some (xv i)) (Fin.cases .none (fun i => .some (sv i))))

axiom correct {P X : Type} {m n : ℕ} (S : TransitionSystem P)
    (φ : MonadicSecondOrder.Formula P m n) (xv : Fin m → X) (sv : Fin n → X)
    (σ : X → Set S.Vertex) (ρ : Fin m → S.Vertex) (τ : Fin n → Set S.Vertex)
    (hx : ∀ i, σ (xv i) = {ρ i}) (hs : ∀ i, σ (sv i) = τ i) :
    (translate φ xv sv).eval S σ ↔ φ.eval S ρ τ

end Lax369799.SetLogicTranslation

statements.signature:
correct : ∀ {P X : Type} {m n : Nat} (S : Lax369799.TransitionSystems.TransitionSystem P)
  (φ : Lax369799.MonadicSecondOrder.Formula P m n) (xv : Fin m → X) (sv : Fin n → X) (σ : X → Set S.Vertex)
  (ρ : Fin m → S.Vertex) (τ : Fin n → Set S.Vertex),
  (∀ (i : Fin m), Eq (σ (xv i)) (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (ρ i))) →
    (∀ (i : Fin n), Eq (σ (sv i)) (τ i)) →
      Iff (Lax369799.SetLogic.Formula.eval S (Lax369799.SetLogicTranslation.translate φ xv sv) σ)
        (Lax369799.MonadicSecondOrder.Formula.eval S φ ρ τ)

concepts.title: Set-algebras with retained vertices
concepts.description:
Definition 63 evaluates all finite set-systems, including unreachable
vertices. Its axioms are the atomic unit, associativity, invariance under
unfold-equivalence, and the reverse comparison for morphisms. There is
no continuity axiom. Foldings here are locally surjective covers that are
also surjective on all vertices, as in Definitions 8 and 18.
The yield-syntactic quotient has this structure, with its contextual
order equal to the order induced by binary disjoint union.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.ExpandedSyntacticAlgebra

/-!
---
title: Set-algebras with retained vertices
type: theorem
---
Definition 63 evaluates all finite set-systems, including unreachable
vertices. Its axioms are the atomic unit, associativity, invariance under
unfold-equivalence, and the reverse comparison for morphisms. There is
no continuity axiom. Foldings here are locally surjective covers that are
also surjective on all vertices, as in Definitions 8 and 18.
The yield-syntactic quotient has this structure, with its contextual
order equal to the order induced by binary disjoint union.
-/

namespace Lax369799.SetSystemAlgebras
open RankedSystems (RankedSet)
open FinitePresentations FiniteSyntacticAlgebra

def UnfoldEquivalent {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} (S T : FiniteSystem A n) : Prop :=
  ∃ U : FiniteSystem A n,
    ∃ f : PresentationCovers.Cover U.graph S.graph,
    ∃ g : PresentationCovers.Cover U.graph T.graph,
      Function.Surjective f.toFun ∧ Function.Surjective g.toFun

structure SetAlgebra (A : RankedSet) extends Algebra A where
  unfold_invariant : ∀ n (S T : FiniteSystem A n),
    UnfoldEquivalent S T → eval n S = eval n T
  morphism : ∀ n (S T : FiniteSystem A n), Nonempty (FiniteMorphisms.Morphism S T) →
    sumValue toAlgebra (eval n T) (eval n S) = eval n T

def Below {A : RankedSet} (E : SetAlgebra A) {n : ℕ} (a b : A n) : Prop :=
  sumValue E.toAlgebra a b = a

structure Morphism {A B : RankedSet} (E : SetAlgebra A) (D : SetAlgebra B) where
  map : RankedSystems.RankedMap A B
  commutes : ∀ n (S : FiniteSystem A n),
    D.eval n (relabel map S) = map n (E.eval n S)

axiom folding_invariance {A : RankedSet} (E : SetAlgebra A) {n : ℕ}
    (S T : FiniteSystem A n) (f : PresentationCovers.Cover S.graph T.graph)
    (hf : Function.Surjective f.toFun) : E.eval n S = E.eval n T

axiom eval_sum {A : RankedSet} (E : SetAlgebra A) {n : ℕ} (S T : FiniteSystem A n) :
    E.eval n (sum S T) = sumValue E.toAlgebra (E.eval n S) (E.eval n T)

axiom meet_laws {A : RankedSet} (E : SetAlgebra A) (n : ℕ) :
    (∀ a b c : A n, sumValue E.toAlgebra (sumValue E.toAlgebra a b) c =
      sumValue E.toAlgebra a (sumValue E.toAlgebra b c)) ∧
    (∀ a b : A n, sumValue E.toAlgebra a b = sumValue E.toAlgebra b a) ∧
    (∀ a : A n, sumValue E.toAlgebra a a = a)

axiom order_laws {A : RankedSet} (E : SetAlgebra A) (n : ℕ) :
    (∀ a : A n, Below E a a) ∧
    (∀ a b : A n, Below E a b → Below E b a → a = b) ∧
    (∀ a b c : A n, Below E a b → Below E b c → Below E a c) ∧
    (∀ a b c : A n, Below E c (sumValue E.toAlgebra a b) ↔ Below E c a ∧ Below E c b)

axiom evaluation_monotone {A B : RankedSet} (E : SetAlgebra A) {n : ℕ}
    (P : FiniteSystem B n) (q r : ∀ v : P.Vertex, A (P.graph.label v).1)
    (h : ∀ v, Below E (q v) (r v)) :
    Below E (E.eval n (withLabels P q)) (E.eval n (withLabels P r))

axiom syntactic_order {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    (E : ExpandedSyntacticAlgebra.SyntacticAlgebra L) {n : ℕ}
    (a b : FiniteContextualOrder.Carrier (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) n) :
    FiniteContextualOrder.ClassBelow (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) a b ↔
      sumValue E.algebra a b = a

axiom syntactic_structure {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    (E : ExpandedSyntacticAlgebra.SyntacticAlgebra L) :
    ∃ D : SetAlgebra (FiniteContextualOrder.Carrier (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L)),
      D.toAlgebra = E.algebra

end Lax369799.SetSystemAlgebras

  Eq (E.eval n (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.sum S T))

    (And
      (∀ (a b : A n),
        Eq (Lax369799.FiniteSyntacticAlgebra.sumValue E.toAlgebra a b)
          (Lax369799.FiniteSyntacticAlgebra.sumValue E.toAlgebra b a))

          Lax369799.SetSystemAlgebras.Below E a b →

  (a b : Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.Carrier (Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) n),

concepts.title: Small profiles and the yield-syntactic congruence
concepts.description:
The small-map bound b_A is |A₀| + |A₁| + 1 in Section 4.3. Equality of
initial and root profiles restricted to these maps determines every
closed contextual acceptance test. Thus small-profile equivalence
refines the yield-syntactic equivalence (Corollary 84), and has finite
index in every rank when the observing algebra is rankwise finite.
Contexts and substitution retain all vertices, as in Definition 68.

import Lax369799.BoundedProfileRefinement

/-!
---
title: Small profiles and the yield-syntactic congruence
type: theorem
---
The small-map bound b_A is |A₀| + |A₁| + 1 in Section 4.3. Equality of
initial and root profiles restricted to these maps determines every
closed contextual acceptance test. Thus small-profile equivalence
refines the yield-syntactic equivalence (Corollary 84), and has finite
index in every rank when the observing algebra is rankwise finite.
Contexts and substitution retain all vertices, as in Definition 68.
-/

namespace Lax369799.SmallProfileRefinement
open RankedSystems Algebras FinitePresentations

axiom refines {A B : RankedSet} (E : Algebra B) (hB : RankwiseFinite B)
    (hE : UnfoldInvariant E) (η : RankedMap A B) (F : Set (B 0)) (L : Language A)
    (hL : Recognizes E η F L) {n : ℕ} (S T : FiniteSystem A n)
    (h : FiniteProfiles.SmallProfileEquivalent
      (fun k R => E.eval k (relabelSystem η R)) S T) :
    FiniteContextualOrder.Equivalent (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) S T

end Lax369799.SmallProfileRefinement

  Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankwiseFinite B →
    Lax369799.Algebras.UnfoldInvariant E →
      ∀ (η : Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankedMap A B) (F : Set (B 0)) (L : Lax369799.Algebras.Language A),
        Lax369799.Algebras.Recognizes E η F L →
          ∀ {n : Nat} (S T : Lax369799.FinitePresentations.FiniteSystem A n),
            Lax369799.FiniteProfiles.SmallProfileEquivalent

              Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.Equivalent (Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) S T

concepts.description:
Each unary component has its own rooted copy of the incoming context piece.
There is no choice between different successors beneath that root.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.FiniteExtremal
import Lax369799.DeterministicElements

/-!
---
title: Extremal witnesses with separate rooted components
type: theorem
---
Each unary component has its own rooted copy of the incoming context piece.
There is no choice between different successors beneath that root.
-/
namespace Lax369799.SplitExtremal
open RankedSystems (RankedSet)
open FinitePresentations FiniteContextualOrder FiniteSyntacticAlgebra
open ExtremalContexts (Boundary Data)
open FiniteExtremal (IsExtremal Accepts value)

def component {A : RankedSet} {k : ℕ} (B : Boundary k)
    (m : Fin (k + 1) → A 1) (a : A k) (i : Fin k) : FiniteSystem A 1 where
  size := k + 2
  graph := {
    label := Fin.cases ⟨k, a⟩ (fun j => ⟨1, m j⟩)
    initial := {0}
    root := fun v => v = (0 : Fin (k + 1)).succ ∨ (v = 0 ∧ B.root)
    edge := fun v d t => Fin.cases
      ((∃ j : Fin k, d = j.val ∧ t = .inl j.succ.succ) ∨
       (∃ j : Fin k, j ∈ B.loops ∧ d = j.val ∧ t = .inl 0) ∨
       (d = i.val ∧ t = .inr 0))
      (fun _ => d = 0 ∧ t = .inl 0) v
    direction_valid := by
      intro v d t
      refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) v
      · rintro (⟨j, rfl, _⟩ | ⟨j, _, rfl, _⟩ | ⟨rfl, _⟩)
        · exact j.isLt
        · exact j.isLt
        · exact i.isLt
      · rintro ⟨rfl, _⟩; exact Nat.zero_lt_one }

def pattern {A : RankedSet} {k : ℕ} (B : Boundary k)
    (m : Fin (k + 1) → A 1) (a : A k) : FiniteSystem (FiniteSystem A) k where
  size := k
  graph := {
    label := fun i => ⟨1, component B m a i⟩
    initial := Set.univ
    root := ∅
    edge := fun i d t => d = 0 ∧ t = .inr i
    direction_valid := by rintro i d t ⟨rfl, _⟩; exact Nat.zero_lt_one }

noncomputable def delta {A : RankedSet} {k : ℕ} (B : Boundary k)
    (m : Fin (k + 1) → A 1) (a : A k) : FiniteSystem A k := flatten (pattern B m a)

axiom delta_boundary_comparison {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    (E : Algebra (Carrier (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L)))
    (hE : ∀ n (S : FiniteSystem (FiniteSystem A) n),
      E.eval n (relabel (quotientMap (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L)) S) =
        quotientMap (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) n (flatten S))
    {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (x y : Data (Carrier (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L)) k)
    (a : Carrier (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) k)
    (hx : IsExtremal (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) E a x)
    (hy : Accepts (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) E (E.eval k (delta x.1 x.2 a)) y) :
    (y.1.root → x.1.root) ∧ y.1.loops ⊆ x.1.loops

axiom delta_piece_comparison {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    (E : Algebra (Carrier (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L)))
    (hE : ∀ n (S : FiniteSystem (FiniteSystem A) n),
      E.eval n (relabel (quotientMap (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L)) S) =
        quotientMap (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) n (flatten S))
    {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (x y : Data (Carrier (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L)) k)
    (a : Carrier (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) k)
    (hx : IsExtremal (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) E a x)
    (hy : Accepts (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) E (E.eval k (delta x.1 x.2 a)) y) :
    ∀ j, ClassBelow (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) (x.2 j) (y.2 j)

axiom delta_below {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    (E : Algebra (Carrier (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L)))
    (hE : ∀ n (S : FiniteSystem (FiniteSystem A) n),
      E.eval n (relabel (quotientMap (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L)) S) =
        quotientMap (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) n (flatten S))
    {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (x : Data (Carrier (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L)) k)
    (a : Carrier (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) k)
    (hx : IsExtremal (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) E a x) :
    ClassBelow (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) (E.eval k (delta x.1 x.2 a)) a

axiom delta_in_context {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    (E : Algebra (Carrier (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L)))
    (hE : ∀ n (S : FiniteSystem (FiniteSystem A) n),
      E.eval n (relabel (quotientMap (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L)) S) =
        quotientMap (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) n (flatten S))
    {k : ℕ} (x : Data (Carrier (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L)) k)
    (a : Carrier (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) k) :
    ClassBelow (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) (value E a x)
      (value E (E.eval k (delta x.1 x.2 a)) x)

axiom parallel_value {A : RankedSet} (E : Algebra A) {k : ℕ}
    (B : Boundary k) (m : Fin (k + 1) → A 1) (a : A k) :
    E.eval k (ofSetSystem (DeterministicElements.parallel (fun i => E.eval 1 (component B m a i)))) =
      E.eval k (delta B m a)

/-- The witness accepts precisely the normal data above its extremal datum. -/
axiom acceptance_iff_dataBelow {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    (E : Algebra (Carrier (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L)))
    (hE : ∀ n (S : FiniteSystem (FiniteSystem A) n),
      E.eval n (relabel (quotientMap (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L)) S) =
        quotientMap (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) n (flatten S))
    {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (x y : Data (Carrier (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L)) k)
    (a : Carrier (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) k)
    (hx : IsExtremal (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) E a x) :
    Accepts (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) E (E.eval k (delta x.1 x.2 a)) y ↔
      FiniteExtremal.DataBelow (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) x y

/-- Meet of normal context data: union the boundary marks and sum the pieces. -/
def meetData {A : RankedSet} (E : Algebra A) {k : ℕ} (y z : Data A k) : Data A k :=
  (⟨y.1.root ∨ z.1.root, y.1.loops ∪ z.1.loops⟩, fun i => sumValue E (y.2 i) (z.2 i))

axiom accepting_meetData {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    (E : Algebra (Carrier (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L)))
    (hE : ∀ n (S : FiniteSystem (FiniteSystem A) n),
      E.eval n (relabel (quotientMap (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L)) S) =
        quotientMap (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) n (flatten S))
    {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (x y z : Data (Carrier (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L)) k)
    (a : Carrier (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) k)
    (hx : IsExtremal (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) E a x) :
    Accepts (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) E (E.eval k (delta x.1 x.2 a)) (meetData E y z) ↔
      Accepts (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) E (E.eval k (delta x.1 x.2 a)) y ∧
      Accepts (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) E (E.eval k (delta x.1 x.2 a)) z

end Lax369799.SplitExtremal

concepts.title: Substitution congruence for compacted evaluations
concepts.description:
Pointwise equality of the supported-evaluation profiles of inner systems
is preserved by deterministic substitution. A common compacted outer
shape compares their supported evaluations after the unused ports are
removed.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.SupportEvaluation
import Lax369799.PolynomialContexts

/-!
---
title: Substitution congruence for compacted evaluations
type: theorem
---
Pointwise equality of the supported-evaluation profiles of inner systems
is preserved by deterministic substitution. A common compacted outer
shape compares their supported evaluations after the unused ports are
removed.
-/

namespace Lax369799.SubstitutionProfiles
open RankedSystems SupportedAlgebras
open SupportEvaluation (Equivalent)

axiom pointwise_congruence {A B : RankedSet} (E : Algebra B) {n : ℕ}
    (P : System A n) (q s : ∀ v, System B (P.val.graph.label v).1)
    (hqs : ∀ v, Equivalent E (q v) (s v))
    (F H : System B n)
    (hF : Lax369799.Flattening.SystemFlattening (PolynomialContexts.withLabels P q) F)
    (hH : Lax369799.Flattening.SystemFlattening (PolynomialContexts.withLabels P s) H) :
    Equivalent E F H

end Lax369799.SubstitutionProfiles

concepts.title: Factoring out unused output variables
concepts.description:
Every deterministic presentation is an injective renaming of a system
whose output variables all occur. Renaming a fully supported system has
full support precisely when the variable map is surjective.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.SupportedSystems

/-!
---
title: Factoring out unused output variables
type: theorem
---
Every deterministic presentation is an injective renaming of a system
whose output variables all occur. Renaming a fully supported system has
full support precisely when the variable map is surjective.
-/

namespace Lax369799.SupportCompaction
open RankedSystems Renaming Resolutions

axiom compact_exists {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} (S : RankedSystems.System A n) :
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (σ : Fin m → Fin n) (T : SupportedSystems.System A m),
      Function.Injective σ ∧ renameSystem σ T.val = S

axiom rename_supported_iff {A : RankedSet} {m n : ℕ} (σ : Fin m → Fin n)
    (T : SupportedSystems.System A m) :
    SupportedSystems.FullySupported (renameSystem σ T.val) ↔ Function.Surjective σ

axiom rename_set_injective {A : RankedSet} {m n : ℕ} (σ : Fin m → Fin n)
    (hσ : Function.Injective σ) : Function.Injective (@Resolutions.rename A m n σ)

axiom rename_system_injective {A : RankedSet} {m n : ℕ} (σ : Fin m → Fin n)
    (hσ : Function.Injective σ) : Function.Injective (@renameSystem A m n σ)

axiom support_image {A : RankedSet} {m n : ℕ} (σ : Fin m → Fin n)
    (T : SupportedSystems.System A m) (j : Fin n) :
    (∃ v d, (renameSystem σ T.val).val.graph.edge v d (.inr j)) ↔ j ∈ Set.range σ

axiom compact_unique {A : RankedSet} {m k n : ℕ}
    (σ : Fin m → Fin n) (τ : Fin k → Fin n)
    (hσ : Function.Injective σ) (hτ : Function.Injective τ)
    (S : SupportedSystems.System A m) (T : SupportedSystems.System A k)
    (h : renameSystem σ S.val = renameSystem τ T.val) :
    ∃ e : Fin m ≃ Fin k, (∀ i, τ (e i) = σ i) ∧ renameSystem e S.val = T.val

end Lax369799.SupportCompaction

concepts.title: Algebras on fully supported systems
concepts.description:
Evaluation is defined on the systems of Definition 6, with every output
reachable. Restriction of an algebra on arbitrary deterministic systems
preserves its algebra laws, unfolding invariance, and recognition. Evaluation commutes with surjective output renaming.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.SupportedSystems
import Lax369799.Algebras

/-!
---
title: Algebras on fully supported systems
type: theorem
---
Evaluation is defined on the systems of Definition 6, with every output
reachable. Restriction of an algebra on arbitrary deterministic systems
preserves its algebra laws, unfolding invariance, and recognition. Evaluation commutes with surjective output renaming.
-/

namespace Lax369799.SupportedAlgebras
open RankedSystems (RankedSet RankedMap RankwiseFinite)
open SupportedSystems Morphisms

structure Algebra (A : RankedSet) where
  eval : ∀ n, System A n → A n
  isomorphic : ∀ n (S T : System A n), Isomorphic S.val.val T.val.val → eval n S = eval n T
  unit : ∀ n (a : A n), eval n (atomic a) = a
  associative : ∀ n (S : System (System A) n) (T : System A n),
    Flattening.SystemFlattening (forgetPattern S) T.val →
      eval n (relabel eval S) = eval n T

def UnfoldInvariant {A : RankedSet} (E : Algebra A) : Prop :=
  ∀ n (S T : System A n), UnfoldEquivalent S.val.val T.val.val → E.eval n S = E.eval n T

def Recognizes {A B : RankedSet} (E : Algebra B) (η : RankedMap A B)
    (F : Set (B 0)) (L : Algebras.Language A) : Prop :=
  ∀ T : System A 0, T.val ∈ L ↔ E.eval 0 (relabel η T) ∈ F

def Recognizable {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A) : Prop :=
  ∃ (B : RankedSet) (E : Algebra B) (η : RankedMap A B) (F : Set (B 0)),
    RankwiseFinite B ∧ Recognizes E η F L

def restrict {A : RankedSet} (E : Algebras.Algebra A) : Algebra A where
  eval := fun n S => E.eval n S.val
  isomorphic := fun n S T h => E.isomorphic n S.val T.val h
  unit := E.unit
  associative := fun n S T h => E.associative n (forgetPattern S) T.val h

axiom restrict_invariant {A : RankedSet} (E : Algebras.Algebra A)
    (hE : Algebras.UnfoldInvariant E) : UnfoldInvariant (restrict E)

axiom legacy_recognizable {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    (hL : Algebras.Recognizable L) : Recognizable L

axiom rename_evaluation {A : RankedSet} (E : Algebra A)
    {m n : ℕ} (σ : Fin m → Fin n) (hσ : Function.Surjective σ) (S : System A m) :
    E.eval n (rename σ hσ S) = E.eval n (rename σ hσ (atomic (E.eval m S)))

end Lax369799.SupportedAlgebras

  Lax369799.Algebras.Recognizable L → Lax369799.SupportedAlgebras.Recognizable L

  (hσ : Function.Surjective σ) (S : Lax369799.SupportedSystems.System A m),
  Eq (E.eval n (Lax369799.SupportedSystems.rename σ hσ S))

  Lax369799.Algebras.UnfoldInvariant E →
    Lax369799.SupportedAlgebras.UnfoldInvariant (Lax369799.SupportedAlgebras.restrict E)

concepts.title: Extending supported algebras and preserving recognition
concepts.description:
The quotient of arbitrary systems by their supported-evaluation profiles
is an algebra. Evaluation chooses inner representatives and flattens;
substitution congruence and the deterministic substitution laws make it
well defined and associative. The construction preserves finite sorts
and closed recognition. Recognizability using the fully supported systems
of Definition 6 is therefore equivalent to recognizability using arbitrary
deterministic presentations.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.SupportEvaluation

/-!
---
title: Extending supported algebras and preserving recognition
type: theorem
---
The quotient of arbitrary systems by their supported-evaluation profiles
is an algebra. Evaluation chooses inner representatives and flattens;
substitution congruence and the deterministic substitution laws make it
well defined and associative. The construction preserves finite sorts
and closed recognition. Recognizability using the fully supported systems
of Definition 6 is therefore equivalent to recognizability using arbitrary
deterministic presentations.
-/

namespace Lax369799.SupportedCompletion
open RankedSystems Morphisms
open SupportEvaluation (Carrier classMap)

axiom algebra {B : RankedSet} (E : SupportedAlgebras.Algebra B) :
    ∃ D : Algebras.Algebra (Carrier E), ∀ n (P : System (System B) n) (U : System B n),
      Lax369799.Flattening.SystemFlattening P U →
        D.eval n (relabelSystem (classMap E) P) = classMap E n U

axiom legacy_recognizable {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    (hL : SupportedAlgebras.Recognizable L) : Algebras.Recognizable L

axiom recognizable_iff {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A) :
    SupportedAlgebras.Recognizable L ↔ Algebras.Recognizable L

/-- Map a letter to the class of its atomic presentation. -/
def letter {B : RankedSet} (E : SupportedAlgebras.Algebra B) : RankedMap B (Carrier E) :=
  fun n b => classMap E n (atomicSystem b)

open SupportEvaluation (Equivalent)

axiom profile_morphism {B : RankedSet} (E : SupportedAlgebras.Algebra B)
    (hE : SupportedAlgebras.UnfoldInvariant E) {n : ℕ} (S T : System B n)
    (f : Morphism S.val T.val) : Equivalent E S T

axiom profile_unfold {B : RankedSet} (E : SupportedAlgebras.Algebra B)
    (hE : SupportedAlgebras.UnfoldInvariant E) {n : ℕ} (S T : System B n)
    (h : UnfoldEquivalent S.val T.val) : Equivalent E S T

axiom eval_letters {B : RankedSet} (E : SupportedAlgebras.Algebra B)
    (D : Algebras.Algebra (Carrier E))
    (hD : ∀ n (P : System (System B) n) (U : System B n),
      Flattening.SystemFlattening P U → D.eval n (relabelSystem (classMap E) P) = classMap E n U)
    {n : ℕ} (S : System B n) :
    D.eval n (relabelSystem (letter E) S) = classMap E n S

axiom regular_completion {B : RankedSet} (E : SupportedAlgebras.Algebra B)
    (hE : SupportedAlgebras.UnfoldInvariant E) :
    ∃ D : Algebras.Algebra (Carrier E), Algebras.UnfoldInvariant D ∧
      ∀ n (S : System B n), D.eval n (relabelSystem (letter E) S) = classMap E n S

axiom unary_card_bound {B : RankedSet} (E : SupportedAlgebras.Algebra B)
    (hB : RankwiseFinite B) : Nat.card (Carrier E 1) ≤ Nat.card (B 0) + Nat.card (B 1)

end Lax369799.SupportedCompletion

concepts.title: Smallification in supported contexts
concepts.description:
Lemma 81 with the original supported algebra and bound |B₀| + |B₁| + 1.
The quotient map is surjective and its section is injective. The new
argument is the surjective renaming of the original system; its context
has precisely the selected hole directions and is trimmed to reachable
vertices. The two closed evaluations agree.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.SupportedAlgebras
import Lax369799.ContextPorts

/-!
---
title: Smallification in supported contexts
type: theorem
---
Lemma 81 with the original supported algebra and bound |B₀| + |B₁| + 1.
The quotient map is surjective and its section is injective. The new
argument is the surjective renaming of the original system; its context
has precisely the selected hole directions and is trimmed to reachable
vertices. The two closed evaluations agree.
-/

namespace Lax369799.SupportedContextSmallification
open RankedSystems Flattening

axiom smallification {A B : RankedSet} (E : SupportedAlgebras.Algebra B)
    (hB : RankwiseFinite B) (hE : SupportedAlgebras.UnfoldInvariant E) (η : RankedMap A B)
    {m n : ℕ} (C : SetContext A m 0) (hC : C.system.Deterministic)
    (S : SupportedSystems.System A m) (σ : Fin m → Fin n) :
    ∃ (m' : ℕ) (τ : Fin m → Fin m') (sectionMap : Fin m' → Fin m),
      m' ≤ m ∧ Function.Surjective τ ∧ Function.Injective sectionMap ∧
      (∀ j,τ (sectionMap j) = j) ∧ (∀ i,σ (sectionMap (τ i)) = σ i) ∧
      Resolutions.SmallMap B (σ ∘ sectionMap) ∧
      ∃ (S' : SupportedSystems.System A m') (D : SetContext A m' 0),
        S'.val = Renaming.renameSystem τ S.val ∧
        D.system = trim (Lax369799.ContextPorts.resizeGraph C sectionMap) ∧ D.system.Deterministic ∧
        ∃ U V : SupportedSystems.System A 0,
          U.val.val = plug C S.val.val ∧ V.val.val = plug D S'.val.val ∧
          E.eval 0 (SupportedSystems.relabel η U) = E.eval 0 (SupportedSystems.relabel η V)

end Lax369799.SupportedContextSmallification

statements.signature:
smallification : ∀ {A B : Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankedSet} (E : Lax369799.SupportedAlgebras.Algebra B),
  Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankwiseFinite B →
    Lax369799.SupportedAlgebras.UnfoldInvariant E →
      ∀ (η : Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankedMap A B) {m n : Nat} (C : Lax369799.Flattening.SetContext A m 0),
        C.system.Deterministic →
          ∀ (S : Lax369799.SupportedSystems.System A m) (σ : Fin m → Fin n),
            Exists fun m' =>
              Exists fun τ =>
                Exists fun sectionMap =>
                  And (instLENat.le m' m)
                    (And (Function.Surjective τ)
                      (And (Function.Injective sectionMap)
                        (And (∀ (j : Fin m'), Eq (τ (sectionMap j)) j)
                          (And (∀ (i : Fin m), Eq (σ (sectionMap (τ i))) (σ i))
                            (And (Lax369799.Resolutions.SmallMap B (Function.comp σ sectionMap))
                              (Exists fun S' =>
                                Exists fun D =>
                                  And (Eq S'.val (Lax369799.Renaming.renameSystem τ S.val))
                                    (And
                                      (Eq D.system
                                        (Lax369799.RankedSystems.trim
                                          (Lax369799.ContextPorts.resizeGraph C sectionMap)))
                                      (And D.system.Deterministic
                                        (Exists fun U =>
                                          Exists fun V =>
                                            And (Eq U.val.val (Lax369799.Flattening.plug C S.val.val))
                                              (And (Eq V.val.val (Lax369799.Flattening.plug D S'.val.val))
                                                (Eq (E.eval 0 (Lax369799.SupportedSystems.relabel η U))
                                                  (E.eval 0 (Lax369799.SupportedSystems.relabel η V)))))))))))))

concepts.title: Selection and common unfoldings of fully supported systems
concepts.description:
Morphisms between revised systems are foldings. A locally surjective
morphism from an unpruned set-system to a system admits an injective
system selection (Lemma 11). Common unfoldings can be chosen to be
systems (Lemma 20), and unfoldings lift through surjective renaming
while preserving full support (Lemma 24).
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.SupportedSystems
import Lax369799.FiniteStructureTheorems
import Lax369799.ResolutionLifting

/-!
---
title: Selection and common unfoldings of fully supported systems
type: theorem
---
Morphisms between revised systems are foldings. A locally surjective
morphism from an unpruned set-system to a system admits an injective
system selection (Lemma 11). Common unfoldings can be chosen to be
systems (Lemma 20), and unfoldings lift through surjective renaming
while preserving full support (Lemma 24).
-/

namespace Lax369799.SupportedMorphisms
open RankedSystems (RankedSet)
open FinitePresentations FiniteMorphisms FiniteStructureTheorems

def presentation {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} (S : SupportedSystems.System A n) : FiniteSystem A n :=
  ofSetSystem S.val.val

axiom source_support {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ}
    (S : RankedSystems.System A n) (T : SupportedSystems.System A n)
    (f : Morphism (ofSetSystem S.val) (presentation T)) : SupportedSystems.FullySupported S

axiom system_folding {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} (S T : SupportedSystems.System A n)
    (f : Morphism (presentation S) (presentation T)) : Folding f

axiom system_selection {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} (S : FiniteSystem A n)
    (T : SupportedSystems.System A n) (f : Morphism S (presentation T))
    (hf : LocallySurjective f) :
    ∃ (U : SupportedSystems.System A n) (i : Morphism (presentation U) S)
      (g : Morphism (presentation U) (presentation T)),
      Function.Injective i.toFun ∧ g.toFun = f.toFun ∘ i.toFun ∧ Folding g

axiom common_system_unfolding {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ}
    (S T : SupportedSystems.System A n)
    (h : UnfoldEquivalent (presentation S) (presentation T)) :
    ∃ (U : SupportedSystems.System A n) (f : Morphism (presentation U) (presentation S))
      (g : Morphism (presentation U) (presentation T)), Folding f ∧ Folding g

axiom system_pullback {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} (S T U : SupportedSystems.System A n)
    (f : Morphism (presentation S) (presentation U))
    (g : Morphism (presentation T) (presentation U)) :
    ∃ (P : SupportedSystems.System A n) (p : Morphism (presentation P) (presentation S))
      (q : Morphism (presentation P) (presentation T)),
      f.toFun ∘ p.toFun = g.toFun ∘ q.toFun ∧ Folding p ∧ Folding q ∧
      (∀ (V : SupportedSystems.System A n) (a : Morphism (presentation V) (presentation S))
        (b : Morphism (presentation V) (presentation T)),
        f.toFun ∘ a.toFun = g.toFun ∘ b.toFun →
        ∃! h : Morphism (presentation V) (presentation P),
          p.toFun ∘ h.toFun = a.toFun ∧ q.toFun ∘ h.toFun = b.toFun)

axiom rename_lift {A : RankedSet} {m n : ℕ} (σ : Fin m → Fin n)
    (hσ : Function.Surjective σ) (S : SupportedSystems.System A m)
    (R : SupportedSystems.System A n)
    (f : Morphisms.Morphism R.val.val (Resolutions.rename σ S.val.val)) :
    ∃ U : SupportedSystems.System A m,
      SupportedSystems.rename σ hσ U = R ∧ Morphisms.UnfoldsTo S.val.val U.val.val

end Lax369799.SupportedMorphisms

    Exists fun U =>
      Exists fun f =>
        Exists fun g => And (Lax369799.FiniteStructureTheorems.Folding f) (Lax369799.FiniteStructureTheorems.Folding g)

      (Lax369799.SupportedMorphisms.presentation T)),
  Lax369799.SupportedSystems.FullySupported S

system_folding : ∀ {A : Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankedSet} {n : Nat} (S T : Lax369799.SupportedSystems.System A n)
  (f :
    Lax369799.FiniteMorphisms.Morphism (Lax369799.SupportedMorphisms.presentation S)
      (Lax369799.SupportedMorphisms.presentation T)),
  Lax369799.FiniteStructureTheorems.Folding f

system_pullback : ∀ {A : Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankedSet} {n : Nat} (S T U : Lax369799.SupportedSystems.System A n)
  (f :
    Lax369799.FiniteMorphisms.Morphism (Lax369799.SupportedMorphisms.presentation S)
      (Lax369799.SupportedMorphisms.presentation U))
  (g :
    Lax369799.FiniteMorphisms.Morphism (Lax369799.SupportedMorphisms.presentation T)
      (Lax369799.SupportedMorphisms.presentation U)),
  Exists fun P =>
    Exists fun p =>
      Exists fun q =>
        And (Eq (Function.comp f.toFun p.toFun) (Function.comp g.toFun q.toFun))
          (And (Lax369799.FiniteStructureTheorems.Folding p)
            (And (Lax369799.FiniteStructureTheorems.Folding q)
              (∀ (V : Lax369799.SupportedSystems.System A n)
                (a :
                  Lax369799.FiniteMorphisms.Morphism (Lax369799.SupportedMorphisms.presentation V)
                    (Lax369799.SupportedMorphisms.presentation S))
                (b :
                  Lax369799.FiniteMorphisms.Morphism (Lax369799.SupportedMorphisms.presentation V)
                    (Lax369799.SupportedMorphisms.presentation T)),
                Eq (Function.comp f.toFun a.toFun) (Function.comp g.toFun b.toFun) →
                  ExistsUnique fun h =>
                    And (Eq (Function.comp p.toFun h.toFun) a.toFun) (Eq (Function.comp q.toFun h.toFun) b.toFun))))

system_selection : ∀ {A : Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankedSet} {n : Nat} (S : Lax369799.FinitePresentations.FiniteSystem A n)
  (T : Lax369799.SupportedSystems.System A n)
  (f : Lax369799.FiniteMorphisms.Morphism S (Lax369799.SupportedMorphisms.presentation T)),
  Lax369799.FiniteStructureTheorems.LocallySurjective f →
    Exists fun U =>
      Exists fun i =>
        Exists fun g =>
          And (Function.Injective i.toFun)
            (And (Eq g.toFun (Function.comp f.toFun i.toFun)) (Lax369799.FiniteStructureTheorems.Folding g))

concepts.title: Profiles of fully supported resolutions
concepts.description:
The profiles of Section 4.3 record a value in the original supported
algebra and the variable map of a fully supported resolution. Root
profiles start at the root marks. Small profiles restrict each fibre
to the revised bound |B₀| + |B₁| + 1.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.SupportedYields
import Lax369799.SupportedCompletion
import Lax369799.Resolutions
import Lax369799.FiniteProfiles

/-!
---
title: Profiles of fully supported resolutions
type: theorem
---
The profiles of Section 4.3 record a value in the original supported
algebra and the variable map of a fully supported resolution. Root
profiles start at the root marks. Small profiles restrict each fibre
to the revised bound |B₀| + |B₁| + 1.
-/

namespace Lax369799.SupportedProfiles
open RankedSystems (RankedSet RankedMap)
open FinitePresentations FiniteMorphisms SupportedMorphisms FiniteRenaming

def Profile {A B : RankedSet} (E : SupportedAlgebras.Algebra B) (η : RankedMap A B)
    {n : ℕ} (S : FiniteSystem A n) : Set (Resolutions.ProfileEntry B n) :=
  {e | ∃ T : SupportedSystems.System A e.1,
    Nonempty (Morphism (push e.2.2 (presentation T)) S) ∧
      E.eval e.1 (SupportedSystems.relabel η T) = e.2.1}

def ProfileEquivalent {A B : RankedSet} (E : SupportedAlgebras.Algebra B) (η : RankedMap A B)
    {n : ℕ} (S T : FiniteSystem A n) : Prop :=
  Profile E η S = Profile E η T ∧
    Profile E η (SupportedYields.uproot S) = Profile E η (SupportedYields.uproot T)

def SmallProfile {A B : RankedSet} (E : SupportedAlgebras.Algebra B) (η : RankedMap A B)
    {n : ℕ} (S : FiniteSystem A n) : Set (Resolutions.ProfileEntry B n) :=
  {e | e ∈ Profile E η S ∧ Resolutions.SmallMap B e.2.2}

def SmallProfileEquivalent {A B : RankedSet} (E : SupportedAlgebras.Algebra B) (η : RankedMap A B)
    {n : ℕ} (S T : FiniteSystem A n) : Prop :=
  SmallProfile E η S = SmallProfile E η T ∧
    SmallProfile E η (SupportedYields.uproot S) = SmallProfile E η (SupportedYields.uproot T)

open RankedSystems (System RankwiseFinite relabelSystem trim)
open SupportEvaluation (Carrier classMap)

axiom full_completion {A B : RankedSet} (E : SupportedAlgebras.Algebra B)
    (η : RankedMap A B) (D : Algebras.Algebra (Carrier E)) (hDE : Algebras.UnfoldInvariant D)
    (hD : ∀ n (R : System B n),
      D.eval n (relabelSystem (SupportedCompletion.letter E) R) = classMap E n R)
    {n : ℕ} (S T : FiniteSystem A n) (h : ProfileEquivalent E η S T) :
    Resolutions.ProfileEquivalent
      (fun k R => D.eval k (relabelSystem (fun j a => SupportedCompletion.letter E j (η j a)) R))
      (trim S.graph) (trim T.graph)

axiom small_completion {A B : RankedSet} (E : SupportedAlgebras.Algebra B)
    (hB : RankwiseFinite B) (η : RankedMap A B) (D : Algebras.Algebra (Carrier E))
    (hDE : Algebras.UnfoldInvariant D)
    (hD : ∀ n (R : System B n),
      D.eval n (relabelSystem (SupportedCompletion.letter E) R) = classMap E n R)
    {n : ℕ} (S T : FiniteSystem A n) (h : SmallProfileEquivalent E η S T) :
    FiniteProfiles.BoundedProfileEquivalent (Nat.card (Carrier E 1) + 1)
      (fun k R => D.eval k (relabelSystem (fun j a => SupportedCompletion.letter E j (η j a)) R)) S T

axiom full_refines {A B : RankedSet} (E : SupportedAlgebras.Algebra B)
    (hB : RankwiseFinite B) (hE : SupportedAlgebras.UnfoldInvariant E)
    (η : RankedMap A B) (F : Set (B 0)) (L : Algebras.Language A)
    (hL : SupportedAlgebras.Recognizes E η F L) {n : ℕ} (S T : FiniteSystem A n)
    (h : ProfileEquivalent E η S T) :
    FiniteContextualOrder.Equivalent (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) S T

axiom small_refines {A B : RankedSet} (E : SupportedAlgebras.Algebra B)
    (hB : RankwiseFinite B) (hE : SupportedAlgebras.UnfoldInvariant E)
    (η : RankedMap A B) (F : Set (B 0)) (L : Algebras.Language A)
    (hL : SupportedAlgebras.Recognizes E η F L) {n : ℕ} (S T : FiniteSystem A n)
    (h : SmallProfileEquivalent E η S T) :
    FiniteContextualOrder.Equivalent (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) S T

axiom yield_profile {A B : RankedSet} (E : SupportedAlgebras.Algebra B)
    (hE : SupportedAlgebras.UnfoldInvariant E) (η : RankedMap A B) {n : ℕ}
    (S : FiniteSystem A n) (e : Resolutions.ProfileEntry B n) :
    e ∈ Profile E η S ↔
      ∃ T : SupportedSystems.System A e.1, SupportedYields.InitialYield S T e.2.2 ∧
        E.eval e.1 (SupportedSystems.relabel η T) = e.2.1

axiom closed_small_profile {A B : RankedSet} (E : SupportedAlgebras.Algebra B)
    (η : RankedMap A B) (S : FiniteSystem A 0) :
    SmallProfile E η S = Profile E η S

axiom small_profile_finite {A B : RankedSet} (E : SupportedAlgebras.Algebra B)
    (hB : RankwiseFinite B) (η : RankedMap A B) (n : ℕ) :
    Finite (Quot (@SmallProfileEquivalent A B E η n))

axiom closed_congruence {A B : RankedSet} (E : SupportedAlgebras.Algebra B)
    (hB : RankwiseFinite B) (hE : SupportedAlgebras.UnfoldInvariant E) (η : RankedMap A B)
    (P : FiniteSystem (FiniteSystem A) 0) (Q : ∀ v, FiniteSystem A (P.graph.label v).1)
    (h : ∀ v, SmallProfileEquivalent E η (Inner P.graph v) (Q v)) :
    ProfileEquivalent E η (flatten P) (flatten (withLabels P Q))

axiom congruence {A B : RankedSet} (E : SupportedAlgebras.Algebra B)
    (hE : SupportedAlgebras.UnfoldInvariant E) (η : RankedMap A B) {n : ℕ}
    (P : FiniteSystem (FiniteSystem A) n) (Q : ∀ v, FiniteSystem A (P.graph.label v).1)
    (h : ∀ v, ProfileEquivalent E η (Inner P.graph v) (Q v)) :
    ProfileEquivalent E η (flatten P) (flatten (withLabels P Q))

end Lax369799.SupportedProfiles

  Lax369799.Algebras.UnfoldInvariant D →
    (∀ (n : Nat) (R : Lax369799.RankedSystems.System B n),

concepts.title: Language invariance, closure, and syntactic finiteness for supported algebras
concepts.description:
Lemmas 56, 62, and 75 with revised Definition 6 as the algebra domain.
The completion bridge transfers finite recognition, while invariance of
a recognized language follows directly from invariance of its evaluation.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.SupportedAlgebras
import Lax369799.RecognitionClosure
import Lax369799.RecognitionProjection
import Lax369799.BoundedProfileRefinement

/-!
---
title: Language invariance, closure, and syntactic finiteness for supported algebras
type: theorem
---
Lemmas 56, 62, and 75 with revised Definition 6 as the algebra domain.
The completion bridge transfers finite recognition, while invariance of
a recognized language follows directly from invariance of its evaluation.
-/

namespace Lax369799.SupportedRecognition
open RankedSystems Algebras

axiom language_invariant {A B : RankedSet} (E : SupportedAlgebras.Algebra B)
    (hE : SupportedAlgebras.UnfoldInvariant E) (η : RankedMap A B) (F : Set (B 0))
    (L : Language A) (hL : SupportedAlgebras.Recognizes E η F L) : UnfoldInvariantLanguage L

axiom complement {A : RankedSet} (L : Language A) (h : SupportedAlgebras.Recognizable L) :
    SupportedAlgebras.Recognizable Lᶜ

axiom intersection {A : RankedSet} (L K : Language A)
    (hL : SupportedAlgebras.Recognizable L) (hK : SupportedAlgebras.Recognizable K) :
    SupportedAlgebras.Recognizable (L ∩ K)

axiom union {A : RankedSet} (L K : Language A)
    (hL : SupportedAlgebras.Recognizable L) (hK : SupportedAlgebras.Recognizable K) :
    SupportedAlgebras.Recognizable (L ∪ K)

axiom inverse_relabel {A B : RankedSet} (η : RankedMap A B) (L : Language B)
    (hL : SupportedAlgebras.Recognizable L) :
    SupportedAlgebras.Recognizable {S | relabelSystem η S ∈ L}

axiom projection {A B : RankedSet} (η : RankedMap A B)
    (hη : ∀ n, Function.Surjective (η n)) (L : Language A)
    (hL : SupportedAlgebras.Recognizable L) :
    SupportedAlgebras.Recognizable (RecognitionProjection.Projected η L)

axiom syntactic_rankwise_finite {A : RankedSet} (L : Language A)
    (hL : UnfoldInvariantLanguage L) (hrec : SupportedAlgebras.Recognizable L) :
    RankwiseFinite (FiniteContextualOrder.Carrier (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L))

end Lax369799.SupportedRecognition

concepts.title: Flatten-resolutions with supported systems and explicit output maps
concepts.description:
The four conditions of Lemma 46 specify an outer vertex map, local
variable maps and yields, preservation of initial vertices and transitions,
and preservation of output edges through the prescribed global map.
Both levels of the resolving system are fully supported.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.SupportedYields
import Lax369799.SupportedSystems
import Lax369799.SupportedCompletion
import Lax369799.Resolutions

/-!
---
title: Flatten-resolutions with supported systems and explicit output maps
type: theorem
---
The four conditions of Lemma 46 specify an outer vertex map, local
variable maps and yields, preservation of initial vertices and transitions,
and preservation of output edges through the prescribed global map.
Both levels of the resolving system are fully supported.
-/

namespace Lax369799.SupportedResolutions
open RankedSystems (RankedSet)
open FinitePresentations SupportedMorphisms

structure Resolution {A : RankedSet} {m n : ℕ} (S : FiniteSystem (FiniteSystem A) n)
    (T : SupportedSystems.System (SupportedSystems.System A) m) (τ : Fin m → Fin n) where
  vertex : T.val.val.Vertex → S.Vertex
  variableMap : ∀ v, Fin (T.val.val.graph.label v).1 → Fin (S.graph.label (vertex v)).1
  initial : ∀ v,T.val.val.graph.initial v → S.graph.initial (vertex v)
  resolves : ∀ v, SupportedYields.InitialYield (Inner S.graph (vertex v))
    (T.val.val.graph.label v).2 (variableMap v)
  transition : ∀ v (i : Fin (T.val.val.graph.label v).1) w,
    T.val.val.graph.edge v i.val (.inl w) → S.graph.edge (vertex v) (variableMap v i).val (.inl (vertex w))
  exit : ∀ v (i : Fin (T.val.val.graph.label v).1) j,
    T.val.val.graph.edge v i.val (.inr j) → S.graph.edge (vertex v) (variableMap v i).val (.inr (τ j))

open SupportedYields

axiom sound {A : RankedSet} {m n : ℕ} (S : FiniteSystem (FiniteSystem A) n)
    (T : SupportedSystems.System (SupportedSystems.System A) m) (τ : Fin m → Fin n)
    (r : Resolution S T τ) (V : SupportedSystems.System A m)
    (hV : Flattening.SystemFlattening (SupportedSystems.forgetPattern T) V.val) :
    InitialYield (flatten S) V τ

open RankedSystems (RankwiseFinite RankedMap)
open Resolutions

axiom small_resolution {A B : RankedSet} (E : SupportedAlgebras.Algebra B)
    (hB : RankwiseFinite B) (hE : SupportedAlgebras.UnfoldInvariant E) (η : RankedMap A B)
    (S : FiniteSystem (FiniteSystem A) 0)
    (T : SupportedSystems.System (SupportedSystems.System A) 0) (r : Resolution S T Fin.elim0)
    (R : SupportedSystems.System A 0)
    (hR : Flattening.SystemFlattening (SupportedSystems.forgetPattern T) R.val) :
    ∃ (U : SupportedSystems.System (SupportedSystems.System A) 0)
      (V : SupportedSystems.System A 0) (r' : Resolution S U Fin.elim0),
      Flattening.SystemFlattening (SupportedSystems.forgetPattern U) V.val ∧
      (∀ v,SmallMap B (r'.variableMap v)) ∧
      E.eval 0 (SupportedSystems.relabel η R) = E.eval 0 (SupportedSystems.relabel η V)

end Lax369799.SupportedResolutions

  Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankwiseFinite B →
    Lax369799.SupportedAlgebras.UnfoldInvariant E →
      ∀ (η : Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankedMap A B)
        (S : Lax369799.FinitePresentations.FiniteSystem (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.FiniteSystem A) 0)
        (T : Lax369799.SupportedSystems.System (Lax369799.SupportedSystems.System A) 0)

                And (Lax369799.Flattening.SystemFlattening (Lax369799.SupportedSystems.forgetPattern U) V.val)
                  (And (∀ (v : Fin U.val.val.size), Lax369799.Resolutions.SmallMap B (r'.variableMap v))
                    (Eq (E.eval 0 (Lax369799.SupportedSystems.relabel η R))
                      (E.eval 0 (Lax369799.SupportedSystems.relabel η V))))
