  (S : Lax369799.FinitePresentations.FiniteSystem (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.FiniteSystem A) n)
  (T : Lax369799.SupportedSystems.System (Lax369799.SupportedSystems.System A) m) (τ : Fin m → Fin n)
  (r : Lax369799.SupportedResolutions.Resolution S T τ) (V : Lax369799.SupportedSystems.System A m),
  Lax369799.Flattening.SystemFlattening (Lax369799.SupportedSystems.forgetPattern T) V.val →
    Lax369799.SupportedYields.InitialYield (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.flatten S) V τ

concepts.title: Systems with all output variables reachable
concepts.description:
Definition 6 requires every vertex and every output variable to be
reachable from the unique initial vertex. The earlier deterministic
presentation interface already requires vertex reachability; full support
adds occurrence of every variable edge. Relabelling and surjective
renaming preserve this condition. Flattening fully supported systems
retains all vertices and all output variables (Lemma 33). In rank zero,
the support condition is vacuous.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.FinitePresentations
import Lax369799.FlatteningTheorems
import Lax369799.Renaming

/-!
---
title: Systems with all output variables reachable
type: theorem
---
Definition 6 requires every vertex and every output variable to be
reachable from the unique initial vertex. The earlier deterministic
presentation interface already requires vertex reachability; full support
adds occurrence of every variable edge. Relabelling and surjective
renaming preserve this condition. Flattening fully supported systems
retains all vertices and all output variables (Lemma 33). In rank zero,
the support condition is vacuous.
-/

namespace Lax369799.SupportedSystems
open RankedSystems (RankedSet RankedMap)
open FinitePresentations

def FullySupported {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} (S : RankedSystems.System A n) : Prop :=
  ∀ i : Fin n, ∃ v d, S.val.graph.edge v d (.inr i)

abbrev System (A : RankedSet) (n : ℕ) := {S : RankedSystems.System A n // FullySupported S}

def forget {A : RankedSet} : RankedMap (System A) (RankedSystems.System A) := fun _ S => S.val

def relabel {A B : RankedSet} (f : RankedMap A B) {n : ℕ} (S : System A n) : System B n :=
  ⟨RankedSystems.relabelSystem f S.val, S.property⟩

def atomic {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} (a : A n) : System A n :=
  ⟨RankedSystems.atomicSystem a, fun i => ⟨(0 : Fin 1), i.val, i, rfl, rfl⟩⟩

def closedEquiv (A : RankedSet) : System A 0 ≃ RankedSystems.System A 0 where
  toFun := Subtype.val
  invFun := fun S => ⟨S, fun i => Fin.elim0 i⟩
  left_inv := fun _ => rfl
  right_inv := fun _ => rfl

def rename {A : RankedSet} {m n : ℕ} (σ : Fin m → Fin n)
    (hσ : Function.Surjective σ) (S : System A m) : System A n :=
  ⟨Renaming.renameSystem σ S.val, fun j => by
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hσ j
    obtain ⟨v, d, hd⟩ := S.property i
    exact ⟨v, d, .inr i, hd, rfl⟩⟩

def pattern {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} (S : System (System A) n) :
    FiniteSystem (FiniteSystem A) n :=
  FinitePresentations.relabel (fun _ T => ofSetSystem T.val.val) (ofSetSystem S.val.val)

def forgetPattern {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} (S : System (System A) n) :
    RankedSystems.System (RankedSystems.System A) n :=
  RankedSystems.relabelSystem forget S.val

axiom flatten_reachable {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} (S : System (System A) n) :
    ∀ v, (flattenPresentation (pattern S).graph).Reachable v

axiom flatten_system {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} (S : System (System A) n) :
    ∃ T : System A n, Flattening.SystemFlattening (forgetPattern S) T.val

end Lax369799.SupportedSystems

  (S : Lax369799.SupportedSystems.System (Lax369799.SupportedSystems.System A) n)
  (v : Lax369799.FinitePresentations.FlattenedVertex (Lax369799.SupportedSystems.pattern S).graph),
  (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.flattenPresentation (Lax369799.SupportedSystems.pattern S).graph).Reachable v

concepts.title: Supported yields, contextual order, and substitution congruence
concepts.description:
Yields with explicit variable maps agree with the reachable presentation
interface after unused outputs are compacted. The comparison preserves
both initial and root yields. Yield inclusion is stable under contexts
and simultaneous substitution, and reverses the yield-syntactic order.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.SupportedYields
import Lax369799.FiniteYieldContinuity

/-!
---
title: Supported yields, contextual order, and substitution congruence
type: theorem
---
Yields with explicit variable maps agree with the reachable presentation
interface after unused outputs are compacted. The comparison preserves
both initial and root yields. Yield inclusion is stable under contexts
and simultaneous substitution, and reverses the yield-syntactic order.
-/

namespace Lax369799.SupportedYieldComparison
open RankedSystems FinitePresentations FiniteContexts
open SupportedMorphisms FiniteRenaming SupportedYields

axiom initial_yield {A : RankedSet} {m n : ℕ} (S : FiniteSystem A n)
    (U : SupportedSystems.System A m) (σ : Fin m → Fin n) :
    InitialYield S U σ ↔ Morphisms.InitYield (trim S.graph) (Renaming.renameSystem σ U.val)

axiom root_yield {A : RankedSet} {m n : ℕ} (S : FiniteSystem A n)
    (U : SupportedSystems.System A m) (σ : Fin m → Fin n) :
    RootYield S U σ ↔ Morphisms.InitYield (RankedSystems.uproot (trim S.graph)) (Renaming.renameSystem σ U.val)

axiom legacy_below {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} (S T : FiniteSystem A n) :
    YieldBelow S T ↔ Morphisms.YieldBelow (trim S.graph) (trim T.graph)

axiom context_mono {A : RankedSet} {k n : ℕ} (C : Context A k n)
    (S T : FiniteSystem A k) (h : YieldBelow S T) : YieldBelow (plug C S) (plug C T)

axiom yield_order {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A) {n : ℕ}
    (S T : FiniteSystem A n) (h : YieldBelow S T) :
    FiniteContextualOrder.Below (FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) T S

axiom flatten_mono {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} (P : FiniteSystem (FiniteSystem A) n)
    (Q : ∀ v, FiniteSystem A (P.graph.label v).1) (h : ∀ v, YieldBelow (Inner P.graph v) (Q v)) :
    YieldBelow (flatten P) (flatten (withLabels P Q))

axiom flatten_congruence {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} (P : FiniteSystem (FiniteSystem A) n)
    (Q : ∀ v, FiniteSystem A (P.graph.label v).1) (h : ∀ v, YieldEquivalent (Inner P.graph v) (Q v)) :
    YieldEquivalent (flatten P) (flatten (withLabels P Q))

end Lax369799.SupportedYieldComparison

concepts.title: Finite yield approximation with supported witnesses
concepts.description:
Corollary 50 for unpruned contexts. Each approximating component records
a fully supported system, its variable map, and its initial or root
yield witness. The disjoint sum realizes those maps before insertion.
Both initial and root target yields retain their original variable map.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.SupportedYields
import Lax369799.FiniteYieldContinuity

/-!
---
title: Finite yield approximation with supported witnesses
type: theorem
---
Corollary 50 for unpruned contexts. Each approximating component records
a fully supported system, its variable map, and its initial or root
yield witness. The disjoint sum realizes those maps before insertion.
Both initial and root target yields retain their original variable map.
-/

namespace Lax369799.SupportedYieldContinuity
open RankedSystems FinitePresentations SupportedMorphisms SupportedYields

structure Component {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} (S : FiniteSystem A n) where
  arity : ℕ
  system : SupportedSystems.System A arity
  variableMap : Fin arity → Fin n
  rooted : Bool
  yields : if rooted then RootYield S system variableMap else InitialYield S system variableMap

def Component.realize {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} {S : FiniteSystem A n} (c : Component S) : SetSystem A n :=
  if c.rooted then RankedSystems.plant (Renaming.renameSystem c.variableMap c.system.val).val
    else (Renaming.renameSystem c.variableMap c.system.val).val

noncomputable def realizationSum {A : RankedSet} {n m : ℕ} {S : FiniteSystem A n}
    (F : Fin m → Component S) : FiniteSystem A n :=
  ofSetSystem (YieldContinuity.finiteSum (fun i => (F i).realize))


open FiniteContexts

axiom initial_continuity {A : RankedSet} {k n r : ℕ} (C : Context A k n)
    (S : FiniteSystem A k) (U : SupportedSystems.System A r) (σ : Fin r → Fin n) :
    InitialYield (plug C S) U σ ↔
      ∃ (m : ℕ) (F : Fin m → Component S), InitialYield (plug C (realizationSum F)) U σ

axiom root_continuity {A : RankedSet} {k n r : ℕ} (C : Context A k n)
    (S : FiniteSystem A k) (U : SupportedSystems.System A r) (σ : Fin r → Fin n) :
    RootYield (plug C S) U σ ↔
      ∃ (m : ℕ) (F : Fin m → Component S), RootYield (plug C (realizationSum F)) U σ

end Lax369799.SupportedYieldContinuity

  Iff (Lax369799.SupportedYields.InitialYield (Lax369799.FiniteContexts.plug C S) U σ)
    (Exists fun m =>
      Exists fun F =>
        Lax369799.SupportedYields.InitialYield
          (Lax369799.FiniteContexts.plug C (Lax369799.SupportedYieldContinuity.realizationSum F)) U σ)

concepts.title: Yields with explicit variable maps and full support
concepts.description:
Definition 25 records both a supported system and its variable map.
Initial and root yields are kept separate. Theorems cover invariance
with this map fixed (Lemma 26), morphism monotonicity and invariance
under local surjectivity (Lemma 27), unfold-invariance (Corollary 28),
and the characterization of unfold-equivalence on systems (Lemma 29).
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.SupportedMorphisms
import Lax369799.FiniteRenaming

/-!
---
title: Yields with explicit variable maps and full support
type: theorem
---
Definition 25 records both a supported system and its variable map.
Initial and root yields are kept separate. Theorems cover invariance
with this map fixed (Lemma 26), morphism monotonicity and invariance
under local surjectivity (Lemma 27), unfold-invariance (Corollary 28),
and the characterization of unfold-equivalence on systems (Lemma 29).
-/

namespace Lax369799.SupportedYields
open RankedSystems (RankedSet)
open FinitePresentations FiniteMorphisms FiniteStructureTheorems
open SupportedMorphisms FiniteRenaming

def uproot {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} (S : FiniteSystem A n) : FiniteSystem A n :=
  ⟨S.size,{S.graph with initial := S.graph.root,root := ∅}⟩

def InitialYield {A : RankedSet} {m n : ℕ} (S : FiniteSystem A n)
    (T : SupportedSystems.System A m) (σ : Fin m → Fin n) : Prop :=
  ∃ (U : SupportedSystems.System A m) (_a : Morphism (push σ (presentation U)) S)
    (b : Morphism (presentation U) (presentation T)), Folding b

def RootYield {A : RankedSet} {m n : ℕ} (S : FiniteSystem A n)
    (T : SupportedSystems.System A m) (σ : Fin m → Fin n) : Prop :=
  InitialYield (uproot S) T σ

def YieldBelow {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} (S T : FiniteSystem A n) : Prop :=
  ∀ (m : ℕ) (R : SupportedSystems.System A m) (σ : Fin m → Fin n),
    (InitialYield S R σ → InitialYield T R σ) ∧ (RootYield S R σ → RootYield T R σ)

def YieldEquivalent {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} (S T : FiniteSystem A n) : Prop :=
  ∀ (m : ℕ) (R : SupportedSystems.System A m) (σ : Fin m → Fin n),
    (InitialYield S R σ ↔ InitialYield T R σ) ∧ (RootYield S R σ ↔ RootYield T R σ)

axiom unfold_invariance {A : RankedSet} {m n : ℕ} (S : FiniteSystem A n)
    (T T' : SupportedSystems.System A m) (σ : Fin m → Fin n)
    (h : UnfoldEquivalent (presentation T) (presentation T')) :
    (InitialYield S T σ ↔ InitialYield S T' σ) ∧ (RootYield S T σ ↔ RootYield S T' σ)

axiom morphism_yields {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} {S T : FiniteSystem A n}
    (f : Morphism S T) : YieldBelow S T ∧ (LocallySurjective f → YieldEquivalent S T)

axiom unfold_yields {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} {S T : FiniteSystem A n}
    (h : UnfoldEquivalent S T) : YieldEquivalent S T

axiom system_yield_equivalence {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ}
    (S T : SupportedSystems.System A n) :
    UnfoldEquivalent (presentation S) (presentation T) ↔
      YieldEquivalent (presentation S) (presentation T)

end Lax369799.SupportedYields

  (f : Lax369799.FiniteMorphisms.Morphism S T),
  And (Lax369799.SupportedYields.YieldBelow S T)
    (Lax369799.FiniteStructureTheorems.LocallySurjective f → Lax369799.SupportedYields.YieldEquivalent S T)

  Iff
    (Lax369799.FiniteStructureTheorems.UnfoldEquivalent (Lax369799.SupportedMorphisms.presentation S)
      (Lax369799.SupportedMorphisms.presentation T))
    (Lax369799.SupportedYields.YieldEquivalent (Lax369799.SupportedMorphisms.presentation S)
      (Lax369799.SupportedMorphisms.presentation T))

  (T T' : Lax369799.SupportedSystems.System A m) (σ : Fin m → Fin n),
  Lax369799.FiniteStructureTheorems.UnfoldEquivalent (Lax369799.SupportedMorphisms.presentation T)
      (Lax369799.SupportedMorphisms.presentation T') →

      (Iff (Lax369799.SupportedYields.RootYield S T σ) (Lax369799.SupportedYields.RootYield S T' σ))

concepts.title: Finite observations after output compaction
concepts.description:
An observation records an injective output map and the evaluation of a
fully supported compacted system. Observation profiles have finite index
when the algebra has finite sorts. Two systems have the same profile precisely when a common output map
exposes equal supported values. The closed quotient recovers the original closed sort.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.SupportedAlgebras
import Mathlib.Data.Finite.Sigma
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Powerset

/-!
---
title: Finite observations after output compaction
type: theorem
---
An observation records an injective output map and the evaluation of a
fully supported compacted system. Observation profiles have finite index
when the algebra has finite sorts. Two systems have the same profile precisely when a common output map
exposes equal supported values. The closed quotient recovers the original closed sort.
-/

namespace Lax369799.SupportEvaluation
open RankedSystems (RankedSet RankwiseFinite)
open SupportedSystems SupportedAlgebras

structure Observation (B : RankedSet) (n : ℕ) where
  arity : Fin (n+1)
  ports : Fin arity.val ↪ Fin n
  value : B arity.val

def profile {B : RankedSet} (E : Algebra B) {n : ℕ} (S : RankedSystems.System B n) :
    Set (Observation B n) :=
  {o | ∃ T : System B o.arity.val,
    Renaming.renameSystem o.ports T.val = S ∧ E.eval o.arity.val T = o.value}

def Equivalent {B : RankedSet} (E : Algebra B) {n : ℕ}
    (S T : RankedSystems.System B n) : Prop := profile E S = profile E T

abbrev Carrier {B : RankedSet} (E : Algebra B) : RankedSet :=
  fun n => Quot (@Equivalent B E n)

def classMap {B : RankedSet} (E : Algebra B) : RankedSystems.RankedMap (RankedSystems.System B) (Carrier E) :=
  fun _ => Quot.mk _

axiom profile_nonempty {B : RankedSet} (E : Algebra B) {n : ℕ}
    (S : RankedSystems.System B n) : (profile E S).Nonempty

axiom finite_observations {B : RankedSet} (hB : RankwiseFinite B) (n : ℕ) :
    Finite (Observation B n)

axiom finite_carrier {B : RankedSet} (E : Algebra B) (hB : RankwiseFinite B) :
    RankwiseFinite (Carrier E)

axiom equivalent_iff {B : RankedSet} (E : Algebra B)
    {n : ℕ} (S T : RankedSystems.System B n) :
    Equivalent E S T ↔ ∃ (m : ℕ) (σ : Fin m → Fin n), Function.Injective σ ∧
      ∃ U V : System B m, Renaming.renameSystem σ U.val = S ∧
        Renaming.renameSystem σ V.val = T ∧ E.eval m U = E.eval m V

axiom closed_equivalent_iff {B : RankedSet} (E : Algebra B)
    (S T : RankedSystems.System B 0) :
    Equivalent E S T ↔ E.eval 0 (closedEquiv B |>.symm S) =
      E.eval 0 (closedEquiv B |>.symm T)

axiom closed_carrier {B : RankedSet} (E : Algebra B) :
    ∃ e : Carrier E 0 ≃ B 0, ∀ S : RankedSystems.System B 0,
      e (classMap E 0 S) = E.eval 0 ((closedEquiv B).symm S)

end Lax369799.SupportEvaluation

  Exists fun e =>
    ∀ (S : Lax369799.RankedSystems.System B 0),
      Eq (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe e (Lax369799.SupportEvaluation.classMap E 0 S))
        (E.eval 0 (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (Lax369799.SupportedSystems.closedEquiv B).symm S))

  (S T : Lax369799.RankedSystems.System B 0),
  Iff (Lax369799.SupportEvaluation.Equivalent E S T)
    (Eq (E.eval 0 (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (Lax369799.SupportedSystems.closedEquiv B).symm S))
      (E.eval 0 (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (Lax369799.SupportedSystems.closedEquiv B).symm T)))

  (S T : Lax369799.RankedSystems.System B n),
  Iff (Lax369799.SupportEvaluation.Equivalent E S T)
    (Exists fun m =>
      Exists fun σ =>
        And (Function.Injective σ)
          (Exists fun U =>
            Exists fun V =>
              And (Eq (Lax369799.Renaming.renameSystem σ U.val) S)
                (And (Eq (Lax369799.Renaming.renameSystem σ V.val) T) (Eq (E.eval m U) (E.eval m V)))))

  Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankwiseFinite B →
    Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankwiseFinite (Lax369799.SupportEvaluation.Carrier E)

  Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankwiseFinite B → ∀ (n : Nat), Finite (Lax369799.SupportEvaluation.Observation B n)

  (S : Lax369799.RankedSystems.System B n), (Lax369799.SupportEvaluation.profile E S).Nonempty

concepts.title: Isomorphisms and compacted output values
concepts.description:
Output compaction along a prescribed support map and reflection of
isomorphisms through injective renaming. Isomorphic systems have equal
observation profiles, and injective output renaming preserves equality
of profiles.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.SupportEvaluation

/-!
---
title: Isomorphisms and compacted output values
type: theorem
---
Output compaction along a prescribed support map and reflection of
isomorphisms through injective renaming. Isomorphic systems have equal
observation profiles, and injective output renaming preserves equality
of profiles.
-/

namespace Lax369799.SupportIsomorphism
open RankedSystems Morphisms Renaming FinitePresentations

axiom compact_along {A : RankedSet} {m n : ℕ} (S : System A n)
    (σ : Fin m → Fin n) (hσ : Function.Injective σ)
    (hs : ∀ j, (∃ v d, S.val.graph.edge v d (.inr j)) ↔ j ∈ Set.range σ) :
    ∃ T : SupportedSystems.System A m, renameSystem σ T.val = S

axiom reflect_morphism {A : RankedSet} {m n : ℕ} (σ : Fin m → Fin n)
    (hσ : Function.Injective σ) (S T : System A m)
    (f : Morphism (renameSystem σ S).val (renameSystem σ T).val) :
    ∃ g : Morphism S.val T.val, g.toFun = f.toFun

axiom occurs_isomorphic {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} (S T : System A n)
    (h : Isomorphic S.val T.val) (j : Fin n) :
    (∃ v d, S.val.graph.edge v d (.inr j)) ↔ ∃ v d, T.val.graph.edge v d (.inr j)

axiom profile_isomorphic {B : RankedSet} (E : SupportedAlgebras.Algebra B) {n : ℕ}
    (S T : System B n) (h : Isomorphic S.val T.val) :
    SupportEvaluation.Equivalent E S T

axiom profile_injective_rename {B : RankedSet} (E : SupportedAlgebras.Algebra B)
    {m n : ℕ} (σ : Fin m → Fin n) (hσ : Function.Injective σ)
    (S T : System B m) (h : SupportEvaluation.Equivalent E S T) :
    SupportEvaluation.Equivalent E (renameSystem σ S) (renameSystem σ T)

end Lax369799.SupportIsomorphism

  Function.Injective σ →
    (∀ (j : Fin n),
        Iff (Exists fun v => Exists fun d => S.val.graph.edge v d (Sum.inr j))
          (Set.instMembership.mem (Set.range σ) j)) →
      Exists fun T => Eq (Lax369799.Renaming.renameSystem σ T.val) S

  Lax369799.Morphisms.Isomorphic S.val T.val →
    ∀ (j : Fin n),
      Iff (Exists fun v => Exists fun d => S.val.graph.edge v d (Sum.inr j))
        (Exists fun v => Exists fun d => T.val.graph.edge v d (Sum.inr j))

profile_injective_rename : ∀ {B : Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankedSet} (E : Lax369799.SupportedAlgebras.Algebra B) {m n : Nat} (σ : Fin m → Fin n),
  Function.Injective σ →
    ∀ (S T : Lax369799.RankedSystems.System B m),
      Lax369799.SupportEvaluation.Equivalent E S T →
        Lax369799.SupportEvaluation.Equivalent E (Lax369799.Renaming.renameSystem σ S)
          (Lax369799.Renaming.renameSystem σ T)

  Function.Injective σ →
    ∀ (S T : Lax369799.RankedSystems.System A m)
      (f :
        Lax369799.Morphisms.Morphism (Lax369799.Renaming.renameSystem σ S).val
          (Lax369799.Renaming.renameSystem σ T).val),
      Exists fun g => Eq g.toFun f.toFun

concepts.title: Substitution after restricting inner output ports
concepts.description:
Renaming the outputs of each inner system and restricting the matching
outer directions produce isomorphic flattened presentations. This holds
for arbitrary port maps and retains roots and output variables. The
restricted outer presentation has a deterministic reachable restriction
when the original outer presentation is deterministic.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.FinitePresentations
import Lax369799.Renaming

/-!
---
title: Substitution after restricting inner output ports
type: theorem
---
Renaming the outputs of each inner system and restricting the matching
outer directions produce isomorphic flattened presentations. This holds
for arbitrary port maps and retains roots and output variables. The
restricted outer presentation has a deterministic reachable restriction
when the original outer presentation is deterministic.
-/

namespace Lax369799.SupportPorts
open RankedSystems

def expanded {A B : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} {V : Type}
    (G : Presentation A n V) (m : V → ℕ)
    (σ : ∀ v, Fin (m v) → Fin (G.label v).1)
    (S : ∀ v, System B (m v)) : Presentation (System B) n V where
  label := fun v => ⟨(G.label v).1, Renaming.renameSystem (σ v) (S v)⟩
  initial := G.initial
  root := G.root
  edge := G.edge
  direction_valid := G.direction_valid

def restricted {A B : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} {V : Type}
    (G : Presentation A n V) (m : V → ℕ)
    (σ : ∀ v, Fin (m v) → Fin (G.label v).1)
    (S : ∀ v, System B (m v)) : Presentation (System B) n V where
  label := fun v => ⟨m v, S v⟩
  initial := G.initial
  root := G.root
  edge := fun v d t => ∃ i : Fin (m v), d = i.val ∧ G.edge v (σ v i).val t
  direction_valid := by rintro v d t ⟨i, rfl, _⟩; exact i.isLt

def flattened {B : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} {V : Type}
    (G : Presentation (System B) n V) :
    Presentation B n ((v : V) × (G.label v).2.val.Vertex) :=
  FinitePresentations.flattenPresentation {
    G with label := fun v => ⟨(G.label v).1,
      FinitePresentations.ofSetSystem (G.label v).2.val⟩ }

axiom flatten_iso {A B : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} {V : Type}
    (G : Presentation A n V) (m : V → ℕ)
    (σ : ∀ v, Fin (m v) → Fin (G.label v).1) (S : ∀ v, System B (m v)) :
    Nonempty (FinitePresentations.PresentationIso
      (flattened (expanded G m σ S)) (flattened (restricted G m σ S)))

axiom restricted_system {A B : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} {V : Type} [Fintype V]
    (G : Presentation A n V) (m : V → ℕ)
    (σ : ∀ v, Fin (m v) → Fin (G.label v).1) (S : ∀ v, System B (m v))
    (r : V) (hi : G.initial = {r}) (hr : G.root = ∅)
    (ht : ∀ v d, d < (G.label v).1 → ∃! t, G.edge v d t) :
    ∃ T : System (System B) n, T.val = trim (restricted G m σ S)

end Lax369799.SupportPorts

  (m : V → Nat) (σ : (v : V) → Fin (m v) → Fin (G.label v).fst) (S : (v : V) → Lax369799.RankedSystems.System B (m v)),
  Nonempty
    (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.PresentationIso
      (Lax369799.SupportPorts.flattened (Lax369799.SupportPorts.expanded G m σ S))

restricted_system : ∀ {A B : Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankedSet} {n : Nat} {V : Type} [inst : Fintype V]
  (G : Lax369799.RankedSystems.Presentation A n V) (m : V → Nat) (σ : (v : V) → Fin (m v) → Fin (G.label v).fst)
  (S : (v : V) → Lax369799.RankedSystems.System B (m v)) (r : V),
  Eq G.initial (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton r) →
    Eq G.root Set.instEmptyCollection.emptyCollection →
      (∀ (v : V) (d : Nat), instLTNat.lt d (G.label v).fst → ExistsUnique fun t => G.edge v d t) →
        Exists fun T => Eq T.val (Lax369799.RankedSystems.trim (Lax369799.SupportPorts.restricted G m σ S))

concepts.title: Syntactic set-algebras and rankwise finiteness
concepts.description:
Recognition below is conditional on the original set-algebra interface.
Existence uses expanded continuity in ExpandedSyntacticAlgebra instead.
The accepting set is an upward-closed meet filter and recognises the language. Small-profile
equivalence has finite index, giving rankwise finiteness when
the language is recognised by a rankwise-finite regular-tree algebra.
These are the principal results of Sections 4.2–4.3.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.SyntacticOrder
import Lax369799.Resolutions

/-!
---
title: Syntactic set-algebras and rankwise finiteness
type: theorem
---
Recognition below is conditional on the original set-algebra interface.
Existence uses expanded continuity in ExpandedSyntacticAlgebra instead.
The accepting set is an upward-closed meet filter and recognises the language. Small-profile
equivalence has finite index, giving rankwise finiteness when
the language is recognised by a rankwise-finite regular-tree algebra.
These are the principal results of Sections 4.2–4.3.
-/

namespace Lax369799.SyntacticAlgebraTheorems
open RankedSystems Morphisms Flattening Algebras SetAlgebras SyntacticOrder Resolutions

-- The revised contextual congruence is stated and proved for all finite
-- presentations in FiniteContextualOrder.contextual_congruence.

-- Existence with expanded continuity is stated in ExpandedSyntacticAlgebra.
-- The original atomic-yield continuity is incompatible with this quotient.

axiom syntactic_recognition {A : RankedSet} (L : Language A)
    (hL : UnfoldInvariantLanguage L) (E : SyntacticAlgebra L) :
    ∃ F : Set (SyntacticCarrier L 0),
      (∀ S, syntacticMap L 0 S ∈ F ↔ Accepting L S) ∧
      (∀ T : System A 0, syntacticMap L 0 T.val ∈ F ↔ T ∈ L) ∧
      (∀ a b, a ∈ F → Below E.algebra a b → b ∈ F) ∧
      (∀ a b, a ∈ F → b ∈ F → meet E.algebra a b ∈ F)

axiom small_profile_finite {A B : RankedSet} (hB : RankwiseFinite B)
    (ρ : ∀ n, System A n → B n) (n : ℕ) :
    Finite (Quot (@SmallProfileEquivalent A B ρ n))

-- SmallProfileRefinement.refines uses the revised small-map bound and
-- the unpruned syntactic order of Definition 68.

axiom syntactic_rankwise_finite {A : RankedSet} (L : Language A)
    (hL : RegularTreeRecognizable L) : RankwiseFinite (SyntacticCarrier L)

end Lax369799.SyntacticAlgebraTheorems

  Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankwiseFinite B →
    ∀ (ρ : (n : Nat) → Lax369799.RankedSystems.System A n → B n) (n : Nat),
      Finite (Quot (Lax369799.Resolutions.SmallProfileEquivalent ρ))

syntactic_rankwise_finite : ∀ {A : Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankedSet} (L : Lax369799.Algebras.Language A),
  Lax369799.Algebras.RegularTreeRecognizable L →
    Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankwiseFinite (Lax369799.SyntacticOrder.SyntacticCarrier L)

syntactic_recognition : ∀ {A : Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankedSet} (L : Lax369799.Algebras.Language A),
  Lax369799.Algebras.UnfoldInvariantLanguage L →
    ∀ (E : Lax369799.SyntacticOrder.SyntacticAlgebra L),
      Exists fun F =>
        And
          (∀ (S : Lax369799.RankedSystems.SetSystem A 0),
            Iff (Set.instMembership.mem F (Lax369799.SyntacticOrder.syntacticMap L 0 S))
              (Lax369799.SyntacticOrder.Accepting L S))
          (And
            (∀ (T : Lax369799.RankedSystems.System A 0),
              Iff (Set.instMembership.mem F (Lax369799.SyntacticOrder.syntacticMap L 0 T.val))
                (Set.instMembership.mem L T))
            (And
              (∀ (a b : Lax369799.SyntacticOrder.SyntacticCarrier L 0),
                Set.instMembership.mem F a → Lax369799.SetAlgebras.Below E.algebra a b → Set.instMembership.mem F b)
              (∀ (a b : Lax369799.SyntacticOrder.SyntacticCarrier L 0),
                Set.instMembership.mem F a →
                  Set.instMembership.mem F b → Set.instMembership.mem F (Lax369799.SetAlgebras.meet E.algebra a b))))

concepts.title: Yield-syntactic order and quotient
concepts.description:
A closed set-system is accepting when all its initial and root yields
belong to the language or its planted copy. The yield-syntactic preorder
compares these acceptance tests in every closed context with one hole.
Mutual comparison defines the syntactic equivalence. `SyntacticAlgebra`
records a set-algebra structure on the resulting quotient whose evaluation
commutes with the quotient map. See Section 4.2.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.SetAlgebras

/-!
---
title: Yield-syntactic order and quotient
type: definition
---
A closed set-system is accepting when all its initial and root yields
belong to the language or its planted copy. The yield-syntactic preorder
compares these acceptance tests in every closed context with one hole.
Mutual comparison defines the syntactic equivalence. `SyntacticAlgebra`
records a set-algebra structure on the resulting quotient whose evaluation
commutes with the quotient map. See Section 4.2.
-/

namespace Lax369799.SyntacticOrder
open RankedSystems Morphisms Flattening Algebras SetAlgebras

def Accepting {A : RankedSet} (L : Language A) (S : SetSystem A 0) : Prop :=
  ∀ T, Yield S T → ∃ U : System A 0, U ∈ L ∧ (T = U.val ∨ T = plant U.val)

def SyntacticBelow {A : RankedSet} (L : Language A) {n : ℕ}
    (S T : SetSystem A n) : Prop :=
  ∀ C : SetContext A n 0, Accepting L (plug C S) → Accepting L (plug C T)

def SyntacticEquivalent {A : RankedSet} (L : Language A) {n : ℕ}
    (S T : SetSystem A n) : Prop := SyntacticBelow L S T ∧ SyntacticBelow L T S

abbrev SyntacticCarrier {A : RankedSet} (L : Language A) : RankedSet :=
  fun n => Quot (@SyntacticEquivalent A L n)

def syntacticMap {A : RankedSet} (L : Language A) :
    RankedMap (SetSystem A) (SyntacticCarrier L) := fun _ => Quot.mk _

structure SyntacticAlgebra {A : RankedSet} (L : Language A) where
  algebra : SetAlgebra (SyntacticCarrier L)
  evaluates : ∀ n (S : SetSystem (SetSystem A) n),
    algebra.eval n (relabel (syntacticMap L) S) = syntacticMap L n (flatten S)

end Lax369799.SyntacticOrder

concepts.title: Evaluation and variable renaming in regular-tree algebras
concepts.description:
Renaming the variables of a system depends only on its algebra value.
This follows by flattening a renamed atomic outer system and applies
also to noninjective variable maps.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.Renaming

/-!
---
title: Evaluation and variable renaming in regular-tree algebras
type: theorem
---
Renaming the variables of a system depends only on its algebra value.
This follows by flattening a renamed atomic outer system and applies
also to noninjective variable maps.
-/
namespace Lax369799.SystemEvaluation
open RankedSystems Algebras Renaming Flattening

/-- Replace the hole symbol by a letter of its rank. -/
def fillLetter {A : RankedSet} {k : ℕ} (a : A k) : RankedMap (WithHole A k) A :=
  fun _ b => match b with
    | .inl b => b
    | .inr ⟨h⟩ => h ▸ a

def substituteSystem {A : RankedSet} {k : ℕ} (S : System A k) :
    RankedMap (WithHole A k) (System A) :=
  fun _ b => match b with
    | .inl b => atomicSystem b
    | .inr ⟨h⟩ => h ▸ S

axiom context_evaluation {A : RankedSet} (E : Algebra A) {k n : ℕ}
    (C : SetContext A k n) (hC : C.system.Deterministic) (S : System A k) :
    ∃ U : System A n, U.val = plug C S.val ∧
      E.eval n U = E.eval n (relabelSystem (fillLetter (E.eval k S)) ⟨C.system, hC⟩)

axiom rename_evaluation {A : RankedSet} (E : Algebra A) (hE : UnfoldInvariant E)
    {m n : ℕ} (σ : Fin m → Fin n) (S : System A m) :
    E.eval n (renameSystem σ S) =
      E.eval n (renameSystem σ (atomicSystem (E.eval m S)))

axiom rename_congruence {A : RankedSet} (E : Algebra A) (hE : UnfoldInvariant E)
    {m n : ℕ} (σ : Fin m → Fin n) (S T : System A m) (h : E.eval m S = E.eval m T) :
    E.eval n (renameSystem σ S) = E.eval n (renameSystem σ T)

end Lax369799.SystemEvaluation

  (C : Lax369799.Flattening.SetContext A k n) (hC : C.system.Deterministic) (S : Lax369799.RankedSystems.System A k),
  Exists fun U =>
    And (Eq U.val (Lax369799.Flattening.plug C S.val))
      (Eq (E.eval n U)
        (E.eval n
          (Lax369799.RankedSystems.relabelSystem (Lax369799.SystemEvaluation.fillLetter (E.eval k S)) ⟨C.system, hC⟩)))

  Lax369799.Algebras.UnfoldInvariant E →
    ∀ {m n : Nat} (σ : Fin m → Fin n) (S T : Lax369799.RankedSystems.System A m),
      Eq (E.eval m S) (E.eval m T) →
        Eq (E.eval n (Lax369799.Renaming.renameSystem σ S)) (E.eval n (Lax369799.Renaming.renameSystem σ T))

  Lax369799.Algebras.UnfoldInvariant E →
    ∀ {m n : Nat} (σ : Fin m → Fin n) (S : Lax369799.RankedSystems.System A m),
      Eq (E.eval n (Lax369799.Renaming.renameSystem σ S))
        (E.eval n (Lax369799.Renaming.renameSystem σ (Lax369799.RankedSystems.atomicSystem (E.eval m S))))

concepts.title: Isomorphisms of deterministic substitutions
concepts.description:
Isomorphisms between deterministic presentations, their reachable
restrictions, and their flattenings. Output renaming commutes with
flattening up to presentation isomorphism.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.SupportPorts

/-!
---
title: Isomorphisms of deterministic substitutions
type: theorem
---
Isomorphisms between deterministic presentations, their reachable
restrictions, and their flattenings. Output renaming commutes with
flattening up to presentation isomorphism.
-/

namespace Lax369799.SystemIsomorphisms
open RankedSystems Morphisms Renaming FinitePresentations

axiom injective_isomorphic {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} (S T : System A n)
    (f : Morphism S.val T.val) (hf : Function.Injective f.toFun) : Isomorphic S.val T.val

axiom iso_symm {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} {S T : SetSystem A n}
    (h : Isomorphic S T) : Isomorphic T S

axiom iso_trans {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} {S T U : SetSystem A n}
    (hST : Isomorphic S T) (hTU : Isomorphic T U) : Isomorphic S U

axiom trim_isomorphic {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} {V W : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype W]
    {G : Presentation A n V} {H : Presentation A n W} (f : PresentationIso G H)
    (hG : (trim G).Deterministic) (hH : (trim H).Deterministic) :
    Isomorphic (trim G) (trim H)

axiom flatten_output_rename {A : RankedSet} {m n : ℕ} (σ : Fin m → Fin n)
    (P : System (System A) m) (U : System A m) (W : System A n)
    (hU : Flattening.SystemFlattening P U)
    (hW : Flattening.SystemFlattening (Renaming.renameSystem σ P) W) :
    Isomorphic (Renaming.renameSystem σ U).val W.val

axiom flatten_from_trim {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} {V : Type} [Fintype V]
    (G : Presentation (System A) n V) (r : V) (hi : G.initial = {r}) (hr : G.root = ∅)
    (ht : ∀ v d, d < (G.label v).1 → ∃! t, G.edge v d t)
    (P : System (System A) n) (hP : P.val = trim G)
    (U : System A n) (hU : Flattening.SystemFlattening P U) :
    Isomorphic U.val (trim (SupportPorts.flattened G))

end Lax369799.SystemIsomorphisms

concepts.title: Unit and associativity for deterministic substitution
concepts.description:
Root-free deterministic substitution obeys the two unit laws and
associativity up to presentation isomorphism. Flattening also preserves
isomorphisms of the outer system.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.PolynomialContexts

/-!
---
title: Unit and associativity for deterministic substitution
type: theorem
---
Root-free deterministic substitution obeys the two unit laws and
associativity up to presentation isomorphism. Flattening also preserves
isomorphisms of the outer system.
-/

namespace Lax369799.SystemMonad
open RankedSystems Morphisms

axiom outer_unit {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} (S : System A n) (U : System A n)
    (hU : Flattening.SystemFlattening (atomicSystem S) U) : Isomorphic U.val S.val

axiom inner_unit {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} (S : System A n) (U : System A n)
    (hU : Flattening.SystemFlattening (relabelSystem (fun _ a => atomicSystem a) S) U) :
    Isomorphic U.val S.val

axiom associative {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} (P : System (System (System A)) n)
    (Q : System (System A) n) (U : System A n)
    (t : ∀ v : P.val.Vertex, System A (P.val.graph.label v).1) (W : System A n)
    (hQ : Flattening.SystemFlattening P Q)
    (hU : Flattening.SystemFlattening Q U)
    (ht : ∀ v, Flattening.SystemFlattening (P.val.graph.label v).2 (t v))
    (hW : Flattening.SystemFlattening (PolynomialContexts.withLabels P t) W) :
    Isomorphic U.val W.val

axiom flatten_isomorphic {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ}
    (P Q : System (System A) n) (U W : System A n)
    (hP : Flattening.SystemFlattening P U) (hQ : Flattening.SystemFlattening Q W)
    (h : Isomorphic P.val Q.val) : Isomorphic U.val W.val

end Lax369799.SystemMonad

  (Q : Lax369799.RankedSystems.System (Lax369799.RankedSystems.System A) n) (U : Lax369799.RankedSystems.System A n)

      (∀ (v : Fin P.val.size), Lax369799.Flattening.SystemFlattening (P.val.graph.label v).snd (t v)) →
        Lax369799.Flattening.SystemFlattening (Lax369799.PolynomialContexts.withLabels P t) W →
          Lax369799.Morphisms.Isomorphic U.val W.val

  (U W : Lax369799.RankedSystems.System A n),

    Lax369799.Flattening.SystemFlattening Q W →
      Lax369799.Morphisms.Isomorphic P.val Q.val → Lax369799.Morphisms.Isomorphic U.val W.val

  Lax369799.Flattening.SystemFlattening
      (Lax369799.RankedSystems.relabelSystem (fun x a => Lax369799.RankedSystems.atomicSystem a) S) U →

    Lax369799.Morphisms.Isomorphic U.val S.val

concepts.title: Unfolding congruence for deterministic substitution
concepts.description:
Substituting pointwise unfold-equivalent inner systems preserves unfolding.
A morphism between deterministic outer systems also induces an unfolding
relation between their flattenings. Inner roots are absent, so outer
unreachable vertices cannot introduce additional root observations.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.PolynomialContexts

/-!
---
title: Unfolding congruence for deterministic substitution
type: theorem
---
Substituting pointwise unfold-equivalent inner systems preserves unfolding.
A morphism between deterministic outer systems also induces an unfolding
relation between their flattenings. Inner roots are absent, so outer
unreachable vertices cannot introduce additional root observations.
-/
namespace Lax369799.SystemSubstitution
open RankedSystems Morphisms Flattening PolynomialContexts

axiom pointwise_unfold {A C : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} (P : System C n)
    (q r : ∀ v, System A (P.val.graph.label v).1)
    (h : ∀ v, UnfoldEquivalent (q v).val (r v).val)
    (U V : System A n) (hU : SystemFlattening (withLabels P q) U)
    (hV : SystemFlattening (withLabels P r) V) : UnfoldEquivalent U.val V.val

axiom outer_morphism {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} (S T : System (System A) n)
    (f : Morphism S.val T.val) (U V : System A n)
    (hU : SystemFlattening S U) (hV : SystemFlattening T V) : UnfoldsTo V.val U.val

axiom evaluation {A B C : RankedSet} (E : Algebras.Algebra B) (η : RankedMap A B)
    (f : RankedMap C (System A)) {n : ℕ} (S : System C n) (U : System A n)
    (hU : SystemFlattening (relabelSystem f S) U) :
    E.eval n (relabelSystem η U) = E.eval n
      (relabelSystem (fun k a => E.eval k (relabelSystem η (f k a))) S)

end Lax369799.SystemSubstitution

  (η : Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankedMap A B)
  (f : Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankedMap C (Lax369799.RankedSystems.System A)) {n : Nat}
  (S : Lax369799.RankedSystems.System C n) (U : Lax369799.RankedSystems.System A n),
  Lax369799.Flattening.SystemFlattening (Lax369799.RankedSystems.relabelSystem f S) U →
    Eq (E.eval n (Lax369799.RankedSystems.relabelSystem η U))
      (E.eval n
        (Lax369799.RankedSystems.relabelSystem (fun k a => E.eval k (Lax369799.RankedSystems.relabelSystem η (f k a)))
          S))

outer_morphism : ∀ {A : Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankedSet} {n : Nat}
  (S T : Lax369799.RankedSystems.System (Lax369799.RankedSystems.System A) n)
  (f : Lax369799.Morphisms.Morphism S.val T.val) (U V : Lax369799.RankedSystems.System A n),
  Lax369799.Flattening.SystemFlattening S U →
    Lax369799.Flattening.SystemFlattening T V → Lax369799.Morphisms.UnfoldsTo V.val U.val

  (q r : (v : Fin P.val.size) → Lax369799.RankedSystems.System A (P.val.graph.label v).fst),
  (∀ (v : Fin P.val.size), Lax369799.Morphisms.UnfoldEquivalent (q v).val (r v).val) →
    ∀ (U V : Lax369799.RankedSystems.System A n),
      Lax369799.Flattening.SystemFlattening (Lax369799.PolynomialContexts.withLabels P q) U →
        Lax369799.Flattening.SystemFlattening (Lax369799.PolynomialContexts.withLabels P r) V →
          Lax369799.Morphisms.UnfoldEquivalent U.val V.val

concepts.title: Ranked encodings of transition systems
concepts.description:
The transition alphabet has a copy of every proposition valuation in every
rank. Decoding a closed system forgets the order and multiplicity of its
outgoing edges. Ranked bisimilarity is generated by unfold-equivalence and
having isomorphic decodings. Section 6.1 proves that this is exactly usual
bisimilarity of the decoded transition systems.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.TransitionSystems
import Lax369799.Morphisms

/-!
---
title: Ranked encodings of transition systems
type: definition
---
The transition alphabet has a copy of every proposition valuation in every
rank. Decoding a closed system forgets the order and multiplicity of its
outgoing edges. Ranked bisimilarity is generated by unfold-equivalence and
having isomorphic decodings. Section 6.1 proves that this is exactly usual
bisimilarity of the decoded transition systems.
-/

namespace Lax369799.TransitionEncoding
open RankedSystems Morphisms TransitionSystems

abbrev TransitionAlphabet (P : Type) : RankedSet := fun _ => Set P

noncomputable def decode {P : Type} (S : System (TransitionAlphabet P) 0) :
    TransitionSystem P where
  size := S.val.size
  initial := Classical.choose S.property.1
  edge := fun v w => ∃ d, S.val.graph.edge v d (.inl w)
  valuation := fun v => (S.val.graph.label v).2
  reachable := by
    intro v
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hp⟩ := S.val.reachable v
    have hi := Classical.choose_spec S.property.1
    rcases hr with hr | hr
    · rw [hi] at hr
      have he : r = Classical.choose S.property.1 := hr
      subst r
      exact hp
    · rw [S.property.2.1] at hr
      exact False.elim hr

def Isomorphic {P : Type} (S T : TransitionSystem P) : Prop :=
  ∃ e : S.Vertex ≃ T.Vertex, e S.initial = T.initial ∧
    (∀ v, S.valuation v = T.valuation (e v)) ∧
    ∀ v w, S.edge v w ↔ T.edge (e v) (e w)

def RankedBisimilar {P : Type} (S T : System (TransitionAlphabet P) 0) : Prop :=
  Relation.EqvGen (fun U V => UnfoldEquivalent U.val V.val ∨
    Isomorphic (decode U) (decode V)) S T

end Lax369799.TransitionEncoding

concepts.title: Finite transition systems and bisimulation
concepts.description:
A finite transition system is a finite directed graph with an initial vertex
and a valuation of proposition letters at each vertex. All vertices are
reachable from the initial vertex. A bisimulation relates the initial
vertices, preserves valuations, and matches successors in both directions.
This is the usual bisimulation of Section 6.1, without an ordering or
multiplicity on the successors.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.RankedSystems

/-!
---
title: Finite transition systems and bisimulation
type: definition
---
A finite transition system is a finite directed graph with an initial vertex
and a valuation of proposition letters at each vertex. All vertices are
reachable from the initial vertex. A bisimulation relates the initial
vertices, preserves valuations, and matches successors in both directions.
This is the usual bisimulation of Section 6.1, without an ordering or
multiplicity on the successors.
-/

namespace Lax369799.TransitionSystems

structure TransitionSystem (P : Type) where
  size : ℕ
  initial : Fin size
  edge : Fin size → Fin size → Prop
  valuation : Fin size → Set P
  reachable : ∀ v, Relation.ReflTransGen edge initial v

abbrev TransitionSystem.Vertex {P : Type} (S : TransitionSystem P) := Fin S.size

def Bisimulation {P : Type} (S T : TransitionSystem P)
    (R : S.Vertex → T.Vertex → Prop) : Prop :=
  R S.initial T.initial ∧ ∀ v w, R v w →
    S.valuation v = T.valuation w ∧
    (∀ v', S.edge v v' → ∃ w', T.edge w w' ∧ R v' w') ∧
    (∀ w', T.edge w w' → ∃ v', S.edge v v' ∧ R v' w')

def Bisimilar {P : Type} (S T : TransitionSystem P) : Prop :=
  ∃ R, Bisimulation S T R

def BisimulationInvariant {P : Type} (L : Set (TransitionSystem P)) : Prop :=
  ∀ S T, Bisimilar S T → (S ∈ L ↔ T ∈ L)

end Lax369799.TransitionSystems

concepts.title: Evaluation of unary chains in every sort
concepts.description:
A finite chain of unary letters followed by a value of any rank is
evaluated by successive unary application. For a unary final letter this
computes the semigroup value of a nonempty word.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.UnaryComposition
import Lax369799.UnaryFactorization

/-!
---
title: Evaluation of unary chains in every sort
type: theorem
---
A finite chain of unary letters followed by a value of any rank is
evaluated by successive unary application. For a unary final letter this
computes the semigroup value of a nonempty word.
-/

namespace Lax369799.UnaryChains
open RankedSystems (RankedSet)
open FinitePresentations FiniteSyntacticAlgebra

def path {A : RankedSet} {k n : ℕ} (w : Fin k → A 1) (a : A n) : FiniteSystem A n where
  size := k + 1
  graph := {
    label := Fin.lastCases ⟨n, a⟩ (fun i => ⟨1, w i⟩)
    initial := {0}
    root := ∅
    edge := fun v d t =>
      (∃ i : Fin k, v = i.castSucc ∧ d = 0 ∧ t = .inl i.succ) ∨
      (v = Fin.last k ∧ ∃ j : Fin n, d = j.val ∧ t = .inr j)
    direction_valid := by
      rintro v d t (⟨i, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, j, rfl, _⟩) <;> simp }

axiom evaluation {A : RankedSet} (E : Algebra A) {k n : ℕ}
    (w : Fin k → A 1) (a : A n) :
    E.eval n (path w a) = (List.ofFn w).foldr (UnaryComposition.act E) a

def word {A : RankedSet} (w : ℕ → A 1) (i k : ℕ) : FiniteSystem A 1 :=
  path (fun t : Fin k => w (i + t.val)) (w (i + k))

axiom word_evaluation {A : RankedSet} (E : Algebra A) (w : ℕ → A 1) (i k : ℕ) :
    E.eval 1 (word w i k) = UnaryFactorization.block E w i (i + k + 1)

end Lax369799.UnaryChains

statements.signature:
evaluation : ∀ {A : Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankedSet} (E : Lax369799.FiniteSyntacticAlgebra.Algebra A) {k n : Nat} (w : Fin k → A 1)
  (a : A n),
  Eq (E.eval n (Lax369799.UnaryChains.path w a)) (List.foldr (Lax369799.UnaryComposition.act E) a (List.ofFn w))

word_evaluation : ∀ {A : Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankedSet} (E : Lax369799.FiniteSyntacticAlgebra.Algebra A) (w : Nat → A 1) (i k : Nat),
  Eq (E.eval 1 (Lax369799.UnaryChains.word w i k))
    (Lax369799.UnaryFactorization.block E w i (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd i k) 1))

concepts.title: The unary semigroup and its action
concepts.description:
Unary values compose by evaluating a two-vertex chain. Associativity of
the algebra makes this composition associative, and the same operation
acts on every sort. This supplies the finite semigroup used to factor
infinite unary branch words in Section 6.3.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.FiniteBranchWords

/-!
---
title: The unary semigroup and its action
type: theorem
---
Unary values compose by evaluating a two-vertex chain. Associativity of
the algebra makes this composition associative, and the same operation
acts on every sort. This supplies the finite semigroup used to factor
infinite unary branch words in Section 6.3.
-/

namespace Lax369799.UnaryComposition
open RankedSystems (RankedSet)
open FinitePresentations FiniteSyntacticAlgebra

def application {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} (b : A 1) (a : A n) : FiniteSystem A n where
  size := 2
  graph := {
    label := Fin.cases ⟨1, b⟩ (fun _ => ⟨n, a⟩)
    initial := {0}
    root := ∅
    edge := fun v d t =>
      (v = 0 ∧ d = 0 ∧ t = .inl 1) ∨
      (v = 1 ∧ ∃ j : Fin n, d = j.val ∧ t = .inr j)
    direction_valid := by
      rintro v d t (⟨rfl, rfl, _⟩ | ⟨rfl, j, rfl, _⟩)
      · exact Nat.zero_lt_one
      · exact j.isLt }

def act {A : RankedSet} (E : Algebra A) {n : ℕ} (b : A 1) (a : A n) : A n :=
  E.eval n (application b a)

def product {A : RankedSet} (E : Algebra A) (a b : A 1) : A 1 := act E a b

axiom action_law {A : RankedSet} (E : Algebra A) {n : ℕ}
    (a b : A 1) (c : A n) : act E (product E a b) c = act E a (act E b c)

axiom associative {A : RankedSet} (E : Algebra A) (a b c : A 1) :
    product E (product E a b) c = product E a (product E b c)

axiom nullary_action {A : RankedSet} (E : Algebra A) (b : A 1) (a : A 0) :
    act E b a = FiniteBranchWords.act E b a

end Lax369799.UnaryComposition

  (c : A n),
  Eq (Lax369799.UnaryComposition.act E (Lax369799.UnaryComposition.product E a b) c)
    (Lax369799.UnaryComposition.act E a (Lax369799.UnaryComposition.act E b c))

associative : ∀ {A : Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankedSet} (E : Lax369799.FiniteSyntacticAlgebra.Algebra A) (a b c : A 1),
  Eq (Lax369799.UnaryComposition.product E (Lax369799.UnaryComposition.product E a b) c)
    (Lax369799.UnaryComposition.product E a (Lax369799.UnaryComposition.product E b c))

nullary_action : ∀ {A : Lax369799.RankedSystems.RankedSet} (E : Lax369799.FiniteSyntacticAlgebra.Algebra A) (b : A 1) (a : A 0),
  Eq (Lax369799.UnaryComposition.act E b a) (Lax369799.FiniteBranchWords.act E b a)

concepts.title: Stable factorization of algebraic branch words
concepts.description:
An infinite word of unary values of a finite algebra has a stable
factorization. The prefix value absorbs an idempotent block value, and
the cuts may simultaneously visit one fixed vertex of any finite graph
through which the word runs. The associated two-vertex lasso evaluates
the regular word formed from these two values.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.UnaryComposition
import Lax369799.SemigroupFactorization

/-!
---
title: Stable factorization of algebraic branch words
type: theorem
---
An infinite word of unary values of a finite algebra has a stable
factorization. The prefix value absorbs an idempotent block value, and
the cuts may simultaneously visit one fixed vertex of any finite graph
through which the word runs. The associated two-vertex lasso evaluates
the regular word formed from these two values.
-/

namespace Lax369799.UnaryFactorization
open RankedSystems (RankedSet)
open FinitePresentations FiniteSyntacticAlgebra UnaryComposition

def block {A : RankedSet} (E : Algebra A) (w : ℕ → A 1) (i j : ℕ) : A 1 :=
  ((List.range' (i + 1) (j - i - 1)).map w).foldl (product E) (w i)

def lasso {A : RankedSet} (a e : A 1) : FiniteSystem A 0 where
  size := 2
  graph := {
    label := Fin.cases ⟨1, a⟩ (fun _ => ⟨1, e⟩)
    initial := {0}
    root := ∅
    edge := fun _ d t => d = 0 ∧ t = .inl 1
    direction_valid := by
      rintro v d t ⟨rfl, _⟩
      exact Fin.cases Nat.zero_lt_one (fun _ => Nat.zero_lt_one) v }

axiom stable_factorization {A : RankedSet} (E : Algebra A) [Finite (A 1)]
    {V : Type} [Finite V] (w : ℕ → A 1) (v : ℕ → V) :
    ∃ (cut : ℕ → ℕ) (a e : A 1) (r : V), StrictMono cut ∧ 0 < cut 0 ∧
      product E e e = e ∧ product E a e = a ∧ (∀ i, v (cut i) = r) ∧
      (∀ i, block E w 0 (cut i) = a) ∧
      (∀ i j, i < j → block E w (cut i) (cut j) = e)

end Lax369799.UnaryFactorization

concepts.title: Evaluation of finite unary branch graphs
concepts.description:
A finite unary graph generated by its initial vertex evaluates like any
lasso obtained by cutting its path at a repeated vertex and composing the
two nonempty words. Stable factorization proves that its value is accepted
exactly when its unfolded word satisfies the algebraic omega condition.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.SetSystemAlgebras
import Lax369799.AlgebraicOmegaWords
import Lax369799.UnaryChains

/-!
---
title: Evaluation of finite unary branch graphs
type: theorem
---
A finite unary graph generated by its initial vertex evaluates like any
lasso obtained by cutting its path at a repeated vertex and composing the
two nonempty words. Stable factorization proves that its value is accepted
exactly when its unfolded word satisfies the algebraic omega condition.
-/

namespace Lax369799.UnaryGraphEvaluation
open RankedSystems (RankedSet Presentation)
open FinitePresentations FiniteSyntacticAlgebra UnaryFactorization SetSystemAlgebras

def trace {V : Type} (next : V → V) (start : V) : ℕ → V
  | 0 => start
  | n + 1 => next (trace next start n)

def graph {A : RankedSet} {V : Type} (next : V → V) (start : V) (b : V → A 1) :
    Presentation A 0 V where
  label := fun v => ⟨1, b v⟩
  initial := {start}
  root := ∅
  edge := fun v d t => d = 0 ∧ t = .inl (next v)
  direction_valid := by rintro v d t ⟨rfl, _⟩; exact Nat.zero_lt_one

axiom cycle_folding {A : RankedSet} (E : SetAlgebra A)
    {V : Type} [Fintype V] (next : V → V) (start : V) (b : V → A 1)
    (hreach : ∀ v, ∃ n, trace next start n = v) (m k : ℕ)
    (hclose : trace next start (m + k + 2) = trace next start (m + 1)) :
    E.eval 0 (enumerate (graph next start b)) = E.eval 0 (lasso
      (block E.toAlgebra (b ∘ trace next start) 0 (m + 1))
      (block E.toAlgebra (b ∘ trace next start) (m + 1) (m + k + 2)))

axiom agreement {A : RankedSet} (E : SetAlgebra A)
    (F : Set (A 0)) [Finite (A 1)] {V : Type} [Fintype V]
    (next : V → V) (start : V) (b : V → A 1) (hreach : ∀ v, ∃ n, trace next start n = v) :
    E.eval 0 (enumerate (graph next start b)) ∈ F ↔
      AlgebraicOmegaWords.Accepts E.toAlgebra F (b ∘ trace next start)

end Lax369799.UnaryGraphEvaluation

  {V : Type} [inst : Fintype V] (next : V → V) (start : V) (b : V → A 1),
  (∀ (v : V), Exists fun n => Eq (Lax369799.UnaryGraphEvaluation.trace next start n) v) →
    Iff
      (Set.instMembership.mem F
        (E.eval 0 (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.enumerate (Lax369799.UnaryGraphEvaluation.graph next start b))))
      (Lax369799.AlgebraicOmegaWords.Accepts E.toAlgebra F
        (Function.comp b (Lax369799.UnaryGraphEvaluation.trace next start)))

  (next : V → V) (start : V) (b : V → A 1),
  (∀ (v : V), Exists fun n => Eq (Lax369799.UnaryGraphEvaluation.trace next start n) v) →
    ∀ (m k : Nat),
      Eq (Lax369799.UnaryGraphEvaluation.trace next start (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd m k) 2))
          (Lax369799.UnaryGraphEvaluation.trace next start (instHAdd.hAdd m 1)) →
        Eq (E.eval 0 (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.enumerate (Lax369799.UnaryGraphEvaluation.graph next start b)))
          (E.eval 0
            (Lax369799.UnaryFactorization.lasso
              (Lax369799.UnaryFactorization.block E.toAlgebra
                (Function.comp b (Lax369799.UnaryGraphEvaluation.trace next start)) 0 (instHAdd.hAdd m 1))
              (Lax369799.UnaryFactorization.block E.toAlgebra
                (Function.comp b (Lax369799.UnaryGraphEvaluation.trace next start)) (instHAdd.hAdd m 1)
                (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd m k) 2))))

concepts.title: Algebraic evaluation and the words of a regular branch
concepts.description:
A closed deterministic system with only unary and nullary labels follows
one branch. Its value is accepted exactly when its terminating branch
word, or its infinite branch word, satisfies the corresponding algebraic
word condition. This includes both chains ending at a nullary vertex and
infinite branches represented by finite graphs.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.UnaryGraphEvaluation
import Lax369799.UnfoldAutomata
import Lax369799.FinitePathEvaluation

/-!
---
title: Algebraic evaluation and the words of a regular branch
type: theorem
---
A closed deterministic system with only unary and nullary labels follows
one branch. Its value is accepted exactly when its terminating branch
word, or its infinite branch word, satisfies the corresponding algebraic
word condition. This includes both chains ending at a nullary vertex and
infinite branches represented by finite graphs.
-/

namespace Lax369799.UnarySystemEvaluation
open RankedSystems (RankedSet System)
open FinitePresentations FiniteSyntacticAlgebra UnfoldAutomata SetSystemAlgebras

def Unary {A : RankedSet} (S : System A 0) : Prop := ∀ v, Rank S v ≤ 1

def unaryLabel {A : RankedSet} {S : System A 0} (hu : Unary S)
    (v : S.val.Vertex) (d : Fin (Rank S v)) : A 1 := by
  have h : Rank S v = 1 := by have := hu v; have := d.isLt; omega
  exact h ▸ (S.val.graph.label v).2

def finiteWord {A : RankedSet} {S : System A 0} (hu : Unary S)
    {k : ℕ} (b : FiniteBranch S k) : List (A 1) :=
  List.ofFn (fun i => unaryLabel hu (b.vertex i.castSucc) (b.direction i))

def leafValue {A : RankedSet} {S : System A 0} {k : ℕ} (b : FiniteBranch S k) : A 0 :=
  b.ends ▸ (S.val.graph.label (b.vertex (Fin.last k))).2

def infiniteWord {A : RankedSet} {S : System A 0} (hu : Unary S)
    (b : InfiniteBranch S) : ℕ → A 1 := fun n => unaryLabel hu (b.vertex n) (b.direction n)

axiom agreement {A : RankedSet} (E : SetAlgebra A)
    (F : Set (A 0)) [Finite (A 1)] (S : System A 0) (hu : Unary S) :
    E.eval 0 (ofSetSystem S.val) ∈ F ↔
      (∀ k (b : FiniteBranch S k), FiniteBranchWords.value E.toAlgebra (finiteWord hu b) (leafValue b) ∈ F) ∧
      (∀ b : InfiniteBranch S, AlgebraicOmegaWords.Accepts E.toAlgebra F (infiniteWord hu b))

end Lax369799.UnarySystemEvaluation

  (S : Lax369799.RankedSystems.System A 0) (hu : Lax369799.UnarySystemEvaluation.Unary S),
  Iff (Set.instMembership.mem F (E.eval 0 (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.ofSetSystem S.val)))
    (And
      (∀ (k : Nat) (b : Lax369799.UnfoldAutomata.FiniteBranch S k),
        Set.instMembership.mem F
          (Lax369799.FiniteBranchWords.value E.toAlgebra (Lax369799.UnarySystemEvaluation.finiteWord hu b)
            (Lax369799.UnarySystemEvaluation.leafValue b)))
      (∀ (b : Lax369799.UnfoldAutomata.InfiniteBranch S),
        Lax369799.AlgebraicOmegaWords.Accepts E.toAlgebra F (Lax369799.UnarySystemEvaluation.infiniteWord hu b)))

concepts.title: Variable exits of unary systems
concepts.description:
A deterministic system whose labels have rank at most one follows a single
path from its initial vertex. Consequently all its variable exits use the
same variable. This is the path property used in the characterization of
deterministic algebra elements in Section 5.1.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.Morphisms
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Prod

/-!
---
title: Variable exits of unary systems
type: theorem
---
A deterministic system whose labels have rank at most one follows a single
path from its initial vertex. Consequently all its variable exits use the
same variable. This is the path property used in the characterization of
deterministic algebra elements in Section 5.1.
-/
namespace Lax369799.UnarySystems
open RankedSystems Morphisms

axiom unique_exit {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} (S : System A n)
    (hS : ∀ v, (S.val.graph.label v).1 ≤ 1)
    {v w : S.val.Vertex} {d e : ℕ} {i j : Fin n}
    (hi : S.val.graph.edge v d (.inr i)) (hj : S.val.graph.edge w e (.inr j)) : i = j

/-- One copy for each variable, retaining only exits to that variable. -/
def variablePieces {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} {V : Type} (G : Presentation A n V) :
    Presentation A n (Fin n × V) where
  label := fun v => G.label v.2
  initial := fun v => G.initial v.2
  root := fun v => G.root v.2
  edge := fun v d t => ∃ s, G.edge v.2 d s ∧
    (∀ i, s = .inr i → i = v.1) ∧ t = Sum.map (fun w => (v.1, w)) id s
  direction_valid := by rintro v d t ⟨s, hs, _, _⟩; exact G.direction_valid _ _ _ hs

axiom variable_decomposition {A : RankedSet} {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    {V : Type} [Fintype V] (G : Presentation A n V)
    (hG : ∀ v, (G.label v).1 ≤ 1) :
    YieldEquivalent (trim G) (trim (variablePieces G))

end Lax369799.UnarySystems

  (∀ (v : Fin S.val.size), instLENat.le (S.val.graph.label v).fst 1) →
    ∀ {v w : S.val.Vertex} {d e : Nat} {i j : Fin n},
      S.val.graph.edge v d (Sum.inr i) → S.val.graph.edge w e (Sum.inr j) → Eq i j

  instLTNat.lt 0 n →
    ∀ {V : Type} [inst : Fintype V] (G : Lax369799.RankedSystems.Presentation A n V),
      (∀ (v : V), instLENat.le (G.label v).fst 1) →
        Lax369799.Morphisms.YieldEquivalent (Lax369799.RankedSystems.trim G)
          (Lax369799.RankedSystems.trim (Lax369799.UnarySystems.variablePieces G))

concepts.title: Normal data for a unary type with a closed continuation
concepts.description:
After removing a unary hole, a closed continuation is an isolated nullary
component of each unary piece. It is initial only in the outgoing piece.
The incoming testing prefix is planted in both pieces. These data turn a
binary sum of continuations into the meet of the two normal data.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.ClosedUnaryLift
import Lax369799.SplitExtremal

/-!
---
title: Normal data for a unary type with a closed continuation
type: theorem
---
After removing a unary hole, a closed continuation is an isolated nullary
component of each unary piece. It is initial only in the outgoing piece.
The incoming testing prefix is planted in both pieces. These data turn a
binary sum of continuations into the meet of the two normal data.
-/
namespace Lax369799.UnaryTestContexts
open RankedSystems (RankedSet)
open FinitePresentations FiniteSyntacticAlgebra FiniteContextualOrder FiniteAcceptance
open ExtremalContexts (Data)

noncomputable def data {A : RankedSet} (E : Algebra A) (root : Prop) (t : A 1) (c : A 0) : Data A 1 :=
  (⟨root, ∅⟩, fun i => sumValue E (E.eval 1 (plant (atomic t)))
    (ClosedUnaryLift.value E (i == 1) c))

axiom data_sum {A : RankedSet} (L : Algebras.Language A)
    (E : Algebra (Carrier (Accepting L)))
    (hE : ∀ n (S : FiniteSystem (FiniteSystem A) n),
      E.eval n (relabel (quotientMap (Accepting L)) S) = quotientMap (Accepting L) n (flatten S))
    (root : Prop) (t : Carrier (Accepting L) 1) (c d : Carrier (Accepting L) 0) :
    data E root t (sumValue E c d) = SplitExtremal.meetData E (data E root t c) (data E root t d)

end Lax369799.UnaryTestContexts

  (E :
    Lax369799.FiniteSyntacticAlgebra.Algebra
      (Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.Carrier (Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L))),
  (∀ (n : Nat) (S : Lax369799.FinitePresentations.FiniteSystem (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.FiniteSystem A) n),
      Eq
        (E.eval n
          (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.relabel
            (Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.quotientMap (Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L)) S))
        (Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.quotientMap (Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) n
          (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.flatten S))) →
    ∀ (root : Prop) (t : Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.Carrier (Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) 1)
      (c d : Lax369799.FiniteContextualOrder.Carrier (Lax369799.FiniteAcceptance.Accepting L) 0),
      Eq (Lax369799.UnaryTestContexts.data E root t (Lax369799.FiniteSyntacticAlgebra.sumValue E c d))
        (Lax369799.SplitExtremal.meetData E (Lax369799.UnaryTestContexts.data E root t c)
          (Lax369799.UnaryTestContexts.data E root t d))

concepts.title: Full-profile transfer in every output rank
concepts.description:
Full local profiles preserve the values of resolutions under substitution.
The proof requires no finite bound on local variable maps. Both initial
and root observations are covered for arbitrary finite presentations,
including unreachable vertices, in every output rank.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax369799.RootProfileSubstitution

/-!
---
title: Full-profile transfer in every output rank
type: theorem
---
Full local profiles preserve the values of resolutions under substitution.
The proof requires no finite bound on local variable maps. Both initial
and root observations are covered for arbitrary finite presentations,
including unreachable vertices, in every output rank.
-/

namespace Lax369799.UnboundedSubstitution
open RankedSystems Morphisms Algebras Flattening Resolutions ProfileSubstitution
open ObservedSubstitution PresentationObservations RootExpansion

axiom transfer_resolution {A B : RankedSet} (E : Algebra B) (hE : UnfoldInvariant E)
    (η : RankedMap A B) {n : ℕ} (P : SetSystem (SetSystem A) n)
    (Q : ∀ v, SetSystem A (P.graph.label v).1)
    (hQ : ∀ v, Profile
        (fun k R => E.eval k (relabelSystem η R)) (Inner P v) =
      Profile
        (fun k R => E.eval k (relabelSystem η R)) (Q v))
    (R : System A n) (hR : DirectResolution (flatten P) R) :
    ∃ U : System A n, DirectResolution (flatten (withLabels P Q)) U ∧
      E.eval n (relabelSystem η R) = E.eval n (relabelSystem η U)

axiom transfer_value {A B : RankedSet} (E : Algebra B) (hE : UnfoldInvariant E)
    (η : RankedMap A B) {n : ℕ} {V : Type} [Fintype V]
    (P : Presentation (SetSystem A) n V) (Q : ∀ v, SetSystem A (P.label v).1)
    (hP : ∀ v, (P.label v).2.graph.root = ∅) (hQ : ∀ v, (Q v).graph.root = ∅)
    (h : ∀ v, Profile
        (fun k R => E.eval k (relabelSystem η R)) (P.label v).2 =
      Profile
        (fun k R => E.eval k (relabelSystem η R)) (Q v)) :
    values E η (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.flattenPresentation (finiteLabels P)) ⊆
      values E η (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.flattenPresentation (finiteLabels (replaceLabels P Q)))

axiom transfer_initial_value {A B : RankedSet} (E : Algebra B) (hE : UnfoldInvariant E)
    (η : RankedMap A B) {n : ℕ} {V : Type} [Fintype V]
    (P : Presentation (SetSystem A) n V) (Q : ∀ v, SetSystem A (P.label v).1)
    (hi : ∀ v, Profile
        (fun k R => E.eval k (relabelSystem η R)) (P.label v).2 =
      Profile
        (fun k R => E.eval k (relabelSystem η R)) (Q v)) :
    values E η (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.flattenPresentation (finiteLabels P)) ⊆
      values E η (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.flattenPresentation (finiteLabels (replaceLabels P Q)))

axiom transfer_root_value {A B : RankedSet} (E : Algebra B) (hE : UnfoldInvariant E)
    (η : RankedMap A B) {n : ℕ} {V : Type} [Fintype V]
    (P : Presentation (SetSystem A) n V) (Q : ∀ v, SetSystem A (P.label v).1)
    (hi : ∀ v, Profile
        (fun k R => E.eval k (relabelSystem η R)) (P.label v).2 =
      Profile
        (fun k R => E.eval k (relabelSystem η R)) (Q v))
    (hr : ∀ v, Profile
        (fun k R => E.eval k (relabelSystem η R)) (uproot (P.label v).2) =
      Profile
        (fun k R => E.eval k (relabelSystem η R)) (uproot (Q v))) :
    values E η (startAtRoots (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.flattenPresentation (finiteLabels P))) ⊆
      values E η (startAtRoots (Lax369799.FinitePresentations.flattenPresentation
        (finiteLabels (replaceLabels P Q))))

end Lax369799.UnboundedSubstitution
